10.1002/hec.4879.abstractZh: 当一项著名的医学研究的结论被推翻时，会发生什么？我们通过一项关于臀位分娩的医学试验，估计了此类研究结论的逆转对医生选择及婴儿健康结果的影响。利用1995至2010年的美国出生证明记录，我们采用了差异估计方法来计算剖宫产、低Apgar评分和低出生体重等指标的影响。研究发现，一项关于适时处理臀位分娩的高知名度随机对照试验的结论被推翻后，剖宫产率在这类分娩中的下降幅度为15%至23%，而此时整体剖宫产率呈上升趋势。我们发现，传统上处于不利地位的人群（即非白人、受教育程度较低的人群）受到的影响最大。然而，我们并未发现这种实践方式的改变对婴儿健康有显著影响。与先前的研究不同，我们发现医生迅速更新了他们的信念，并且确实会根据新的医学研究进行调整，尤其是年轻医生，在强制性的政策或专业指南出台之前。

abstract.text: In this paper we provide an adaptation of the Foster-Greer-Thorbecke (FGT) family of poverty measures for the measurement and analysis of catastrophic health expenditure (CHE). The adaptation entails introducing the FGT-type family of CHE measures with a single CHE aversion parameter whose value can be increased to put greater emphasis on the health expenditure proportions that overshoot the prescribed threshold proportions for CHE characterization by the greatest margins. The subgroup decomposition property of the FGT-type family of CHE measures (i.e., the ability to isolate the contributions of the various mutually exclusive population subgroups to the overall FGT-type CHE measure) is discussed along with other normative properties. We also show how the estimation and subgroup decomposition of the FGT-type family of CHE measures can be conveniently accomplished using ordinary least squares regression. An illustrative example is also provided to show how the FGT approach can provide valuable insights into the distribution of CHE among the healthcare spending units that incur CHE.

10.1002/hec.4880.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们为灾难性健康支出（CHE）的测量和分析提供了一种对Foster-Greer-Thorbecke（FGT）贫困度量系列的适应性改进。这种改进包括引入一种FGT类型的CHE度量系列，该系列包含一个单一的CHE厌恶参数，其值可以增大，以更强调那些超过规定的CHE阈值比例的医疗支出部分。我们还讨论了FGT类型CHE度量系列的子群分解特性（即，能够分离出各个互斥的人口子群对整体FGT类型CHE度量的贡献），以及其他规范特性。此外，我们展示了如何使用普通最小二乘回归方法方便地估计和分解FGT类型CHE度量系列。文中还提供了一个示例，说明FGT方法如何为分析产生CHE的医疗保健支出单位之间的CHE分布提供有价值的见解。

abstract.text: We study the impact of vertical identification card laws, which changed the orientation of driver's licenses and state identification cards from horizontal to vertical for those under 21 years, on teenage tobacco and alcohol use. We study this question using four national datasets (pooled national and state Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System, National Youth Tobacco Survey, Current Population Survey to Tobacco Use Supplements, and Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System). We improve previous databases of vertical ID law implementation by using original archival research to identify the exact date of the law change. We estimate models using standard two-way fixed effects and stacked difference-in-differences that avoid bias from dynamic and heterogeneous treatment effects. Using data through 2021, we do not find evidence of reductions in teenage tobacco and alcohol use. While these laws reduce retail-based purchasing, they also increase social sourcing, thus leading to no net impact on use.

10.1002/hec.4881.abstractZh: 我们研究了垂直身份识别卡法律对青少年烟草和酒精使用的影响。这些法律改变了21岁以下人群的身份证和驾驶证的用途，使其从横向变为垂直。我们利用四个国家级数据集（包括全国和州级青少年风险行为监测系统、全国青少年烟草调查、当前人口调查及烟草使用补充数据，以及行为风险因素监测系统）来研究这一问题。我们通过原始档案研究确定了法律变更的确切日期，从而改进了之前关于垂直身份识别卡法律实施的数据库。我们使用标准双向固定效应模型和堆叠差异-差异模型进行模型估计，以避免动态和异质处理效应带来的偏差。根据截至2021年的数据，我们没有发现青少年烟草和酒精使用减少的证据。虽然这些法律减少了零售购买，但它们也增加了社交采购，因此对使用行为没有净影响。

abstract.text: Estimates of the impact of body mass index and obesity on health and labor market outcomes often use instrumental variables estimation (IV) to mitigate bias due to endogeneity. When these studies rely on survey data that include self- or proxy-reported height and weight, there is non-classical measurement error due to the tendency of individuals to under-report their own weight. Mean reverting errors in weight do not cause IV to be asymptotically biased per se, but may result in bias if instruments are correlated with additive error in weight. We demonstrate the conditions under which IV is biased when there is non-classical measurement error and derive bounds for this bias conditional on instrument strength and the severity of mean-reverting error. We show that improvements in instrument relevance alone cannot eliminate IV bias, but reducing the correlation between weight and reporting error mitigates the bias. A solution we consider is regression calibration (RC) of endogenous variables with external validation data. In simulations, we find IV estimation paired with RC can produce consistent estimates when correctly specified. Even when RC fails to match the covariance structure of reporting error, there is still a reduction in asymptotic bias.

10.1002/hec.4882.abstractZh: 关于体重指数和肥胖对健康及劳动力市场结果影响的估计，通常采用工具变量估计方法来减少内生性导致的偏差。当这些研究依赖于包含自我或代理报告身高和体重的调查数据时，由于个体倾向于低估自己的体重，会出现非经典测量误差。体重的平均回归误差本身并不会导致工具变量渐近偏差，但如果工具变量与体重的加性误差相关，则可能导致偏差。我们证明了在存在非经典测量误差的情况下，工具变量出现偏差的条件，并推导出在工具变量强度和平均回归误差严重程度给定的情况下，这种偏差的界限。我们发现，仅提高工具变量的相关性并不能消除工具变量偏差，但减少体重与报告误差之间的相关性可以减轻这种偏差。我们考虑的一种解决方案是对内生变量进行回归校准，并利用外部验证数据进行验证。在模拟实验中，我们发现，当正确指定时，工具变量估计与回归校准相结合可以产生一致的估计结果。即使回归校准未能匹配报告误差的协方差结构，渐近偏差仍然会有所减少。

abstract.text: The health production function of the canonical health-capital model is generalized to allow the state of health to affect the total and marginal products of health investment. If the total and marginal products of health investment are nonincreasing functions of the state of health, then the solution of the generalized model is locally qualitatively identical to that of the canonical model. Moreover, and in contrast to the canonical model, the generalized model is able to rationalize the cycling of the state of health and health investment observed in some individuals. The necessary conditions on the health production function for cyclical behavior are identified as well.

10.1002/hec.4883.abstractZh: 该经典健康资本模型的健康生产函数被推广，以允许健康状态影响健康投资的总产品和边际产品。如果健康投资的总产品和边际产品是健康状态的非增函数，那么推广模型的解在局部上与经典模型的解具有相同的性质。此外，与经典模型不同，推广模型能够解释某些个体中观察到的健康状态和健康投资的周期性变化。同时，也确定了健康生产函数对于周期性行为所需的必要条件。

abstract.text: To evidence the impact of air pollution on the health of urban populations, several studies use natural experiments that shift commuting from public transport to cars (or vice-versa). However, as public transport use declines, reduced interpersonal contact may lead to slower virus spread and thus lower respiratory morbidity. Using a difference-in-differences strategy, we show that respiratory hospitalisations are both positively affected by air pollution and negatively affected by viral spread following partial unavailability of public transport due to strikes in the ten most populated French cities during the period 2010-2015. Our results are in line with studies in other countries that have found a significant increase in urgent respiratory hospitalisations following a public transport strike, most likely due to car pollution, but we also find a detectable interaction with viral spread, which should not be overlooked when interpreting these studies.

10.1002/hec.4884.abstractZh: 为了证明空气污染对城市人口健康的影响，一些研究采用了自然实验，将通勤方式从公共交通转变为汽车（或相反）。然而，随着公共交通使用的减少，人际接触减少可能导致病毒传播速度变慢，从而降低呼吸道疾病发病率。通过差异-差异策略，我们发现，在2010-2015年期间，法国十个人口最多的城市发生罢工时，部分公共交通服务中断，不仅空气污染对呼吸道疾病住院率有积极影响，同时也对病毒传播产生了负面影响。我们的研究结果与其他国家的研究结果一致，这些研究发现在公共交通罢工后，急性呼吸道疾病住院率显著上升，这很可能是由于汽车排放造成的。此外，我们还发现了病毒传播与空气污染之间的相互作用，这在解读这些研究时不应被忽视。

abstract.text: Medical innovations may lessen the perceived risk of disease which can decrease the take-up of healthy behaviors, a phenomenon known as risk compensation. In contrast, a diagnosis provides updated information about the state of one's health which may motivate positive behavior change. In this paper, I consider how behavior changes in response to a diagnosis of cardiovascular disease (CVD) before and after the FDA approval of new classes of drugs to treat high blood pressure and high cholesterol in 1973. I find that individuals diagnosed with CVD are more likely to follow a diet and decrease body-mass index in response to the diagnosis, irrespective of medication approvals. Nonsmoking is a notable exception. Prior to medication availability, there is no change in smoking behavior in response to a CVD diagnosis. Conversely, when medication is available, there is a significant decline in smoking. The empirical complementarity of medication and smoking cessation may be driven by increased exposure to medical professionals (who emphasize the harms of smoking) or because medication decreases the risk of CVD death which heightens the importance of investing in future health.

10.1002/hec.4885.abstractZh: 医学创新可能会降低人们对疾病的恐惧感，从而减少健康行为的采纳，这种现象被称为风险补偿。相比之下，诊断结果提供了关于个人健康状况的最新信息，这可能会促使人们积极改变行为。在本文中，我研究了在1973年FDA批准用于治疗高血压和高胆固醇的新药类之前和之后，被诊断出患有心血管疾病的人行为如何发生变化。我发现，无论是否获得药物批准，被诊断出患有心血管疾病的人更有可能遵循饮食控制并降低体重指数。不吸烟是一个显著的例外。在药物可用之前，被诊断出患有心血管疾病并不会改变吸烟行为。相反，当药物可用时，吸烟行为显著减少。药物与戒烟之间的实证互补性可能是由于人们更多地接触到强调吸烟危害的医学专业人士，或者因为药物降低了心血管疾病死亡的风险，这进一步强调了投资未来健康的重要性。

abstract.text: Evidence is mixed on whether increased access to insurance, specifically through the ACA's Medicaid expansion, exacerbated the opioid public health crisis through increased opioid prescribing. Using survey data on retail prescription drug fills from 2008 to 2019, we did not find a significant relationship between Medicaid expansion and opioid prescribing in the newly eligible Medicaid population. It may be that the dangers of opioids were known well enough by the time of the Medicaid expansion that lack of access to care was no longer a binding constraint on opioid prescription receipt.

10.1002/hec.4886.abstractZh: 关于通过《平价医疗法案》的医疗补助扩展政策增加保险覆盖是否加剧了阿片类药物公共健康危机的问题，研究结果并不一致。利用2008至2019年的零售处方药填充量调查数据，我们发现医疗补助扩展政策与新增医疗补助对象的阿片类药物处方之间并无显著关联。可能的情况是，在医疗补助扩展政策实施时，人们已经充分认识到阿片类药物的潜在危险，因此缺乏医疗服务已不再成为限制阿片类药物处方的因素。

abstract.text: Using three waves of the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study, this paper examines whether financial transfers from adult children to elderly parents affect the latter's mental health. Both OLS and instrumental variable (IV) estimates show that financial transfers significantly attenuate depressive symptoms of elderly individuals, with a much larger size of the IV estimates. We also examine the income and cultural channels through which intergenerational transfers work and further discuss the explanatory powers of these two channels through a decomposition analysis. The results suggest the cultural channel accounts for a larger proportion of the financial transfer effect. This means that the unique beneficial impact of intergenerational financial transfers on the mental health of older adults cannot be fully substituted in the foreseeable future.

10.1002/hec.4887.abstractZh: 本文利用中国健康与退休纵向研究的三个数据波，探讨成年子女向老年父母进行财务转移是否会影响后者的心理健康。普通最小二乘法和工具变量估计均表明，财务转移显著减轻了老年人的抑郁症状，且工具变量估计的效应更为显著。我们还研究了代际转移通过收入和文化渠道发挥作用的方式，并通过分解分析进一步探讨了这两种渠道的解释力。研究结果表明，文化渠道在财务转移效应中占更大比例。这意味着，代际财务转移对老年人心理健康的独特积极影响在可预见的未来无法完全被替代。

abstract.text: The market for heated tobacco products (HTPs) has grown rapidly in recent years, and many governments have started to include HTPs in tax codes to regulate their use. Currently, the evidence on how HTP prices impact tobacco use behaviors or whether consumers consider them as economic substitutes for cigarettes is lacking. This study is the first to answer these questions with a unique database to assess the own- and cross- price elasticities of HTP and cigarette demand. We collect a unique database of quarterly retail prices and sales of heated tobacco units and comparable scale cigarettes from 2014 to 2022, available for most countries where both HTPs and cigarettes are sold, and estimate the own- and cross- price elasticities of cigarette and HTP demand using a seemingly unrelated regression model. We find that HTP demand is price elastic (i.e., sensitive to prices) and has an own-price elasticity of -1.2 to -1.3, about four times greater than the own-price elasticity of cigarettes, which is about -0.3. We also find that cigarettes and HTPs are weak economic substitutes: while HTP demand is responsive to higher cigarette prices, cigarette demand is not sensitive to HTP prices. Our results suggest that tax policies that increase HTP and cigarette prices simultaneously will reduce HTP consumption without increasing cigarette consumption.

10.1002/hec.4888.abstractZh: 近年来，加热烟草产品的市场迅速增长，许多政府开始将加热烟草产品纳入税收法规以规范其使用。目前，关于加热烟草产品价格如何影响烟草使用行为，或者消费者是否将其视为香烟的经济替代品，相关的研究尚不充分。本研究首次通过独特的数据库来评估加热烟草产品和香烟需求的自身价格弹性及交叉价格弹性。我们收集了2014年至2022年间大多数销售加热烟草产品和香烟国家的季度零售价格和销量数据，并使用看似不相关的回归模型来估算香烟和加热烟草需求的自身价格弹性及交叉价格弹性。研究发现，加热烟草产品的需求具有价格弹性，自身价格弹性为-1.2至-1.3，约为香烟自身价格弹性的四倍，而香烟自身价格弹性约为-0.3。此外，我们还发现香烟和加热烟草产品是较弱的经济替代品：虽然加热烟草产品的需求对较高的香烟价格有反应，但香烟需求对加热烟草产品的价格并不敏感。我们的研究结果表明，同时提高加热烟草产品和香烟价格的税收政策，可以在不增加香烟消费的情况下减少加热烟草产品的消费。

abstract.text: Our study examines the causal effect of rural hospital closures on nearby hospitals' nurse staffing levels and health care utilization. We use data from the 2014-2019 American Hospital Association Survey on nurse staffing level outcomes including licensed practical or vocational nurses (LPNs), registered nurses (RNs), and advanced practice nurses (APNs); and health care utilization outcomes, including inpatient and outpatient surgical operations and emergency department (ED) visits. Using propensity score matching and difference-in-differences (DID) methods, we find that rural hospital closures lead to an average increase of 37.3% in the number of nurses in nearby rural hospitals during the 4 years following the closure. This increase is found across all categories of nurses, including LPNs, RNs, and APNs. We also find a substantial increase in the provision of inpatient and outpatient surgical operations but there is no change in ED visits. We do not find any effects for nearby urban hospitals. Our study suggests that a large proportion of the nursing workforce relocates to nearby hospitals after a rural hospital closure, which mitigates the negative consequences of such closures and allows these nearby hospitals to provide a larger volume of highly profitable services.

10.1002/hec.4889.abstractZh: 我们的研究探讨了农村医院关闭对附近医院护士人员配置和医疗利用的影响。我们使用了2014-2019年美国医院协会关于护士人员配置的调查数据，包括执业护士、注册护士和高级实践护士；以及医疗利用的相关数据，包括住院和门诊手术以及急诊科就诊情况。通过倾向得分匹配和差异内生方法分析发现，农村医院关闭后4年内，附近农村医院的护士数量平均增加了37.3%。这一增长涵盖了所有类型的护士，包括执业护士、注册护士和高级实践护士。我们还发现，住院和门诊手术的服务量显著增加，而急诊科就诊次数则没有变化。我们没有发现对附近城市医院有任何影响。我们的研究表明，农村医院关闭后，大量护理人员会迁移到附近医院，这减轻了关闭带来的负面影响，并使这些附近医院能够提供更多高利润的服务。

abstract.text: The call for "health and wellbeing in all policies" requires a preference-based measure that collapses multi-dimensional health and wellbeing into a single index, such as equivalent income. We aim to elicit preferences of the UK general public to estimate a value set for a suite of seven commonly used wellbeing indicators including health, income, and other dimensions, in terms of equivalent income. Secondly, we examine heterogeneous preferences by gender, by age, and by income. Thirdly, we explore the stability of preferences, since the survey took place amid the pandemic, possibly affecting preferences over health and wellbeing. Effects of attrition and of time are distinguished. Data were collected online across two waves using Discrete Choice Experiments through an internet panel (N1 = 3362; and N2 = 3357). The regression coefficients for all the ordered attribute levels have the expected sign, are significant, and ordered. Equivalent income was found to vary up to 10% by gender and by age (both significant) and 4% by income (not significant), while the effect of time was up to 16% (significant). The study facilitates the calculation of overall wellbeing in terms of equivalent income based on the preferences of the UK public, where the relevant wellbeing indicators are available.

10.1002/hec.4890.abstractZh: “所有政策中都应关注健康与福祉”的呼吁需要一种基于偏好的衡量方式，将多维度的健康与福祉整合为单一指标，例如等效收入。我们的目标是通过调查英国公众的偏好，来估算七项常用福祉指标的价值，这些指标包括健康、收入以及其他维度，以等效收入作为衡量标准。其次，我们研究了不同性别、年龄和收入群体之间的偏好差异。第三，由于调查是在疫情期间进行的，可能会受到疫情对健康和福祉偏好影响，因此我们还探讨了偏好的稳定性。我们区分了流失效应和时间效应。数据通过互联网面板在两次在线调查中收集（N1 = 3362；N2 = 3357）。所有有序属性水平的回归系数都具有预期的符号，且显著有序。结果发现，等效收入因性别和年龄而异，分别变化了10%（均显著），因收入变化了4%（不显著），而时间效应则达到了16%（显著）。本研究有助于根据英国公众的偏好，计算出以等效收入衡量的整体福祉水平，前提是相关福祉指标是可获得的。

abstract.text: Estimating the causal effects of health policy interventions is crucial for policymaking but is challenging when using real-world administrative health care data due to a lack of methodological guidance. To help fill this gap, we conducted a plasmode simulation using such data from a recent policy initiative launched in a deprived urban area in Germany. Our aim was to evaluate and compare the following methods for estimating causal effects: propensity score matching, inverse probability of treatment weighting, and entropy balancing, all combined with difference-in-differences analysis, augmented inverse probability weighting, and targeted maximum likelihood estimation. Additionally, we estimated nuisance parameters using regression models and an ensemble learner called superlearner. We focused on treatment effects related to the number of physician visits, total health care cost, and hospitalization. While each approach has its strengths and weaknesses, our results demonstrate that the superlearner generally worked well for handling nuisance terms in large covariate sets when combined with doubly robust estimation methods to estimate the causal contrast of interest. In contrast, regression-based nuisance parameter estimation worked best in small covariate sets when combined with singly robust methods.

10.1002/hec.4891.abstractZh: 估算健康政策干预的因果效应对政策制定至关重要，但在使用实际行政医疗数据时却面临挑战，因为缺乏方法学指导。为了填补这一空白，我们使用德国一个贫困城市地区最近一项政策倡议的数据进行了模拟实验。我们的目标是评估并比较以下估算因果效应的方法：倾向得分匹配、逆处理概率加权以及熵平衡法，这些方法均结合了差异-差异分析、增强逆处理概率加权以及目标最大似然估计。此外，我们还使用回归模型和一种名为超级学习器的集成学习器来估算干扰参数。我们重点关注与医生就诊次数、总医疗成本以及住院次数相关的治疗效果。虽然每种方法都有其优缺点，但我们的结果表明，当超级学习器与双重稳健估计方法结合使用时，能够很好地处理大型协变量集合中的干扰项，从而估算出感兴趣的因果对比。相比之下，基于回归的干扰参数估计在小型协变量集合中，当与单一稳健方法结合使用时效果最佳。

abstract.text: This study investigates the impacts of health shocks among older individuals on the dynamics of their living arrangements in Europe and the United States. Exploiting unpredicted health shocks, we use an event-study difference-in-differences approach to demonstrate that health shocks increase difficulties with activities of daily living and instrumental activities of daily living, thereby increasing the need for care. Our findings indicate that health shocks raise the probability of nursing home residency and co-residence with adult children by 0.7 and 1.4 percentage points in Europe, and by 2.1 and 1.8 percentage points in the U.S., respectively. Further analyses reveal that more generous long-term care public policies correlate with a higher probability of nursing home residency and a lower probability of co-residing with adult children, highlighting the significant role of public policies in household responses to health shocks. Additionally, we find that health shocks negatively impact adult children's labor supply, particularly in the U.S.

10.1002/hec.4893.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了健康冲击对欧洲和美国老年人生活安排动态的影响。通过利用不可预测的健康冲击，我们采用事件研究差异-差异方法证明，健康冲击会增加日常生活活动及工具性日常生活活动的困难，从而提升对护理的需求。研究发现，健康冲击使欧洲老年人入住养老院和与成年子女同住的概率分别上升0.7和1.4个百分点，而在美国则分别上升2.1和1.8个百分点。进一步分析表明，更宽松的长期护理公共政策与老年人入住养老院的概率较高以及与成年子女同住的概率较低之间存在正相关关系，这凸显了公共政策在家庭应对健康冲击中的重要作用。此外，我们还发现，健康冲击对成年子女的劳动力供给产生负面影响，尤其是在美国。

abstract.text: Over the past decade, single mothers have experienced increasing work requirements both in the UK and in other developed countries. Our aim was to examine if increasing job hours are associated with mental health of single mothers compared to partnered mothers. Using 13 waves of the Understanding Society Survey (2009-2023), we estimated the relationship between changing job hours and mental health using difference-in-difference event study design, accounting for differential treatment effects across time and individuals. We also investigated the role of potential mechanisms, including role strain and additional income. Our findings suggest that increasing job hours from part-time to full-time is associated with an instantaneous decrease in mental health of 0.19 standard deviations for single mothers [95% CI: -0.37;-0.01], with no effect for partnered mothers. Further analyses suggest increased role strain for single mothers as a mechanism helping explain these differences. The negative effects of increasing job hours and increased role strain should be considered when developing future welfare policies for single mothers, to ensure that greater work requirements do not undermine the mental health of the already vulnerable population group.

10.1002/hec.4895.abstractZh: 在过去十年中，英国及其他发达国家中的单身母亲面临着日益增加的工作要求。我们的研究旨在探讨工作时间的增加是否与单身母亲的心理健康有关，与有伴侣的母亲相比如何。我们利用“理解社会调查”的13个数据周期（2009-2023年），采用差异-差异事件研究设计来估计工作时间变化与心理健康之间的关系，同时考虑了时间和个体之间的差异效应。我们还研究了潜在机制的作用，包括角色压力与额外收入。研究发现，从兼职到全职的工作时间增加会导致单身母亲的心理健康立即下降0.19个标准差[95%置信区间：-0.37;-0.01]，而有伴侣的母亲则没有这种影响。进一步分析表明，角色压力的增加是解释这些差异的一个机制。在制定针对单身母亲的未来福利政策时，应考虑到工作时间增加和角色压力增加的负面影响，以确保增加的工作要求不会损害已经脆弱的群体的心理健康。

abstract.text: This paper empirically investigates the impact of public long-term care insurance (LTCI) on the utilization of inpatient services and associated expenditures among disabled Chinese individuals, using data from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study from 2011 to 2018. Employing a staggered difference-in-difference approach within a propensity score matching framework (PSM-DID), the study finds that the introduction of LTCI significantly reduces the likelihood of inpatient service usage by 4.2%, the annual number of inpatient admissions by 10.2%, the annual inpatient cost by 16.2%, the out-of-pocket expenses by 20.7%, and the reimbursement expenditure by the public medical insurer by 9.9%. The study further explores the mechanisms underlying these effects and identifies that the Substitution Effect, where care services in community healthcare centers and nursing homes replace hospitalizations, outweighs the Income Effect generated by LTCI benefits. By leveraging the quasi-natural experimental setting of diverse LTCI policies across cities, the study also examines the heterogeneous impacts of LTCI based on household income, eligibility criteria, and reimbursement methods. The findings underscore the positive role of LTCI in controlling medical expenses and alleviating congestion in urban hospitals, offering valuable insights for promoting "Healthy Aging".

10.1002/hec.4896.abstractZh: 本文通过2011至2018年中国健康与退休纵向研究的数据，实证研究了公共长期护理保险对残疾中国人群住院服务利用及相关支出的影响。采用倾向得分匹配框架下的分阶段差异估计方法，研究发现，LTCI的引入显著降低了住院服务使用的可能性4.2%，年度住院人次减少了10.2%，年度住院费用增加了16.2%，个人自付费用增加了20.7%，公共医疗保险机构的报销支出减少了9.9%。研究进一步探讨了这些效应背后的机制，发现社区医疗中心和养老院提供的替代性护理服务所带来的替代效应，超过了LTCI福利带来的收入效应。通过利用不同城市LTCI政策的准自然实验环境，研究还考察了基于家庭收入、资格标准和报销方式的LTCI的异质影响。研究结果强调了LTCI在控制医疗费用和缓解城市医院拥堵方面的积极作用，为促进“健康老龄化”提供了宝贵的见解。

abstract.text: The literature on health shocks finds that minor injuries have only short-term labor market impacts. However, mild traumatic brain injuries (mTBIs, commonly referred to as concussions) may be different as the medical literature highlights that they can have longer-term health and cognitive effects. Moreover, TBIs are one of the most common causes of disability globally, with the vast majority being mild. Thus, it is important to understand the impact of mTBIs on labor market outcomes. We use administrative data on all medically-diagnosed mild traumatic brain injuries (mTBIs) in New Zealand linked to monthly tax records to examine the labor market effects of a mTBI. We use a comparison group of those who suffer a mTBI at a later date to overcome potential endogeneity issues, and employ a doubly-robust difference-in-differences method. We find that suffering a mTBI has negative labor market effects. Rather than dissipating over time, these negative effects grow, representing a decrease in employment of 20 percentage points and earning losses of about a third after 48 months. Our results highlight the need for timely diagnosis and treatment to mitigate the effect of mTBIs to reduce economic and social costs.

10.1002/hec.4897.abstractZh: 关于健康冲击的文献表明，轻微伤害对劳动力市场的冲击通常是短期的。然而，轻度创伤性脑损伤（通常称为脑震荡）可能有所不同，医学文献指出它们可能带来更长期的健康和认知影响。此外，创伤性脑损伤是全球导致残疾的最常见原因之一，其中绝大多数属于轻度损伤。因此，了解轻度创伤性脑损伤对劳动力市场结果的影响非常重要。我们利用了新西兰所有经医学诊断的轻度创伤性脑损伤患者的行政数据，并结合每月的税务记录来研究这种损伤对劳动力市场的影響。为了克服潜在的内生性问题，我们使用了后来发生轻度创伤性脑损伤的对照组，并采用了双重稳健的差异中差异方法。研究发现，遭受轻度创伤性脑损伤会对劳动力市场产生负面影响。这些负面影响并非随着时间的推移而消失，反而会持续加剧，在48个月后，就业率下降20个百分点，收入损失约三分之一。我们的研究结果强调了及时诊断和治疗的重要性，以减轻轻度创伤性脑损伤对经济和社会成本的负面影响。

abstract.text: Steering patients to lower priced and/or higher quality providers can increase the value of a healthcare system. In a managed care setting, health insurers may use financial incentives for this purpose. However, introducing cost-sharing differences among providers may cause enrolee discontent, which may result in disenrollment. Simply informing and guiding enrolees to preferred providers without financial incentives may therefore be an attractive alternative for insurers. But the effectiveness of such a soft channelling strategy is unclear. This paper investigates whether a Dutch health insurer's strategy of designating preferred hospitals for breast cancer surgery and for inguinal hernia repair affected its enrolees' hospital choices. In October 2008, preferred hospitals received a quality label ('TopCare') because of their high-quality performances in previous years. The insurer recommended these hospitals to enrolees without a financial incentive. Individual patient-level claims data from the insurer over a 5-year period (2006-2010) and a conditional logit choice model was used. Our study samples for breast cancer surgery and inguinal hernia repair included 7985 and 17,292 patients, respectively. It is found that for both procedures, patients ex ante already had a certain preference for the hospitals designated by the insurer as top-quality providers, even when considering possible additional travel time. Also, for both procedures, patient choice did not differ significantly before and after the launch of the TopCare label. The quality label did not increase patient demand for preferred hospitals. Thus, the insurer's strategy to steer patients to preferred hospital alternatives without a financial incentive was not effective.

10.1002/hpm.3836.abstractZh: 引导患者选择价格更低或质量更高的医疗服务提供者可以提高医疗系统的价值。在管理式医疗环境中，健康保险公司可能会采用经济激励措施来实现这一目标。然而，在医疗服务提供者之间引入费用分担差异可能会引发患者的不满，从而导致患者退保。因此，仅通过告知和引导患者选择首选医疗服务提供者而无需经济激励，可能是保险公司的一个有吸引力的选择。但是，这种软性引导策略的有效性尚不清楚。本文研究了荷兰一家健康保险公司为乳腺癌手术和腹股沟疝修补手术指定首选医院的做法是否影响了患者的医院选择。2008年10月，这些首选医院因在以往年度的高质量表现而获得了“TopCare”质量标签。保险公司在没有经济激励的情况下推荐这些医院给患者。研究使用了保险公司5年（2006-2010年）内的个人患者索赔数据，并采用条件Logit选择模型进行分析。对于乳腺癌手术和腹股沟疝修补手术，分别有7985名和17,292名患者被纳入研究样本。研究发现，对于这两种手术，即使考虑到可能的额外旅行时间，患者在事前就已经对保险公司指定的顶级医疗服务提供者有一定的偏好。此外，在“TopCare”标签推出前后，患者的选择并没有显著变化。质量标签并没有增加患者对首选医院的需求。因此，保险公司引导患者选择首选医院而不提供经济激励的策略并不有效。

abstract.text: Summary The number of parameters in a standard multinomial logit model increases linearly with the number of choice alternatives and number of explanatory variables. Because many modern applications involve large choice sets with categorical explanatory variables, which enter the model as large sets of binary dummies, the number of parameters in a multinomial logit model is often large. This paper proposes a new method for data‐driven two‐way parameter clustering over outcome categories and explanatory dummy categories in a multinomial logit model. A Bayesian Dirichlet process mixture model encourages parameters to cluster over the categories, which reduces the number of unique model parameters and provides interpretable clusters of categories. In an empirical application, we estimate the holiday preferences of 11 household types over 49 holiday destinations and identify a small number of household segments with different preferences across clusters of holiday destinations.

10.1002/jae.3034.abstractZh: 摘要：标准多项逻辑模型中的参数数量随着选择选项的数量和解释变量的增加而线性增加。由于许多现代应用涉及包含分类解释变量的大型选择集，这些变量以大型二进制虚拟变量的形式进入模型，因此多项逻辑模型中的参数数量通常很大。本文提出了一种新的方法，用于在多项逻辑模型中对结果类别和解释虚拟类别进行数据驱动的双向参数聚类。贝叶斯狄利克雷过程混合模型促使参数在类别上聚集，从而减少了唯一模型参数的数量，并提供了可解释的类别簇。在一项实证应用中，我们估计了11种家庭类型对49个度假目的地的偏好，并识别出少数几个在不同度假目的地类别簇中具有不同偏好的家庭群体。

abstract.text: We experiment with recent ensemble machine learning methods in estimating healthcare costs, utilizing Finnish data containing rich individual-level information on healthcare costs, socioeconomic status and diagnostic data from multiple registries. Our data are a random 10% sample (553,675 observations) from the Finnish population in 2017. Using annual healthcare cost in 2017 as a response variable, we compare the performance of Random forest, Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM) and eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) to linear regression. As machine learning methods are often seen as unsuitable in risk adjustment applications because of their relative opaqueness, we also introduce visualizations from the machine learning literature to help interpret the contribution of individual variables to the prediction. Our results show that ensemble machine learning methods can improve predictive performance, with all of them significantly outperforming linear regression, and that a certain level of interpretation can be provided for them. We also find individual-level socioeconomic variables to improve prediction accuracy and that their effect is larger for machine learning methods. However, we find that the predictions used for funding allocations are sensitive to model selection, highlighting the need for comprehensive robustness testing when estimating risk adjustment models used in applications.

10.1007/s10198-023-01656-w.abstractZh: 我们采用最近的集成机器学习方法来估算医疗成本，利用了包含丰富个人层面医疗成本、社会经济状况以及来自多个登记系统的诊断数据的芬兰数据。我们的数据是从2017年芬兰人口中随机抽取的10%（553,675个观测值）。以2017年的年度医疗成本作为响应变量，我们比较了随机森林、梯度提升机（GBM）和极端梯度提升（XGBoost）与线性回归的性能。由于机器学习方法在风险调整应用中往往被认为不够透明，我们引入了机器学习文献中的可视化工具，以帮助解释各个变量对预测的贡献。我们的结果显示，集成机器学习方法可以提高预测性能，其中所有方法的性能都显著优于线性回归，并且可以为这些模型提供一定程度的解释性。我们还发现，个人层面的社会经济变量可以提高预测准确性，且对机器学习方法的影响更大。然而，我们发现用于资金分配的预测结果对模型选择非常敏感，这凸显了在估算风险调整模型时需要进行全面的稳健性测试的重要性。

abstract.text: We investigate quality provision and the occurrence of strategic behaviour in competitive hospital markets where providers are assumed to be semi-altruistic towards patients. For this, we employ a laboratory experiment with a hospital market framing. Subjects decide on the quality levels for one of three competing hospitals respectively. We vary the organizational aspect of whether quality decisions within hospitals are made by individuals or teams. Realized monetary patient benefits go to real patients outside the lab. In both settings, we find that degrees of cooperation quickly converge towards negative values, implying absence of collusion and patient centred or competitive quality choices. Moreover, hospitals treat quality as a strategic complement and adjust their quality choice in the same direction as their competitors. The response magnitude for team markets is weaker; this is driven by non-cooperative or altruistic teams, which tend to set levels of quality that are strategically independent.

10.1007/s10754-024-09366-3.abstractZh: 我们研究了在竞争性的医院市场中，医疗服务提供者被假设为对病人具有半利他性时，质量提供情况以及战略行为的发生。为此，我们采用了一个以医院市场为框架的实验室实验。参与者分别决定三家竞争医院的质量水平。我们改变了医院内部质量决策是由个人还是团队做出的这一组织方面因素。实际获得的货币病人收益则归实验室外的真实病人所有。在两种情况下，我们发现合作程度迅速趋向于负值，这意味着不存在勾结，且质量选择以病人为中心或具有竞争性。此外，医院将质量视为一种战略补充，并调整其质量选择以与竞争对手保持一致。在团队市场中，这种响应力度较弱；这是由于非合作性或利他性的团队，它们倾向于设定具有战略独立性的质量水平。

abstract.text: Background Regional market competition is known to impact practice patterns in surgical care. We aimed to investigate the association of regional market competition with the utilization of early peripheral vascular interventions (PVIs) for the treatment of claudication, and the subsequent impact on clinical outcomes. Methods We conducted a retrospective analysis of 100% Medicare fee-for-service claims data from January 2019 to December 2021 to identify patients with a new diagnosis of claudication. We calculated the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index for all sites of service performing PVI according to Health Service Area. Multivariable logistic regression and Cox proportional hazards models were used to assess the association of regional market competition with early (<6 months) PVI for claudication, and progression to chronic limb-threatening ischemia, repeat PVI, and major amputation. Results We identified 300,492 patients with a new diagnosis of claudication (mean age 73.8 years, 51.6% male, 11.1% Black), of which 6.1% underwent an early PVI for claudication. Most patients (72.4%) were treated in low-competition markets. After adjusting for patient characteristics, patients treated in moderate-competition markets had the highest odds of receiving an early PVI. Regional market competition was not associated with conversion to chronic limb-threatening ischemia or repeat PVI (P > 0.05), but patients treated in high- (adjusted hazard ratio [aHR] 0.70, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.56-0.86) and moderate- (aHR 0.82, 95% CI 0.69-0.92) competition markets had lower hazards of major amputation compared to patients treated in low-competition markets. Early PVI was significantly associated with worse clinical outcomes after adjusting for all factors including market competition (all, P < 0.05). Conclusions There is a complex interplay between regional market competition, early PVI utilization, and subsequent clinical outcomes for patients with claudication. Early PVI continues to demonstrate a strong association with unfavorable clinical outcomes even when accounting for market competition.

10.1016/j.avsg.2024.09.047.abstractZh:
背景：区域市场竞争已知会影响外科护理的实践模式。我们旨在研究区域市场竞争与早期外周血管干预术（PVI）用于治疗间歇性跛行的关联，以及其对临床结果的后续影响。  
方法：我们对2019年1月至2021年12月期间100%的Medicare按服务收费索赔数据进行了回顾性分析，以识别新诊断为间歇性跛行的患者。我们根据医疗服务区域计算了所有进行PVI服务的地点的Herfindahl-Hirschman指数。使用多变量逻辑回归和Cox比例风险模型来评估区域市场竞争与早期（<6个月）PVI治疗间歇性跛行、进展为慢性肢体威胁性缺血、重复PVI以及重大截肢之间的关联。  
结果：我们识别出300,492名新诊断为间歇性跛行的患者（平均年龄73.8岁，51.6%为男性，11.1%为黑人），其中6.1%接受了早期PVI治疗。大多数患者（72.4%）在竞争较低的地区接受治疗。在调整患者特征后，接受中度竞争市场治疗的患者最有可能接受早期PVI。区域市场竞争与转为慢性肢体威胁性缺血或重复PVI无关（P > 0.05），但在高度竞争（调整后的风险比[aHR] 0.70，95%置信区间[CI] 0.56-0.86）和中度竞争市场治疗的患者，与在竞争较低地区治疗的患者相比，重大截肢的风险较低。在调整所有因素包括市场竞争后，早期PVI与较差的临床结果显著相关（所有因素，P < 0.05）。结论：区域市场竞争、早期PVI的使用以及随后患者的临床结果之间存在复杂的相互作用。即使考虑到市场竞争因素，早期PVI仍然与不良临床结果有很强的关联。

abstract.text: China's multilevel medical education system generates tremendous physician human capital heterogeneity. This paper attempts to take advantage of the differences level of doctors' human capital to reveal the relationship between healthcare service mismatch and doctors' human capital using the DRGs data of a province in China. This paper found that: first, a higher level of physician human capital (PHC) in hospitals significantly increases the mismatch of medical services; second, there is a complementary effect between doctors' human capital and medical care accessibility, which significantly increases the degree of healthcare service mismatch, and these conclusions still hold after controlling the endogeneity and a series of robustness tests. Third, the mismatch effect is more significant in surgery than that of in internal medicine departments and the mismatch effect is stronger in county hospitals than that of provincial hospitals. Therefore, both patients' great confidence in superior medical services and the heterogeneity of PHC contribute to the mismatch of medical services in China.

10.1016/j.ceqi.2024.05.001.abstractZh: 中国的多层次医学教育体系产生了巨大的医生人力资本异质性。本文试图利用医生人力资本水平的差异，通过中国某省份的DRGs数据，揭示医疗服务不匹配与医生人力资本之间的关系。研究发现：首先，医院中医生人力资本水平越高，医疗服务不匹配的程度就越严重；其次，医生人力资本与医疗可及性之间存在互补效应，这显著增加了医疗服务不匹配的程度，这些结论在控制内生性和进行一系列稳健性测试后仍然成立。第三，手术部门的医疗服务不匹配效应比内科部门更为显著，而县级医院的匹配效应比省级医院更为强烈。因此，患者对优质医疗服务的高度信任以及医生人力资本的差异性，共同导致了中国医疗服务的不匹配现象。

abstract.text: Los profesionales del sistema de salud merecen una buena gestión, y España, estancada en su productividad, la necesita. Una buena gestión es posible, como se comprobó durante los estados de alarma de 2020. Nada de lo aprendido se ha consolidado. No sirve el extremo de considerar oxímoron el término «gestión pública», pues nunca en la historia se ha precisado mejor estado que ahora, además de mejor mercado, por razones que van más allá de la consolidación del estado del bienestar. Tampoco sirve el extremo opuesto de pensar que fuera del funcionariado no hay salvación: la esclerosis burocratizante, uno de los signos de deterioro, enfocada exclusivamente a la legalidad, o como mínimo a su apariencia, no puede continuar ignorando que también se precisa efectividad. Se sabe medir la calidad de la gestión, en general y en el sector sanitario, y hay conocimiento acerca de cómo mejorarla. Modelos más flexibles de relaciones laborales —para seleccionar, reclutar y retener con criterios de «igualdad, mérito y capacidad» mejorados— requieren modificaciones en la arquitectura institucional como las que este artículo plantea: competencia por comparación en calidad entre centros autónomos y responsables que comparten reglas de juego en un terreno nivelado. El sistema sanitario, la joya del país, gracias en gran parte a la calidad de sus recursos humanos, no tan solo merece que sus potencialidades sean liberadas, sino que puede liderar el imprescindible aumento de la capacidad resolutiva, que asegura su impacto en el bienestar social, así como plasmar en propiedad intelectual su capacidad investigadora e innovadora con el consecuente impacto en el producto interior bruto. Healthcare professionals deserve good management, and Spain, stagnant in its productivity, needs it. Good management is possible, as evidenced during the states of alarm in 2020. None of the lessons learned have been consolidated. Dismissing the term “public management” as an oxymoron is extreme, as there has never been a greater need for a well-functioning state, along with a better market, for reasons beyond the consolidation of the welfare state. The opposite extreme of thinking that salvation lies only within the civil service is also unhelpful. Bureaucratic sclerosis, a sign of deterioration, focused on legality or its appearance, cannot continue to ignore the need for effectiveness. The quality of management, both in general and in the healthcare sector, can be measured, and there is knowledge on how to improve it. More flexible models of labor relations —for selection, recruitment, and retention based on improved criteria of “equality, merit, and capability”— require modifications in institutional architecture, as proposed in this article: competitor benchmarking among autonomous centers and responsible entities that share standardized rules. The healthcare system, the jewel of the country, thanks in large part to the quality of its human resources, not only deserves to have its potential unleashed but can also lead the necessary increase in its resolution capacity, ensuring its impact on social well-being. It can also document its research and innovative capabilities in intellectual property, thereby contributing to the gross domestic product.

10.1016/j.gaceta.2024.102394.abstractZh: 卫生系统的专业人员理应得到良好的管理，而生产力停滞的西班牙正是需要这种管理的。良好的管理是可能的，正如在2020年的紧急状态期间所证明的那样。从中学到的经验并未得到巩固。将“公共管理”一词视为矛盾修辞语是毫无意义的，因为在历史上从未有过比现在更明确的国家治理状态，此外还有更好的市场状况，这背后有着超越福利国家巩固的更深层次的原因。同样，认为除了官僚体系之外没有其他出路也是错误的：官僚主义的僵化是衰退的一个标志，它只关注合法性，或者至少只是表面的合法性，但无法忽视效率的重要性。我们了解如何衡量管理的质量，无论是在一般领域还是卫生部门。也有知识可以帮助我们改进管理。更灵活的工作关系模式——基于“平等、能力和才能”的标准来选拔、招聘和留住人才——需要改变制度架构，正如本文所提出的那样：通过比较不同自治机构之间的质量来竞争，让它们在一个公平的平台上共同竞争。卫生系统是国家的重要支柱，很大程度上归功于其人力资源的质量。它不仅应该充分发挥其潜力，还可以引领解决社会问题的关键能力提升，从而确保对社会福利产生积极影响，并将研究和创新能力转化为知识产权，进而对国内生产总值产生影响。卫生专业人员理应得到良好的管理，而生产力停滞的西班牙正是需要这种管理的。良好的管理是可能的，这一点在2020年的危机时期得到了证明。然而，从这些经验中得到的教训并未得到充分整合。将“公共管理”一词视为矛盾的说法是极端的，因为现在比以往任何时候都更需要一个运转良好的国家以及一个更完善的市场，这不仅仅是因为福利国家的整合问题。认为救赎只能存在于公务员体系内的观点也是不切实际的。官僚僵化是一种恶化的迹象，它只关注合法性或表面的形式，但无法继续忽视效率的需求。无论是总体管理还是医疗保健领域的管理质量，都可以进行衡量，并且已有知识可以改进这些管理。更灵活的劳动关系模式——基于“平等、能力和才能”等改进标准来进行选拔、招聘和留住人才——需要制度结构的调整，正如本文所提出的：在拥有标准化规则的自主中心和责任实体之间进行竞争性的基准对比。医疗保健系统作为国家的瑰宝，在很大程度上得益于其人力资源的质量，它不仅应该充分发挥其潜力，还可以提升其解决问题的能力，从而确保对社会福祉产生积极影响。此外，它还可以通过知识产权来展示其研究和创新能力，从而为国内生产总值做出贡献。

abstract.text: Parliament has imposed duties on the government and NHS in England aimed at reducing health inequalities. to understand the effect on inequalities of government policies, which require the NHS in England to outsource elective surgery to the private sector. We analysed the numbers of admissions for hip and knee replacement surgery from the least and most deprived population quintiles in three time periods: before the introduction of the policies (1997/98-2002/03); following the implementation of the independent sector treatment centre programme (2003/04-2006/07); and after the extension of 'choice at referral’ (2007/08-2018/19). despite admission rates doubling and trebling for hip and knee replacements respectively between 1997/98 and 2018/19, inequality grew to the detriment of the most deprived. Inequality grew at the fastest rate during period 3; admission rates to the NHS fell while admissions to the private sector continued to rise. By 2018/19 almost a third of NHS funded procedures were provided privately. In 1997/98, for every 10 patients admitted for hip and knee surgery from the most deprived quintile, 13 and 9 respectively were admitted from the least deprived, by 2018/19 the gap had widened to 19 and 15 respectively. Socio-economic inequalities for hip and knee replacement have widened as outsourcing of NHS treatment to the private sector has increased. The NHS must rebuild in-house capacity and provision instead of outsourcing care.

10.1016/j.healthpol.2024.105118.abstractZh: 英国议会向政府和国民医疗服务体系（NHS）征收了旨在减少健康不平等的税收。为了了解政府政策对不平等的影响，这些政策要求英格兰的NHS将选择性手术外包给私营部门。我们分析了三个时期中，最贫困和最富裕人群在髋关节和膝关节置换手术中的入院数量：政策实施前（1997/98-2002/03年）；独立部门治疗中心计划实施之后（2003/04-2006/07年）；以及“转诊选择”政策扩展之后（2007/08-2018/19年）。尽管在1997/98年至2018/19年间，髋关节和膝关节置换手术的入院率分别翻了一番和三倍，但不平等现象却加剧了，最贫困人群受到的损害更大。在第三个时期，不平等的增长速度最快；NHS的入院率下降，而私营部门的入院率持续上升。到2018/19年，几乎三分之一由NHS资助的手术是由私营部门提供的。在1997/98年，每10名来自最贫困群体的患者接受髋关节和膝关节手术时，分别有13名和9名来自最富裕群体患者接受手术；到2018/19年，这一差距扩大到19名和15名。随着NHS将治疗外包给私营部门的情况增加，髋关节和膝关节置换手术的社会经济不平等现象也加剧了。NHS必须重建内部能力和服务，而不是将护理外包出去。

abstract.text: Background Portugal introduced freedom of choice for initial specialist consultations in 2016 to boost quality via competition. However, for tangible benefits, specialized care demand must be quality-elastic. This research probes the relation between choosing hospital out the residence area and their quality traits. Methods We used data for all primary consultation requests from primary care centres to hospitals from 1/1/2017 to 31/12/2018 (n = 3,346,335). We modelled the choice of a hospital as a function of its quality characteristics, adjusting for area-based socioeconomic variables using logistic regressions. Results Results indicate that patients and their general practitioners consider quality indicators when choosing a hospital. Higher mortality, longer waiting times and higher readmission rates at the hospital of origin were positively associated with the patient's choice. Freedom of choice is less used when the distance to the hospital of origin increases. Similar patterns were observed for larger hospitals and those with academic status. Discussion This study underscores the relevance of quality considerations in hospital selection by both patients and their general practitioners (GPs). The implications are two-fold. Firstly, improving quality appears as a factor to increase attractiveness, so that hospital competition may lead to improved health outcomes. Secondly, it highlights that hospital financing should include an activity dimension in which "money follows the patient", otherwise no financial incentive exists to improve quality. Hence, the current hospital financing model and the limited possibility to choose in certain areas limit the potential of quality improvement based on enhanced attractivity. Decision makers should be aware that quality is a driver of patient choice, as our study demonstrates, and adapt the system to take advantage of this reality.

10.1016/j.healthpol.2024.105163.abstractZh:
背景：葡萄牙在2016年引入了初次专科咨询的选择自由，旨在通过竞争提高医疗质量。然而，要实现实际效益，专科护理的需求必须具备质量弹性。本研究探讨了患者选择居住地附近的医院与其医疗质量特征之间的关系。

方法：我们使用了2017年1月1日至2018年12月31日期间所有从初级保健中心转诊至医院的初次咨询请求数据（n = 3,346,335）。我们通过逻辑回归模型，将医院的选择与其质量特征联系起来，并考虑了基于地理的社会经济变量。

结果：结果表明，患者在选择医院时会考虑质量指标。较高的死亡率、较长的等待时间和较高的再入院率与患者的选择呈正相关。当与原医院的距离增加时，选择自由的使用频率降低。对于规模较大的医院和具有学术地位的医院，也观察到了类似的模式。

讨论：本研究强调了患者及其全科医生在选择医院时重视质量因素的重要性。其意义有两个方面：首先，提高质量似乎是提高医院吸引力的一个因素，因此医院之间的竞争可能会带来更好的健康结果。其次，这表明医院融资应包含“资金跟随患者”的活动维度，否则就没有动力去提高质量。因此，当前医院融资模式以及在某些地区选择有限的可能性，限制了基于增强吸引力的质量改进潜力。决策者应当意识到，正如我们的研究所示，质量是患者选择的重要因素，因此应当调整系统以充分利用这一现实。

abstract.text: Introduction: This work investigates the compatibility of integrated care and competition in China and analyses the impact of integrated care on regional care quality (DeptQ) within a competitive framework. Method: The study was built on multivariate correspondence analysis and a two-way fixed-effects model. The data were collected from Xiamen's Big Data Application Open Platform and represent nine specialised departments that regularly performed inter-institutional referrals between 2016 and 2019. Results: First, care quality for referred patients (ReferQ) and the relative scale of referred patients (ReferScale) and competition have an antagonistic but not completely mutually exclusive relationship. Second, ReferQ and competition both have a significant effect on DeptQ, but only when competition is weak can ReferQ and competition act synergistically on DeptQ. When competition is fierce, competition will weaken the impact of ReferQ on DeptQ. Conclusion: Changes in the intensity of integrated care and competition ultimately affect care quality.

10.1016/j.heliyon.2024.e24836.abstractZh: 引言：本研究探讨了中国综合护理与竞争之间的兼容性，并分析综合护理在竞争框架下对区域护理质量的影响。方法：该研究基于多变量对应分析和双向固定效应模型进行。数据来自厦门大数据应用开放平台，涵盖了2016年至2019年间定期进行跨机构转诊的九个专业科室。结果：首先，转诊患者的护理质量（ReferQ）与转诊患者的相对规模（ReferScale）以及竞争之间存在一种对立关系，但并非完全互斥。其次，ReferQ和竞争都对区域护理质量有显著影响，但只有当竞争较弱时，ReferQ和竞争才能对区域护理质量产生协同效应。当竞争非常激烈时，竞争会削弱ReferQ对区域护理质量的影响。结论：综合护理的强度和竞争的变化最终会影响护理质量。

abstract.text: This study investigates how differences in the market structure between the Japanese horse racing and Keirin 1 racing markets affects the influence exercised by high-turnover operators (major operators) in both markets on low-turnover operators (minor operators) in those markets. 2 In the horse racing market structure, there are few competitors, and the difference in turnover 3 between major and minor operators is large. In contrast, in the Keirin racing market structure, there are many competitors, and the difference in turnover between major and minor operators is small. Panel analysis results show that in horse racing, operators with low turnover are significantly affected by those with high turnover, while in Keirin racing, operators with low turnover are less affected by competitors with high turnover. The results not only indicate that firms are affected differently by competitors due to the market structure but also suggest that this has an impact on market segmentation policies and firms' marketing efforts.

10.1016/j.heliyon.2024.e30274.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了日本赛马市场和Keirin一骑定胜负的市场结构差异如何影响这两个市场中高营业额经营者（主要经营者）对低营业额经营者（次要经营者）的影响。在赛马市场结构中，竞争者较少，主要经营者与次要经营者之间的营业额差异较大。相比之下，在Keirin一骑定胜负的市场结构中，竞争者众多，主要经营者与次要经营者之间的营业额差异较小。面板分析结果显示，在赛马市场中，低营业额经营者受到高营业额经营者的显著影响，而在Keirin一骑定胜负的市场中，低营业额经营者受到高营业额竞争者的影响较小。这些结果不仅表明由于市场结构的不同，企业受到竞争对手的影响程度也不同，还表明这会影响市场细分政策以及企业的营销努力。

abstract.text: We argue and demonstrate that human capital services—health, education and behavioral health—suffer from underutilized human capital. Healthcare providers, teachers, mothers and poor people have significant funds of knowledge about how to improve human capital that they do not use. This problem is not unique to Africa, but it is particularly pernicious in that setting due to historically low state capabilities. We demonstrate measurement methods that establish this gap and discuss approaches to research and policy that could be used to close the gap.

10.1016/j.ijedudev.2024.103093.abstractZh: 我们论证并证明，人力资本服务——如健康、教育和行为健康——因人力资本未被充分利用而受到困扰。医疗保健提供者、教师、母亲以及贫困人群拥有大量关于如何提升人力资本的知识，但这些知识并未被有效利用。这一问题并非非洲所独有，但在非洲这一特定环境下尤为严重，因为历史上该地区的政府能力较低。我们提出了衡量这一差距的方法，并探讨了可用于缩小这一差距的研究与政策方法。

abstract.text: While effective bureaucracy is crucial for state capacity, its decision-making remains a black box. We elicit preferences of 900+ real-world public procurement officials in Finland and Germany. This is an important pursuit as they report having sizeable discretion and minimal extrinsic incentives. Through conjoint experiments, we identify the relative importance of multiple features of procurement outcomes. Officials prioritize avoiding unexpectedly high prices over seeking low prices. Avoiding winners with prior bad performance is the most important feature. Officials avoid very low competition, while litigation risks and regional favoritism matter less. Preferences and office interests appear well-aligned among bureaucrats.

10.1016/j.jebo.2024.106716.abstractZh: 虽然有效的官僚机构对于国家治理能力至关重要，但其决策过程仍然是一个谜。我们对芬兰和德国的900多名实际公共采购官员的偏好进行了调查。这一研究非常重要，因为这些官员表示他们拥有相当大的自由裁量权，并且外部激励很少。通过联合实验，我们确定了采购结果中多个因素的相对重要性。官员们更重视避免意外的高价，而不是追求低价。避免以往表现不佳的胜出者是最重要的影响因素。官员们也避免非常低的竞争，而诉讼风险和地区性偏袒的影响则较小。官员们的偏好和办公利益似乎是一致的。

abstract.text: Rivalry in consumption generates variation in the choice sets decision-makers face. Neglecting such variation generates biased demand estimates. Whereas previous research used information from periodic inventory systems to correct this bias, this study instead uses novel data from a real-time inventory system that records all public charging sessions by electric vehicles in a residential area of Amsterdam. For each transaction I can reconstruct a user’s exact set of available alternatives at the time of arrival which allows me to impose deterministic choice set constraints. I show that this significantly improves demand forecasts for local charging facilities, with estimated differences between observed and latent demand reaching up to 40 percentage points at some locations. For the current demand and infrastructure, consumption rivalry however remains a local phenomenon limited to peak hours. A policy analysis suggests that it is not cost effective to install more capacity just to mitigate consumption rivalry. Instead, it may be better to implement policies aimed at increasing the utilization of existing capacity.

10.1016/j.jeem.2024.102929.abstractZh: 消费竞争会导致决策者面临的选择集出现差异。忽略这种差异会导致需求估计出现偏差。以往的研究利用周期性库存系统的数据来纠正这种偏差，而本研究则采用来自实时库存系统的新颖数据，该系统记录了阿姆斯特丹某居民区内电动汽车的所有公共充电行为。通过每笔交易，我可以重建用户在到达时的具体可用选择集，从而施加确定性选择集约束。研究表明，这种方法显著改善了当地充电设施的需求预测，在某些地点，实际需求与潜在需求之间的差距可达40个百分点。然而，就当前的需求和基础设施而言，消费竞争仍然是一种仅限于高峰时段的局部现象。政策分析表明，仅仅为了缓解消费竞争而增加容量并不具有成本效益。相反，实施旨在提高现有容量利用率的政策可能更为有效。

abstract.text: Prescription drug insurance increasingly imposes prior authorization (requiring providers to request coverage before claim approval) to manage utilization. Prior authorization has been criticized because of its administrative burden on providers. The primary alternative to managing utilization is imposing out-of-pocket (OOP) payment to incentivize beneficiaries to seek lower-cost care, effectively providing beneficiaries with partial insurance. Would beneficiaries prefer indirectly paying for prior authorization through higher premiums; or would they prefer prior authorization was replaced by higher OOP costs? This tradeoff depends on how much OOP costs could be displaced by prior authorization, which depends on their relative impact on demand. I estimate the effect of prior authorization and OOP costs on pharmaceutical demand in Medicare Part D, addressing endogeneity caused by unobserved drug quality and selection into plans. Despite criticism of prior authorization, I find that Medicare beneficiaries would prefer higher premiums to pay for prior authorization, over higher OOP costs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102830.abstractZh: 处方药保险越来越多地采用预先授权机制（要求医疗服务提供者在进行索赔批准前申请覆盖），以管理用药情况。预先授权机制因其给医疗服务提供者带来的行政负担而受到批评。管理用药情况的主要替代方案是实施自付费用制度，以激励受益人寻求成本较低的医疗服务，从而为受益人提供部分保险。受益人是否更倾向于通过更高的保费间接支付预先授权费用，还是希望预先授权被更高的自付费用所取代？这种权衡取决于预先授权所能替代的自付费用程度，而这又取决于其对需求的相对影响。我估算了预先授权和自付费用对Medicare Part D中药品需求的影響，同时考虑了因未观察到的药品质量和选择计划所带来的内生性问题。尽管预先授权机制存在批评，但我发现，与更高的自付费用相比，Medicare受益人更倾向于支付更高的保费来支付预先授权费用。

abstract.text: A major policy concern across public vaccination programs is non-compliance. Exploiting Danish population data and three national reforms in regression discontinuity designs, we document the effects of reminders for childhood vaccination coverage. Retrospective reminders are primarily effective for families with small children and when sent out close to the recommended vaccination age. Digital and postal reminders are equally effective. Prospective reminders increase timely vaccinations in later childhood and help reaching high coverage for new vaccines in increasingly complex vaccination programs. While reminders prompt additional preventive care for focal children, we find no spillovers to other health behaviors or relatives.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102832.abstractZh: 公共疫苗接种计划中的一个主要政策问题是患者不配合接种。通过利用丹麦的人口数据以及三种基于回归不连续设计的全国性改革措施，我们研究了提醒措施对儿童疫苗接种覆盖率的影响。回顾性提醒对有小孩的家庭尤其有效，且通常在推荐接种年龄附近发出。数字提醒和纸质提醒的效果相当。前瞻性提醒能够增加儿童后期及时接种疫苗的比例，并有助于在日益复杂的疫苗接种计划中达到较高的新疫苗接种率。虽然提醒措施促使儿童接受额外的预防保健，但我们并未发现其对其他健康行为或亲属产生任何溢出效应。

abstract.text: This paper uses the gradual implementation of a primary healthcare (PHC) intervention in Costa Rica to examine the long-term effect of PHC on mortality. Nine years after opening a primary care center, known as a Health Area, there was an associated 13% reduction in age-adjusted mortality rate in the assigned patient population. The effect was highest among adults over 65 years of age and for those with noncommunicable diseases, such as cardiovascular-related causes of death. We also show that as Health Areas opened, more individuals sought care at primary care clinics, while fewer sought care at emergency rooms; these changes may have partially mediated the effect of the intervention on mortality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102833.abstractZh: 本文以哥斯达黎加逐步实施初级医疗保健干预为例，研究初级医疗保健对死亡率的长期影响。在设立一个被称为“健康区”的初级保健中心九年后，该区域的患者年龄调整死亡率下降了13%。这一效果在65岁以上的成年人以及患有非传染性疾病（如心血管疾病导致的死亡）的人群中最为显著。我们还发现，随着健康区的设立，更多患者选择到初级保健诊所就诊，而到急诊室就诊的患者数量则有所减少；这些变化可能部分解释了该干预措施对死亡率的影响。

abstract.text: Despite the growing prevalence of insufficient sleep among individuals, we still know little about the labour market return to sleep. To address this gap, we use longitudinal data from Germany and leverage exogenous fluctuations in sleep duration caused by variations in time and local sunset times. Our findings reveal that a one-hour increase in weekly sleep is associated with a 1.6 percentage point rise in employment and a 3.4% increase in weekly earnings. Such effect on earnings stems from productivity improvements given that the number of working hours decreases with longer sleep duration. We also identify a key mechanism driving these effects, namely the enhanced mental well-being experienced by individuals who sleep longer hours.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102840.abstractZh: 尽管睡眠不足在人群中越来越普遍，但我们对睡眠对劳动力市场的影响知之甚少。为了填补这一空白，我们利用了德国的纵向数据，并借助因时间和当地日落时间变化导致的睡眠时长外生波动。研究发现，每周睡眠时间增加一小时，与就业率上升1.6个百分点以及每周收入增加3.4%相关。这种对收入的影响源于生产力的提升，因为睡眠时间越长，工作小时数就会减少。我们还发现了推动这些效应的关键机制，即睡眠时间较长的个体所体验到的心理健康状况有所改善。

abstract.text: We examine differences in the prescribing of psychiatric medications to lower-income and higher-income children in the Canadian province of Ontario using rich administrative data that includes diagnosis codes and physician identifiers. Our most striking finding is that conditional on diagnosis and medical history, low-income children are more likely to be prescribed antipsychotics and benzodiazepines than higher-income children who see the same doctors. These are drugs with potentially dangerous side effects that ideally should be prescribed to children only under narrowly proscribed circumstances. Lower-income children are also less likely to be prescribed SSRIs, the first-line treatment for depression and anxiety conditional on diagnosis. Hence, socioeconomic differences in the prescribing of psychotropic medications to children persist even in the context of universal public health insurance and universal drug coverage.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102841.abstractZh: 我们研究了在加拿大安大略省，针对低收入和高收入儿童开具精神药物的情况差异，研究数据来自包含诊断代码和医生识别信息的丰富行政数据。我们发现，在相同的诊断和病史条件下，低收入儿童更可能被开具抗精神病药和苯二氮卓类药物，而高收入儿童在同样看医生的情况下则较少被开具这些药物。这些药物可能存在危险的副作用，理想情况下只应在严格规定的条件下才应用于儿童。此外，低收入儿童被开具SSRIs的可能性也较低，而SSRIs是治疗和缓解抑郁及焦虑症状的一线药物。因此，即使在全民公共卫生保险和全民药物覆盖的背景下，儿童精神药物的使用仍存在社会经济差异。

abstract.text: Adjusting the valuation of life along the (i) person-specific (age, health, wealth) and (ii) mortality risk-specific (beneficial or detrimental, temporary or permanent changes) dimensions is relevant in prioritizing healthcare interventions. These adjustments are provided by solving a life cycle model of consumption, leisure and health choices and the associated Hicksian variations for mortality changes. The calibrated model yields plausible Values of Life Year between 154K$ and 200K$ and Values of Statistical Life close to 6.0M$. The willingness to pay (WTP) and to accept (WTA) compensation are equal and symmetric for one-shot beneficial and detrimental changes in mortality risk. However, permanent, and expected longevity changes are both associated with larger willingness for gains, relative to losses, and larger WTA than WTP. Ageing lowers both variations via falling resources and health, lower marginal continuation utility of living and decreasing longevity returns of changes in mortality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102842.abstractZh: 调整生命价值的评估方式，考虑两个方面：一是个人特定的因素（年龄、健康状况、财富），二是与死亡风险相关的因素（有益或有害的变化，临时或永久性的变化）。这种调整是通过解决一个包含消费、休闲和健康选择的生命周期模型以及与之相关的死亡风险变化的希克斯变分模型来实现的。经过校准的模型得出的生命价值在15.4万美元到20万美元之间，而统计生命价值接近60万美元。对于一次性有益或有害的死亡风险变化，支付意愿和接受意愿是相等且对称的。然而，永久性的和预期的长寿变化都伴随着更大的收益意愿，相对于损失而言，并且接受补偿的意愿大于支付补偿的意愿。随着年龄的增长，由于资源和健康状况的下降，这两种变分都会降低，同时生活的边际持续效用也会降低，死亡风险变化带来的长寿回报也会减少。

abstract.text: We investigate the effects of introducing population-wide free-of-charge Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination programs on the targeted adolescent cohorts and their siblings. For identification, we rely on regression discontinuity designs and high-quality Danish administrative data to exploit that date of birth determines program eligibility. We find that the programs increased the HPV vaccine take-up of both the targeted children (53.2 percentage points for girls and 36.0 percentage points for boys) and their older same-sex siblings (4.5 percentage points for sisters and 3.5 percentage points for brothers). We show that while the direct effects of the programs reduced HPV vaccine take-up inequality, the spillover effects, in contrast, contributed to an increase in vaccine take-up inequality highlighting the potential importance of spillover effects in the determination of distributional consequences of public health programs. Finally, we find some evidence of cross-vaccine spillovers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102843.abstractZh: 我们研究了在全人口范围内实施免费人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）疫苗接种计划对目标青少年群体及其兄弟姐妹的影响。为了进行分析，我们采用了回归不连续设计，并利用了高质量的丹麦行政数据，这些数据能够准确反映出生日期与疫苗接种资格之间的关系。研究发现，该疫苗接种计划增加了目标儿童（女孩增加了53.2个百分点，男孩增加了36.0个百分点）以及他们年长的同性兄弟姐妹的疫苗接种率（姐妹增加了4.5个百分点，兄弟增加了3.5个百分点）。我们指出，虽然该计划的直接效果减少了HPV疫苗接种的不平等现象，但溢出效应却导致了疫苗接种不平等的加剧，这凸显了溢出效应在决定公共卫生计划分配后果中的潜在重要性。最后，我们还发现了一些关于不同疫苗之间溢出效应的证据。

abstract.text: We study the impact of scope-of-practice laws in a highly regulated and important policy setting, the provision of medication-assisted treatment for opioid use disorder. We consider two natural experiments generated by policy changes at the state and federal level that allow nurse practitioners more practice autonomy. Both experiments show that liberalizations of prescribing authority lead to large improvements in access to care. Further, we use rich address-level data to answer key policy questions. Expanding nurse practitioner prescribing authority reduces urban-rural disparities in health care access. Additionally, expanded autonomy increases access to care provided by physicians, driven by complementarities between providers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102844.abstractZh: 我们研究了在高度监管且重要的政策环境下，执业范围法律对阿片类药物使用障碍药物辅助治疗提供的影响。我们考虑了由州和联邦层面的政策变化引发的两次自然实验，这些实验赋予了护士执业者更多的执业自主权。两次实验均表明，处方权力的放宽显著改善了医疗服务的可及性。此外，我们利用丰富的地址级数据来回答关键的政策问题。扩大护士执业者的处方权减少了城乡之间在医疗服务可及性方面的差异。同时，更大的自主权增加了患者获得医生医疗服务的可能性，这得益于医疗服务提供者之间的互补性。

abstract.text: Young people in sub-Saharan Africa are particularly at high risk of sexually transmitted infections. Little is known about their preferences and even less about their association with risky sexual behaviour. We conducted incentivized economic experiments to measure risk, time and prosocial preferences in Zimbabwe. Preferences measured at baseline predict biomarker and self-reported measures of risky sexual behaviour gathered 12 months later. We find robust evidence that individuals more altruistic at baseline are more likely to be Herpes Simplex Virus Type-2 (HSV-2) positive 12 months later. Analysis by sex shows this association is driven by our sample of women. Having more sexual partners is associated with greater risk tolerance amongst men and greater impatience amongst women. Results highlight heterogeneity in the association between preferences and risky sexual behaviour.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102845.abstractZh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的年轻人特别容易感染性传播疾病。关于他们的偏好知之甚少，更不用说与危险性行为之间的关联了。我们在津巴布韦进行了激励性经济实验，以测量风险、时间以及亲社会偏好。在基线阶段测量的偏好能够预测12个月后收集到的生物标志物数据以及自我报告的危险性行为情况。我们发现，在基线阶段表现出更多利他行为的个体，在12个月后更有可能感染单纯疱疹病毒2型。按性别分析后，这种关联主要由女性样本所体现。男性拥有更多性伴侣时，风险承受能力更高；而女性则表现出更大的急躁情绪。研究结果凸显了偏好与危险性行为之间关联的多样性。

abstract.text: We examine physician responses to a global information shock and how these impact their patients. We exploit international news over the safety of an innovation in healthcare, the drug-eluting stent. We use data on interventional cardiologists' use of stents to define and measure cardiologists' responsiveness to the initial positive news and link this to their patients' outcomes. We find substantial heterogeneity in responsiveness to news. Patients treated by cardiologists who respond slowly to the initial positive news have fewer adverse outcomes. This is not due to patient-physician sorting. Instead, our results suggest that the differences are partially driven by slow responders being better at deciding when (not) to use the new technology, which in turn affects their patient outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102846.abstractZh: 我们研究了医生对全球信息冲击的反应，以及这些反应如何影响他们的患者。我们利用国际新闻中关于一种医疗创新——药物洗脱支架的安全性信息。我们通过介入心脏病专家使用支架的数据来定义和衡量医生对最初积极消息的反应，并将其与患者的治疗效果联系起来。我们发现，对消息的反应存在显著的异质性。那些对最初积极消息反应迟缓的心脏病专家所治疗的患者，其不良后果较少。这并不是由于患者与医生的匹配问题。相反，我们的结果表明，这种差异部分是由于反应迟缓的医生更擅长判断何时使用新技术，这反过来又影响了患者的治疗效果。

abstract.text: We introduce a measure of population health that is sensitive to inequality in both age-specific health and lifespan and can be calculated from a health-extended period life table. By allowing for inequality aversion, the measure generalises health-adjusted life expectancy without requiring more data. A transformation of change in the (life-years) measure gives a distributionally sensitive monetary valuation of change in population health and disease burden. Application to Sub-Saharan Africa between 1990 and 2019 reveals that the change in population health is sensitive to allowing for lifespan inequality but is less sensitive to age-specific health inequality. Allowing for distributional sensitivity changes relative burdens of diseases, reduces convergence between the burdens of communicable and non-communicable diseases, and so could influence disease prioritisation. It increases the value of health improvements relative to GDP.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102847.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种衡量人口健康的方法，该方法能够敏感地反映年龄特定健康状况和寿命方面的不平等现象，并且可以通过健康延长期生命表来计算。通过考虑对不平等的厌恶，该方法可以在不需要更多数据的情况下，对健康调整后的预期寿命进行概括。对（寿命年数）指标进行转换后，可以得到一个对人口健康变化和疾病负担具有分布敏感性的货币估值。将该方法应用于1990年至2019年的撒哈拉以南非洲地区，发现人口健康的变化对于考虑寿命方面的不平等是敏感的，但对于年龄特定健康状况的不平等则不太敏感。考虑分布敏感性可以改变疾病的相对负担，减少传染病和非传染病负担之间的趋同，从而可能影响疾病的优先级排序。此外，该方法还能提高健康改善相对于GDP的价值。

abstract.text: This article investigates patterns of pharmaceutical development activity around the 2012 creation of the FDA's Breakthrough Therapy Designation (BTD). The BTD introduced regulatory flexibility and support to avoid ethical challenges created by experimental therapies of exceptional performance in early stage clinical trials. We argue that the program's design indirectly created substantial incentives for the industry to pursue the designation. Consistent with this hypothesis, our evidence links the creation of the program with a substantial increase in the number of new drug indications entering the clinical trial process. This surge in introductions has resulted in a discernible increase in approvals, which has manifested with a lag and may strengthen in the future. Countering theoretical predictions, BTD incentives have not led to increased risk taking in project selection.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102855.abstractZh: 本文研究了2012年FDA推出突破性疗法认定（BTD）制度后，制药行业相关活动的模式。该制度引入了监管灵活性，并提供了支持，以应对早期临床试验中表现卓越的实验性疗法所引发的伦理挑战。我们认为，该制度的设计间接为制药行业提供了大量激励，促使他们争取这一认定。与此假设一致的是，我们的证据表明，该制度的推出与进入临床试验的新药物适应症数量显著增加有关。这一数量的激增导致了批准数量的明显增加，这一变化存在滞后现象，未来可能会进一步加剧。与理论预测相反，BTD的激励措施并未导致项目选择中的风险增加。

abstract.text: We design a novel experiment to identify aversion to pure (univariate) health inequality separately from aversion to income-related and income-caused health inequality. Participants allocate resources to determine health of individuals. Identification comes from random variation in resource productivity and information on income and its causal effect. We gather data (26,286 observations) from a sample of UK adults (n = 337) and estimate pooled and participant-specific social preferences while accounting for noise. The median person has strong aversion to pure health inequality, challenging the health maximisation objective of economic evaluation. Aversion to health inequality is even stronger when it is related to income. However, the median person prioritises health of poorer individuals less than is assumed in the standard measure of income-related health inequality. On average, aversion to that inequality does not become stronger when low income is known to cause ill-health. There is substantial heterogeneity in all three types of inequality aversion.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102856.abstractZh: 我们设计了一项新颖的实验，旨在区分对纯健康不平等的厌恶与对与收入相关及由收入引起的健康不平等的厌恶。参与者需要分配资源来决定个人的健康状况。这种区分基于资源生产力的随机变化以及关于收入及其因果效应的信息。我们从英国成年人样本中收集了26,286个观测数据（样本量为337人），并估算了综合社会偏好以及个体特定的社会偏好，同时考虑了噪声的影响。中位数的个体对纯健康不平等有着强烈的厌恶，这与经济评估中追求的健康最大化目标相矛盾。当健康不平等与收入相关时，这种厌恶更为明显。然而，中位数个体对贫困个体的健康状况的优先级低于标准衡量方法中假设的那样。平均而言，当已知低收入会导致健康问题时，对那种健康不平等的厌恶并不会增强。三种类型的不平等厌恶都存在显著的异质性。

abstract.text: Mainstream health economic theory implies that an expected gain in health-related quality of life (HRQoL) produces the same value for consumers, regardless of baseline health. Several strands of recent research call this implication into question. Generalized Risk-Adjusted Cost-Effectiveness (GRACE) demonstrates theoretically that baseline health status influences value, so long as consumers are not risk-neutral over health. Prior empirical literature casts doubt on risk-neutral expected utility-maximization in the health domain. We estimate utility over HRQoL in a nationally representative U.S. population and use our estimates to measure risk preferences over health. We find that individuals are risk-seeking at low levels of health, become risk-averse at health equal to 0.485 (measured on a 0-1 scale), and are most risk-averse at perfect health (coefficient of relative risk aversion = 4.51). We develop the resulting implications for medical decision making, cost-effectiveness analyses, and the proper theory of health-related decision making under uncertainty.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102857.abstractZh: 主流健康经济理论认为，预期在健康相关生活质量上的提升能够为消费者带来相同的价值，而无需考虑消费者的基础健康状况。然而，最近的一些研究对这一观点提出了质疑。广义风险调整成本效益分析表明，只要消费者在健康风险方面不是风险中性的，基础健康状况确实会影响价值。先前的实证文献对健康领域的风险中性期望效用最大化理论提出了质疑。我们对美国全国代表性人群的健康相关生活质量效用进行了估算，并利用这些估算结果来衡量消费者对健康的风险偏好。研究发现，个体在健康水平较低时倾向于承担风险；当健康水平达到0.485（以0-1尺度衡量）时，个体变得风险规避；而在完全健康状态下，个体表现出最强的风险规避倾向（相对风险厌恶系数=4.51）。这些发现为医疗决策、成本效益分析以及在不确定性下的健康相关决策制定提供了重要启示。

abstract.text: Most transplant centers require candidates be insured before they can join the waitlist for a deceased donor organ. After the Affordable Care Act, many uninsured Americans gained improved access to Medicaid. I examine the effect of this increase in access to insurance and find that Medicaid expansions significantly increase Medicaid-insured waitlist registrations by 39% and deceased donor transplants received by 44%, but the increase in registrations is larger for candidates who live closer to a transplant center. Additionally I show that most of these registrations would have been privately insured otherwise but provide suggestive evidence that this is better explained by improved access to subsidized private coverage due to other ACA reforms than from candidates with private coverage before the ACA switching to Medicaid coverage after expansion. This suggests that although the ACA improved access to the transplantation system, access is still limited for candidates who live far from centers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102858.abstractZh: 大多数移植中心要求候选人在加入已故捐赠者器官等待名单之前必须拥有保险。根据《平价医疗法案》的实施，许多无保险的美国人获得了更好的医疗保障。我研究了这种保险获取机会增加的影响，发现医疗补助政策的扩展使拥有医疗补助的等待名单注册人数增加了39%，已故捐赠者移植手术接受人数增加了44%。不过，对于居住在移植中心附近的人来说，注册人数的增加幅度更大。此外，我还表明，这些注册人数中的大部分原本可能会选择私人保险，但有证据表明，这种增加更多是由于《平价医疗法案》规定的其他改革措施改善了私人保险的获取机会，而非因为候选人在《平价医疗法案》实施前就拥有私人保险，并在法案扩展后转而使用医疗补助保险。这表明，尽管《平价医疗法案》改善了移植系统的可及性，但对于居住在远离移植中心的人来说，可及性仍然有限。

abstract.text: This paper examines the relationship between immigration enforcement and institutionalization rates of the elderly. Exploiting the staggered implementation of the Secure Communities (SC) immigration enforcement program across U.S. counties from 2008 through 2014, we show that SC led to a 0.26 percentage points (6.8 percent) increase in the likelihood that Americans aged 65 and above live in an institution. Supportive of supply shocks in the household services market as a central mechanism, we find that the elderly who are most likely to purchase domestic worker services are also the most likely to move into nursing homes following the implementation of SC. Additionally, we find suggestive evidence of significant reductions in the work hours of housekeepers, personal care aides, and home health workers hinting at the critical role of negative supply shocks in occupations that facilitate aging in community.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102859.abstractZh: 本文探讨了移民执法与老年人入住机构率之间的关系。通过分析2008年至2014年间美国各县实施“安全社区”移民执法计划的进程，我们发现该计划使65岁及以上的美国人入住机构的几率增加了0.26个百分点（即6.8%）。我们认为，家庭服务市场的供应冲击是这一现象的核心机制。研究发现，那些最有可能购买国内劳动力服务的老年人，在“安全社区”计划实施后也最有可能入住养老院。此外，我们还发现，家政人员、个人护理助手和家庭健康工作者的工作时间显著减少，这表明在促进社区老龄化过程中，供应方面的负面冲击起着关键作用。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of raising the minimum legal sale age of tobacco to 21 (i.e., "T21"). We estimate difference-in-differences models using the Monitoring the Future (MTF) survey data and Nielsen Retail Scanner data from 2012 to 2019. Outcomes include cigarette and e-cigarette use and sales. We find sizable reductions in e-cigarette and cigarette use for 12th graders. T21 also reduced cigarette sales by 12.4 % and e-cigarette sales by 69.3 % in counties with the highest percent quartile of individuals under 21 years of age. In terms of mechanisms, we find that T21 increases ID checking and perceived risks of using both products.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102860.abstractZh: 我们研究了将烟草的最低合法销售年龄提高到21岁（即“T21”）的影响。我们使用《未来监测》调查数据和2012至2019年的Nielsen零售扫描数据，建立了差异-差异模型。研究结果显示，12年级学生的电子香烟使用和销售量显著减少。在21岁以下人口比例最高的县，T21政策使香烟销售减少了12.4%，电子香烟销售减少了69.3%。从机制角度来看，我们发现T21政策增加了对消费者的身份核实，并提升了使用这两种产品的风险感知。

abstract.text: We study intertemporal tradeoffs that health authorities face when considering the control of an epidemic using innovative curative medical treatments. We set up a dynamically controlled susceptible-infected-recovered (SIR) model for an epidemic in which patients can be asymptomatic, and we analyze the optimality conditions of the sequence of cure expenses decided by health authorities at the onset of the drug innovation process. We show that analytical conclusions are ambiguous because of their dependence on parameter values. As an application, we focus on the case study of hepatitis C, the treatment for which underwent a major upheaval when curative drugs were introduced in 2014. We calibrate our controlled SIR model using French data and simulate optimal policies. We show that the optimal policy entails some front loading of the intertemporal budget. The analysis demonstrates how beneficial intertemporal budgeting can be compared to non-forward-looking constant budget allocation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102861.abstractZh: 我们研究了卫生当局在考虑使用创新治疗方法来控制疫情时所面临的跨时性权衡问题。我们建立了一个动态控制的易感者-感染者-康复者（SIR）模型，用于描述疫情情况，其中患者可能是无症状的。我们分析了卫生当局在药物创新初期决定治疗费用顺序的最优条件。我们发现，由于分析结论依赖于参数值，因此存在不确定性。作为应用案例，我们重点关注丙型肝炎的治疗情况，该疾病在2014年引入治疗性药物后发生了重大变革。我们使用法国数据对控制型SIR模型进行校准，并模拟最优政策。结果表明，最优政策需要提前安排跨时性预算分配。分析表明，与不考虑未来的固定预算分配相比，跨时性预算分配具有更高的效益。

abstract.text: There is considerable controversy about what causes (in)effectiveness of physician performance pay in improving the quality of care. Using a behavioral experiment with German primary-care physicians, we study the incentive effect of performance pay on service provision and quality of care. To explore whether variations in quality are based on the incentive scheme and the interplay with physicians' real-world profit orientation and patient-regarding motivations, we link administrative data on practice characteristics and survey data on physicians' attitudes with experimental data. We find that, under performance pay, quality increases by about 7pp compared to baseline capitation. While the effect increases with the severity of illness, the bonus level does not significantly affect the quality of care. Data linkage indicates that primary-care physicians in high-profit practices provide a lower quality of care. Physicians' other-regarding motivations and attitudes are significant drivers of high treatment quality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102862.abstractZh: 关于为何医生绩效薪酬在提高护理质量方面效果不佳的问题，存在相当大的争议。我们通过一项针对德国初级保健医生的行为实验，研究了绩效薪酬对服务提供和护理质量的影响。为了探讨质量差异是否源于激励机制，以及这种机制与医生现实中的利润导向和以患者为中心的动机之间的相互作用，我们将关于诊所特征的行政数据与关于医生态度的调查数据，以及实验数据进行了关联分析。研究发现，在绩效薪酬制度下，护理质量比基准下的按服务收费制度提高了约7个百分点。虽然这种效应随着疾病严重程度的增加而增强，但奖金水平对护理质量的影响并不显著。数据关联分析表明，在高利润诊所中工作的初级保健医生所提供的护理质量较低。医生对其他方面的动机和态度是高质量治疗的重要驱动因素。

abstract.text: In countries with dual public and private healthcare systems, individuals are often incentivized to purchase private health insurance through subsidies and penalty. We use administrative data from Australia to study how high-income earners respond on both the intensive and extensive margins to the simultaneous withdrawal of a premium subsidy, and the increase of a tax penalty. We estimate regression discontinuity models by exploiting discontinuous changes in the penalty and subsidy rates. Our setting is particularly interesting because means testing creates different incentives at the extensive and intensive margins. Specifically, we could expect to see higher take-up of insurance coupled with downgrading to less expensive plans. We find evidence that the penalty - despite being large in value - only has a modest effect on take-up. Our results show little evidence of downgrading, which is consistent with a low price elasticity for the high-income earners we study.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102863.abstractZh: 在拥有公共和私人双重医疗系统的国家，个人通常会受到补贴和罚款的激励来购买私人健康保险。我们利用澳大利亚的行政数据来研究高收入人群在保费补贴同时取消以及税收罚款增加的情况下，如何在密集型和广度型两个层面上做出反应。我们通过利用罚款和补贴率的突然变化来估计回归不连续模型。我们的研究背景特别有趣，因为资产核查在广度和密集型层面上创造了不同的激励因素。具体来说，我们预期会看到保险覆盖率的提高，同时也会伴随着转向更便宜的保险计划。我们发现，尽管罚款金额较大，但对保险覆盖率的提升影响有限。我们的研究结果几乎没有显示出转向更便宜保险计划的迹象，这与我们所研究的高收入人群对价格弹性较低的情况是一致的。

abstract.text: The paper estimates the causal effect of a health treatment on patients' beliefs, preferences and memories about the treatment. It exploits a natural experiment which occurred in the United Kingdom during the COVID-19 vaccination campaign. UK residents could choose to opt into the vaccination program, but not which vaccine they received. The assignment to a vaccine offered little objective information for learning about its qualities, but triggered strong psychological demand for reassuring beliefs. We surveyed a sample of UK residents about their beliefs on the different COVID-19 vaccines before and after receiving their jab. Before vaccination, individuals exhibit similar prior beliefs and stated preferences about the different vaccines. After vaccination, however, they update their beliefs overly optimistically about the safety and effectiveness of the vaccine they received, state that they would have chosen it if they could, and have distorted memories about their past beliefs. These results cannot be explained by conventional experience effects. At the aggregated level, they show that random assignment to a health treatment predicts a polarization of opinions about its quality. At the individual level, these findings provide evidence in line with the predictions of motivated beliefs and over-inference from weak signals in a real-world health setting.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102864.abstractZh: 该论文估计了某种健康治疗对患者关于该治疗的信念、偏好和记忆的因果效应。研究利用了在英国COVID-19疫苗接种活动期间发生的一项自然实验。英国居民可以选择参与疫苗接种计划，但无法选择接种哪种疫苗。被分配到某种疫苗并没有提供关于其特性的客观信息，但却引发了强烈的心理需求，即希望获得令人安心的信念。我们对一些英国居民在接种疫苗前后对不同COVID-19疫苗的信念进行了调查。在接种疫苗之前，个体对不同疫苗的先前信念和偏好大致相同。然而，在接种疫苗后，他们对所接种疫苗的安全性和效果持过于乐观的态度，声称如果可以选择的话，他们会选择这种疫苗，并且对过去的信念产生了扭曲的记忆。这些结果无法用传统的经验效应来解释。在总体层面上，随机分配到某种健康治疗的情况下，人们的意见会对其质量产生两极分化。在个体层面上，这些发现支持了动机性信念和从微弱信号中过度推断的预测。

abstract.text: The US government increasingly provides public health insurance coverage through private firms. We examine associated welfare implications for beneficiaries, using a 'revealed preference' framework based on beneficiaries' program attrition rates. Focusing on the Medicaid program in New York State, we exploit quasi-random variation in the initial assignment at birth to public versus private Medicaid based on birth weight. We find that infants assigned to private Medicaid at birth are less likely to subsequently leave Medicaid. We provide suggestive evidence that reduced attrition reflects beneficiary responses to improved program quality, rather than alternative mechanisms such as private Medicaid plans reducing re-enrollment barriers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102865.abstractZh: 美国政府越来越多地通过私人公司提供公共健康保险。我们基于受益人的项目退出率，使用“揭示性偏好”框架来研究这对受益人的福利影响。以纽约州的医疗补助计划为例，我们利用了出生时就被分配到公共或私人医疗补助计划的准随机差异，这些差异基于出生体重。我们发现，出生时被分配到私人医疗补助计划的婴儿，随后离开医疗补助计划的可能性较低。我们有证据表明，减少的退出率反映了受益人对项目质量改善的反应，而不是其他机制，比如私人医疗补助计划降低了重新加入的障碍。

abstract.text: Nurses are increasingly providing primary care, yet the literature on cost-sharing has paid little attention to nurse visits. We employ a staggered difference-in-differences design to examine the effects of adopting a 10-euro copayment for nurse visits on the use of public primary care among Finnish adults. We find that the copayment reduced nurse visits by 9%-10% during a one-year follow-up. There is heterogeneity by income in absolute terms, but not in relative terms. The spillover effects on general practitioner (GP) use are negative but small, with varying statistical significance. We also analyze the subsequent nationwide abolition of the copayment. However, we refrain from drawing causal conclusions from this due to the lack of credibility in the parallel trends assumption. Overall, our analysis suggests that moderate copayments can create a greater barrier to access for low-income individuals. We also provide an example of using a pre-analysis plan for retrospective observational data.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102866.abstractZh: 护士越来越多地提供初级医疗服务，但关于费用分担的文献很少关注护士的诊疗服务。我们采用分阶段差异设计来研究对芬兰成年人实施10欧元诊疗服务费用分担政策对公共初级医疗服务使用的影响。研究发现，在为期一年的跟踪调查中，费用分担政策使护士的诊疗服务减少了9%-10%。不同收入群体的绝对费用分担差异显著，但相对差异并不明显。对全科医生服务使用的溢出效应是负面的，但影响较小，且统计显著性不同。我们还分析了随后全国范围内取消该费用分担政策的情况。然而，由于无法验证平行趋势假设的可信度，我们未能从这一分析中得出因果结论。总体而言，我们的分析表明，适度的费用分担政策可能会给低收入人群带来更大的就医障碍。我们还提供了一个使用预分析计划对回顾性观察数据进行分析的案例。

abstract.text: Behavioral adjustments to mitigate increasing risk of STIs can increase or decrease the likelihood of pregnancy. This paper measures the effects of the arrival and spread of AIDS across U.S. cities in the 1980s and 1990s on births and abortions.
