I show that the AIDS epidemic increased the birth rate by 0.55 percent and the abortion rate by 1.77 percent. I find support for two underlying mechanisms to explain the increase in pregnancies. Some women opted into monogamous partnerships in response to the AIDS epidemic, with a corresponding increase in the marriage rate and improvement in infant health. Others switched from prescription contraceptive methods to condoms. These behavioral changes lowered the incidence of other sexually transmitted infections, but increased both planned and unplanned pregnancies.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102867.abstractZh: 为减轻性传播感染风险而做出的行为调整，可能会增加或减少怀孕的可能性。本文研究了20世纪80年代和90年代艾滋病在美国城市的传播对出生率和堕胎率的影响。研究表明，艾滋病疫情使出生率上升了0.55%，堕胎率上升了1.77%。我提出了两种机制来解释怀孕数量的增加：一些女性因艾滋病疫情而选择维持一夫一妻制伴侣关系，这相应地提高了结婚率并改善了婴儿健康；另一些女性则从处方避孕药转向使用避孕套。这些行为改变降低了其他性传播感染的发生率，但增加了计划内和计划外的怀孕情况。

abstract.text: This paper shows that selection incentives in downstream markets distort upstream prices. It is possible for inputs to be priced above the value that the good has for final consumers. We apply this idea to pharmaceutical companies selling drugs to a health insurance market with selection problems. We specify the conditions under which drugs are sold at prices exceeding treatment value. Another feature of the model is an excessive private incentive to reduce market size, e.g. in the form of personalized medicine.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102868.abstractZh: 本文指出，下游市场中的选择激励会扭曲上游价格。输入品的定价可能高于最终消费者所感受到的价值。我们将这一理念应用于向存在选择问题的健康保险市场销售药物的制药公司。我们明确了药物以超过治疗价值的价格出售的条件。该模型的另一个特点是，私人存在过度减少市场规模的动机，例如通过个性化医疗来实现。

abstract.text: This paper assesses analytical strategies that respect the bounded-count nature of health outcomes encountered often in empirical applications. Absent in the literature is a comprehensive discussion and critique of strategies for analyzing and understanding such data. The paper's goal is to provide an in-depth consideration of prominent issues arising in and strategies for undertaking such analyses, emphasizing the merits and limitations of various analytical tools empirical researchers may contemplate. Three main topics are covered. First, bounded-count health outcomes' measurement properties are reviewed and their implications assessed. Second, issues arising when bounded-count outcomes are the objects of concern in evaluations are described. Third, the (conditional) probability and moment structures of bounded-count outcomes are derived and corresponding specification and estimation strategies presented with particular attention to partial effects. Many questions may be asked of such data in health research and a researcher's choice of analytical method is often consequential.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102875.abstractZh: 本文评估了那些能够尊重健康结果有限数量特性的分析策略，这类特性在实证研究中经常遇到。目前文献中缺乏对这类数据分析策略的全面讨论和批判。本文旨在深入探讨进行此类分析时出现的突出问题及应对策略，强调实证研究人员可能考虑的各种分析工具的优缺点。文章主要涵盖三个主题：首先，回顾了有限数量健康结果的测量特性及其影响；其次，描述了在评估中涉及有限数量结果时可能出现的问题；第三，推导了有限数量结果的（条件）概率和矩结构，并提出了相应的规范和估计策略，特别关注部分效应。在健康研究中，这类数据可能会引发许多问题，研究人员选择分析方法往往具有重大影响。

abstract.text: Prior research has found that a high level of residential racial segregation, or the degree to which racial/ethnic groups are isolated from one another, is associated with worsened infant health outcomes, particularly among non-Hispanic (NH) Black infant populations. However, because exposure to segregation is non-random, it is unclear whether and to what extent segregation is causally linked to infant health. To overcome this empirical limitation, we leverage exogenous variation in the placement of railroad tracks in the 19th century to predict contemporary segregation, an approach first introduced by Ananat (2011). In alignment with prior literature, we find that residential segregation has statistically significant associations with negative birth outcomes among Black infant populations in the area. Using OLS methods underestimates the negative impacts of segregation on infant health. We fail to detect comparable effects on health outcomes among NH White infant populations. Further, we identify several key mechanisms by which residential segregation could influence health outcomes among Black infant populations, including lower access to prenatal care during the first trimester, higher levels of anti-Black prejudice, greater transportation barriers, and increased food insecurity. Given that poor birth outcomes have adverse effects on adults' health and well-being, the findings suggest that in-utero exposure to residential segregation could have important implications for Black-White inequality over the life course.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102876.abstractZh: 先前的研究发现，高水平的住宅种族隔离，即种族/族裔群体之间的隔离程度，与婴儿健康结果的恶化有关，尤其是在非西班牙裔黑人婴儿群体中。然而，由于隔离的暴露并非随机的，因此尚不清楚隔离是否在某种程度上与婴儿健康结果存在因果关系。为了克服这一实证限制，我们利用了19世纪铁路轨道布局的外生变化来预测当代的隔离情况，这一方法最初由Ananat在2011年提出。与先前的研究一致，我们发现住宅隔离与黑人婴儿群体的负面出生结果之间存在统计学上的显著关联。使用OLS方法会低估隔离对婴儿健康的负面影响。我们未能发现非西班牙裔白人婴儿群体在健康结果上的类似影响。此外，我们确定了几种住宅隔离可能影响黑人婴儿群体健康结果的关键机制，包括孕早期产前护理的获取难度增加、针对黑人的偏见加剧、交通障碍增大以及食物不安全问题的增加。鉴于不良出生结果会对成人的健康和福祉产生不利影响，这些发现表明，子宫内暴露于住宅隔离可能对黑人与白人的不平等关系在生命过程中产生重要影响。

abstract.text: Medicaid spends nearly 100 billion dollars annually on home and community-based care for the disabled. Much of this care is provided by personal care aides, few of whom have received training related to the services they provide. We conducted a randomized controlled trial to estimate their demand for training. We find that 13 percent of these caregivers complete training without an incentive. Paying the caregivers four times their hourly wage increases training completion by roughly nine percentage points. Additional experimental variation suggests that among individuals confirmed to be aware of the training, the financial incentive increases completion from 35 to 58 percent. Demand curves based on these results suggest that while many caregivers value the opportunity to train, policies aimed at universal take up require large financial incentives.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102877.abstractZh: 医疗补助每年在针对残疾人的家庭及社区护理上花费近1000亿美元。这些护理工作主要由个人护理助手承担，其中很少有人接受过与所提供服务相关的培训。我们进行了一项随机对照试验，以评估他们对培训的需求。研究发现，有13%的护理助手在没有激励措施的情况下完成了培训。支付护理助手每小时工资的四倍后，培训完成率大约提高了9个百分点。进一步的实验结果显示，在那些被确认了解培训信息的人群中，经济激励措施可将培训完成率从35%提高到58%。根据这些结果得出的需求曲线表明，虽然许多护理助手重视培训机会，但旨在实现普遍接受度的政策需要较大的经济激励。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the interplay between congressional politics, the actions of the executive branch, and hospitals' regulated Medicare payments. We focus on the 2003 Medicare Modernization Act (MMA) and analyze a provision in the law - Section 508 - that raised certain hospitals' regulated payments. We show, via our analysis of the Section 508 program, that Medicare payments are malleable and can be influenced by political dynamics. In the cross-section, hospitals represented by members of Congress who voted "yea" on the MMA were more likely to receive Section 508 payment increases. We interviewed the Secretary of Health and Human Services who oversaw the MMA, and he described how these payment increases were designed to win support for the law. The Section 508 payment increases raised hospitals' activity and spending. Members of Congress representing recipient hospitals received increased campaign contributions after the Section 508 payment increases were extended. Ultimately, our analysis highlights how Medicare payment increases can serve as an appealing tool for legislative leaders working to win votes for wider pieces of legislation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102878.abstractZh: 本文分析了国会政治、行政部门的行为以及医院在医疗保险支付方面的监管关系。我们重点关注2003年的《医疗保险现代化法案》，并分析了该法案中的一项条款——第508条——该条款提高了某些医院的支付金额。通过对第508条条款的分析，我们发现医疗保险支付具有可塑性，并受到政治动态的影响。从横截面来看，那些在《医疗保险现代化法案》上投赞成票的国会议员所代表的医院更有可能获得第508条条款带来的支付增加。我们采访了负责该法案的卫生与公共服务部长，他描述了这些支付增加是为了赢得对法案的支持而设计的。第508条条款的支付增加刺激了医院的活动和支出。在支付增加条款得到延长后，代表这些医院的国会议员获得的竞选捐款也增加了。最终，我们的分析表明，医疗保险支付的增加可以成为立法领导人争取更多立法支持的有吸引力的工具。

abstract.text: Integration of health care services has been promoted in several countries to improve the quality and coordination of care. We investigate the effects of such integration in a model where providers compete on quality to attract patients under regulated prices. We identify countervailing effects of integration on quality of care. While integration makes coordination of care more profitable for providers due to bundled payments, it also softens competition as patient choice is restricted. We also identify circumstances due to asymmetries across providers and/or services under which integration either increases or reduces the quality of services provided. In the absence of synergies, integration generally leads to increases in quality for some services and reductions for others. The corresponding effect on health benefits depends largely on whether integration leads to quality dispersion or convergence across services. If the softening of competition effect is weak, integration is likely to improve quality and patient outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102880.abstractZh: 多个国家都在推动医疗保健服务的整合，以提高护理质量和协调性。我们在一个模型中研究了这种整合的影响，该模型中的医疗服务提供者通过质量竞争来吸引患者，并遵循规定的价格。我们发现，整合对护理质量有正反两方面的影响。由于捆绑支付机制，整合使得护理协调对服务提供者来说更有利可图，但同时也削弱了竞争，因为患者的选择受到了限制。我们还发现了由于服务提供者和/或服务之间的不对称，整合可能会提高或降低所提供的服务质量。在没有协同效应的情况下，整合通常会提高某些服务的质量，而降低其他服务的质量。相应的健康效益效果则主要取决于整合是否会导致服务质量的分散或趋同。如果竞争减弱的效果较弱，那么整合很可能会提高质量和患者治疗效果。

abstract.text: Unexpected peaks in volumes of attendances at hospital emergency departments (EDs) have been found to affect waiting times, intensity of care and outcomes. We ask whether these effects of ED crowding on patients are caused by poor clinical prioritisation or a quality-quantity trade-off generated by a binding capacity constraint. We study the effects of crowding created by lower-severity patients on the outcomes of approximately 13 million higher-severity patients attending the 140 public EDs in England between April 2016 and March 2017. Our identification approach relies on high-dimensional fixed effects to account for planned capacity. Unexpected demand from low-severity patients has very limited effects on the care provided to higher-severity patients throughout their entire pathway in ED. Detrimental effects of crowding caused by low-severity patients materialise only at very high levels of unexpected demand, suggesting that binding resource constraints impact patient care only when demand greatly exceeds the ED's expectations. These effects are smaller than those caused by crowding induced by higher-severity patients, suggesting an efficient prioritisation of incoming patients in EDs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102881.abstractZh: 研究发现，医院急诊部门就诊量的意外高峰会影响等待时间、护理强度以及治疗结果。我们探讨的是，急诊部门拥挤对患者的影响是否源于临床优先级的不足，还是由于资源限制导致的质量与数量之间的权衡。本研究分析了2016年4月至2017年3月期间，英格兰140家公立急诊部门中，约1300万重症患者因低严重程度患者造成的拥挤对重症患者治疗结果的影响。我们的分析采用高维固定效应模型，以考虑计划中的服务能力。低严重程度患者的意外需求对重症患者整个治疗过程中的护理效果影响有限。只有当意外需求达到非常高的水平时，低严重程度患者造成的拥挤才会产生负面影响，这表明资源限制仅在需求远超急诊部门预期时才会影响患者护理。这些影响小于由重症患者引起的拥挤所带来的影响，这表明急诊部门能够高效地对新入院患者进行优先处理。

abstract.text: Seasonal infectious diseases can cause demand and supply pressures that reduce the ability of healthcare systems to provide high-quality care. This may generate negative spillover effects on the health outcomes of patients seeking medical help for unrelated reasons. Separating these indirect burdens from the direct consequences for infected patients is usually impossible due to a lack of suitable data and an absence of population testing. However, this paper finds robust empirical evidence of excess mortality among non-COVID-19 patients in an integrated public healthcare system: the English National Health Service (NHS). Analysing the forecast error in the NHS' model for predicted mortality, we find at least one additional excess death among patients who sought medical help for reasons unrelated to COVID-19 for every 42 COVID-19-related deaths in the population. We identify COVID-19 pressures as a key driver of non-COVID-19 excess mortality in NHS hospitals during the pandemic, and characterize the hospital populations and medical conditions that were disproportionately affected. Our findings have substantive relevance in shaping our understanding of the wider burden of COVID-19, and other seasonal diseases more generally, and can contribute to debates on optimal public health policy.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102882.abstractZh: 季节性传染病会导致供需压力，从而降低医疗系统提供高质量医疗服务的能力。这可能会对因其他原因寻求医疗帮助的患者健康结果产生负面影响。由于缺乏合适的数据和人口检测，通常无法将这些间接负担与感染患者直接后果区分开来。然而，本文发现，在英格兰国家卫生服务系统这一综合公共医疗体系中，非COVID-19患者出现了明显的超额死亡现象。通过分析该体系模型中预测的死亡率预测误差，我们发现，每有42例与COVID-19相关的死亡，就至少有1例非COVID-19患者死亡。我们认为，COVID-19疫情是NHS医院非COVID-19超额死亡的主要诱因，并指出了那些受到严重影响的医院人群和医疗状况。我们的发现对于理解COVID-19及其他季节性疾病的更广泛影响具有重要意义，并有助于讨论最优的公共卫生政策。

abstract.text: We investigate how religion concordance influences the effectiveness of preventive health campaigns. Conducted during the early stages of the COVID-19 pandemic in two major Indian cities marked by Hindu-Muslim tensions, we randomly assigned a representative sample of slum residents to receive either a physician-delivered information campaign promoting health-related preventive practices, or uninformative control messages on their mobile phones. Messages, introduced by a local citizen (the sender), were cross-randomized to start with a greeting signaling either a Hindu or a Muslim identity, manipulating religion concordance between sender and receiver. We found that doctor messages increased compliance with recommended practices and beliefs in their efficacy. Our findings suggest that the campaign's impact is primarily driven by shared religion between sender and receiver, leading to increased message engagement and compliance with recommended practices. Additionally, we observe that religion concordance helps protect against misinformation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102883.abstractZh: 我们研究了宗教和谐性如何影响预防健康活动的效果。在印度两个以印度教与穆斯林紧张关系为特征的城市，在COVID-19疫情初期阶段，我们随机分配了部分贫民窟居民，让他们接受由医生提供的健康相关预防信息宣传活动，或者接收一些无信息的控制性信息。这些信息由当地一名公民（信息发送者）提供，并随机分配，开始时会包含表示发送者所属印度教或穆斯林身份的问候语，以此操纵发送者与接收者之间的宗教和谐性。我们发现，医生提供的信息增加了人们对推荐做法的遵守程度，以及对其有效性的信任。我们的研究结果表明，该活动的影响主要源于发送者与接收者之间的共同宗教背景，这促进了信息的参与度和对推荐做法的遵守。此外，我们还观察到，宗教和谐性有助于防止错误信息的传播。

abstract.text: We estimate a dynamic structural model of labor supply, retirement, and informal caregiving to study short and long-term costs of informal caregiving in Germany. Incorporating labor market frictions and the German tax and benefit system, we find that in the absence of Germany's public long-term insurance scheme, informal elderly care has adverse and persistent effects on labor market outcomes and, thus, negatively affects lifetime earnings and future pension benefits. These consequences of caregiving are heterogeneous and depend on age, previous earnings, and institutional regulations. Policy simulations suggest that while public long-term care insurance policies are fiscally costly and induce negative labor market effects, they can largely offset the personal costs of caregiving and increase welfare, especially for low-income individuals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102884.abstractZh: 我们建立了一个动态结构模型，研究劳动力供应、退休以及非正式护理在德国的短期和长期成本。通过纳入劳动力市场摩擦以及德国的税收和福利制度，我们发现，在缺乏德国公共长期保险计划的情况下，非正式老年护理对劳动力市场结果产生负面且持续的影响，从而降低了个人的终身收入和未来的养老金福利。这些护理带来的后果因年龄、先前收入以及制度规定而异。政策模拟表明，虽然公共长期护理保险计划在财政上成本较高，并导致负面的劳动力市场效应，但它们可以很大程度上抵消护理的个人成本，并提升福利，尤其是对低收入人群而言。

abstract.text: We develop a unified framework for the measurement and valuation of health and productivity. Within this framework, we characterize evaluation functions allowing for compromises between the classical quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) and its polar productivity-adjusted life years (PALYs). Our framework and characterization results provide a new normative basis for the economic evaluation of health care interventions, as well as occupational health and safety policies, aimed to impact both health and productivity of individuals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102885.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个统一的框架，用于衡量和评估健康与生产力。在该框架内，我们定义了能够兼顾经典的质量调整生命年（QALYs）与其对立面——生产力调整生命年（PALYs）的评估函数。我们的框架和评估结果为医疗干预措施以及旨在同时影响个人健康与生产力的职业健康与安全政策的经济评估提供了新的规范基础。

abstract.text: This study examines the gender-specific and enduring impacts of parental health shocks on adult children's employment in China, where both formal care and health insurance are limited. Using an event-study approach, we establish a causal link between parental health shocks and a notable decline in female employment, which persists for at least six years following the shock. Male employment, however, exhibits minimal change on average, although this conceals an increase among poor families, indicating a channel beyond heightened informal care. Our findings underscore the consequences of "growing old before getting rich" for developing countries.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102886.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了在中国，由于正式照顾和医疗保险的有限性，父母健康冲击对成年子女就业产生的性别特定且持久的影响。通过事件研究法，我们建立了父母健康冲击与女性就业显著下降之间的因果关系，这种下降在冲击发生后至少持续六年。而男性就业的平均变化较小，尽管这掩盖了贫困家庭中的就业增加情况，表明存在除非正式照顾增加之外的其他影响渠道。我们的研究结果强调了“在致富之前先变老”对发展中国家的影响。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the influence of gifts - monetary and in-kind payments - from drug firms to US physicians on prescription behavior and drug costs. Using causal models and machine learning, we estimate physicians' heterogeneous responses to payments on antidiabetic prescriptions. We find that payments lead to increased prescription of brand drugs, resulting in a cost rise of $23 per dollar value of transfer received. Paid physicians show higher responses when they treat higher proportions of patients receiving a government-funded low-income subsidy that lowers out-of-pocket drug costs. We estimate that introducing a national gift ban would reduce diabetes drug costs by 2%.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102887.abstractZh: 本文研究了药物公司向美国医生提供的现金和实物礼物对处方行为及药物成本的影响。通过因果模型和机器学习方法，我们估计了医生对糖尿病处方中礼物的不同反应。研究发现，礼物支付导致品牌药物的处方量增加，每收到一美元礼金，药物成本增加23美元。当医生治疗的病人中，有较高比例的人享受政府提供的低收入补贴，从而降低了自付药物成本时，他们的反应更为积极。我们估计，实施全国性的礼物禁令可以将糖尿病药物成本降低2%。

abstract.text: We examine whether a friend or older sibling's teen pregnancy impacts one's own sexual behavior. Employing an event study design and rich retrospective data on sexual activity, we find that those who observe a peer's teen pregnancy change sexual behavior after the pregnancy ends to put themselves at lower risk of their own teen pregnancy; specifically, they are less likely to have unprotected sex and have fewer sexual partners in the year following the end of the teen pregnancy. We find that females are more likely to change their sexual behavior compared to males, and the effects are primarily driven by peer live births, as opposed to other pregnancies. Ultimately, we find a slight decline in the likelihood of one's own teen pregnancy, though estimates are noisy. Our work suggests that education campaigns that provide a realistic portrayal of teen parenthood may be an effective tool for impacting teen behavior.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102888.abstractZh: 我们研究了朋友的或年长兄弟姐妹的青少年怀孕是否会影响个人的性行为。通过事件研究设计和关于性行为的大量回顾性数据，我们发现那些观察到同龄人青少年怀孕的人，在怀孕结束后会改变性行为，以降低自己怀孕的风险；具体来说，他们更不可能进行无保护的性行为，并且在青少年怀孕结束后的一年里，性伴侣数量也会减少。我们发现，女性比男性更有可能改变性行为，而这种影响主要是由同龄人的活产事件所驱动的，而不是其他类型的怀孕。最终，我们发现个人青少年怀孕的可能性略有下降，尽管估计值存在不确定性。我们的研究表明，提供关于青少年父母身份的真实描绘的教育活动，可能是影响青少年行为的有效手段。

abstract.text: Healthcare is often free at the point-of-care so that price does not deter patients. However, the dis-utility from waiting for care that often occurs could also lead to deterrence. I investigate responses in the volume and types of patients that demand emergency care when predicted waiting times quasi-randomly change. I leverage a discontinuity to compare emergency sites with similar predicted wait times but with different apparent wait times displayed to patients. I use impulse response functions estimated by local projections to estimate effects of predicted wait times on patient demand for care. An additional thirty minutes of predicted wait time results in 15% fewer waiting patients at urgent cares and 2% fewer waiting patients at emergency departments within three hours of display. Patients that stop using emergency care are also triaged as healthier. However, at very high predicted wait times, there are reductions in demand for all patients including sicker patients.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102898.abstractZh: 医疗保健通常在服务点免费提供，以避免价格成为患者的障碍。然而，等待治疗所带来的不便利性也可能导致患者不愿接受服务。我研究了在预测等待时间发生准随机变化时，需要紧急护理的患者数量及类型的变化情况。我利用不连续性来比较预测等待时间相近但实际等待时间不同的紧急医疗站点。通过局部预测估计的脉冲响应函数，我评估了预测等待时间对病人需求的影响。在预测等待时间增加30分钟的情况下，紧急护理中心的等待患者数量减少了15%，急诊科的等待患者数量减少了2%。停止使用紧急护理的患者也被归类为更健康的人群。然而，在预测等待时间非常高的情况下，所有类型的患者需求都会减少，包括病情较重的患者。

abstract.text: Childhood vaccinations are among the most cost-effective health interventions. Yet, in India, where immunisation services are widely available free of charge, a substantial proportion of children remain unvaccinated. We revisit households 30 months after a randomised experiment of a health information intervention designed to educate mothers on the benefits of child vaccination in Uttar Pradesh, India. We find that the large short-term effects on the uptake of diphtheria-pertussis-tetanus and measles vaccination were sustained at 30 months, suggesting the intervention did not simply bring forward vaccinations. We apply causal forests and find that the intervention increased vaccination uptake, but that there was substantial variation in the magnitude of the estimated effects. We conclude that characterising those who benefited most and conversely those who benefited least provides policy-makers with insights on how the intervention worked, and how the targeting of households could be improved.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102899.abstractZh: 儿童疫苗接种是成本效益最高的健康干预措施之一。然而，在印度，尽管免疫服务普遍免费提供，仍有相当比例的儿童未接受疫苗接种。我们在印度北方邦进行了一项健康信息干预的随机实验后30个月，再次对家庭进行了调查。我们发现，白喉-百日咳-破伤风和麻疹疫苗接种的短期效果在30个月后仍然持续，这表明该干预措施不仅促进了疫苗接种的普及。我们通过因果森林分析发现，该干预措施确实增加了疫苗接种的接受率，但估计效果的大小存在显著差异。我们得出结论，了解哪些家庭受益最多、哪些家庭受益最少，可以为政策制定者提供有关干预措施效果的见解，并有助于改进对家庭的针对性干预。

abstract.text: Demand-side cost-sharing reduces moral hazard in healthcare but increases exposure to out-of-pocket expenditure. We introduce a structural microsimulation model to evaluate both total and out-of-pocket expenditure for different cost-sharing schemes. We use a Bayesian mixture model to capture the healthcare expenditure distributions across different age-gender categories. We estimate the model using Dutch data and simulate outcomes for a number of policies. The model suggests that for a deductible of 300 euros shifting the starting point of the deductible away from zero to 400 euros leads to an average 4% reduction in healthcare expenditure and 47% lower out-of-pocket payments.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102900.abstractZh: 需求端费用分担可以减少医疗领域的道德风险，但会增加个人自付费用。我们引入了一个结构微观模拟模型，以评估不同费用分担方案下的总医疗费用和个人自付费用。我们使用贝叶斯混合模型来捕捉不同年龄性别类别的医疗费用分布。我们采用荷兰数据对模型进行估计，并模拟了多种政策下的结果。模型表明，将免赔额从零提高到400欧元，可以平均减少4%的医疗费用，并降低47%的个人自付费用。

abstract.text: Health plans for the poor increasingly limit access to specialty hospitals. We investigate the role of adverse selection in generating this equilibrium among private plans in Medicaid. Studying a network change, we find that covering a top cancer hospital causes severe adverse selection, increasing demand for a plan by 50% among enrollees with cancer versus no impact for others. Medicaid's fixed insurer payments make offsetting this selection, and the contract distortions it induces, challenging, requiring either infeasibly high payment rates or near-perfect risk adjustment. By contrast, a small explicit bonus for covering the hospital is sufficient to make coverage profitable.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102901.abstractZh: 针对贫困群体的健康计划越来越限制他们访问专科医院的机会。我们研究了逆向选择在这一过程中所起的作用，尤其是在医疗补助计划中的私人保险计划之间。通过研究网络变化，我们发现覆盖顶级癌症医院会导致严重的逆向选择，使得患有癌症的参保者对该保险计划的需求增加50%，而其他人群则没有这种影响。医疗补助计划固定的保险支付使得这种逆向选择得以抵消，而合同中的扭曲现象则使得风险调整变得具有挑战性，需要极高的支付率或近乎完美的风险调整。相比之下，为覆盖这些医院提供少量明确的奖励就足以使保险覆盖变得盈利。

abstract.text: Private equity is an increasing presence in US healthcare, with unclear consequences. Leveraging unique data sources and difference-in-differences designs, we examine the largest private equity hospital takeover in history. The affected hospital chain sharply shifts its advertising strategy and pursues joint ventures with ambulatory surgery centers. Inpatient throughput is increased by allowing more patient transfers, and crucially, capturing more patients through the emergency department. The hospitals also manage shorter, less treatment-intensive stays for admitted patients. Outpatient surgical care volume declines, but remaining cases focus on higher complexity procedures. Importantly, behavior changes persist even after private equity divests.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102902.abstractZh: 私募股权在美国医疗保健领域的存在日益增多，但其影响尚不明确。通过利用独特的数据来源和差异-差异设计，我们研究了历史上规模最大的私募股权医院收购案例。受影响的医院连锁企业大幅调整了广告策略，并寻求与门诊手术中心的合作。通过允许更多的患者转院，医院的住院量有所增加，更重要的是，通过急诊科吸引了更多患者。医院还减少了住院患者的治疗时间，使其住院期更短、治疗强度更低。门诊手术护理量有所减少，但剩余的业务主要集中在更复杂的手术上。重要的是，即使私募股权退出后，这些行为变化仍然持续存在。

abstract.text: Is the education-health gradient inflated because both education and health are associated with unobserved socio-emotional skills? We find that the gradient in health behaviors and outcomes is reduced by about 15 to 50% from accounting for fine-grained personality facets and up to another 50% from Locus of Control. Traditional aggregated Big-Five scales, however, have a much smaller contribution to the gradient. We use sibling-fixed effects to net out the contribution from genes and shared childhood environment, decomposing the gradient into its components with an order-invariant method. We rely on a large survey (N = 28,261) linked to high-quality Danish administrative registers with information on parental background and objectively measured diagnoses and care use. Accounting for Locus of Control yields the strongest gradient reduction in self-rated health status and objective diagnoses (30%-50%), and in health behaviors the most important factor is Extraversion, a skill that has been shown to be malleable in interventions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102911.abstractZh: 教育与健康之间的梯度是否因教育和健康都与未观察到的社会情感技能相关而变得虚高？我们发现，通过考虑细致的个性特征，健康行为和结果之间的梯度减少了约15%至50%；而通过考虑控制点因素，这一减少幅度又增加了50%。然而，传统的综合五大人格量表对梯度的贡献要小得多。我们利用兄弟姐妹固定效应来抵消基因和共同童年环境的影响，并使用顺序不变的方法将梯度分解为其组成部分。我们基于一项大规模调查（样本量28,261人），该调查与高质量的丹麦行政登记数据相关联，其中包含关于父母背景以及客观测量出的疾病和护理使用情况的信息。考虑控制点因素后，自我评估健康状况和客观诊断结果的梯度减少最为显著（30%-50%），而在健康行为方面，最重要的因素是外向性，这种技能在干预研究中已被证明是可塑的。

abstract.text: Health expenditure data almost always include extreme values, implying that the underlying distribution has heavy tails. This may result in infinite variances as well as higher-order moments and bias the commonly used least squares methods. To accommodate extreme values, we propose an estimation method that recovers the right tail of health expenditure distributions. It extends the popular two-part model to develop a novel three-part model. We apply the proposed method to claims data from one of the biggest German private health insurers. Our findings show that the estimated age gradient in health care spending differs substantially from the standard least squares method.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102912.abstractZh: 健康支出数据几乎总是包含极端值，这意味着其潜在分布具有重尾特性。这可能导致方差无限增大，以及高阶矩的偏差，从而影响常用的最小二乘法。为了处理极端值，我们提出了一种估计方法，能够捕捉健康支出分布的右尾部分。该方法将流行的两部分模型扩展为新的三部分模型。我们将所提出的方法应用于德国最大的私人健康保险公司之一的索赔数据。研究发现，与健康支出标准的最小二乘法相比，所估计的年龄梯度存在显著差异。

abstract.text: Alcohol control policies are implemented to reduce alcoholism and related harms around the globe. This work examines the effects of a policy that restricted when alcohol could be purchased on child outcomes in Russia. To identify causal impacts, I exploit variation in the timing and severity of the restriction, which was implemented in Russian states between 2005 and 2010. Utilizing household survey data and a difference-in-differences estimation approach, I find that the policy has improved children's physical health, with younger children being more affected, and additionally has decreased a variety of risky behavior indicators. Potential mechanisms for these effects include alcohol consumption, parental employment, household income, family stability, and time use. This work demonstrates that policies controlling parental substance access can have important effects on child health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102913.abstractZh: 全球范围内实施了酒精控制政策，以减少酒精中毒及相关危害。本研究探讨了在俄罗斯实施限制酒精购买时间政策对儿童结果的影响。为了识别因果效应，我利用了2005年至2010年间俄罗斯各州实施的限制措施的时间和强度差异。通过家庭调查数据和差异估计方法，我发现该政策改善了儿童的身体健康状况，其中年幼的儿童受影响更为严重，同时减少了多种危险行为指标。这些效应的潜在机制包括酒精消费、父母就业状况、家庭收入、家庭稳定以及时间利用方式。本研究表明，控制父母接触酒精的政策对儿童健康具有重要作用。

abstract.text: In a randomized controlled trial conducted in three waves over 2.5 years and involving nearly 700 customer-service representatives (CSRs) from a Canadian government service agency, we studied how providing CSRs with repeated performance feedback, with or without peer comparison, affected their subsequent organ donor registration rates. The feedback resulted in a 25 % increase in daily signups compared to otherwise equivalent encouragements and reminders. Adding benchmark information about peer performance did not amplify or diminish this effect. We observed increased registration rates for both high and low performers. A post-intervention survey indicates that CSRs in all conditions found the information included in the treatments helpful and motivating, and that signing up organ donors makes their job more meaningful. We also found suggestive evidence that performance feedback with benchmark information was the most motivating and created the least pressure to perform.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102914.abstractZh: 在一项为期2.5年、分三阶段进行的随机对照试验中，涉及了来自一家加拿大政府服务机构的近700名客户服务代表。我们研究了向客户服务代表提供重复绩效反馈（无论是否包含同行比较）对其后续器官捐赠登记率的影响。与同等程度的鼓励和提醒相比，这种反馈使每日登记率增加了25%。添加关于同行绩效的基准信息并未增强或减弱这一效果。我们发现，无论是表现优异还是表现不佳的客户服务代表，其登记率都有所提高。事后调查表明，所有条件下的客户服务代表都认为治疗中包含的信息具有帮助性和激励性，并且登记器官捐赠者使他们的工作更有意义。我们还发现了一些证据，表明包含基准信息的绩效反馈最具激励作用，同时也最小化了执行任务的压力。

abstract.text: This paper examines the influence of housing wealth on fertility outcomes through a regression discontinuity design based on a 2006 Chinese housing-market policy. Our analysis reveals that the positive impact of this policy on housing wealth significantly enhances the likelihood of fertility by 7.3 %. Our result implies that a 1 % increase in housing wealth can raise the fertility rate by 0.18 %. Furthermore, we observe that children born subsequent to the positive housing wealth shock exhibit improved health, not only at birth but also over the long term. Lastly, we present suggestive evidence suggesting that both parental pre-birth time allocation and parental health may help explain the documented positive effects of housing wealth on fertility rates.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102915.abstractZh: 本文通过基于2006年中国住房市场政策的回归 discontinuity设计，探讨了住房财富对生育结果的影响。我们的分析表明，该政策对住房财富的积极影响显著提升了生育率7.3%。我们的结果表明，住房财富每增加1%，生育率可提高0.18%。此外，我们观察到，在住房财富冲击之后出生的孩子，不仅在出生时，而且在长期内，健康状况都更为良好。最后，我们提出了一些有启发性的证据，表明父母在出生前的时间分配以及父母的健康状况，可能有助于解释住房财富对生育率的积极影响。

abstract.text: This study assesses the impact of financial incentives on hygienic latrine ownership by poor/near-poor households in Vietnam. Rural communes were randomly assigned to a control group and three treatment arm groups: (T1) a rebate for households that installed a hygienic latrine; (T2) a financial reward for commune governments if the proportion of hygienic latrines in their commune increased by 30 percentage points; (T3) both a household rebate and a commune reward. We find a strong and positive effect from the household rebate (treatment arms 1 and 3) but an insignificant effect from the commune reward (treatment arm 2) on household ownership of a septic tank latrine. Our analysis provides suggestive evidence that microcredit is a channel through which a rebate encourages the installation of septic tank latrines. We also find that treatment arm 3 increases people's knowledge regarding sanitation and the availability of water and soap for handwashing within households.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102916.abstractZh: 本研究评估了金融激励对越南贫困/低收入家庭卫生厕所拥有情况的影响。农村社区被随机分配到对照组和三个处理组：(T1) 为安装卫生厕所的家庭提供补贴；(T2) 如果社区内卫生厕所的比例增加30个百分点，则对社区政府给予经济奖励；(T3) 同时提供家庭补贴和社区奖励。我们发现，家庭补贴对卫生厕所的拥有有显著的正面影响（处理组1和3），而社区奖励对卫生厕所的拥有则没有显著效果（处理组2）。我们的分析表明，小额信贷是鼓励安装卫生厕所的一种途径。此外，处理组3还提高了人们对卫生设施的认知，以及家庭内洗手用水和肥皂的可用性。

abstract.text: Despite efforts to expand naloxone access, opioid-related overdoses remain a significant contributor to mortality. We study state efforts to expand naloxone distribution through pharmacies by reducing the non-monetary costs to prescribers, dispensers, and/or potential recipients of naloxone. We find that laws that only address liability costs have small and insignificant effects on the volume of naloxone dispensed through pharmacies. In contrast, we estimate large effects of laws removing the need for patients to obtain prescriptions from traditional prescribers (e.g., primary care physicians): laws authorizing non-patient-specific prescription distribution and laws granting pharmacists prescriptive authority. We test whether areas designated as primary care shortage areas-where it would be costlier to obtain a prescription-were disproportionately impacted. Shortage areas experienced sharper growth in pharmacy naloxone dispensing in states adopting prescriptive authority policies. These gains were primarily due to those facing low out-of-pocket costs, suggesting that price barriers also must be addressed to increase naloxone purchases.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102917.abstractZh: 尽管努力扩大纳洛酮的获取渠道，与阿片类药物相关的过量用药仍然是导致死亡的重要原因之一。本研究探讨了各州通过减少处方者、分发者和潜在接收者非货币成本来扩大纳洛酮在药店分发范围的举措。我们发现，仅涉及责任成本的法律对药店中纳洛酮分发量的影响很小且微不足道。相比之下，我们估计了取消患者需从传统处方者（如初级保健医生）处获取处方的法律、授权药剂师开具处方的法律等法规所带来的巨大影响。我们测试了被指定为初级保健短缺地区的区域是否受到不成比例的影响——在这些地区获取处方成本更高。在采用处方授权政策的州，短缺地区的药店纳洛酮分发量增长更为显著。这些增长主要得益于那些面临较低自付成本的地区，这表明除了价格障碍外，还需要解决其他问题以增加纳洛酮的购买量。

abstract.text: We study the effects of health insurance coverage on agricultural production decisions, examining the causal relationships by exploiting a health care reform and providing a theoretical framework to elucidate underlying mechanisms. We find that the reform led to long-run increases in total cultivation investments and output, accompanied by a shift in households' cultivation portfolio towards riskier crops. We explain these findings using a model of agricultural investment, highlighting the important roles of health insurance in mitigating background medical expenditure risks and enhancing health. We also find that the reform improved households' financial well-being through reduced debts and defaults on loans.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102918.abstractZh: 我们研究了医疗保险覆盖对农业生产决策的影响，通过利用一项医疗改革来探讨因果关系，并提供一个理论框架以阐明其背后的机制。我们发现，这项改革导致长期内总种植投资和产出增加，同时家庭种植结构向风险更高的作物转变。我们使用农业投资模型来解释这些发现，强调了医疗保险在减轻基础医疗费用风险和提高健康水平方面的重要作用。我们还发现，这项改革通过减少债务和贷款违约，提升了家庭的财务福祉。

abstract.text: E-cigarette licensure laws (ELLs) require retailers to obtain a state license to sell e-cigarettes over the counter. This study is the first to comprehensively explore the effect of ELL adoption on youth tobacco product use. Using data from the State Youth Risk Behavior Survey (YRBS) and a difference-in-differences approach, we find no evidence that ELL adoption reduces youth ENDS use. The precision of our estimates allows us to rule out, with 95 % confidence, ELL-induced declines in prior-month, frequent, and everyday youth ENDS use of more than 0.7, 0.3, and 0.4 percentage points, respectively. The pattern of null findings persists when we examine ELLs that impose higher penalties for retailer non-compliance, higher renewable licensure fees, and criminal in addition to civil penalties. We conclude that ELLs have only limited success in curbing access to ENDS among youths.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102919.abstractZh: 电子香烟许可法要求零售商获得州级许可证，才能通过柜台销售电子香烟。本研究首次全面探讨了电子香烟许可制度对青少年烟草产品使用的影响。通过《州青少年风险行为调查》的数据以及差异-差异分析法，我们发现电子香烟许可制度的实施并未减少青少年的电子烟草产品使用。我们的估计精度表明，可以以95%的置信度排除电子香烟许可制度导致青少年电子烟草产品使用量下降超过0.7个百分点、0.3个百分点和0.4个百分点的可能性。即使我们考察了对零售商不合规行为实施更高罚款、更高可再生许可费用以及刑事和民事处罚的电子香烟许可制度，这种无显著影响的模式仍然成立。我们得出结论，电子香烟许可制度在限制青少年获取电子烟草产品方面成效有限。

abstract.text: We study competing hospitals' incentives for quality provision in a dynamic setting where healthcare is an experience good. In our model, the utility a patient derives from choosing a particular provider depends on a subjective component specific to the match between the patient and the provider, which can only be learned through experience. We find that the experience-good nature of healthcare can either reinforce or dampen the demand responsiveness to quality and the hospitals' incentives for quality provision, depending on two key factors: the shape of the distribution of match-specific utilities and the cost relationship between quality provision and treatment volume. We establish conditions under which ignoring the experience dimension of healthcare leads to inaccurate assessments of the competitiveness of hospital markets.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102920.abstractZh: 我们研究了在动态环境中，竞争医院在提供质量方面的激励机制，其中医疗服务是一种体验型商品。在我们的模型中，患者选择特定医疗服务提供者所获得的效用取决于患者与提供者之间的匹配情况这一主观因素，而这一因素只能通过经验来学习。我们发现，医疗服务的体验型特性可能会加强或减弱患者对质量的响应能力，以及医院在提供质量方面的激励措施，这取决于两个关键因素：匹配特定效用的分布形态，以及提供质量与治疗量之间的成本关系。我们确定了在忽略医疗服务的体验维度时，会对医院市场的竞争力评估产生不准确影响的情形。

abstract.text: Spending at end of life (EOL) accounts for a large and growing share of healthcare expenditures in the US, and often reflects aggressive care with questionable value for dying patients. Using a novel instrumental variables approach, we conduct the first study on the causal effect of Medicare reimbursement for advance care planning (ACP)-the process of discussing and recording patient preferences for goals of care-on care utilization, spending, and mortality outcomes for critically ill Medicare patients. We find that billed ACP services substantially increase hospice use and hospice spending within a year, accompanied by corresponding increase in one-year mortality. The impacts of ACP services on hospice use and spending are especially prominent among patients with dementia and those of lower socioeconomic status. Among decedents, death is significantly less likely to occur in the hospital, and total and inpatient spending within the last 30 days of life fall significantly. Our findings suggest that paying for ACP services can be effective in improving hospice use for critically ill Medicare patients, with the (possibly intended) consequence of increased one-year mortality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102921.abstractZh: 临终阶段的支出在美国医疗保健支出中占有较大且不断增长的份额，通常反映出对临终患者而言价值存疑的过度护理。通过一种新颖的工具变量方法，我们首次研究了医疗保险报销对预先护理计划（ACP）的因果效应——即讨论并记录患者关于护理目标的偏好——对危重病医疗保险患者护理利用、支出和死亡率的影响。我们发现，计费中的ACP服务在一年内显著增加了临终关怀的使用和支出，同时死亡率也相应上升。ACP服务对临终关怀使用和支出的影响在患有痴呆症的患者以及社会经济地位较低的人群中尤为明显。在逝者身上，死亡在医院内发生的可能性显著降低，过去30天内总支出和住院支出也显著减少。我们的研究结果表明，为ACP服务付费可以有效提高危重病医疗保险患者的临终关怀使用率，但可能带来的后果是一年内的死亡率增加。

abstract.text: This paper theoretically studies pharmaceutical innovation collaborations, where heterogeneous firms compete for heterogeneous academics. At an interim stage, the firm evaluates the project, which allows it to monitor academics and decide whether to terminate the project to avoid the loss from a future failure. This paper explores the contract, project termination strategy, and collaboration matching. The firm's innovation strategy (exploitations or explorations) determines the evaluation structure, which may affect the market equilibrium. By considering different innovation strategies, this paper shows that in each case, the equilibrium matching is unique (either positive or negative assortative). Consequently, the chosen innovation strategy plays a pivotal role in shaping equilibrium matching outcomes. These findings provide theoretical insights into pharma-academic alliances, shed light on the observed positive or negative assortative properties in the market, and advocate for the consideration of innovation strategies and evaluation structures in future research endeavors. Moreover, this paper also provides several empirical and policy implications.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102922.abstractZh: 本文从理论角度研究了制药领域的创新合作，其中不同性质的公司在与不同性质的学者合作时展开竞争。在中期阶段，企业会对项目进行评估，从而能够监控学者的情况，并决定是否终止项目以避免未来可能出现的失败损失。本文探讨了合同安排、项目终止策略以及合作匹配机制。企业的创新策略（探索性或开发性）决定了评估结构，这可能会影响市场均衡。通过考虑不同的创新策略，本文表明在每种情况下，均衡匹配都是唯一的（无论是正选择还是负选择）。因此，所选的创新策略在塑造均衡匹配结果方面起着关键作用。这些发现为制药企业与学者的合作提供了理论依据，揭示了市场中观察到的正选择或负选择特性，并建议在未来的研究工作中考虑创新策略和评估结构。此外，本文还提出了一些实证和政策意义。

abstract.text: Housing instability and drug misuse are two of the United States' most pressing challenges, each bearing profound health and societal consequences. A crucial yet largely underexplored question is the extent to which the opioid crisis has intensified housing instability. Our study ventures into this relatively uncharted nexus, investigating how the OxyContin reformulation, a pivotal moment in the U.S. opioid epidemic, impacted eviction rates. Employing a dose-response Difference-in-Differences model and analyzing eviction data from 2004 to 2016, we demonstrate that the OxyContin reformulation precipitated a significant increase in evictions, especially in areas with weak eviction protections or limited access to psychiatric treatment resources. Channel analyses reveal increased marijuana initiation and heightened mental and physical health issues following the reformulation. Moreover, the OxyContin reformulation leads to greater reliance on the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program, signaling an escalated financial strain on governmental resources. Finally, we find evidence of increased marital disruption post-reformulation. Our findings underscore the urgent need for collaborative efforts between public health and housing authorities to address both the opioid and housing crises.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102930.abstractZh: 住房不稳定和药物滥用是美国面临的两大紧迫问题，它们都带来了严重的健康和社会后果。一个关键但研究不足的问题是，阿片类药物危机在多大程度上加剧了住房不稳定问题。我们的研究探索了这一相对未被充分研究的关联，探讨了美国阿片类药物危机中的一个关键节点——奥施康定重新配方，对驱逐率的影响。通过采用剂量反应差异模型，并分析2004至2016年的驱逐数据，我们发现奥施康定重新配方显著增加了驱逐事件，尤其是在驱逐保护较弱或获得精神治疗资源有限的地区。渠道分析显示，重新配方后大麻使用率上升，同时精神和身体健康问题也加重。此外，奥施康定重新配方还导致人们更加依赖补充营养援助计划，这表明政府资源面临更大的财政压力。最后，我们发现重新配方后婚姻破裂的情况有所增加。我们的研究结果强调了公共卫生和住房管理部门需要共同努力，以应对阿片类药物危机和住房问题。

abstract.text: Some harm reduction strategies encourage individuals to switch from a harmful addictive good to a less harmful addictive good; examples include e-cigarettes (substitutes for combustible cigarettes) and methadone and buprenorphine (substitutes for opioids). These have proven to be controversial. Advocates argue that people struggling with addiction benefit because they can switch to a less harmful substance, but opponents argue that this could encourage abstainers to begin using the harm-reduction method or even, eventually, the original addictive good. This paper builds on theories of addiction to model the introduction of a harm reduction method, and demonstrates the conditions under which each side is correct.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102931.abstractZh: 一些减少危害的策略鼓励人们从有害的成瘾性物品转向危害较小的成瘾性物品；例如电子香烟（可燃香烟的替代品）以及美沙酮和丁丙诺啡（阿片类药物的替代品）。这些措施引发了争议。支持者认为，与成瘾作斗争的人可以通过转向危害较小的物质而受益，但反对者则认为，这可能会促使不使用者开始使用这种减少危害的方法，甚至最终转向原来的成瘾性物品。本文基于成瘾理论，对引入减少危害的方法进行了建模，并探讨了各方观点正确的条件。

abstract.text: We use data from the Population Assessment of Tobacco Use and Health (PATH), a longitudinal data set including self-reported and biomarker measures of tobacco use, to examine the effects of state-level tobacco 21 (T21) laws on smoking and vaping. T21 laws reduce self-reported cigarette smoking among 18-to-20 year olds, concentrated in males. Initial non-users who "age-out" of treatment are less likely to subsequently initiate self-reported smoking or vaping. Treated smokers are less likely to buy their own cigarettes and more likely to buy cigarettes in a different state. Biomarker results are mixed, and we find some evidence of a reduction in nicotine exposure but less evidence for a reduction in exposure to tobacco. Finally, we test for non-classical measurement error. T21 laws reduce the probability that clinically identified likely cigarette smokers self-report as smokers, which may increase the apparent effect of T21 laws on cigarette smoking as measured by self-reports.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102932.abstractZh: 我们使用了“烟草使用与健康人口评估”（PATH）的数据集，该数据集包含自我报告和生物标志物测量数据，以研究州级烟草21（T21）法律对吸烟和吸电子烟的影响。T21法律减少了18至20岁人群中自我报告的吸烟行为，且这一影响主要集中在男性身上。最初不吸烟但“随着年龄增长不再接受干预”的人群，后续开始自我报告吸烟或吸电子烟的可能性较低。接受干预的吸烟者更不愿意自己购买香烟，而更倾向于在另一个州购买香烟。生物标志物结果不一，我们发现有证据表明尼古丁暴露有所减少，但关于烟草暴露减少的证据则较少。最后，我们检验了非经典测量误差的影响。T21法律降低了临床认定可能为吸烟者的人自我报告为吸烟者的概率，这可能增加了T21法律对吸烟行为的实际影响。

abstract.text: This paper provides an institutional economics framework for analyzing medical ethics. An ethical policy partitions the set of physician actions into (un)ethical subsets, with unethical actions then unavailable. Individual physicians' preferences over policies combined with a political process determine equilibrium constraints. I show that physicians' concern for colleagues' patients uniquely motivates their support for ethics which restrict behavior under strong assumptions. Without these assumptions, even identical physicians might ban actions they would otherwise select for reasons varying from protecting patients to differences in the costs of maintaining ethical policies. Interestingly, heightened altruism for colleagues' patients makes the former reasoning less credible. Novel applications for 'Provide Free Care to Physicians' and 'Duty to Treat in a Pandemic' demonstrate: (i) rising physician income can explain long-run weakening of both formal ethics in the United States; and (ii) the duty to treat can deteriorate as fewer physicians are required to improve pandemic outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102933.abstractZh: 本文提供了一个制度经济学框架，用于分析医学伦理问题。伦理政策将医生的行为划分为（不）伦理的类别，不伦理的行为因此无法实施。个体医生对政策的偏好与政治过程共同决定了均衡约束。研究表明，医生对同事患者的关心是他们对伦理支持的唯一动机，这在强假设下是成立的。如果没有这些假设，即使是相同的医生也可能禁止某些行为，而这些行为原本会被选择，原因从保护患者到维持伦理政策的成本差异不等。有趣的是，对同事患者的更高程度的利他主义使得前一种理由变得不那么可信。对于“为医生提供免费医疗”和“在疫情中承担治疗责任”的新应用表明：(i) 医生收入的增加可以解释美国正式伦理的长期弱化；(ii) 随着需要治疗的医生数量减少，承担治疗责任的能力可能会下降。

abstract.text: Community water fluoridation has been named one of the 10 greatest public health achievements of the 20th century for its role in improving dental health. Fluoride has large negative effects at high doses, clear benefits at low levels, and an unclear optimal dosage level. I leverage county-level variation in the timing of fluoride adoption, combined with restricted U.S. Census data that link over 29 million individuals to their county of birth, to estimate the causal effects of childhood fluoride exposure. Children exposed to community water fluoridation from age zero to five are worse off as adults on indices of economic self-sufficiency (-1.9% of a SD) and physical ability and health (-1.2% of a SD). They are also significantly less likely to graduate high school (-1.5 percentage points) or serve in the military (-1.0 percentage points). These findings challenge existing conclusions about safe levels of fluoride exposure.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102934.abstractZh: 社区水氟化物添加因其在改善口腔健康方面的作用而被誉为20世纪十大公共卫生成就之一。氟化物在高剂量下具有显著的负面影响，而在低剂量下则具有明显的好处，但其最佳剂量水平尚不明确。我利用县级层面氟化物添加时间的差异，并结合美国人口普查数据（该数据将超过2900万个人与其出生地联系起来），来估算儿童氟化物暴露的因果效应。从零岁到五岁的儿童如果接受社区水氟化物添加，成年后的经济自给能力（标准差的-1.9%）以及身体能力和健康状况（标准差的-1.2%）都会较差。他们高中毕业的可能性也显著降低（低1.5个百分点），同时参军的可能性也大幅降低（低1.0个百分点）。这些发现对关于氟化物安全暴露水平的现有结论提出了挑战。

abstract.text: While a large literature examines the immediate and long-run effects of public health insurance, much less is known about the impacts of total program exposure on child developmental outcomes. This paper uses an instrumental variable strategy to estimate the effect of cumulative eligibility gain on cognitive and behavioral outcomes measured at three points during childhood. Our analysis leverages substantial variation in cumulative eligibility due to the dramatic public insurance expansions between the 1980s and 2000s. We find that increased eligibility improves child cognitive skills and present suggestive evidence on better behavioral outcomes. There are notable heterogeneous effects across the subgroups of interest. Both prenatal eligibility and childhood eligibility are important for driving gains in the test scores at older ages. Improved child health is found to be a mediator of the impact of increased eligibility.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102935.abstractZh: 虽然已有大量文献研究公共健康保险对短期和长期的影响，但关于整个项目对儿童发展结果的影响则知之甚少。本文采用工具变量策略，估计累计资格获得量对儿童在三个阶段认知和行为结果的影响。我们的分析利用了1980年代至2000年代公共保险大幅扩展所导致的累计资格差异。研究发现，增加资格可获得性有助于提升儿童的认知能力，并显示出更好的行为表现。不同子群体之间存在显著的异质性效应。产前资格获得性和儿童时期的资格获得性都对提高较大年龄段的测试成绩至关重要。此外，改善儿童健康状况被认为是提高资格可获得性影响的中介因素。

abstract.text: This study provides the first population-representative quasi-experimental estimates on the impact of housing upgrades on occupant health. We analyze the exceptional period of renovations in East Germany following the German reunification during the 1990s. Triggered by one of the largest governmental loan programs in history, 3.6 million dwellings were renovated, focussing on upgrades to the building insulation, windows and heating systems. Using rich survey data based on the Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP) as well as administrative records of hospital admissions in Germany, we consistently show that housing weatherization upgrades sustainably reduce the demand for health care among the elderly sample of the population.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102936.abstractZh: 本研究首次提供了关于住房升级对居民健康影响的代表性群体准实验估计结果。我们分析了20世纪90年代德国统一后东德进行的大规模改造工程。这一改造活动是由历史上规模最大的政府贷款计划引发的，共有360万套住宅接受了改造，重点是对建筑隔热、窗户和供暖系统的升级。通过基于社会经济面板数据以及德国医院入院记录的丰富调查数据，我们一致发现，住房的改善措施能够可持续地降低老年人群体的医疗需求。

abstract.text: We study the impact on children's bodyweight of switching from means-tested to universal provision of nutritious free school meals in England. We exploit the roll-out of universal provision across Local Authorities to estimate effects at different ages and durations of exposure, based on nurse-collected, population-wide health data for state school children. Exposure to universal free lunches reduces obesity prevalence and BMI among children aged 4-5 and 10-11, but older children's bodyweights are less responsive than younger children's. We find tentative evidence that effects may be cumulative, as impacts are largest for those exposed to universal free school meals throughout primary school.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102937.abstractZh: 我们研究了在英格兰从基于经济状况的配给制转变为普遍提供营养免费学校餐对儿童体重的影响。我们利用地方当局普遍提供免费学校餐的举措，基于护士收集的全国家庭健康数据，对不同年龄和暴露时间段的效应进行了评估。普遍提供免费午餐降低了4-5岁和10-11岁儿童的肥胖率和BMI，但较大年龄儿童的体重变化反应程度低于较小年龄儿童。我们发现，这种影响可能是累积性的，因为那些在小学阶段一直接受免费学校餐的儿童受到的影响最大。

abstract.text: Since the recent US Supreme Court decision in Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization, people across the country have experienced large sudden changes in their access to abortion care. In this paper, I look to the history of abortion access in the United States to inform predictions for this new future. I study the effects of targeted regulations on abortion providers (TRAP laws) on a variety of maternal and infant health outcomes, using variation in the timing of policy adoption across states and a direct measure of the distance to an abortion provider. I implement difference-in-differences techniques across outcomes from restricted-use microdata on the universe of US births. I find that TRAP laws lead to 11-16 % increased rates of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy. Additionally, I find evidence that TRAP laws widen existing disparities in adverse infant health outcomes across parental race. These results demonstrate the potentially wide-ranging health effects of restricting access to abortion.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102938.abstractZh: 自从美国最高法院在Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization案中的裁决之后，全国各地的民众在获得堕胎服务方面经历了巨大的突然变化。在本文中，我借鉴了美国堕胎服务历史的相关信息，以预测这一新未来的发展。我研究了针对堕胎服务提供者的特定法规（TRAP法律）对多种母婴健康结果的影响，通过考察各州政策实施时间的差异，以及直接衡量到堕胎服务提供者距离的情况，来进行分析。我运用差异中的差异技术，从美国出生人群的限制性微观数据中获取各种结果，发现TRAP法律导致妊娠高血压疾病的发生率增加了11-16%。此外，我还发现了TRAP法律加剧了不同种族父母之间在婴儿健康不良结果方面的差异。这些结果表明，限制堕胎服务的做法可能带来广泛的健康影响。

abstract.text: Abortion restrictions affect access to reproductive health care. Research has demonstrated that abortion restrictions (policies that restrict access to abortion services or cause abortion clinics to close) result in reductions of and delays in abortions. We leverage two population-based datasets to investigate the effects of mandatory waiting periods (MWPs), a restrictive state abortion policy, on the prevalence of intimate partner violence (IPV), one of the most common types of crime and a highly prevalent and costly public health problem, using data from the National Incident-Based Reporting System and Uniform Crime Report - Supplemental Homicide Reports. We hypothesize that MWPs increase the prevalence of IPV through changes in financial strains, negative health consequences, and intra-household power dynamics. Using difference-in-differences, event study, and methods accounting for staggered treatment timing, we find that MWPs are associated with increases in IPV. Our findings are valuable for policymakers in today's post-Dobbs environment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102939.abstractZh: 堕胎限制会影响生殖健康服务的获取。研究表明，堕胎限制（限制堕胎服务或导致堕胎诊所关闭的政策）会导致堕胎数量减少和延迟。我们利用两个基于人口的数据集，研究强制性等待期这一限制性州级堕胎政策对亲密伴侣暴力发生率的影响。亲密伴侣暴力是最常见的犯罪类型之一，也是一种高发且成本高昂的公共卫生问题。我们依据《国家基于事件的报告系统》和《统一犯罪报告——补充杀人报告》的数据进行研究。我们假设，强制性等待期通过增加经济压力、负面健康后果以及家庭内部权力动态的变化，增加了亲密伴侣暴力的发生率。通过差异内生差异分析、事件研究法以及考虑处理时间错序的方法，我们发现强制性等待期与亲密伴侣暴力的增加有关。我们的研究结果对于当前后多布斯时代的政策制定者来说具有参考价值。

abstract.text: The UK Universal Credit (UC) welfare reform simplified the benefits system whilst strongly incentivising a return to sustainable employment. Exploiting a staggered roll-out, we estimate the differential effect of unemployment under UC versus the former system on mental health. Groups with fewer insurance possibilities - single adults and lone parents - experience a mental health deterioration of 8.4-13.9% standard deviations which persists into the subsequent year. For couples, UC partially or fully mitigates mental health consequences of unemployment. Exploring mechanisms, for single adults and lone parents, reduced benefit income and strict job search requirements dominate any positive welfare effects of the reduced administrative burden of claiming benefits.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102940.abstractZh: 英国的通用信贷福利改革简化了福利体系，同时大力激励人们回归可持续就业。通过分阶段实施，我们估计了通用信贷制度与旧有制度下失业对心理健康的不同影响。保险保障较少的群体——单身成年人及单亲家庭——其心理健康状况恶化了8.4%至13.9%的标准偏差，这种影响会持续至次年。对于夫妻来说，通用信贷制度在一定程度上缓解了失业带来的心理健康问题。对于单身成年人和单亲家庭而言，减少福利收入以及严格的求职要求，抵消了因行政手续简化而带来的任何积极福利效果。

abstract.text: We investigate the use of a highly scalable intervention to help individuals achieve their physical activity goals: self-funded commitment contracts. Using a randomised experiment, we compare the effect of soft (non-incentivised) and hard (incentivised) contracts among 1629 members of a gym in Stockholm, Sweden. We find a significant positive impact of being offered a hard contract on monthly visits to the gym and the probability of meeting one's contract goal. Relative to the control group, being offered a hard contract significantly increases gym visits by 21%, while being offered a soft contract leads to an 8% increase.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102943.abstractZh: 我们研究了一种高度可扩展的干预措施在帮助个人实现体育活动目标方面的应用：自筹资金承诺合同。通过随机实验，我们比较了软性（无激励）和硬性（有激励）合同对瑞典斯德哥尔摩一家健身房1629名会员的影响。研究发现，提供硬性合同对每月去健身房的次数以及实现合同目标的可能性有显著的积极影响。与对照组相比，提供硬性合同使去健身房的次数增加了21%，而提供软性合同则使去健身房的次数增加了8%。

abstract.text: This study examines how the undervaluation of funds in Medical Savings Accounts (MSAs) influences healthcare utilization in China. Given that MSA funds are restricted to healthcare expenses, individuals may undervalue these funds relative to cash, leading to potential overuse of health care. Through an event study approach using administrative data, we find significant reductions in healthcare utilization after MSA balances are depleted-outpatient care expenses drop by 49 percent, and drugstore purchases decrease by 41 percent. These effects persist across socioeconomic groups, indicating that liquidity constraints are not a major factor. Our back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that insured individuals undervalue MSA funds by 40-70 %. This research sheds light on the behavioral impacts of MSAs and the broader implications of perceived price distortions in health insurance.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102946.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了医疗储蓄账户中的资金被低估如何影响中国的医疗使用。由于医疗储蓄账户的资金仅限于医疗支出，个人可能会相对于现金低估这些资金的价值，从而导致医疗服务的过度使用。通过采用行政数据的事件研究方法，我们发现，在医疗储蓄账户余额耗尽后，医疗使用显著减少：门诊费用下降了49%，药品购买量减少了41%。这些效应在不同社会经济群体中都存在，表明流动性限制并非主要因素。我们的粗略计算表明，被保险人士对医疗储蓄账户资金的低估程度为40-70%。这项研究揭示了医疗储蓄账户的行为影响，以及保险价格扭曲所带来的更广泛影响。

abstract.text: Combining capitation with a cap on health care providers' average revenue can reduce allocative inefficiency. But the cap may be undercut by health care providers who churn their patient censuses. We investigate this possibility in the U.S. hospice industry, where Medicare pays hospice programs fixed daily rates but caps their average annual revenue. By leveraging variation generated by the cap's nonlinear design and the transition between fiscal years, we find that programs on track to exceed the cap raise enrollment rates by 5.8 % and live discharge rates by 4.3 % in the fourth quarter. But this churning falls far short of eliminating their financial penalties: it amounts to 10 % of an average program's excess revenue at most. Marginal enrollees have longer remaining lifetimes and more fragmented hospice spells on average, suggesting weaker intrinsic demand for hospice care. We discuss the cap's implications for market structure.

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2025.105435.abstractZh: 将按人头收费与对医疗服务提供者平均收入的限制相结合，可以减少资源配置的低效率。但是，那些频繁更换患者的医疗服务提供者可能会破坏这一限制的效果。我们在美国临终关怀行业对此进行了研究，该行业由医疗保险支付临终关怀项目的固定日费率，但对其平均年收入设限。通过利用这一限制的非线性设计以及财政年度之间的转换所带来的变化，我们发现，那些预计能够超过限制的项目在第四季度使注册率提高了5.8%，而出院率则提高了4.3%。然而，这种频繁更换患者的做法远远不足以消除其财务惩罚：最多只能使项目的总收入增加10%。边际注册患者平均剩余的生命期更长，临终关怀的持续时间也更为分散，这表明对临终关怀的内在需求较弱。我们讨论了这一限制对市场结构的影响。

abstract.text: How do employment, tasks, and productivity change with robot adoption? Unlike manufacturing, little is known about these issues in the service sector, where robot adoption is expanding. As a first step towards filling this gap, we study Japanese nursing homes using original facility-level panel data that includes the different robots used and the tasks performed. We find that robot adoption is accompanied by an increase in employment and retention and the relationship is strongest for non-regular care workers and monitoring robots. The share of specific tasks performed by robots increases with the adoption of the respective type of robot, leading to reallocation of care worker effort to “human touch” tasks that support quality care. Robots are associated with improved quality (reduction in restraint use and pressure ulcers) and productivity.

10.1016/j.labeco.2024.102666.abstractZh: 随着机器人的普及，就业、任务和生产率如何变化？与制造业不同，在服务领域，关于机器人普及的影响知之甚少。为了填补这一空白，我们研究了日本的养老院，使用了包含不同使用的机器人以及所执行任务的原始设施级面板数据。我们发现，机器人普及伴随着就业和保留率的上升，这种关系在非定期护理人员和监控机器人上最为明显。随着特定类型机器人的普及，机器人执行的特定任务比例增加，导致护理人员的精力重新分配到能够提升护理质量的“人文关怀”任务上。机器人还与护理质量的提高（如减少约束使用和压疮）以及生产率的提升相关。

abstract.text: We study how the threat of entry affects service quantity and quality of general practitioners (GPs). We leverage Germany’s needs-based primary care planning system, in which the likelihood of new GPs reduces by 20 percentage points when primary care coverage exceeds a cut-off. We compile novel data covering all German primary care regions and up to 30,000 GP-level observations from 2014 to 2019. Reduced threat of entry lowers patient satisfaction for incumbent GPs without nearby competitors but not in areas with competitors. We find no effects on working hours or quality measures at the regional level including hospitalizations and mortality.

10.1016/j.labeco.2024.102669.abstractZh: 我们研究了进入威胁如何影响全科医生的服务数量和质量。我们借鉴了德国基于需求的基础护理规划体系，该体系规定，当基础护理覆盖率超过某个阈值时，新全科医生的出现概率会降低20个百分点。我们收集了涵盖德国所有基础护理区域的数据，以及2014年至2019年间多达30,000个全科医生级别的观察数据。进入威胁的降低会降低现有全科医生的患者满意度，但在有竞争对手的地区则不会如此。我们在区域层面未发现工作时间或质量指标方面的变化，包括住院率和死亡率。

abstract.text: The hospital sector is frequently subject to reconfigurations, with some departments closing and new ones opening. Using a conditional logit model based on observed patient choices, we quantify the effects of a hospital department closure on the welfare of elective hip replacement patients in England. We simulate eight separate closures of the provider with lowest quality, as measured by one of four quality measures: revisions, emergency readmissions, 30-day mortality, change in the Oxford Hip Score , in urban and rural areas. The average reduction in welfare for patients who attended the closed hospital is equivalent to having to travel between two and ten additional kilometres for treatment, compared to their average travel distance, pre-closure, of 17.4 km. The reduction in patient welfare is generally more pronounced when closing a hospital in a rural area (about 50% higher when quality is measured by the Oxford Hip Score and emergency readmissions).

10.1016/j.regsciurbeco.2024.104064.abstractZh: 医院行业经常面临重组，一些科室会关闭，新的科室也会开设。我们基于观察到的患者选择，使用条件Logit模型来量化医院科室关闭对英格兰进行髋关节置换手术患者的福利的影响。我们模拟了八个不同情况下质量最低的医疗机构的关闭，这些关闭是根据四个不同的质量指标来衡量的：手术修正次数、急诊再入院次数、30天死亡率、牛津髋关节评分的变化，这些模拟发生在城市和农村地区。对于前往关闭的医院接受治疗的患者来说，平均福利下降相当于需要额外往返两到十公里，而关闭前的平均出行距离为17.4公里。当在农村地区关闭医院时，患者福利的下降更为明显（当以牛津髋关节评分和急诊再入院次数作为质量指标时，下降幅度约为50%）。

abstract.text: Academic Medical Centers (AMCs) - comprising medical schools, teaching hospitals, and research laboratories - play an important role in US biomedical innovation. The Balanced Budget Act of 1997 changed reimbursements for Medicare inpatient claims and subsidies for medical residents. We compare AMCs' relative exposure to the reform, how these differences affect their researchers' ability to attract NIH grant funding, and the quantity, impact, and content of their publications. We find that in response to the reform, research activity increased by approximately 6%. Changes in research composition suggest that hospitals responded to Medicare funding cuts by encouraging incumbent investigators to increase their research activities and by redirecting hiring efforts towards individuals attracted to AMCs (e.g., translational researchers). We find little effect on clinical outcomes.

10.1016/j.respol.2024.105163.abstractZh: 学术医疗中心（AMCs）——包括医学院、教学医院和研究实验室——在美国生物医学创新中发挥着重要作用。1997年的《平衡预算法案》改变了医疗保险住院费用的报销方式，并对医学住院医师提供了补贴。我们比较了这些中心在改革中的相对影响，这些差异如何影响研究人员吸引NIH资助的能力，以及他们的出版物数量、影响力和内容。研究发现，作为对改革的响应，研究活动增加了约6%。研究内容的调整表明，医院通过鼓励现有研究人员增加研究活动，并将招聘重点转向被吸引到学术医疗中心的人员（如转化研究人员），来应对医疗保险资金削减的影响。不过，这些变化对临床结果的影响较小。

abstract.text: A critical aspect of healthcare reforms in various countries revolves around the relationship between efficiency, quality, and competition. Exploring the spatial dimension of competition is essential to understand this connection thoroughly. In this study, we develop a theoretical model that examines hospitals' choices regarding quality and cost-containment efforts across different competitive environments characterized by varying spatial distributions of hospitals. We derive and fully characterize hospitals' reaction functions and Nash equilibria concerning quality and cost-containment efforts. Our findings reveal that while localized competition tends to reduce hospitals' efforts in cost containment, its impact on treatment quality can vary. This variation depends on factors such as the cost of delivering quality care, its benefits to patients, and hospitals' objectives, including their level of altruism. Our findings contribute to the ongoing debate on the role of local competition in healthcare. They offer insights into the conditions that could yield divergent outcomes, often advocated by conflicting perspectives. These conditions serve as a foundation for refining competition policy models in healthcare.

10.1016/j.rie.2024.100962.abstractZh: 各国医疗改革的一个关键方面是效率、质量和竞争之间的关系。探讨竞争的空间维度对于全面理解这种关系至关重要。在本研究中，我们建立了一个理论模型，用于分析医院在不同竞争环境下的质量与成本控制方面的选择，这些竞争环境具有不同的医院空间分布特征。我们推导并全面描述了医院在质量与成本控制方面的反应函数以及纳什均衡。研究发现，虽然局部竞争往往会减少医院在成本控制方面的努力，但其对治疗质量的影响可能会有所不同。这种差异取决于诸如提供高质量护理的成本、其对患者的好处以及医院的目标等因素，包括医院的利他主义程度。我们的研究结果为关于局部竞争在医疗领域作用的持续讨论提供了见解。它们揭示了可能导致不同结果的条件，这些条件常常被不同的观点所倡导。这些条件为完善医疗领域的竞争政策模型提供了基础。

abstract.text: Countries increasingly rely on competition among hospitals to improve health outcomes. However, there is limited empirical evidence on the effect of competition on health outcomes in Germany. We examined the effect of hospital competition on quality of care, which is assessed using health outcomes (risk-adjusted in-hospital and post-hospitalization mortality and cardiac-related readmissions), focusing on acute myocardial infarction (AMI) treatment. We obtained data on all hospital utilizations and mortality of 13.2% of the population from a large statutory health insurer and all AMI admission records from Diagnosis-Related Groups Statistic from 2015-19. We constructed the measures of hospital competition, which mitigates the possibility of endogeneity bias. The relationships between health outcomes and competition measures are estimated using linear probability models. Intense competition was associated with lower quality of care in terms of mortality and cardiac-related readmissions. Patients treated in hospitals facing high competition were 0.9 (1.2) percentage points more likely to die within 90 days (2 years) of admission, and 1.4 (1.6) percentage points more likely to be readmitted within 90 days (2 years) of discharge than patients treated in hospitals facing low competition. Our results indicate that hospital competition does not lead to better health outcomes for AMI patients in Germany. Therefore, additional measures are necessary to achieve quality improvement.

10.1016/j.socscimed.2024.116910.abstractZh: 各国越来越依赖医院之间的竞争来改善健康结果。然而，关于竞争对德国健康结果影响的实证证据有限。我们研究了医院竞争对护理质量的影响，评估依据是健康结果（包括风险调整后的住院期间和出院后的死亡率以及心脏相关再入院率），重点关注急性心肌梗死（AMI）的治疗。我们获得了来自一家大型法定健康保险公司的13.2%人口的所有医院使用情况和死亡率数据，以及2015-19年间诊断相关组统计中的所有AMI入院记录。我们构建了医院竞争的指标，以缓解内生性偏差的可能性。健康结果与竞争指标之间的关系通过线性概率模型进行估计。激烈的竞争与较低的护理质量相关，表现为较低的死亡率和心脏相关再入院率。在竞争激烈的医院接受治疗的患者，在入院后90天（2年内）死亡的可能性高出0.9（1.2）个百分点，在出院后90天（2年内）再次入院的可能性高出1.4（1.6）个百分点。我们的结果表明，医院竞争并未使德国AMI患者的健康结果得到改善。因此，需要采取额外的措施来实现质量的提升。

abstract.text: Increasing evidence suggests that new technologies tend to substitute for low skilled labour and complement highly skilled labour. This paper considers the manner in which new technology impacts on two distinct groups of highly skilled health care labour, cardiologists and cardiac surgeons. We consider the diffusion impact of PCI as it replaces CABG in the treatment of cardiovascular disease in the English NHS, and explicitly estimate the degree to which the cardiac surgical workforce reacts to this newer technology. Using administrative data we trace the complementarity between CABG and PCI during the mature phase of technology adoption, mapped against an increasing employment of cardiologists as they replace cardiothoracic surgeons. Our findings show evidence of growing employment of cardiologists, as PCI is increasingly expanded to older and sicker patients. While in cardiothoracic surgery, surgeons compensate falling CABG rates in a manner consistent with undertaking replacement activity and redeployment. While for cardiologists this reflects the general findings in the literature, that new technology enhances rather than substitutes for skilled labour, for the surgeons the new technology leads to redeployment rather than a downsizing of their labour.

10.1016/j.socscimed.2024.117014.abstractZh: 越来越多的证据表明，新技术倾向于替代低技能劳动力，并补充高技能劳动力。本文探讨了新技术对两类高技能医疗劳动力的影响：心脏病专家和心脏外科医生。我们研究了PCI技术在英国国家医疗服务体系中对CABG的替代效应，并明确评估了心脏外科医生对这一新技术的反应程度。通过行政数据，我们追踪了技术采用成熟阶段CABG与PCI之间的互补性，同时观察了心脏病专家随着取代心胸外科医生而增加的就业情况。我们的研究发现，随着PCI越来越多地被用于年龄更大、病情更严重的患者，心脏病专家的就业人数也在增加。而在心胸外科手术领域，外科医生通过承担替代性任务来弥补CABG手术率的下降。对于心脏病专家来说，这一情况反映了文献中的普遍现象，即新技术增强了而非替代了熟练劳动力；而对于外科医生而言，新技术则导致了劳动力的重新配置，而非减少。

abstract.text: This national US study determined the causal impact of shared decision making (SDM) on pain outcomes, including any overall pain and the subcategories of any acute pain and any chronic pain. We additionally examined whether the causal impact of SDM on overall pain is moderated by gender, race-ethnicity, clinician-patient racial-ethnic concordance, and clinician-patient gender concordance. We used national US data from the 2003-2017 Medical Expenditure Panel Survey, which were externally valid to the US national non-institutionalized population, employed a standard measure of shared decision making, and applied an internally-valid two-stage least squares approach that used the peer SDM behavior of similar clinicians as an instrument. The instrument was sufficiently strong and statistically uncorrelated with patient characteristics. We found a large impact of SDM on both female and male chronic pain outcomes, where the effect for females was approximately 50% larger than for males, with a 10 percentage point increase in SDM quality resulted fewer females experiencing chronic pain that interfered with everyday activities (-24.8 percentage points; 95% confidence interval [CI]: 43.3, -6.4) than males (-16.5 percentage points; 95% CI: 32.9, -1.0). We estimated that a 10 percentage point national increase in the SDM index would thus result in 10.1 million fewer females and 5.7 million fewer males in the US experiencing chronic pain that interfered with their daily activities. Policy implications include both increasing the quality of SDM for all patients and educating male patients on the value of SDM.

10.1016/j.socscimed.2024.117132.abstractZh: 这项针对美国的全国性研究旨在确定共同决策对疼痛结果的影响，包括总体疼痛以及急性疼痛和慢性疼痛的细分类别。我们还探讨了共同决策对总体疼痛的影响是否受到性别、种族-族裔背景、临床医生与患者的种族-族裔一致性以及临床医生与患者的性别一致性等因素的调节。研究使用了2003年至2017年美国的医疗支出调查数据，这些数据对美国的非机构化人口具有外部有效性。研究采用了标准的共同决策衡量方法，并采用了一种内部有效的两阶段最小二乘法，以类似临床医生的同伴共同决策行为作为评估工具。该工具具有足够的效度，并且与患者特征无统计相关性。研究发现，共同决策对女性和男性的慢性疼痛结果都有显著影响，其中女性的影响大约比男性大50%。共同决策质量的提高10个百分点，意味着有较少的女性出现影响日常活动的慢性疼痛（降低24.8个百分点；95%置信区间：43.3，-6.4），而男性则减少16.5个百分点（95%置信区间：32.9，-1.0）。据估计，共同决策指数在全国范围内提高10个百分点，将导致美国有101万女性以及570万男性减少出现影响日常活动的慢性疼痛的情况。政策建议包括提高所有患者的共同决策质量，以及教育男性患者了解共同决策的价值。

abstract.text: Zusammenfassung Die Auswirkung der Leistungskonzentration auf die Ergebnisqualität stationärer Leistungen im Krankenhaussektor ist Gegenstand kontroverser wissenschaftlicher Diskussionen. Besonders wichtig ist diese Debatte im Bereich der Geburtshilfe. Ziel dieses Beitrags war es, den Einfluss von Volume-Outcome-Faktoren und wettbewerbsökonomischen Parametern auf die Ergebnisqualität in geburtshilflichen Abteilungen deutscher Krankenhäuser zu untersuchen. Diesem Zweck liegt ein quantitativer Forschungsansatz zu Grunde, bei dem Struktur- und Leistungsdaten von 412 deutschen Krankenhäusern im Jahr 2021 analysiert wurden. Zur Überprüfung der Hypothesen wurde ein polynomiales multiples Regressionsmodell mit insgesamt elf unabhängigen Variablen geschätzt. Als Indikator für die Ergebnisqualität in Geburtshilfeabteilungen diente die Sterblichkeit von Neugeborenen. Entgegen den Erwartungen spielen die für Geburten wichtigen wettbewerbsökonomischen Parameter eine eher untergeordnete Rolle, während für Volume-Outcome-Beziehungen starke empirische Belege gefunden werden konnten. Die Ergebnisse dieser Studie legen nahe, dass positive Qualitätseffekte von Leistungskonzentrationen auch im Bereich der Geburtshilfe überwiegen und liefern damit unterstützende Indizien für die Argumentationslogik der bevorstehenden Krankenhausreform in Deutschland.

10.1055/a-2373-6769.abstractZh: 摘要 医疗服务集中对医院产科服务质量的影响一直是学术界的争议话题。在产科领域，这一争论尤为关键。本文旨在研究数量-结果因素以及竞争经济参数对德国医院产科服务质量的影响。研究采用了定量研究方法，分析了2021年412家德国医院的结构和医疗服务数据。为了验证假设，采用了包含11个独立变量的多项式多元回归模型。产科服务质量的指标选为新生儿死亡率。与预期相反，对分娩至关重要的竞争经济参数作用相对较小，而数量-结果关系则得到了强有力的实证支持。研究结果表明，医疗服务集中的积极质量效应在产科领域更为显著，这为德国即将进行的医院改革提供了有力的论据支持。

abstract.text: In China, hospitals are classified into three tiers based on size and quality to triage patients. Among them, tier-2 and tier-3 hospitals provide similar inpatient services, while tier-3s have higher patient cost sharing due to their ability to provide more sophisticated care. In this study, we exploit a plausibly exogenous change in the financial environment facing tier-2 hospitals: reduced cost sharing in tier-3s. We find that patients are diverted from tier-2s after the reform, and in response to income loss, tier-2s increase the surgical probability and total expense per admission. A 1% decrease in the number of admissions increases the surgical probability by 0.25%, which suggests supplier-induced demand. We also find that tier-2 hospitals induce greater demand from patients with less urgent conditions and more elective procedures. Our analysis suggests that benevolent cost sharing reduction may have unintended consequences beyond the targeted group, and policymakers who neglect these effects would underestimate the costs of such reforms.

10.1080/00036846.2024.2364107.abstractZh: 在中国，医院根据规模和质量被分为三个等级，以对患者进行分流。其中，二级和三级医院提供类似的住院服务，而三级医院由于能够提供更精细的护理，患者的费用分担比例更高。在本研究中，我们关注了二级医院面临的一个可能由外部因素引起的财务环境变化：三级医院的费用分担减少。我们发现，改革后，患者从二级医院转向了三级医院，并且由于收入减少，二级医院增加了手术的概率和每次住院的总费用。入院数量减少1%会使手术概率增加0.25%，这表明存在供应商诱导的需求。我们还发现，二级医院吸引了更多病情较不紧急且需要更多选择性手术的患者。我们的分析表明，积极的费用分担减少可能会带来超出预期的影响，忽视这些效应的政策制定者将低估此类改革的成本。

abstract.text: Although many studies have discussed the social impact of ride-hailing services, there is no consensus on whether ride-hailing services aggravate or alleviate road traffic fatalities. In particular, no research has deeply studied the relationship between ride-hailing services and road traffic fatalities in the Chinese context. Based on the panel data of 115 cities from 2005 to 2018, this study uses the different entry times of Didi Express and Didi Hitch to design a natural experiment. A multi-period differences-in-differences model is used to analyze the impact of Didi Express and Didi Hitch on road traffic fatalities. The results show that the entry of Didi Express significantly increases road traffic fatalities, but its impact decreases year by year. The entry of Didi Hitch has no significant impact on road traffic fatalities. Further analysis shows that the ride-hailing regulation effectively alleviates the impact of Didi Express on road traffic fatalities. These findings reveal that the increased numbers of on-road vehicles, engagement of unqualified drivers, and use of noncompliant vehicles may contribute to road traffic fatalities associated with Didi Express. Therefore, systematically promoting the enforcement of ride-hailing regulation is essential to mitigate road traffic fatalities.

10.1080/19439962.2024.2341377.abstractZh: 尽管许多研究探讨了网约车服务的社会影响，但关于网约车服务是加剧了还是减轻了道路交通死亡事故，目前尚无共识。特别是在中国背景下，尚未有研究深入探讨网约车服务与道路交通死亡事故之间的关系。本研究基于2005至2018年间115个城市的面板数据，利用滴滴快车和滴滴拼车不同的进入时间设计了一个自然实验。通过多期差异-差异模型分析滴滴快车和滴滴拼车对道路交通死亡事故的影响。结果显示，滴滴快车的进入显著增加了道路交通死亡事故，但其影响逐年减弱。而滴滴拼车的进入对道路交通死亡事故没有显著影响。进一步分析表明，网约车监管有效减轻了滴滴快车对道路交通死亡事故的影响。这些发现表明，道路上的车辆数量增加、不合格驾驶员的参与以及不合规车辆的使用，可能是导致与滴滴快车相关的道路交通死亡事故的原因。因此，系统地推进网约车监管的落实对于减轻道路交通死亡事故至关重要。

abstract.text: We document strong skill matching in Turkish firms’ production networks. Additionally, in the data, export demand shocks from rich countries increase firms’ skill intensity and their trade with skill-intensive domestic partners. We explain these patterns using a quantitative model with heterogeneous firms, quality choices, and endogenous networks. A counterfactual economy-wide export demand shock of 5% leads both exporters and nonexporters to upgrade quality, raising the average wage by 1.2%. This effect is nine times the effect in a scenario without interconnected quality choices. We use the model to study the conditions for the success of export promotion policies.

10.1086/725703.abstractZh: 我们发现在土耳其企业的生产网络中，技能匹配程度很高。此外，数据表明，来自富裕国家的出口需求冲击会提高企业的技能强度，并增强其与技能密集型国内合作伙伴的贸易往来。我们使用一个包含异质企业、质量选择以及内生网络的定量模型来解释这些现象。如果整个经济领域发生5%的出口需求冲击，那么出口商和非出口商都会提升产品质量，平均工资也会上升1.2%。这一效应是缺乏质量选择互联性情景下的九倍。我们利用该模型来研究出口促进政策成功实施的条件。

abstract.text: We evaluate progress in the War on Poverty as President Lyndon B. Johnson defined it, which established a 20% baseline poverty rate and adopted an absolute standard. While the official poverty rate fell from 19.5% in 1963 to 10.5% in 2019, our absolute full-income poverty measure—which uses a fuller income measure and updates thresholds only for inflation—fell from 19.5% to 1.6%. However, we also show that relative poverty reductions have been modest. Additionally, government dependence increased over this time, with the share of working-age adults receiving under half their income from market sources more than doubling.

10.1086/725705.abstractZh: 我们评估了林登·B·约翰逊总统所定义的“反贫困战争”的进展。该计划设定了20%的贫困基准线，并采用了绝对标准。虽然官方贫困率从1963年的19.5%降至2019年的10.5%，但我们使用更全面的收入衡量标准，并仅根据通货膨胀情况更新门槛的绝对全收入贫困指标，其数值从19.5%降至1.6%。然而，我们也发现相对贫困率的降低幅度较为有限。此外，政府依赖性在此期间有所上升，处于工作年龄的成年人从市场来源获得的收入不足其总收入的一半的比例，这一比例增加了两倍多。

abstract.text: This paper extends a canonical model of intergenerational human capital investment to a geographic context to study the role of migration in influencing income mobility in the United States. The main result is that migration is considerably influential in shaping the high rates of economic mobility observed among children from low-wage areas, with human capital investment behavioral responses being important to consider. Equalizing school quality across locations does more to reduce interstate inequality in income mobility than equalizing skill prices, and policies that attempt to decrease human capital flight from low-wage areas via cash transfers are unlikely to be cost-effective.

10.1086/725706.abstractZh: 本文将代际人力资本投资的经典模型扩展至地理背景，研究迁移对美国收入流动性影响的作用。主要结论是，迁移在塑造来自低工资地区儿童的高经济流动性方面具有显著影响力，而人力资本投资的行为反应也需要予以重视。在减少跨州收入流动性方面，均衡各地学校质量比均衡技能价格更为有效，而通过现金转移来减少低工资地区人力资本流失的政策，其成本效益可能并不高。

abstract.text: In the United States, households obtain health insurance through distinct market segments. To explore the economics of this segmentation, we consider the effects of pooling coverage provided through small employers and through individual marketplaces. We model households’ demand for insurance and health care along with insurers’ price setting to predict equilibrium choices and premiums. Applying our model to data from Oregon, we find that pooling can mitigate adverse selection in the individual market and benefit small group households without raising taxpayer costs. Our estimates provide insight into the effects of new regulations that allow employers to shift coverage to individual marketplaces.

10.1086/725707.abstractZh: 在美国，家庭通过不同的市场渠道获得健康保险。为了探讨这种分层的经济效应，我们考虑了小型雇主和个人市场提供的保险覆盖的整合效果。我们模拟了家庭对保险和医疗服务的需求，以及保险公司定价行为，以预测均衡选择和保费。将我们的模型应用于俄勒冈州的数据，我们发现整合可以减轻个人市场中的逆向选择问题，并使小型群体家庭受益，而不会增加纳税人的负担。我们的估计结果揭示了允许雇主将保险覆盖转移给个人市场的新法规所带来的影响。

abstract.text: We show how real and financial frictions amplify, prolong, and propagate the negative impact of uncertainty shocks. We use a novel instrumentation strategy to address endogeneity in estimating the impact of uncertainty by exploiting differential firm exposure to exchange rate, policy, and energy price volatility. We show that financially constrained firms cut investment more than unconstrained firms following an uncertainty shock. We then build a general equilibrium heterogeneous firms model with real and financial frictions, finding that financial frictions (i) amplify uncertainty shocks by doubling their impact on output; (ii) increase persistence by doubling the duration of the drop; and (iii) propagate uncertainty shocks by spreading their impact onto financial variables.

10.1086/726230.abstractZh: 我们展示了实际和财务摩擦如何放大、延长并加剧不确定性冲击的负面影响。我们采用一种新颖的计量策略，通过利用不同企业在汇率、政策和能源价格波动方面的差异来估计不确定性冲击的影响。我们发现，在不确定性冲击之后，财务上受限的企业比财务上不受限的企业更大幅度地削减投资。随后，我们构建了一个包含实际和财务摩擦的一般均衡异质企业模型，发现财务摩擦具有以下作用：(i) 通过使不确定性冲击对产出的影响翻倍而加剧其影响；(ii) 通过延长产出下降的持续时间来增加其持续性；(iii) 通过将影响扩散到财务变量上来加剧不确定性冲击。

abstract.text: We estimate a life-cycle model of consumption, human capital investment, and labor supply. The interaction between human capital and labor supply toward the end of the life cycle is most novel. The estimates replicate the main features of the data, in particular the large increase in wages and small increase in labor supply at the beginning of the life cycle and the small decrease in wages but large decrease in labor supply toward the end. We show that incorporating human capital is critical when analyzing changes to Social Security.

10.1086/726232.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个关于消费、人力资本投资和劳动力供给的生命周期模型。在生命周期的末期，人力资本与劳动力供给之间的互动是最新颖的。模型的结果与数据的主要特征相符，特别是在生命周期初期，工资大幅上升而劳动力供给增长较小；而在末期，工资下降幅度较小，但劳动力供给则大幅减少。我们指出，在分析社会保障政策的变化时，考虑人力资本因素至关重要。

abstract.text: We measure college graduate quality—the average human capital of a college’s graduates—for graduates from 2,800 colleges in 48 countries.
