10.1093/qje/qjae021.abstractZh: 我们通过关于专业利率预测和宏观经济状况的面板数据，来估计人们对美联储货币政策规则的看法。人们对联邦基金利率与经济状况之间关系的看法随时间而变化，尤其是在货币政策周期中。预测者会根据高频利率的意外变化，更新他们对美联储政策规则的看法，这表明他们对这一规则的信息掌握并不完善。货币政策观念对货币传导过程至关重要，因为它们影响着利率对宏观经济新闻的敏感度、长期债券的期限溢价，以及股市对货币政策意外反应的响应。一个简单的学习模型，考虑到预测者的异质性和关于政策规则的信息不完全性，能够解释我们的实证发现。

abstract.text: Domestic abuse encompasses a range of damaging behaviors beyond physical violence, including economic and emotional abuse. We analyze the impact of cohabiting with an abusive partner on victims’ economic outcomes. In so doing, we highlight the systematic role of economic suppression in such relationships. Using Finnish administrative data and a matched-control event-study design, along with a within-individual comparison of outcomes across relationships, we document three new facts. First, women who begin relationships with (eventually) physically abusive men suffer large and significant earnings and employment falls immediately upon cohabiting with the abusive partner. Second, the decline in economic outcomes is non-monotonic in women’s pre-cohabitation outside options. Third, men who are violent against women in any capacity impose economic costs on all their female partners, even those who do not report physical violence. To rationalize these findings, we develop a new dynamic model of abusive relationships where women do not perfectly observe their partner’s type, and abusive men have an incentive to use economic suppression to sabotage women’s outside options and their ability to later exit the relationship.

10.1093/qje/qjae022.abstractZh: 家庭虐待包括除身体暴力之外的各种有害行为，还包括经济和情感上的虐待。我们分析了与施虐伴侣同居对受害者经济结果的影响，并强调了经济压制在这种关系中的系统性作用。利用芬兰的行政数据以及匹配对照事件研究设计，并对比不同关系中的个体结果，我们发现了三个新的事实。首先，与最终会实施身体暴力的男性开始恋爱关系的女性，在与施虐伴侣同居后，她们的收入和就业状况会立即出现显著下降。其次，经济结果的下降程度与女性在同居前是否有其他选择无关。第三，无论以何种方式对女性实施暴力的男性，都会给所有女性伴侣带来经济负担，即使那些没有报告身体暴力的女性也是如此。为了解释这些发现，我们提出了一个新的动态模型，其中女性并不能完全了解伴侣的施虐行为，而施虐男性则有动机通过经济压制来破坏女性的外部选择以及她们日后离开关系的机会。

abstract.text: This article studies the long-run effects of slavery and restrictive Jim Crow institutions on Black Americans’ economic outcomes. We track individual-level census records of each Black family from 1850 to 1940 and extend our analysis to neighborhood-level outcomes in 2000 and surname-based outcomes in 2023. We show that Black families whose ancestors were enslaved until the Civil War have considerably lower education, income, and wealth than Black families whose ancestors were free before the Civil War. The disparities between the two groups have persisted substantially because most families enslaved until the Civil War lived in states with strict Jim Crow regimes after slavery ended. In a regression discontinuity design based on ancestors’ enslavement locations, we show that Jim Crow institutions sharply reduced Black families’ economic progress in the long run.

10.1093/qje/qjae023.abstractZh: 本文研究了奴隶制以及限制性吉姆·克劳制度对黑人美国人经济成果的长期影响。我们追踪了1850年至1940年间每个黑人家庭的个体级人口普查记录，并将分析范围扩展到2000年的社区级结果以及2023年的姓氏相关结果。研究表明，那些祖先在南北战争前被奴役的黑人家庭，其教育水平、收入和经济财富都明显低于那些在南北战争前就自由生活的黑人家庭。这两组家庭之间的差距持续存在，主要是因为大多数在南北战争前被奴役的家庭生活在奴隶制结束后仍实行严格吉姆·克劳制度的州。基于祖先被奴役地点的回归 discontinuity 设计表明，吉姆·克劳制度在长期内显著降低了黑人家庭的经济进步。

abstract.text: Forward-looking investments determine the resilience of firms’ supply chains. Such investments confer externalities on other firms in the production network. We compare the equilibrium and optimal allocations in a general equilibrium model with an arbitrary number of vertical production tiers. Our model features endogenous investments in protective capabilities, endogenous formation of supply links, and sequential bargaining over quantities and payments between firms in successive tiers. We derive policies that implement the first-best allocation, allowing for subsidies to input purchases, network formation, and investments in protective capabilities. The first-best policies depend only on production function parameters of the pertinent tier. When subsidies to transactions are infeasible, the second-best subsidies for resilience depend on production function parameters throughout the network, and subsidies are larger upstream than downstream whenever the bargaining weights of buyers are nonincreasing along the chain.

10.1093/qje/qjae024.abstractZh: 前瞻性投资决定了企业供应链的韧性。这类投资为生产网络中的其他企业带来外部性收益。我们在一个具有任意数量垂直生产层级的一般均衡模型中，比较了均衡状态与最优分配情况。我们的模型包含了对保护能力的内生性投资、供应链接的内生性形成，以及各生产层级之间关于数量和支付方式的顺序谈判。我们提出了实施最优分配的政策，包括对投入采购、网络形成以及保护能力投资进行补贴。最优政策仅依赖于相关生产层级的生产函数参数。当对交易的补贴不可行时，提高韧性的次优补贴则取决于整个网络的生产函数参数，并且当买方的谈判权重沿链条呈非递增趋势时，上游的补贴要比下游更大。

abstract.text: This article explores the use of social signaling as a policy tool to sustainably affect childhood immunization. In a 26-month field experiment with public clinics in Sierra Leone, I introduce a verifiable signal-in the form of color-coded bracelets-given to children upon timely completion of the first four or all five required vaccinations. Signals increase parents' belief in the visibility of their actions and knowledge of other children's vaccine status. The impact of signals varies significantly with the cost and perceived benefits of the action. There are no discernible effects on timely and complete immunization when the signal is linked to an easier-to-complete vaccine with low perceived benefits, and large positive effects when the signal is linked to a costlier-to-achieve vaccine with high perceived benefits. Parents adjust their behavior nine months before realizing the social image benefit, demonstrating the motivational strength of signaling incentives. Of substantive policy importance, bracelets increase full immunization at one year of age by 9 percentage points, with impacts persisting at two years of age. At a marginal cost of US$24.7 per fully immunized child, social signals can be as cost-effective as financial or in-kind incentives.

10.1093/qje/qjae025.abstractZh: 本文探讨了将社会信号作为政策工具来可持续地影响儿童免疫接种的效果。在塞拉利昂的公立诊所进行了一项为期26个月的实地实验，我们向儿童在按时完成前四次或全部五次必要疫苗接种后，发放了可验证的信号——以彩色编码的手镯形式。信号能够增强父母对自己行为的可见性认知，以及他们对其他儿童疫苗接种状况的了解。信号的效果因行动的成本和感知收益而异。当信号与更容易完成且感知收益较低的疫苗相关联时，不会对及时和完整的免疫接种产生明显影响；而当信号与成本较高但感知收益较高的疫苗相关联时，则会产生显著的正面效果。父母在意识到社会信号带来的好处之前九个月就开始调整自己的行为，这表明信号激励具有强大的动机作用。从政策角度来看，手镯可以将一岁儿童的完全免疫率提高9个百分点，且这种效果在两岁时仍然持续。以每名完全免疫儿童24.7美元的成本，社会信号可以像经济或实物激励一样具有成本效益。

abstract.text: I develop a directed technical change model of economic growth and energy efficiency in order to study the impact of climate change mitigation policies on energy use. I show that the standard Cobb–Douglas production function used in the environmental macroeconomics literature overstates the reduction in cumulative energy use that can be achieved with a given path of energy taxes. I also show that, in the model, the government combines energy taxes with research and development (R&D) policy that favors output-increasing technology—rather than energy efficiency technology—to maximize welfare subject to a constraint on cumulative energy use. In addition, I study energy use dynamics following sudden improvements in energy efficiency. Exogenous shocks that increase energy efficiency also decrease the incentive for subsequent energy efficiency R&D and increase long-run energy use relative to a world without the original shock. Subsidies for energy efficiency R&D, however, permanently alter R&D incentives and decrease long-run energy use.

10.1093/restud/rdad001.abstractZh: 我开发了一个针对经济增长和能源效率的技术变革模型，以研究气候变化缓解政策对能源使用的影响。研究表明，环境宏观经济学文献中使用的标准Cobb–Douglas生产函数高估了在给定能源税政策下可以实现的累计能源使用减少量。此外，该模型还表明，政府将能源税与促进产出增加的技术研发政策相结合，以在累计能源使用的限制条件下最大化福利。此外，我还研究了能源效率突然提升后的能源使用动态。提高能源效率的外生冲击也会降低后续能源效率研发的激励，并导致长期能源使用量相对于没有这种冲击的世界有所增加。然而，对能源效率研发的补贴会永久性地改变研发激励，并降低长期能源使用量。

abstract.text: It is often desired to rank different populations according to the value of some feature of each population. For example, it may be desired to rank neighbourhoods according to some measure of intergenerational mobility or countries according to some measure of academic achievement. These rankings are invariably computed using estimates rather than the true values of these features. As a result, there may be considerable uncertainty concerning the rank of each population. In this paper, we consider the problem of accounting for such uncertainty by constructing confidence sets for the rank of each population. We consider both the problem of constructing marginal confidence sets for the rank of a particular population as well as simultaneous confidence sets for the ranks of all populations. We show how to construct such confidence sets under weak assumptions. An important feature of all of our constructions is that they remain computationally feasible even when the number of populations is very large. We apply our theoretical results to re-examine the rankings of both neighbourhoods in the U.S. in terms of intergenerational mobility and developed countries in terms of academic achievement. The conclusions about which countries do best and worst at reading, math, and science are fairly robust to accounting for uncertainty. The confidence sets for the ranking of the fifty most populous commuting zones by measures of mobility are also found to be small. These confidence sets, however, become much less informative if one includes all commuting zones, if one considers neighbourhoods at a more granular level (counties, census tracts), or if one uses movers across areas to address concerns about selection.

10.1093/restud/rdad006.abstractZh: 通常希望根据每个群体的某个特征值对不同的群体进行排序。例如，可能希望根据代际流动性的某种衡量标准对社区进行排序，或者根据学术成就的某种衡量标准对国家进行排序。这些排序总是使用估计值而不是这些特征的真实值来计算的。因此，每个群体的排名可能存在相当大的不确定性。在本文中，我们考虑通过构建每个群体排名的置信区间来应对这种不确定性问题。我们考虑了为特定群体的排名构建边际置信区间的问题，以及为所有群体的排名同时构建置信区间的问题。我们在弱假设下展示了如何构建这样的置信区间。我们所有构建方法的一个重要特点是，即使群体数量非常多，它们仍然在计算上是可行的。我们将理论结果应用于重新评估美国各社区的代际流动性排名，以及发达国家在学术成就方面的排名。关于哪些国家在阅读、数学和科学方面的表现最好或最差的结论，在考虑不确定性后仍然相当稳健。对于按流动性指标排名的五十个人口最多的通勤区，所得到的置信区间也相当小。然而，如果包括所有通勤区，或者考虑更细粒度的社区（如县、人口普查区），或者使用跨区域的迁移来解决选择问题，这些置信区间的信息量就会大大减少。

abstract.text: Private efficiency of wage rigidity has taken centre stage in economics. Measuring its effects has proven elusive for lack of actual wage data. Using a unique confidential labour contract-level dataset matched with firm-level high-frequency asset prices, we find robust evidence that firms’ stock prices and employment fluctuate more in response to monetary policy announcements, the higher the degree of wage rigidity. Hand-collected information on the periods across renegotiations of collective bargaining agreements allow us to construct an accurate and predetermined measure of wage rigidity. We find that the amplification induced by wage rigidity is stronger for firms with high labour intensity, low profitability, and a large share of workers with more rigid contracts.

10.1093/restud/rdad020.abstractZh: 工资刚性在经济学中被视为一个重要的议题。由于缺乏实际的工资数据，衡量其影响一直难以实现。我们利用一个独特的、包含企业层面高频资产价格信息的保密劳动合同数据集，发现随着工资刚性程度的增加，企业的股票价格和就业情况对货币政策公告的反应更为强烈。通过手工收集集体谈判协议重新谈判期间的详细信息，我们能够构建一个准确且可预测的工资刚性衡量指标。研究发现，对于劳动强度高、盈利能力低以及大部分员工合同刚性较强的企业来说，工资刚性引发的放大效应更为显著。

abstract.text: This paper revisits the link between electrification and the rise in female labour force participation (LFP), and presents theoretical and empirical evidence showing that electrification triggered a rise in female LFP by increasing market opportunities for skilled women. I formalize my theory in an overlapping generations model and find that my mechanism explains one quarter of the rise in female LFP during the rollout of electricity in the U.S. (1880–1940), and matches the slow decline in female home production hours during this period. I then present micro-evidence supporting my theory using newly digitized data on the early electrification of the U.S.

10.1093/restud/rdad021.abstractZh: 本文重新审视了电气化与女性劳动力参与率上升之间的联系，并通过理论和实证证据表明，电气化通过增加女性技术劳动力的市场机会，促成了女性劳动力参与率的上升。我在重叠世代模型中对理论进行了形式化，发现我的机制能够解释美国电力普及期（1880-1940年）内女性劳动力参与率上升的四分之一原因，并且与这一时期女性家庭生产时间缓慢减少的现象相吻合。随后，我利用新数字化数据，提供了支持我理论的微观证据，以进一步验证这一理论。

abstract.text: This paper incorporates diagnostic expectations into a general equilibrium macroeconomic model with a financial intermediary sector. Diagnostic expectations are a forward-looking model of extrapolative expectations that overreact to recent news. Frictions in financial intermediation produce non-linear spikes in risk premia and slumps in investment during periods of financial distress. The interaction of sentiment with financial frictions generates a short-run amplification effect followed by a long-run reversal effect, termed the feedback from behavioural frictions to financial frictions. The model features sentiment-driven financial crises characterized by low pre-crisis risk premia and neglected risk. The conflicting short-run and long-run effect of sentiment produces boom–bust investment cycles. The model also identifies a stabilizing role for diagnostic expectations. Under the baseline calibration, financial crises are less likely to occur when expectations are diagnostic than when they are rational.

10.1093/restud/rdad023.abstractZh: 本文将诊断性预期纳入一个包含金融中介部门的通用均衡宏观经济模型。诊断性预期是一种前瞻性模型，属于外推式预期，会对近期新闻反应过度。金融中介过程中的摩擦会导致风险溢价出现非线性波动，并在金融困境期间引发投资下降。情绪与金融摩擦之间的相互作用会产生短期放大效应，随后又会出现长期逆转效应，这被称为行为摩擦对金融摩擦的反馈效应。该模型描述了由情绪驱动的金融危机，其特征是危机前的风险溢价较低且风险被忽视。情绪在短期和长期中的矛盾效应导致了投资周期的繁荣与萧条。该模型还指出了诊断性预期的稳定作用。在基准校准下，当预期具有诊断性时，金融危机发生的可能性低于当预期具有理性时的情况。

abstract.text: A large psychology literature argues that, due to selective memory recall, decision-makers’ forecasts of the future are overly influenced by the perceived news. We adopt the diagnostic expectations (DE) paradigm [Bordalo et al. (2018), Journal of Finance, 73, 199–227] to capture this feature of belief formation, develop a method to incorporate DE in business cycle models, and study the implications for aggregate dynamics. First, we address (1) the theoretical challenges associated with modelling the feedback between optimal actions and agents’ DE beliefs and (2) the time-inconsistencies that arise under distant memory (i.e. when news is perceived with respect to a more distant past than just the immediate one). Second, we show that under distant memory the interaction between actions and DE beliefs naturally generates repeated boom–bust cycles in response to a single initial shock. We also propose a portable solution method to study DE in dynamic stochastic general equilibrium models and use it to estimate a quantitative DE New Keynesian model. Both endogenous states and distant memory play a critical role in successfully replicating the boom–bust cycle observed in response to a monetary policy shock.

10.1093/restud/rdad024.abstractZh: 大量心理学文献认为，由于选择性记忆的回放，决策者对未来的预测会受到感知到的新闻的过度影响。我们采用诊断性预期范式[Bordalo等人（2018），《金融杂志》，73，199-227]来捕捉这种信念形成的特点，开发了一种将诊断性预期纳入商业周期模型的方法，并研究其对总体动态的影响。首先，我们解决了与建模最优行动与代理人诊断性预期信念之间的反馈关系相关的理论挑战，以及当新闻相对于更遥远的过去被感知时出现的时不一致问题。其次，我们表明，在遥远记忆的情况下，行动与诊断性预期信念之间的相互作用自然会产生对单一初始冲击的反复繁荣-萧条周期。我们还提出了一种适用于动态随机一般均衡模型的研究方法，并用它来估计定量诊断性预期的新凯恩斯模型。内生状态和遥远记忆在成功复制对货币政策冲击产生的繁荣-萧条周期中起着关键作用。

abstract.text: We study how cross-country macroeconomic spillovers caused by sovereign default affect equilibrium bailouts. Because of portfolio diversification, the default of one country causes a macroeconomic contraction in other countries, which motivates a bailout. But why do creditor countries choose to bailout debtor countries instead of their own private sector? We show that this is because an external bailout could be cheaper than a domestic bailout. We also show that although anticipated bailouts lead to higher borrowing, they can be Pareto improving not only ex post (after a country has defaulted) but also ex ante (before the country chooses its debt).

10.1093/restud/rdad025.abstractZh: 我们研究了由于主权违约引起的跨国宏观经济溢出效应如何影响紧急救助的均衡情况。由于投资组合的多样化，一个国家的违约会导致其他国家的宏观经济收缩，从而促使它们寻求紧急救助。但是，为什么债权国会选择救助债务国而不是自己的私营部门呢？我们发现，这是因为外部救助可能比国内救助更经济。我们还指出，尽管预期的救助会导致更高的借贷成本，但这些救助在事后（一个国家违约之后）和事前（一个国家选择债务之前）都能带来帕累托改进。

abstract.text: Using exhaustive administrative data on Italian social security records, we construct measures of local labour market thickness for executives that vary by industry and location. We show that firm performance is strongly and persistently affected by executive death, but only in thin local labour markets. The new executives hired after death events in thin local labour markets have lower education levels and are more likely to be replaced. These predictions are consistent with a simple model of executive search in which market thickness determines the arrival rate of applications for executive positions.

10.1093/restud/rdad027.abstractZh: 我们利用意大利社会保障记录的详尽行政数据，构建了不同行业和地区高管所在地区劳动力市场的衡量指标。我们发现，企业绩效会受到高管去世的强烈且持续的影响，但这种情况仅发生在劳动力市场较为薄弱的地区。在劳动力市场薄弱的地区，高管去世后被新聘用的高管通常受教育程度较低，且更有可能被替换。这些预测与一个简单的高管招聘模型相符，该模型认为劳动力市场的规模决定了申请高管职位的频率。

abstract.text: This paper studies commodity taxation in a model featuring heterogeneous consumers, imperfect competition, and tax salience. We derive new formulas for the incidence and marginal excess burden of commodity taxation highlighting interactions between tax salience and market structure. We estimate the necessary inputs to the formulas by using Nielsen Retail Scanner and Consumer Panel data covering grocery stores and households in the U.S. and detailed sales tax data. We estimate a large amount of pass-through of taxes onto consumer prices and find that households respond more to changes in prices than taxes. We also estimate significant heterogeneity in tax salience across households. We calibrate our new formulas using these results and conclude that essentially all of the incidence of sales taxes falls on consumers, and the marginal excess burden of taxation is larger than estimates based on standard formulas that ignore imperfect competition and tax salience.

10.1093/restud/rdad028.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个具有异质消费者、不完全竞争以及税收显著性特征的模型中的商品税收问题。我们推导出了商品税收的归宿和边际超额负担的新公式，这些公式突出了税收显著性与市场结构之间的相互作用。我们通过使用Nielsen零售扫描仪和消费者面板数据来估算这些公式所需的输入参数，这些数据涵盖了美国的杂货店和家庭以及详细的销售税数据。我们估计了税收对消费者价格的大量传递效应，并发现家庭对价格变化的反应比对税收的反应更为敏感。我们还发现，不同家庭之间的税收显著性存在显著的异质性。利用这些结果对新的公式进行了校准，我们得出结论：基本上所有销售税的归宿都落在消费者身上，而税收的边际超额负担比那些忽略不完全竞争和税收显著性的标准公式所估计的要大。

abstract.text: What determines the distribution of establishments in terms of size and life-cycle growth? How are those determinants related to aggregate productivity? We provide novel answers by developing a framework that uses price and quantity information on establishments’ outputs and inputs to jointly estimate the demand and production parameters, and subsequently, establishments’ quality-adjusted productivity, deriving both micro-level and aggregate implications. We find that the dominant source of variation in establishment size is variation in quality/product appeal but that variation in technical efficiency plays an important supporting role. Multiple factors dampen dispersion in establishment size including dispersion in input (quality-adjusted) prices, markups, and residual wedges. Relatively moderate dampening factors induce large aggregate allocative efficiency losses relative to their absence. We show that joint estimation of the parameters of the demand and production function crucially affects inferences on the determinants of the size distribution of firms and their implications for aggregate productivity.

10.1093/restud/rdad029.abstractZh: 什么决定了企业规模及其生命周期增长的分布？这些决定因素与总体生产率之间有何关系？我们通过构建一个框架来提供新的答案，该框架利用关于企业产出和投入的价格和数量信息，共同估计需求和生产参数，进而得出企业质量调整后的生产率，从而得出微观层面和总体层面的影响。我们发现，企业规模变化的主要来源是质量/产品吸引力的变化，而技术效率的变化则起着重要的辅助作用。多种因素会减弱企业规模的分散性，包括投入（质量调整后）价格的分散、价格加成以及剩余楔形效应。相对适度的减弱因素会导致与不存在这些因素相比，总体配置效率的较大损失。我们表明，对需求和生产函数参数的联合估计对于推断企业规模分布的决定因素以及其对总体生产率的影响至关重要。

abstract.text: We study a model of the rise and fall of illiberal democracies. Voters value both liberty and economic security. In times of crisis, voters may prefer to elect an illiberal government that, by violating constitutional constraints, offers greater economic security but less liberty. However, violating these constraints allows the government to manipulate information, in turn reducing electoral accountability. We show how elements of liberal constitutions induce voters to elect illiberal governments that remain in power for inefficiently long—including forever. We derive insights into what makes constitutions stable against the rise of illiberal governments. We extend the model to allow for illiberal governments to overcome checks and balances and become autocracies. We show that stronger checks and balances are a double-edged sword: they slow down autocratization but may make it more likely. We discuss the empirical relevance of our theoretical framework and its connection to real world examples.

10.1093/restud/rdad030.abstractZh: 我们研究了一种关于非自由民主政体兴衰的模型。选民既重视自由，也重视经济安全。在危机时期，选民可能会选择非自由政府，因为这样的政府通过违反宪法限制来提供更高的经济安全，但自由程度较低。然而，违反这些限制使得政府能够操纵信息，从而降低了选举的问责性。我们揭示了自由宪法中的某些要素如何促使选民选择那些长期执政的非自由政府——甚至可能是永远执政的政府。我们得出了关于哪些因素能使宪法能够抵御非自由政府崛起的见解。我们还将模型扩展为允许非自由政府克服制衡机制，成为专制政府。我们发现，更严格的制衡机制是一把双刃剑：它们虽然减缓了专制化的进程，但也可能使专制化变得更加可能。我们还讨论了我们的理论框架在实证上的相关性，以及它与现实世界案例之间的联系。

abstract.text: We design a laboratory experiment to study bargaining behaviour when negotiations involve multiple issues. Parties must discover both trading prices and agreement scopes, giving rise to unexplored information structures and bargaining strategies. We find that bargainers often trade the efficient set of issues despite lacking information about individual aspects. However, beneficial agreements critically hinge on integrated negotiations that allow deals on bundles of issues. Moreover, access to more information boosts agreement rates in small-surplus negotiations but can also backfire as it triggers increased risk-taking and conflicting fairness preferences in large-surplus negotiations. Finally, successful negotiations display a specific bargaining convention that emerges endogenously. It involves alternating offers that meet the other side’s most recent demand halfway.

10.1093/restud/rdad031.abstractZh: 我们设计了一个实验室实验，用于研究涉及多个问题的谈判中的讨价还价行为。各方必须同时确定交易价格和协议范围，这导致了未探索过的信息结构和讨价还价策略。我们发现，尽管缺乏关于各个方面的信息，讨价还价者仍然会交易最有效的议题组合。然而，有利的协议在很大程度上依赖于能够就多个议题达成一致的综合性谈判。此外，获取更多信息在小型盈余谈判中可以提高达成协议的概率，但在大型盈余谈判中也可能产生反效果，因为它会引发更高的风险承担和冲突的公平偏好。最后，成功的谈判表现出一种特定的讨价还价惯例，这种惯例是内生产生的。它涉及交替提出符合对方最新需求的提议。

abstract.text: In markets for indivisible resources such as workers and objects, subsidy and taxation for an agent may depend on the set of acquired resources and prices. This paper investigates how such transfer policies interfere with the substitutes condition, which is critical for market equilibrium existence and auction mechanism performance among other important issues. For environments where the condition holds in the absence of policy intervention, we investigate which transfer policies preserve the substitutes condition in various economically meaningful settings, establishing a series of characterisation theorems. For environments where the condition may fail without policy intervention, we examine how to use transfer policies to re-establish it, finding exactly when transfer policies based on scales are effective for that purpose. These results serve to inform policymakers, market designers, and market participants of how transfer policies may impact markets, so more informed decisions can be made.

10.1093/restud/rdad032.abstractZh: 在诸如工人和物品这样的不可分割资源的市场中，对代理人的补贴和税收可能取决于所获得的资源和价格。本文研究了此类转移政策如何干扰替代条件，而替代条件对于市场均衡的存在和拍卖机制的性能至关重要。对于在没有政策干预的情况下该条件成立的环境，我们研究了在各种具有经济意义的情境下哪些转移政策能够保持替代条件，并建立了一系列特征定理。对于在没有政策干预的情况下该条件可能不成立的环境，我们探讨了如何利用转移政策来重新建立该条件，并确定了基于规模的转移政策在何时能有效实现这一目标。这些结果有助于为政策制定者、市场设计者和市场参与者提供有关转移政策可能如何影响市场的信息，从而做出更加明智的决策。

abstract.text: This paper is concerned with possible model misspecification in moment inequality models. Two issues are addressed. First, standard tests and confidence sets for the true parameter in the moment inequality literature are not robust to model misspecification in the sense that they exhibit spurious precision when the identified set is empty. This paper introduces tests and confidence sets that provide correct asymptotic inference for a pseudo-true parameter in such scenarios, and hence, do not suffer from spurious precision. Second, specification tests have relatively low power against a range of misspecified models. Thus, failure to reject the null of correct specification does not necessarily provide evidence of correct specification. That is, model specification tests are subject to the problem that absence of evidence is not evidence of absence. This paper develops new diagnostics for model misspecification in moment inequality models that do not suffer from this problem.

10.1093/restud/rdad033.abstractZh: 本文探讨了矩不等式模型中可能的模型误设问题。首先，矩不等式文献中用于检验真实参数的标准检验和置信区间在模型误设的情况下并不稳健，因为当被检验的集合为空时，这些检验会表现出虚假的精确度。本文提出了新的检验和置信区间方法，这些方法能够在模型误设的情况下为伪真实参数提供正确的渐近推断，因此不会出现虚假精确度的问题。其次，针对一系列误设模型的规范检验的效能相对较低。因此，未能拒绝正确规范的零假设并不一定意味着模型规范是正确的。也就是说，模型规范检验存在“无证据即非证据”的问题。本文提出了新的诊断方法，用于识别矩不等式模型中的模型误设问题，这些方法不会受到上述问题的影响。

abstract.text: This paper examines whether monetary policy pass-through to mortgage interest rates affects household fertility decisions. Our empirical strategy exploits variation in households’ eligibility for a rate adjustment, coupled with the large reductions in the monetary policy rate that occurred during the Great Recession in the U.K. and U.S. We estimate that each one percentage point drop in the policy rate increased birth rates amongst households eligible for a rate adjustment by 3%. Our results provide new evidence on the nature of monetary policy transmission to households and suggest a new mechanism via which mortgage contract structures can affect both aggregate demand and supply.

10.1093/restud/rdad034.abstractZh: 本文探讨了货币政策对抵押贷款利率的影响是否会影响家庭生育决策。我们的实证策略利用了家庭在利率调整资格上的差异，并结合英国和美国在大衰退期间货币政策利率的大幅下降。我们估计，政策利率每下降一个百分点，有资格享受利率调整的家庭的出生率就会增加3%。我们的研究结果提供了关于货币政策向家庭传递机制的新证据，并提出了一种新机制，即通过抵押合同结构可以影响总需求和总供给。

abstract.text: Fears of immigrants as a threat to public health have a long and sordid history. At the turn of the 20th century, when immigrants made up one-third of the population in crowded American cities, contemporaries blamed high urban mortality rates on the newest arrivals. We evaluate how the implementation of country-specific immigration quotas in the 1920s affected urban health. Cities with larger quota-induced reductions in immigration experienced a persistent decline in mortality rates, driven by a reduction in deaths from infectious diseases. The unfavourable living conditions immigrants endured explains the majority of the effect as quotas reduced residential crowding and mortality declines were largest in cities where immigrants resided in more crowded conditions and where public health resources were stretched thinnest.

10.1093/restud/rdad035.abstractZh: 对移民作为公共健康威胁的担忧有着悠久而肮脏的历史。在20世纪初，当移民占美国拥挤城市人口的三分之一时，当时的人们将高城市死亡率归咎于新来的移民。我们评估了20世纪20年代实施特定国家移民配额对城市健康的影响。那些因配额而减少移民流入的城市，其死亡率持续下降，这主要是由于传染病导致的死亡人数减少。移民所忍受的不利生活条件解释了这一效果的大部分原因，因为配额减少了居住拥挤程度，而死亡率下降最显著的是那些移民居住条件更拥挤、公共健康资源最紧张的城市。

abstract.text: Uncertainty rises in recessions and falls in booms. But what is the causal relationship? We construct cross-country panel data on stock market returns to proxy for first- and second-moment shocks and instrument these with natural disasters, terrorist attacks, and political shocks. Our IV regression results reveal a robust negative short-term impact of second moments (uncertainty) on growth. Employing multiple vector autoregression estimation approaches, relying on a range of identifying assumptions, also reveals a negative impact of uncertainty on growth. Finally, we show that these results are reproducible in a conventional micro–macro business cycle model with time-varying uncertainty.

10.1093/restud/rdad036.abstractZh: 经济衰退时不确定性上升，经济繁荣时不确定性下降。但两者之间的因果关系是什么？我们构建了关于股市回报的跨国面板数据，以代理第一时刻和第二时刻的冲击，并通过自然灾害、恐怖袭击和政治冲击来对这些数据进行工具变量回归。我们的IV回归结果显示，第二时刻的不确定性对经济增长有显著的负面影响。采用多种向量自回归估计方法，并基于一系列识别假设，同样发现不确定性对经济增长有负面影响。最后，我们证明这些结果在具有时变不确定性的传统微观-宏观商业周期模型中也是可重现的。

abstract.text: We develop a model of inter-temporal and intra-temporal price discrimination by monopoly airlines to study the ability of different discriminatory pricing mechanisms to increase efficiency and the associated distributional implications. To estimate the model, we use unique data from international airline markets with flight-level variation in prices across time, cabins, and markets and information on passengers’ reasons for travel and time of purchase. The current pricing practice yields approximately 77% of the first-best welfare. The source of this inefficiency arises primarily from private information about passenger valuations, not dynamic uncertainty about demand. We also find that if airlines could discriminate between business and leisure passengers, total welfare would improve at the expense of business passenger surplus. Also, replacing the current pricing that involves screening passengers across cabin classes with offering a single cabin class has minimal effect on total welfare.

10.1093/restud/rdad037.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个关于垄断航空公司跨时域和时域价格歧视的模型，以研究不同歧视性定价机制提高效率的能力及其相关的分配影响。为了估算该模型，我们使用了国际航空市场的独特数据，这些数据反映了不同时期、不同舱位和不同市场之间的票价差异，同时包含了乘客出行原因和购买时间的信息。当前的定价方式导致约77%的最佳福利损失。这种效率低下主要源于关于乘客价值的私人信息，而非需求的动态不确定性。我们还发现，如果航空公司能够对商务乘客和休闲乘客进行区分，总福利将会改善，但代价是商务乘客的剩余收益会减少。此外，用单一舱位替代当前涉及不同舱位筛选的定价方式，对总福利的影响很小。

abstract.text: We study the problem of a seller (e.g. a bank) who is privately informed about the quality of her asset and wants to exploit gains from trade with uninformed buyers (e.g. investors) by issuing securities backed by her asset cash flows. In our setting, buyers post menus of contracts to screen the seller, but the seller cannot commit to trade with only one buyer, i.e. markets are non-exclusive. We show that non-exclusive markets behave very differently from exclusive ones: (1) separating contracts are never part of equilibrium; (2) mispricing of claims faced by the seller is always greater than in exclusive markets; (3) there is always a semi-pooling equilibrium where all sellers issue the same debt contract priced at average-valuation, and sellers of low-quality assets issue remaining cash flows at low-valuation; (4) market liquidity can be higher or lower than in exclusive markets, but (5) the average quality of originated assets is always lower. Our model’s predictions are consistent with empirical evidence on the issuance and pricing of mortgage-backed securities, and we use the theory to evaluate recent reforms aimed at enhancing transparency and exclusivity in markets.

10.1093/restud/rdad038.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个私人了解自身资产质量的情况下的卖方（例如银行）面临的问题。该卖方希望通过发行以资产现金流为支持的证券，从与不知情的买方（例如投资者）的交易中获利。在我们的模型中，买方可以提交各种合同来筛选卖方，但卖方不能只与某个买方进行交易，即市场是非独占的。我们指出，非独占市场的行为与独占市场有很大不同：(1) 分离的合同永远不会成为均衡的一部分；(2) 卖方面临的索赔误定价总是高于独占市场；(3) 总是存在一个半池合均衡，在这种均衡中，所有卖方都发行相同的债务合同，其价格等于平均价值；而低质量资产的卖方则以低价值发行剩余的现金流；(4) 市场的流动性可能高于或低于独占市场，但(5) 发行资产的平均质量总是较低。我们模型的预测与关于抵押贷款支持证券发行和定价的实证证据一致，我们利用这一理论来评估旨在提高市场透明度和独占性的最新改革措施。

abstract.text: We develop a dynamic macroeconomic model with heterogeneous financial intermediaries and endogenous entry. Time-varying endogenous macroeconomic risk arises from the risk-shifting behaviour of the cross-section of financial intermediaries. When interest rates are high, a decrease in interest rates stimulates investment and decreases aggregate risk. In contrast, when they are low, further stimulus can increase financial instability while inducing a fall in the risk premium. In this case, there is a trade-off between stimulating the economy and financial stability. This provides a model of the risk-taking channel of monetary policy.

10.1093/restud/rdad039.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个动态宏观经济模型，该模型包含异质性的金融中介机构和内生性进入机制。时间变化的内生性宏观经济风险源于金融中介机构的风险转移行为。当利率较高时，利率的下降会刺激投资并降低总体风险；而当利率较低时，进一步的刺激可能会增加金融不稳定性的同时导致风险溢价下降。在这种情况下，刺激经济与金融稳定之间存在权衡。这一模型为货币政策的风险承担机制提供了理论框架。

abstract.text: This paper studies the optimal design of a macro-prudential instrument, a loan-to-value (LTV) limit, and its implications for monetary policy in a model with nominal rigidities and financial frictions. The analysis accounts for both an effective lower bound on the nominal interest rate and an upper bound on the ability of LTV limits to stimulate credit demand. The welfare-based loss function features a role for macro-prudential policy to enhance risk-sharing. Optimal LTV limits are strongly countercyclical. In a house price boom-bust episode, the active use of LTV limits alleviates debt-deleveraging dynamics and prevents the economy from falling into a liquidity trap.

10.1093/restud/rdad040.abstractZh: 本文研究了一种宏观审慎工具——贷款价值比（LTV）限制措施的最优设计，以及其在具有名义刚性与金融摩擦的模型中对货币政策的启示。分析考虑了名义利率的有效下限以及LTV限制措施刺激信贷需求的能力上限。基于福利的损失函数表明，宏观审慎政策在风险分担方面具有重要作用。最优的LTV限制措施具有强烈的反周期性特征。在房价波动的情境中，积极运用LTV限制措施能够缓解债务去杠杆化的动态，并防止经济陷入流动性陷阱。

abstract.text: I study, both empirically and theoretically, the economic and financial consequences of corporate lobbying. Firms lobby politicians to increase their share of government contracts, but political competition creates firm-level risk, inflating their cost of capital and reducing their incentive to invest in research and development (R&D). I document an annual 6–8% return premium for stocks of high-lobbying firms, which compensates investors for political risk. An estimated model in which firms can lobby and innovate and investors are risk averse replicates key features of corporate lobbying in the U.S., including the well-established paradox that lobbying contributions are small relative to the policies at stake. The model predicts that if investors ceased seeking compensation for political risk, R&D investment would increase by 6% and the innovation rate by 0.4% points. The risk-premium costs of lobbying are quantitatively and economically important even if the resources “wasted” on lobbying are objectively small.

10.1093/restud/rdad041.abstractZh: 我通过实证和理论分析，研究了企业游说在经济和金融方面的后果。企业游说政客以增加其在政府合同中的份额，但政治竞争会带来企业层面的风险，从而推高其资本成本，并降低其投资研发的积极性。我发现，游说能力强的公司的股票每年可获得6-8%的回报溢价，这弥补了投资者因政治风险而付出的代价。一个假设模型表明，如果企业能够游说并创新，而投资者又厌恶风险，那么企业游说的核心特征将得以体现，包括游说捐款相对于相关政策而言其实相当少这一现象。该模型预测，如果投资者不再寻求政治风险的补偿，研发投资将增加6%，创新率将提高0.4个百分点。即使企业游说所“浪费”的资源数量相对较少，其带来的风险溢价在数量和经济上仍然具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Global warming is a worldwide and protracted phenomenon with heterogeneous local economic effects. We propose a dynamic economic assessment model of the world economy with high spatial resolution to assess its consequences. Our model features several forms of adaptation to local temperature changes, including costly trade and migration, local technological innovations, and local natality rates. We quantify the model at a 1∘×1∘ resolution and estimate damage functions that determine the impact of temperature changes on a region’s fundamental productivity and amenities conditional on local temperatures. Welfare losses from global warming are very heterogeneous across locations, with 20% losses in parts of Africa and Latin America but also gains in some northern latitudes. Overall, spatial inequality increases. Uncertainty about average welfare effects is significant but much smaller for relative losses across space. Migration and innovation are shown to be important adaptation mechanisms. We use the model to study the impact of carbon taxes, abatement technologies, and clean energy subsidies. Carbon taxes delay consumption of fossil fuels and help flatten the temperature curve but are much more effective when an abatement technology is forthcoming.

10.1093/restud/rdad042.abstractZh: 全球变暖是一种全球性的长期现象，其对各地经济的影响各不相同。我们提出了一个具有高空间分辨率的动态经济评估模型，以评估其后果。我们的模型包含多种适应局部温度变化的机制，包括昂贵的贸易和移民、局部技术创新以及局部出生率的变化。我们在1×1的网格分辨率下对模型进行了量化，并估算了损害函数，这些函数决定了温度变化对某一地区基本生产力和便利设施的影响。全球变暖带来的福利损失在不同地区差异很大，非洲和拉丁美洲的部分地区损失高达20%，而一些北方地区的地区则有所收益。总体而言，空间不平等程度加剧。关于平均福利影响的不确定性很大，但不同地区的相对损失差异较小。移民和创新被证明是重要的适应机制。我们利用该模型研究碳税、减排技术和清洁能源补贴的影响。碳税可以延缓化石燃料的消耗，有助于使温度曲线趋于平缓，但当有减排技术出现时，碳税的效果会更为显著。

abstract.text: Rich behavioural biases, mistakes, and limits on rational decision-making are often thought to make equilibrium analysis much more intractable. We establish that this is not the case in the context of one-sector growth models such as Ramsey–Cass–Koopmans or Bewley–Aiyagari models. We break down the response of the economy to a change in the environment or policy into two parts: the direct response at the given (pre-tax) prices, and the equilibrium response which plays out as prices change. Our main result demonstrates that under weak regularity conditions, regardless of the details of behavioural preferences, mistakes and constraints on decision-making, the long-run equilibrium will involve a greater capital-labour ratio if and only if the direct response (from the corresponding consumption-saving model) involves an increase in aggregate savings. One implication of this result is that, from a qualitative point of view, behavioural biases matter for long-run equilibrium if and only if they change the direction of the direct response. We provide detailed illustrations of how this result can be applied and generate new insights using models of misperceptions, self-control and temptation, and naive and sophisticated quasi-hyperbolic discounting.

10.1093/restud/rdad043.abstractZh: 人们通常认为，丰富的行为偏差、错误以及对理性决策的限制使得均衡分析变得更加难以处理。然而，我们在单一部门增长模型（如Ramsey–Cass–Koopmans模型或Bewley–Aiyagari模型）的框架下发现并非如此。我们将经济对环境或政策变化的响应分解为两部分：在给定（税前）价格下的直接响应，以及随着价格变化而产生的均衡响应。我们的主要结果表明，在较弱的规律性条件下，无论行为偏好、错误以及决策约束的具体细节如何，长期均衡将涉及更高的资本-劳动比率，当且仅当直接响应（来自相应的消费-储蓄模型）涉及总储蓄的增加时才会如此。这一结果的一个含义是，从定性角度来看，行为偏差对长期均衡的影响取决于它们是否改变了直接响应的方向。我们详细说明了如何应用这一结果，并通过使用关于误解、自我控制与诱惑，以及天真和复杂的准超线性折现的模型，得出了新的见解。

abstract.text: Many e-commerce platforms use buyers’ personal data to intermediate their transactions with sellers. How much value do such intermediaries derive from the data record of each single individual? We characterize this value and find that one of its key components is a novel externality between records, which arises when the intermediary pools some records to withhold the information they contain. Our analysis has several implications about compensating individuals for the use of their data, guiding companies’ investments in data acquisition, and more broadly studying the demand side of data markets. Our methods combine modern information design with classic duality theory and apply to a large class of principal-agent problems.

10.1093/restud/rdad044.abstractZh: 许多电子商务平台利用买家的个人数据来促成与卖家的交易。这些中介从每个个体的数据记录中获得了多少价值？我们对这种价值进行了分析，发现其关键组成部分之一是一种新的外部性——当中介汇总某些记录并隐藏其中包含的信息时，就会产生这种外部性。我们的分析对补偿个体因数据使用而获得的收益、指导公司在数据获取方面的投资，以及更广泛地研究数据市场的需求方都有重要意义。我们的方法结合了现代信息设计与经典的对偶理论，并适用于大量主体-代理问题。

abstract.text: With “2020 hindsight,” the 2000s housing cycle is not a boom–bust but a boom–bust–rebound. Using a spatial equilibrium regression in which house prices are determined by income, amenities, urbanization, and supply, we show that long-run city-level fundamentals predict not only 1997–2019 price and rent growth but also the amplitude of the boom–bust–rebound. This evidence motivates our model of a cycle rooted in fundamentals. Households learn about fundamentals by observing “dividends” but become over-optimistic in the boom due to diagnostic expectations. A bust ensues when beliefs start to correct, exacerbated by a price–foreclosure spiral that drives prices below their long-run level. The rebound follows as prices converge to a path commensurate with higher fundamental growth. The estimated model explains the boom–bust–rebound with a single shock and accounts quantitatively for the dynamics of prices, rents, and foreclosures in cities with the largest cycles. We draw implications for asset cycles more generally.

10.1093/restud/rdad045.abstractZh: 以“2020年的回顾”来看，2000年代的房地产周期并非单纯的繁荣-萧条，而是经历了繁荣-萧条-反弹的过程。通过空间均衡回归模型，我们发现在房价由收入、便利设施、城市化程度和供应等因素决定的情况下，长期的城市基本因素不仅预测了1997年至2019年的房价和租金增长，还决定了繁荣-萧条-反弹的幅度。这一证据支持了我们的模型，即房地产周期根植于基本因素。家庭通过观察“红利”来了解基本因素，但在繁荣时期由于诊断性预期而变得过于乐观。当信念开始纠正时，萧条随之而来，而价格与止赎之间的恶性循环则进一步将价格推至低于长期水平的区间。随着价格逐渐回归到与更高基本增长相适应的路径，反弹随之出现。我们估计的模型能够用单一冲击来解释繁荣-萧条-反弹的过程，并定量地解释了在周期最明显的城市中，房价、租金和止赎的动态变化。这些发现对更广泛的资产周期也具有一定的启示意义。

abstract.text: This paper studies a general model of matching with constraints. Observing that a stable matching typically does not exist, we focus on feasible, individually rational, and fair matchings. We characterize such matchings by fixed points of a certain function. Building on this result, we characterize the class of constraints on individual schools under which there exists a student-optimal fair matching, the matching that is the most preferred by every student among those satisfying the three desirable properties. We study the numerical relevance of our theory using data on government-organized daycare allocation.

10.1093/restud/rdad046.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个带有约束条件的匹配模型。注意到稳定的匹配通常并不存在，我们重点关注可行、个体理性且公平的匹配。我们通过某个函数的固定点来刻画这样的匹配。在此基础上，我们描述了在哪些约束条件下，存在每个学生都认为最理想的公平匹配——即满足三个理想属性的匹配。我们利用政府组织的日托分配数据，研究了我们理论在数值上的相关性。

abstract.text: We study the effect of exposure to immigrants on the educational outcomes of U.S.-born students, using a unique dataset combining population-level birth and school records from Florida. This research question is complicated by the substantial school selection of U.S.-born students, especially among White and comparatively affluent students, in response to the presence of immigrant students in the school. We propose a new identification strategy, comparing sibling outcomes with the inclusion of family fixed effects, to partial out the unobserved non-random selection of native-born families into schools. We find that the presence of immigrant students has a positive effect on the academic achievement of U.S.-born students, especially for students from disadvantaged backgrounds. Moreover, the presence of immigrants does not negatively affect the performance of affluent U.S.-born students, who typically show a higher academic achievement compared to immigrant students. We provide suggestive evidence on potential channels.

10.1093/restud/rdad047.abstractZh: 我们研究了移民的存在对美国出生学生的教育成果的影响，使用了来自佛罗里达州的人口级出生和学校记录相结合的独特数据集。这一研究问题因美国出生学生在选择学校时的显著选择性而变得复杂，尤其是在白人和相对富裕的学生中，他们往往因为移民学生的存在而选择其他学校。我们提出了一种新的识别策略，通过比较兄弟姐妹的结果，并结合家庭固定效应，来部分消除未观察到的本地出生家庭对学校的选择偏差。我们发现，移民学生的存在对美国出生学生的学业成就有积极影响，尤其是来自弱势背景的学生。此外，移民的存在并不会对富裕的美国出生学生的表现产生负面影响，这些学生通常比移民学生有更高的学业成就。我们提供了关于潜在影响渠道的初步证据。

abstract.text: We explore the impact of rising incomes at the top of the distribution on spatial sorting patterns within large U.S. cities. We develop and quantify a spatial model of a city with heterogeneous agents and non-homothetic preferences for neighbourhoods with endogenous amenity quality. As the rich get richer, demand increases for the high-quality amenities available in downtown neighbourhoods. Rising demand drives up house prices and spurs the development of higher quality neighbourhoods downtown. This gentrification of downtowns makes poor incumbents worse off, as they are either displaced to the suburbs or pay higher rents for amenities that they do not value as much. We quantify the corresponding impact on well-being inequality. Through the lens of the quantified model, the change in the income distribution between 1990 and 2014 led to neighbourhood change and spatial resorting within urban areas that increased the welfare of richer households relative to that of poorer households, above and beyond rising nominal income inequality.

10.1093/restud/rdad048.abstractZh: 我们探讨了收入分配顶端收入增长对美国大型城市内部空间分化模式的影响。我们开发并量化了一个城市空间模型，该模型考虑了具有异质性代理人以及非同态偏好特征的社区，这些社区的便利设施质量具有内生性。随着富人越来越富有，他们对市中心社区中高质量便利设施的需求增加。需求的增加推高了房价，并促进了市中心高质量社区的开发。这种市中心地区的绅士化现象使得原有居民处境恶化，他们要么被驱逐到郊区，要么不得不支付更高的租金以获得他们并不那么重视的便利设施。我们量化了这种变化对福祉不平等的影响。通过量化模型的分析，1990年至2014年间收入分配的变化导致了社区结构的改变以及城市区域的空间重新分布，这使得富裕家庭的福祉相对于贫困家庭有所提升，即便名义收入不平等程度有所上升。

abstract.text: This article explores the relationship between the duration of a vacancy and the starting wage of a new job, using linked data on vacancies, the posting establishments, and the workers eventually filling the vacancies. The unique combination of large-scale, administrative worker, establishment, and vacancy data is critical for separating establishment- and job-level determinants of vacancy duration from worker-level heterogeneity. Conditional on observables, we find that vacancy duration is negatively correlated with the starting wage and its establishment component, with precisely estimated elasticities of −0.07 and −0.21, respectively. While the negative relationship is qualitatively consistent with search-theoretic models where firms use the wage as a recruiting device, these elasticities are small, suggesting that firms’ wage policies can account only for a small fraction of the variation in vacancy filling across establishments.

10.1093/restud/rdad051.abstractZh: 本文探讨了职位空缺持续时间与新工作起始工资之间的关系，使用了关于职位空缺、招聘机构以及最终填补空缺的工人的关联数据。这种大规模、针对行政人员、招聘机构和职位空缺数据的独特组合，对于区分空缺持续时间的机构级和职位级决定因素与工人层面的异质性至关重要。在给定可观测变量的前提下，我们发现空缺持续时间与起始工资及其机构成分呈负相关，其精确弹性分别为-0.07和-0.21。虽然这种负相关关系在理论上与搜索理论模型一致，即企业利用工资作为招聘手段，但这些弹性值很小，表明企业的工资政策只能解释部分机构间空缺填补差异的原因。

abstract.text: If sectoral trade flows obey structural gravity, countries’ bilateral trade imbalances are the result of macro trade imbalances, “triangular trade”, or pairwise asymmetric trade barriers. Using data for 40 major economies and the Rest of the World, we show that large and pervasive asymmetries in trade barriers are required to account for most of the observed variation in bilateral imbalances. A dynamic quantitative trade model suggests that eliminating these asymmetries would significantly reduce bilateral (but not macro) imbalances and have sizeable impacts on welfare. We provide evidence that the asymmetries we measure are in part related to the policy environment: trade inside the European Single Market appears to be subject to more bilaterally symmetric frictions. Extending the same symmetry to all parts of the global economy would give a large boost to the real incomes of several non-E.U. countries.

10.1093/restud/rdad052.abstractZh: 如果部门间贸易流动遵循结构性引力模型，那么各国之间的双边贸易失衡可能是宏观贸易失衡、“三角贸易”或成对不对称贸易壁垒的结果。利用40个主要经济体及世界其他地区的数据，我们发现，要解释大部分观察到的双边失衡差异，需要存在广泛且严重的贸易壁垒不对称现象。动态量化贸易模型表明，消除这些不对称现象将显著减少双边（但不会导致宏观层面）失衡，并对福利产生重大影响。我们的研究还表明，所测量的不对称现象在一定程度上与政策环境有关：欧洲单一市场内的贸易似乎受到更为双边对称的摩擦影响。将这种对称性扩展到全球经济的其他部分，将显著提升多个非欧盟国家的实际收入。

abstract.text: Many real-life settings of individual choice involve social interactions, causing targeted policies to have spillover effects. This article develops novel empirical tools for analysing demand and welfare effects of policy interventions in binary choice settings with social interactions. Examples include subsidies for health-product adoption and vouchers for attending a high-achieving school. We show that even with fully parametric specifications and unique equilibrium, choice data, that are sufficient for counterfactual demand prediction under interactions, are insufficient for welfare calculations. This is because distinct underlying mechanisms producing the same interaction coefficient can imply different welfare effects and deadweight-loss from a policy intervention. Standard index restrictions imply distribution-free bounds on welfare. We propose ways to identify and consistently estimate the structural parameters and welfare bounds allowing for unobserved group effects that are potentially correlated with observables and are possibly unbounded. We illustrate our results using experimental data on mosquito-net adoption in rural Kenya.

10.1093/restud/rdad053.abstractZh: 在现实生活中的许多个体选择场景中，都会涉及社会互动，这导致有针对性的政策会产生溢出效应。本文提出了新的实证工具，用于分析在具有社会互动的二元选择场景中，政策干预对需求和福利的影响。例如，对健康产品采用的补贴以及用于就读高成就学校的代金券。我们发现，即使有完全参数化的模型设定和独特的均衡状态，用于反事实需求预测的选择数据，对于福利计算来说是不够的。这是因为产生相同互动系数的不同机制可能会带来不同的福利效应和因政策干预而产生的无谓损失。标准的指数限制意味着福利的边界是分布无关的。我们提出了一些方法，可以识别和一致地估计结构参数和福利边界，同时考虑到可能与可观测变量相关的未观察到的群体效应，这些效应可能是无界的。我们通过肯尼亚农村关于蚊帐采用的实验数据来说明我们的研究结果。

abstract.text: Reclassification risk is a major concern in health insurance where contracts are typically 1 year in length but health shocks often persist for much longer. While most health systems with private insurers pair short-run contracts with substantial pricing regulations to reduce reclassification risk, long-term contracts with one-sided insurer commitment have significant potential to reduce reclassification risk without the negative side effects of price regulation, such as adverse selection. We theoretically characterize optimal long-term insurance contracts with one-sided commitment, extending the literature in directions necessary for studying health insurance markets. We leverage this characterization to provide a simple algorithm for computing optimal contracts from primitives. We estimate key market fundamentals using data on all under-65 privately insured consumers in Utah. We find that dynamic contracts are very effective at reducing reclassification risk for consumers who arrive at the market in good health, but they are ineffective for consumers who come to the market in bad health, demonstrating that there is a role for the government insurance of pre-market health risks. Individuals with steeply rising income profiles find front-loading costly, and thus relatively prefer ACA-type exchanges. Switching costs enhance, while myopia moderately compromises, the performance of dynamic contracts.

10.1093/restud/rdad054.abstractZh: 再分类风险是健康保险中的一个主要问题，通常保险合同为一年期，但健康冲击往往持续更长时间。虽然大多数与私人保险公司合作的医疗系统通过短期合同和严格的定价规定来降低再分类风险，但长期合同结合单方保险公司的承诺在降低再分类风险方面具有显著潜力，同时不会带来价格监管带来的负面效果，如逆向选择问题。我们从理论上描述了具有单方承诺的最优长期保险合同，为研究健康保险市场提供了必要的理论支持。我们利用这些数据来估计关键的市场基本面，这些数据涵盖了犹他州所有65岁以下私人保险消费者的信息。我们发现，动态合同对于健康状况良好的消费者来说非常有效，能够降低再分类风险，但对于健康状况不佳的消费者来说则效果不佳，这表明政府在市场前对健康风险进行保险是有必要的。收入增长迅速的个体更倾向于选择成本较高的动态合同，因此相对更喜欢ACA类型的交易平台。转换成本会增强动态合同的性能，而短视性则会适度降低其性能。

abstract.text: We show that mortgage recourse systems, by discouraging default, magnify the impact of nominal rigidities. They cause deeper and more persistent recessions. This mechanism can account for up to 31% of the recovery gap during the Great Recession between the U.S., mostly a non-recourse economy, and Spain, a recourse economy. General equilibrium effects explain most of the differences between mortgage systems. With recourse, highly indebted homeowners dramatically cut consumption in a crisis, and account for a larger share of the aggregate consumption decline. However, without recourse, mortgages would be more expensive for riskier households, and homeownership rates would be lower.

10.1093/restud/rdad055.abstractZh: 我们指出，抵押贷款追索制度通过抑制违约行为，加剧了名义刚性对经济的影响。这种制度会导致更深刻且更持久的经济衰退。在次贷危机期间，这种机制可能导致美国（主要属于无追索权经济体系）与西班牙（属于有追索权经济体系）之间的经济恢复差距达到31%。一般均衡效应解释了两种抵押贷款制度之间差异的大部分原因。在有追索权制度下，负债严重的房主会在危机中大幅减少消费，从而导致整体消费下降的幅度更大。然而，在没有追索权的情况下，抵押贷款对风险较高的家庭来说会变得更加昂贵，同时房屋所有权率也会更低。

abstract.text: We study how perceptions of corporate responsibility influence policy preferences and the effectiveness of corporate communication when agents have imperfect memory recall. Using a new large-scale survey of U.S. citizens on their support for corporate bailouts, we first establish that the public demands corporations to behave better within society, a sentiment we label “big business discontent.” Using random variation in the order of survey sections and in the exposure to animated videos, we then show that priming respondents to think about corporate responsibility lowers the support for bailouts. This finding suggests that big business discontent influences policy preferences. Furthermore, we find that messages which paint a positive picture of corporate responsibility can “backfire,” as doing so brings attention to an aspect on which the public has negative views. In contrast, reframing corporate bailouts in terms of economic tradeoffs increases support for the policy. We develop a memory-based model of decision-making and communication to rationalize these findings.

10.1093/restud/rdad057.abstractZh: 我们研究了企业责任认知如何影响政策偏好以及企业在记忆不完美情况下的沟通效果。通过一项针对美国公民的大规模调查，了解他们对企业救助的支持程度，我们首先发现公众要求企业在社会中表现得更好，这种情绪我们称之为“大企业不满”。接着，通过随机改变调查环节的顺序以及让受访者观看动画视频的方式，我们发现让受访者思考企业责任问题会降低他们对救助政策的支持。这一发现表明，大企业不满确实会影响政策偏好。此外，我们发现，如果宣传企业责任的积极形象，反而可能适得其反，因为这会吸引公众对负面方面的关注。相反，将企业救助问题重新定义为经济权衡问题，则会增加公众对该政策的支持。我们基于记忆模型来解释这些发现。

abstract.text: Emerging markets have experienced large human and economic costs from coronavirus disease 2019, and their tight fiscal space has limited the support extended to their citizens. We study the impact of an epidemic on economic and health outcomes by integrating epidemiological dynamics into a sovereign default model. The sovereign’s option to default tightens fiscal space and results in an epidemic with limited mitigation and depressed consumption. A quantitative analysis of our model accounts well for the dynamics of fatalities, social distancing, consumption, sovereign debt, and spreads in Latin America. We find that because of default risk, the welfare cost of the pandemic is about a third higher than it is in a version of the model with perfect financial markets. We study debt relief programs and find a compelling case for their implementation. These programs deliver large social gains, improving health and economic outcomes for the country at no cost to international lenders or financial institutions.

10.1093/restud/rdad058.abstractZh: 新兴市场因2019冠状病毒病而遭受了巨大的人力和经济损失，其有限的财政空间也限制了对其公民的支持。我们通过将流行病学动态纳入主权违约模型，研究疫情对经济和健康结果的影响。主权违约的选项会扩大财政空间，但会导致疫情缓解措施有限，消费下降。我们对模型的定量分析很好地解释了拉丁美洲在死亡人数、社交隔离、消费、主权债务以及债务利差方面的动态变化。我们发现，由于违约风险，疫情带来的福利成本比在金融市场完全完善的模型版本中高出约三分之一。我们研究了债务减免计划，并认为实施这些计划具有显著的社会效益。这些计划能够带来巨大的社会收益，改善国家的健康和经济状况，而无需国际贷款机构或金融机构承担任何成本。

abstract.text: We propose a theory that analyzes how a workers’ asset holdings affect their job productivity. In a labor market with uninsurable risk, workers choose to direct their job search trading off productivity and wages against unemployment risk. Workers with low asset holdings have a precautionary job search motive, they direct their search to low productivity jobs because those offer a low risk at the cost of low productivity and a low wage. Our main theoretical contribution shows that the presence of consumption smoothing can reconcile the directed search model with negative duration-dependence on wages, a robust empirical regularity that the canonical directed search model cannot rationalize. We calibrate the infinite horizon economy and find this mechanism to be quantitatively important. We evaluate a tax financed unemployment insurance (UI) scheme and analyze how it affects welfare. Aggregate welfare is inverted U-shaped in benefits: the insurance effect UI dominates the incentive effects for low levels of benefits and vice versa for high benefits. In addition, when UI increases, total production falls in the economy while worker productivity increases.

10.1093/restud/rdad059.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个理论模型，用于分析工人的资产持有情况对其工作生产力的影响。在一个无法投保的风险市场中，工人会在生产力与工资之间做出权衡，以选择是否进行求职。资产持有量较低的工人具有预防性求职动机，他们会选择低生产力的工作，因为这些工作虽然风险较低，但生产力较低且工资也较低。我们的主要理论贡献在于，消费平滑机制能够协调定向搜索模型与工资的负期限依赖性之间的关系，这是典型定向搜索模型无法解释的一个稳健的实证规律。我们对无限期限经济进行了建模，发现这一机制在数量上具有重要意义。我们评估了一种由税收资助的失业保险制度，并分析了其对福利的影响。总体福利与福利水平呈倒U形关系：在福利水平较低时，失业保险的激励效应占主导地位；而在福利水平较高时，保险效应则占据主导地位。此外，当失业保险覆盖率提高时，经济中的总产出会下降，而工人的生产力则会上升。

abstract.text: In the late nineteenth century, the North American bison was brought to the brink of extinction in less than two decades. We demonstrate that the loss of the bison had immediate, negative consequences for the Native Americans who relied on them and ultimately resulted in a persistent reversal of fortunes. Once amongst the tallest people in the world, the generations of bison-reliant people born after the slaughter lost their entire height advantage. By the early twentieth century, child mortality was 16 percentage points higher and the probability of reporting an occupation 19 percentage points lower in bison nations compared with nations that were never reliant on the bison. Throughout the latter half of the twentieth century and into the present, income per capita has remained 25% lower, on average, for bison nations. This persistent gap cannot be explained by differences in agricultural productivity, self-governance, or application of the Dawes Act. We provide evidence that this historical shock altered the dynamic path of development for formerly bison-reliant nations. We demonstrate that limited access to credit constrained the ability of bison nations to adjust through re-specialization and migration.

10.1093/restud/rdad060.abstractZh: 在十九世纪末期，北美野牛在不到二十年的时间里濒临灭绝。我们发现，野牛的灭绝对依赖它们的美洲原住民产生了直接的负面影响，最终导致了他们命运的持续逆转。曾经是世界上最高的人种，那些在野牛被屠杀后出生的世代失去了原有的身高优势。到了二十世纪初，野牛国家的儿童死亡率比那些从未依赖野牛的国家高出16个百分点，报告职业的可能性则低了19个百分点。在整个二十世纪后半叶及至今，野牛国家的人均收入平均低了25%。这种持续的差距无法用农业生产力、自治程度或《道斯法案》的实施差异来解释。我们有证据表明，这一历史冲击改变了那些曾经依赖野牛的国家的发展轨迹。我们发现，有限的信贷获取限制了野牛国家通过重新专业化或迁移来调整自身的能力。

abstract.text: How does an increase in market size, say due to globalization, affect welfare? We study this question using a model with monopolistic competition, heterogeneous markups, and fixed costs. We characterize changes in welfare and decompose changes in allocative efficiency into three different effects: (1) reallocations across firms with heterogeneous price elasticities due to intensifying competition, (2) reallocations due to the exit of marginally profitable firms, and (3) reallocations due to changes in firms’ markups. Whereas the second and third effects have ambiguous implications for welfare, the first effect, which we call the Darwinian effect, always increases welfare regardless of the shape of demand curves. We nonparametrically calibrate demand curves with data from Belgian manufacturing firms and quantify our results. We find that mild increasing returns at the microlevel can catalyze large increasing returns at the macrolevel. Between 70 and 90% of increasing returns to scale come from improvements in how a larger market allocates resources. The lion’s share of these gains are due to the Darwinian effect, which increases the aggregate markup and concentrates sales and employment in high-markup firms. This has implications for policy: an entry subsidy, which harnesses Darwinian reallocations, can improve welfare even when there is more entry than in the first best.

10.1093/restud/rdad061.abstractZh: 市场规模的扩大，比如由于全球化导致的扩大，会对福利产生什么影响？我们采用一个包含垄断竞争、异质性加价和固定成本的模型来研究这个问题。我们描述了福利的变化，并将配置效率的变化分解为三种不同的效应：（1）由于竞争加剧而导致的具有不同价格弹性的企业之间的资源重新分配；（2）由于边际盈利不佳的企业退出而导致的资源重新分配；（3）由于企业加价的变化而导致的资源重新分配。虽然第二种和第三种效应对福利的影响不明确，但第一种效应，我们称之为“达尔文效应”，无论需求曲线的形状如何，都会增加福利。我们利用比利时制造企业的数据对非参数化地校准需求曲线，并量化了我们的研究结果。我们发现，微观层面的轻微规模收益递增可以在宏观层面引发巨大的规模收益递增。70%到90%的规模收益递增来自于更大市场在资源分配方面的改进。这些收益的大部分来自于达尔文效应，它增加了总体加价，并将销售和就业集中在高加价的企业中。这对政策有启示意义：通过提供进入补贴来利用达尔文效应导致的资源重新分配，可以在进入企业数量多于最优情况下的第一种情况下改善福利。

abstract.text: The FDIC resolves insolvent banks with scoring auctions. Although the structure of the scoring rule is known to bidders, they are uncertain about how the FDIC trades off different bid components. Scoring-rule uncertainty motivates bidders to submit multiple bids for the same failed bank. To evaluate the effects of uncertainty and multiple bidding for FDIC costs, we develop a methodology for analysing multidimensional bidding when the auctioneer’s scoring weights are unknown to bidders. We estimate private valuations for failed-bank assets during the great financial crisis and compute counterfactuals in the absence of scoring uncertainty. Our findings imply a substantial reduction in FDIC resolution costs of between 29.8% ($8.2 billion) and 44.6% ($12.3 billion). These savings can reduce policy-driven banking-sector distortions, since FDIC resolution costs are covered either through special levies on banks or through loans from the US Treasury. Our analyses also shed new light on optimal bid portfolio choice in combinatorial auctions.

10.1093/restud/rdad062.abstractZh: 联邦存款保险公司通过评分拍卖来解决破产银行的问题。尽管投标者已知评分规则的结构，但他们不确定联邦存款保险公司是如何权衡不同的投标要素的。评分规则的不确定性促使投标者为同一破产银行提交多个投标。为了评估不确定性和多重投标对联邦存款保险公司成本的影响，我们开发了一种分析方法，用于在拍卖师评分权重对投标者未知的情况下分析多维投标。我们估算了大金融危机期间破产银行资产的私人估值，并计算了在没有评分不确定性的情况下的反事实结果。我们的研究发现，联邦存款保险公司的解决成本显著减少，幅度在29.8%（82亿美元）到44.6%（123亿美元）之间。这些节省可以减少政策驱动的银行业扭曲，因为联邦存款保险公司的解决成本要么通过向银行征收特别税来支付，要么通过美国财政部的贷款来支付。我们的分析还揭示了组合拍卖中最佳投标组合选择的新见解。

abstract.text: We use novel, large-scale data on 17.5 million Americans to study how a policy-driven increase in economic resources affects children's long-term outcomes. Using the 2000 Census and 2001-13 American Community Survey linked to the Social Security Administration's NUMIDENT, we leverage the county-level rollout of the Food Stamps program between 1961 and 1975. We find that children with access to greater economic resources before age five have better outcomes as adults. The treatment-on-the-treated effects show a 6% of a standard deviation improvement in human capital, 3% of a standard deviation increase in economic self-sufficiency, 8% of a standard deviation increase in the quality of neighbourhood of residence, a 1.2-year increase in life expectancy, and a 0.5 percentage-point decrease in likelihood of being incarcerated. These estimates suggest that Food Stamps' transfer of resources to families is a highly cost-effective investment in young children, yielding a marginal value of public funds of approximately sixty-two.

10.1093/restud/rdad063.abstractZh: 我们利用17.5百万美国人的大规模数据，研究政策驱动的经济资源增加如何影响儿童的长期结果。通过结合2000年人口普查、2001至2013年的美国社区调查以及社会保障管理局的NUMIDENT数据，我们利用了1961至1975年间食品券计划在县级层面的实施情况。研究发现，在五岁之前能够获得更多经济资源的儿童，成年后的表现更为良好。政策对受助者的影响表现为：人力资本提升了6个标准差，经济自给能力增加了3个标准差，居住社区的质量提高了8个标准差，预期寿命增加了1.2年，被监禁的可能性降低了0.5个百分点。这些估计表明，食品券向家庭提供的资源转移对幼儿来说是一种非常具有成本效益的投资，其公共资金的边际价值约为六十二。

abstract.text: We study policy experimentation in organizations with endogenous membership. An organization decides when to stop a policy experiment based on its results. As information arrives, agents update their beliefs, and enter or leave the organization based on their expected flow payoffs. Unsuccessful experiments make all agents more pessimistic, but also drive out conservative members. We identify sufficient conditions under which the latter effect dominates, leading to excessive experimentation. In fact, the organization may experiment forever in the face of mounting negative evidence. Ex post heterogeneous payoffs exacerbate the problem, as optimists can join forces with guaranteed winners. Control by shareholders who own all future payoffs, however, can have a corrective effect. Our results contrast with models of collective experimentation with fixed membership, in which under-experimentation is the typical outcome.

10.1093/restud/rdad064.abstractZh: 我们研究了具有内生成员资格的组织中的政策实验。一个组织根据实验结果来决定何时停止政策实验。随着信息的到来，参与者会更新他们的信念，并根据预期的收益流入情况决定是否加入或离开组织。失败的实验会让所有参与者变得更加悲观，但也会将保守的成员驱逐出去。我们确定了使后者效应占主导地位的充分条件，从而导致过度实验。实际上，即使面对越来越多的负面证据，组织也可能永远进行实验。事后异质的收益流会加剧这一问题，因为乐观者可以联合起来争取有保证的收益。然而，拥有所有未来收益的股东的控制可能具有纠正作用。我们的结果与固定成员资格的集体实验模型形成对比，在那种模型中，不足实验是典型的结果。

abstract.text: We show that the entry of formal financial institutions can have far-reaching and long-lasting impacts on informal lending and social networks more generally. We first study the introduction of microfinance in 75 villages in Karnataka, India, 43 of which were exposed to microfinance. Using difference-in-differences, we show that networks shrank more in exposed villages. Moreover, links between households that were both unlikely to borrow from microfinance were at least as likely to disappear as links involving likely borrowers. We replicate these surprising findings in the context of a randomised controlled trial (RCT) in Hyderabad, where a microfinance institution randomly selected 52 of 104 neighbourhoods to enter first. Four years after all neighbourhoods were treated, households in early-entry neighbourhoods had credit access longer and had larger loans. We again find fewer social relationships between households in these neighbourhoods, even among those ex-ante unlikely to borrow. Because the results suggest global spillovers, atypical in usual models of network formation, we develop a new dynamic model of network formation that emphasizes chance meetings, where efforts to socialize generate a global network-level externality. Finally, we analyse informal borrowing and the sensitivity of consumption to income fluctuations. Households unlikely to take up microcredit suffer the greatest loss of informal borrowing and risk sharing, underscoring the global nature of the externality.

10.1093/restud/rdad065.abstractZh: 我们表明，正规金融机构的进入对非正规借贷和社会网络产生了深远而持久的影响。我们首先研究了在印度卡纳塔克邦的75个村庄中引入小额信贷的情况，其中43个村庄接受了小额信贷服务。通过差异-差异分析，我们发现接受小额信贷的村庄中，社交网络规模缩小得更为明显。此外，那些不太可能从小额信贷机构借款的家庭之间的联系，至少与那些可能借款的家庭之间的联系一样容易消失。我们在海得拉巴进行的一项随机对照试验中也发现了类似的令人惊讶的结果，该试验中，一家小额信贷机构随机选择了104个社区中的52个作为试点。在所有社区都接受服务四年后，首批试点社区的居民获得了更长的信贷期限和更大的贷款额度。我们再次发现，这些社区的居民之间的社交关系更少，即使是在那些原本不太可能借款的家庭之间也是如此。由于研究结果表明存在全球性的溢出效应，这在通常的网络形成模型中是不常见的，因此我们开发了一个新的动态网络形成模型，该模型强调偶然相遇的重要性，认为社交努力会产生全球性的网络层面外部性。最后，我们分析了非正规借贷以及消费对收入波动的敏感性。那些不太可能接受小额信贷的家庭在非正规借贷和风险分担方面遭受了最大的损失，这进一步凸显了这种外部性的全球性特征。

abstract.text: Industrialization experiences differ substantially across countries. We use a benchmark model of structural change to shed light on the sources of this heterogeneity and, in particular, the phenomenon of premature deindustrialization. Our analysis leads to three key findings. First, benchmark models of structural change robustly generate hump-shaped patterns for the evolution of the industrial sector. Second, heterogeneous patterns of catch-up in sectoral productivities across countries can generate variation in industrialization experiences similar to those found in the data, including premature deindustrialization. Third, differences in the rate of agricultural productivity growth across economies can account for the majority of the variation in peak industrial employment shares.

10.1093/restud/rdad066.abstractZh: 各国的工业化进程存在显著差异。我们采用一个基准结构变化模型来探讨这种差异性的来源，特别是过早去工业化现象。我们的分析得出三个关键结论：首先，基准结构变化模型能够稳健地描绘出工业部门发展的驼峰状模式；其次，各国在部门生产力追赶方面的差异会导致工业化经历的变异，这种变异与数据中的现象相符，包括过早去工业化；第三，不同经济体农业生产力增长速率的差异可以解释工业就业峰值份额变异的大部分原因。

abstract.text: In many environments, including credit and online markets, records about participants are collected, published, and erased after some time. We study the effects of erasing past records in a dynamic market where the quality of sellers follows a Markov process, and buyers leave feedback about sellers to an information intermediary. When the average quality of sellers is low, unlimited records lead to a market breakdown in the long run. We consider the information design problem and characterize information policies that can sustain trade and that maximize social welfare. These policies hide some information from the market in order to foster socially desirable experimentation. We show that these outcomes can be implemented by appropriately deleting past records. Crucially, positive and negative records play opposite roles with different intensities and must have different lengths: negative records must be deleted sufficiently late, and positive ones sufficiently early.

10.1093/restud/rdad067.abstractZh: 在许多环境中，包括信贷和在线市场，参与者的记录会被收集、发布，并在一段时间后被删除。我们研究了在动态市场中删除过去记录的影响，其中卖家的质量遵循马尔可夫过程，买家会将对卖家的反馈传递给信息中介。当卖家的平均质量较低时，无限制的记录会导致市场长期崩溃。我们考虑了信息设计问题，并描述了能够维持交易并最大化社会福利的信息策略。这些策略会隐藏部分信息，以促进社会所期望的实验。我们表明，通过适当删除过去的记录，可以实现这些结果。关键在于，正面和负面的记录起着相反的作用，且强度不同，它们的保留时间也必须不同：负面记录必须在足够晚的时候被删除，而正面记录则需要在足够早的时候被删除。

abstract.text: In disseminating information, policymakers face a choice between broadcasting to everyone and informing a small number of “seeds” who then spread the message. While broadcasting maximises the initial reach of messages, we offer theoretical and experimental evidence that it need not be the best strategy. In a field experiment during the 2016 Indian demonetisation, we delivered policy information, varying three dimensions of the delivery method at the village level: initial reach (broadcasting versus seeding); whether or not we induced common knowledge of who was initially informed; and number of facts delivered. We measured three outcomes: the volume of conversations about demonetisation, knowledge of demonetisation rules, and choice quality in a strongly incentivised policy-dependent decision. On all three outcomes, under common knowledge, seeding dominates broadcasting; moreover, adding common knowledge makes seeding more effective but broadcasting less so. We interpret our results via a model of image concerns deterring engagement in social learning, and we support this interpretation with evidence on differential behaviour across ability categories.

10.1093/restud/rdad068.abstractZh: 在传播信息的过程中，政策制定者面临两种选择：一种是向所有人广播信息，另一种则是向少数“种子”群体传递信息，再由这些种子群体进一步传播消息。虽然广播方式能够最大化信息的初始传播范围，但我们有理论和实验证据表明，这未必是最佳策略。在2016年印度废钞改革的实地实验中，我们在村级层面改变了三种传递方式：信息的初始传播范围（广播与种子传播）；是否诱导了人们对最初接收信息的人的共同认知；以及传递的信息数量。我们测量了三个结果：关于废钞改革的对话数量、对废钞改革规则的了解程度，以及人们在政策相关决策中的选择质量。在所有这三个结果上，在共同认知的情况下，种子传播方式优于广播方式；此外，增加共同认知会使种子传播方式更有效，而广播方式则效果减弱。我们通过一个关于形象顾虑阻碍社会学习的模型来解释我们的结果，并通过不同能力类别之间的行为差异来支持这一解释。

abstract.text: Do firms adjust wages in response to changes in their own demand level or to changes in competitive pressure from rival employers? We study how exporters adjust wages in response to unexpected product demand shocks during the 2008–9 Great Recession. Using rich data on Portuguese firms’ pre-recession export shipments, we measure firm-level shocks to export demand during the Recession. We show that shocks constructed at the firm level are not necessarily firm-specific and can be decomposed into a common component affecting all producers in a product market and an idiosyncratic component affecting individual firms within markets based on the locations of their pre-recession customers. We demonstrate that while both components impact firms’ output and their workers’ wages, the common component spills over from firms to their labour market rivals, whereas the idiosyncratic component does not. We find that 10–15% of firms’ idiosyncratic demand passes through to their employees’ wage growth with no effect on retention rates, implying significant dependence of wages on noncompetitive quasi-rents. Moreover, we find that wages respond primarily to shifts in internal labour demand when labour markets are thin, but they respond more to competition from other employers when labour markets are fluid. These results indicate that employers’ ability to set wages hinges on the underlying competitiveness of the labour market.

10.1093/restud/rdad069.abstractZh: 企业是会根据自身需求水平的变化，还是会根据竞争对手施加的竞争压力来调整工资呢？我们研究了在2008-2009年经济衰退期间，出口商如何根据意外的产品需求冲击来调整工资。利用葡萄牙企业在经济衰退前的出口数据，我们测量了经济衰退期间企业层面对出口需求的冲击。我们发现，企业层面的冲击并不一定是特定于企业的，并且可以分解为两个组成部分：一个影响整个产品市场所有生产者的共同因素，以及一个影响特定市场中各企业工资的特殊因素，后者取决于这些企业在经济衰退前客户的地理位置。我们指出，尽管这两个组成部分都影响企业的产出和员工的工资，但共同因素会溢出到企业的劳动力市场竞争对手身上，而特殊因素则不会。我们发现，有10-15%的企业特殊需求会转化为员工工资的增长，而这对员工保留率没有影响，这表明工资在很大程度上依赖于非竞争性的准租金。此外，我们发现，在劳动力市场较为紧张的情况下，工资主要受到内部劳动力需求变化的影响；而在劳动力市场流动性较高的情况下，工资则更多地受到其他雇主竞争的影响。这些结果表明，雇主设定工资的能力取决于劳动力市场的潜在竞争力。

abstract.text: We use customs data for Irish firms to show that in successful episodes of export market entry, there are statistically and economically significant post-entry dynamics of quantities, but not of mark-ups. To match these moments, we structurally estimate a model where firms can invest in future customer base through two channels: by selling more today, and by spending on marketing and advertising. Our estimates suggest that customer base is insensitive to lagged sales, so firms have no incentive to engage in dynamic pricing to accumulate customers. Instead, investment in customer base through marketing and advertising explains the dynamics of quantities. The ratio of advertising and marketing expenditures to sales implied by the model is consistent with data from other sources. Our estimated model generates long-run export responses to permanent tariff changes that are bigger than short run responses, as well as responses that are increasing in the expected persistence of tariff shocks, contributing to our understanding of the International Elasticity Puzzle.

10.1093/restud/rdad070.abstractZh: 我们利用爱尔兰企业的海关数据表明，在成功进入出口市场的案例中，数量在进入市场后存在统计上和经济上显著的动态变化，但价格加成则没有。为了匹配这些动态，我们构建了一个模型，企业可以通过两种途径投资未来的客户基础：通过今天销售更多的产品，以及通过营销和广告支出。我们的估计表明，客户基础对滞后销售不敏感，因此企业没有动机通过动态定价来积累客户。相反，通过营销和广告投资客户基础可以解释数量的动态变化。模型所预测的广告和营销支出与销售额的比例与其他来源的数据一致。我们估计的模型能够预测长期对永久性关税变化的出口反应，这些反应比短期反应更为显著，并且随着关税冲击预期持续性的增加而增强，这有助于我们理解国际弹性之谜。

abstract.text: We analyse efficient risk-sharing arrangements when the value from deviating is determined endogenously by another risk-sharing arrangement. Coalitions form to insure against idiosyncratic income risk. Self-enforcing contracts for both the original coalition and any coalition formed (joined) after deviations rely on a belief in future cooperation which we term “trust”. We treat the contracting conditions of original and deviation coalitions symmetrically and show that higher trust tightens incentive constraints since it facilitates the formation of deviating coalitions. As a consequence, although trust facilitates the initial formation of coalitions, the extent of risk sharing in successfully formed coalitions is declining in the extent of trust and efficient allocations might feature resource burning or utility burning: trust is indeed a double-edged sword.

10.1093/restud/rdad071.abstractZh: 我们分析了在偏离所带来的收益由另一种风险分担安排内生决定的情况下，有效风险分担安排的形式。联盟形成是为了防范特定收入风险。原始联盟以及因偏离而形成的任何联盟之间的自我强制合同，都依赖于对未来合作的信任，我们将其称为“信任”。我们对原始联盟和偏离联盟的签约条件进行了对称处理，并表明较高的信任会加强激励约束，因为它有助于形成偏离联盟。因此，尽管信任有助于联盟的初始形成，但在成功形成的联盟中，风险分担的程度随着信任的降低而减少，有效的分配方式可能表现为资源消耗或效用消耗：信任确实是一把双刃剑。

abstract.text: This article proposes a model of non-Bayesian social learning in networks that accounts for heuristics and biases in opinion aggregation. The updating rules are represented by non-linear opinion aggregators from which we extract two extreme networks capturing strong and weak links. We provide graph-theoretic conditions for these networks that characterize opinions’ convergence, consensus formation, and efficient or biased information aggregation. Under these updating rules, agents may ignore some of their neighbours’ opinions, reducing the number of effective connections and inducing long-run disagreement for finite populations. For the wisdom of the crowd in large populations, we highlight a trade-off between how connected the society is and the non-linearity of the opinion aggregator. Our framework bridges several models and phenomena in the non-Bayesian social learning literature, thereby providing a unifying approach to the field.

10.1093/restud/rdad072.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个非贝叶斯社会学习模型，该模型考虑了意见聚合中的启发式方法和偏见。更新规则由非线性意见聚合器表示，从中我们可以提取两种极端网络，分别代表强链接和弱链接。我们为这些网络提供了图论条件，这些条件描述了意见的收敛、共识形成以及有效或偏见的信息聚合。在这些更新规则下，代理人可能会忽略某些邻居的意见，从而减少有效联系的数量，并导致有限人口在长期内出现分歧。对于大规模人口中的群体智慧，我们强调了社会的连通性与意见聚合的非线性之间的权衡。我们的框架连接了非贝叶斯社会学习文献中的多个模型和现象，从而为这一领域提供了一种统一的方法。

abstract.text: This paper analyses how limits to the complexity of statistical models used by market participants can shape asset prices. We consider an economy in which the stochastic process that governs the evolution of economic variables may not have a simple representation, and yet, agents are only capable of entertaining statistical models with a certain level of complexity. As a result, they may end up with a lower-dimensional approximation that does not fully capture the intertemporal complexity of the true data-generating process. We first characterize the implications of the resulting departure from rational expectations and relate the extent of return and forecast-error predictability at various horizons to the complexity of agents’ models and the statistical properties of the underlying process. We then apply our framework to study violations of uncovered interest rate parity in foreign exchange markets. We find that constraints on the complexity of agents’ models can generate return predictability patterns that are simultaneously consistent with the well-known forward discount and predictability reversal puzzles.

10.1093/restud/rdad073.abstractZh: 本文分析了市场参与者所使用的统计模型复杂性的限制如何影响资产价格。我们考虑了一个经济环境，其中控制经济变量演变的随机过程可能无法用简单的模型来表示，而参与者只能构建具有一定复杂度的统计模型。因此，他们可能得到的是一个低维的近似模型，无法完全捕捉真实数据生成过程的跨时复杂性。我们首先描述了这种偏离理性预期的影响，并将不同时间范围内回报和预测误差的可预测性程度与代理人的模型复杂度和基础过程的统计特性联系起来。然后，我们将这一框架应用于研究外汇市场中未揭示的利率平价违规现象。我们发现，对代理人模型复杂性的限制可以产生与著名的远期贴现和预测误差反转悖论相一致的可预测性模式。

abstract.text: In the past three decades, governments in emerging markets have accumulated large amounts of international reserves, especially those with fixed exchange rates. This article proposes a theory of reserve accumulation that can account for these facts. Using a model of endogenous sovereign default with nominal rigidities, we argue that the interaction between sovereign risk and aggregate demand amplification generates a macroeconomic-stabilization hedging role for international reserves. We show that issuing debt to purchase reserves during good times allows the government to stabilize aggregate demand when sovereign spreads rise and rolling over the debt becomes more expensive. We provide empirical evidence consistent with the model’s predictions.

10.1093/restud/rdad075.abstractZh: 在过去三十年中，新兴市场的政府积累了大量国际储备，尤其是那些实行固定汇率的国家。本文提出了一个解释这些现象的储备积累理论。通过构建一个具有名义刚性特征的内生主权违约模型，我们指出主权风险与总需求放大之间的相互作用，国际储备在宏观经济稳定中起到了对冲作用。我们指出，在经济良好时期发行债务购买储备，可以在主权利差上升时稳定总需求，而滚动债务则会使成本增加。我们提供了与模型预测一致的实证证据。

abstract.text: This paper studies two-player games in continuous time with imperfect public monitoring, in which information may arrive both gradually and continuously, governed by a Brownian motion, and abruptly and discontinuously, according to Poisson processes. For this general class of two-player games, we characterize the equilibrium payoff set via a convergent sequence of differential equations. The differential equations characterize the optimal trade-off between value burnt through incentives related to Poisson information and the noisiness of incentives related to Brownian information. In the presence of abrupt information, the boundary of the equilibrium payoff set may not be smooth outside the set of static Nash payoffs. Equilibrium strategies that attain extremal payoff pairs as well as their intertemporal incentives are elicitable from the limiting solution. The characterization is new even when information arrives through Poisson events only.

10.1093/restud/rdad077.abstractZh: 本文研究在连续时间下、存在不完全公共监控的二人博弈，其中信息可能以渐进或连续的方式到达，受布朗运动支配；也可能以突变或间断的方式到达，受泊松过程控制。对于这类一般的二人博弈，我们通过一系列收敛的微分方程来描述均衡收益集。这些微分方程刻画了与泊松信息相关的激励所导致的值损失与与布朗信息相关的激励的噪声之间的最优权衡。在信息突变的情况下，均衡收益集的边界可能在静态纳什收益集之外不平滑。从极限解中可以得出能够获得极端收益对以及其跨时激励的均衡策略。即使信息仅通过泊松事件到达，这种描述也是新的。

abstract.text: We examine two key channels through which commodity price super-cycles affect the economy: a wealth channel, through which higher commodity prices increase domestic demand, and a cost channel, through which they induce wage increases. By exploiting regional variation in exposure to commodity price shocks and administrative firm-level data from Brazil, we empirically disentangle these transmission channels. We introduce a dynamic model with heterogeneous firms and workers to further quantify the mechanisms and evaluate welfare. A counterfactual economy in which commodity booms are purely endowment shocks experiences only 30% of the intersectoral labour reallocation between tradables and nontradables, and 40% of the within-tradable labour reallocation between domestic and exported production. Finally, the consumption-equivalent welfare gain of a commodity super-cycle is twice as large in the counterfactual economy.

10.1093/restud/rdad078.abstractZh: 我们研究了商品价格超级周期影响经济的两个关键渠道：一个是通过提高国内需求来影响需求的财富渠道，另一个是通过引发工资上涨来影响成本的渠道。通过利用地区间对商品价格冲击的差异化以及巴西的行政企业级数据，我们实证分析了这些传导渠道。我们引入了一个具有异质企业和工人的动态模型，以进一步量化这些机制并评估福利效应。在反事实经济中，如果商品价格繁荣仅仅是自然冲击，那么贸易品与非贸易品之间的部门间劳动力重新分配仅达到30%，而贸易品内部国内与出口生产之间的劳动力重新分配则仅为40%。最后，在反事实经济中，商品价格超级周期带来的消费等效福利增益是原来的两倍。

abstract.text: We propose that a person’s desire to consume an object or possess an attribute increases in how much others want but cannot have it. We term this motive imitative superiority-seeking and show that it generates preferences for exclusion that help explain a host of market anomalies and make novel predictions in a variety of domains. In bilateral exchange, trade becomes more zero-sum, leading to an endowment effect. People’s value of consuming a good increases in its scarcity, which generates a motive for firms and organizations to engage in exclusionary policies. A monopolist producing at constant marginal cost can increase profits by randomly excluding buyers relative to the standard optimal mechanism of posting a common price. In the context of auctions, a seller can extract greater revenues by randomly barring a subset of consumers from bidding.
