10.1111/ecca.12520.abstractZh: 在英国，继续教育机构和第六学年学院是帮助16至19岁青少年获取技能的关键机构。这些机构会在青少年完成初中教育后招收一半的学生，其中来自低收入背景的学生比例较高。然而，关于如何提升这些机构的教学效果，我们知之甚少。我们首次对这些机构进行了管理实践调查，并将调查结果与超过40,000名学生的行政纵向数据进行了对比。经过丰富的控制变量后的价值回归分析表明，结构化的管理对教育成果至关重要，尤其是对来自低收入背景的学生而言。假设一个人从管理实践水平处于第10百分位的学院转到第90百分位的学院，其获得良好高中毕业资格的概率将提高8%，这几乎可以弥补来自贫困与非贫困背景学生之间的教育差距。因此，改善管理实践可能是减少不平等的重要途径。

abstract.text: Retention of skilled workers is essential for labour‐intensive organizations like hospitals, where an excessive turnover of doctors and nurses can reduce the quality and quantity of services provided to patients. Exploiting a unique and rich panel dataset based on employee‐level payroll and staff survey records from the universe of English NHS hospitals, we investigate empirically the role played by two non‐pecuniary job factors, staff engagement and the retention of complementary co‐workers, in affecting employee retention within the public hospital sector. We estimate dynamic panel data models to deal with reverse causality bias, and validate these estimates through unconditional quantile regressions with hospital‐level fixed effects. Our findings show that a one standard deviation increase in nurse engagement is associated with a 16% standard deviation increase in their retention; and also that a 10% increase in nurse retention is associated with a 1.6% increase in doctor retention, with this co‐workers' complementarity spillover effect driven by the retention of more experienced nurses. Nurse and doctor engagement is positively associated with managers who have effective communication, involve staff in the decision‐making process, and act on staff feedback; in particular, older nurse engagement is responsive to managers caring for staff health and wellbeing.

10.1111/ecca.12554.abstractZh: 留住技术熟练的工人对于像医院这样需要大量劳动力的组织来说至关重要，因为医生和护士的过度流动会降低为患者提供的服务质量和数量。我们利用一个基于英国国家医疗服务体系医院员工工资记录和员工调查数据的独特且丰富的面板数据集，实证研究了两个非金钱性工作因素——员工参与度和补充员工的保留——对公立医院部门员工保留的影响。我们通过动态面板数据模型来应对反向因果关系的偏差，并通过带有医院层面固定效应的无条件分位数回归来验证这些估计结果。我们的研究发现，护士参与度的提高一个标准差与他们的保留率提高16%相关；同时，护士保留率的提高10%与医生保留率的提高1.6%相关，这种补充员工的互补性溢出效应是由更多经验丰富的护士的保留所驱动的。护士和医生的参与度与那些具有有效沟通能力、让员工参与决策过程并响应员工反馈的管理者呈正相关；特别是，较年长的护士的参与度对关心员工健康和福祉的管理者更为敏感。

abstract.text: AIM: To systematically review the potential of smart home technology to enhance the independence of older adults and reduce their dependence on care. Additionally, it sought to examine the positive impacts of such technology on their golden years. DESIGN: A systematic review based on Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Review and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA). DATA SOURCES: The search was conducted on 8 April 2024. Peer-reviewed studies in PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, IEEE Xplore, Scopus, The Cochrane Library, CINAHL, CNKI, WANFANG DATA and VIP from 1 January 2000 to 8 April 2024 were searched. METHODS: The methodological quality assessment used the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool (MMAT). Positive findings relevant to this study were extracted from the literature and analysed using thematic synthesis. RESULTS: After meticulously examining 3404 studies, we identified 21 relevant sources for in-depth analysis, including qualitative studies (n = 10), experimental studies (n = 9) and mixed method studies (n = 2). These sources were grouped into five core themes based on the pivotal role of smart home technologies in enabling ageing in place: daily monitoring, assisted living activities, life reminders, functional improvement and emotional companionship. The study found that smart home technology offers numerous benefits to the lives of older adults, including increased independence, psychological support, improved cognitive functioning, enhanced self-management, increased mobility, support for caregivers, promoted social engagement and enhanced quality of life. CONCLUSION: Smart home technology can enhance the independence of older adults' lives, reduce their dependence on care, alleviate the burden on caregivers and promote home-based elderly care. IMPACT: This systematic review contributes to understanding the capability of smart home technology to promote elderly care at home and help better utilise smart home technology to benefit older adults. Older adults and their caregivers should be encouraged to adopt this technology to improve older adults' quality of life. PATIENT OR PUBLIC CONTRIBUTION: No patient or public contribution.

10.1111/jan.16569.abstractZh:
目的：系统回顾智能家居技术提升老年人独立性、减少其对护理依赖的潜力。同时，探讨此类技术对老年人晚年的积极影响。  
设计：基于系统回顾与荟萃分析首选报告条目（PRISMA）进行系统回顾。  
数据来源：检索于2024年4月8日，在PubMed、Embase、Web of Science、IEEE Xplore、Scopus、Cochrane Library、CINAHL、CNKI、WANFANG DATA和VIP数据库中，时间范围从2000年1月1日至2024年4月8日，检索了同行评审的研究。  
方法：采用混合方法评估工具（MMAT）对研究的方法学质量进行评估。从文献中提取与本研究相关的阳性结果，并通过主题综合进行分析。  
结果：经过对3404项研究的仔细审查，确定了21个适合深入分析的来源，包括10项定性研究、9项实验研究和2项混合方法研究。根据智能家居技术在促进老年人居家养老中的关键作用，这些来源被分为五个核心主题：日常监测、辅助生活活动、生活提醒、功能改善和情感陪伴。研究发现，智能家居技术为老年人带来了诸多好处，包括提高独立性、提供心理支持、改善认知功能、增强自我管理能力、增加行动能力、减轻护理人员的负担、促进社交参与以及提升生活质量。  
结论：智能家居技术能够提升老年人的生活独立性，减少其对护理的依赖，减轻护理人员的负担，并促进居家养老的发展。影响：本系统综述有助于理解智能家居技术促进家庭养老的能力，并帮助更好地利用智能家居技术来造福老年人。应鼓励老年人及其护理人员采用这项技术，以提高老年人的生活质量。患者或公众贡献：无患者或公众贡献。

abstract.text: Extant research holds that digital sales channels advance competition and service or goods availability but rarely details the attendant information asymmetry. Leveraging a large unique dataset, this study examines a specific case in which consumers have a choice between offline and digital channels for insurance purchases. We find that digital channels screen in consumers with lower unobserved risk. For term life, endowment and disease insurance products, the average risks of the policies purchased through digital channels were significantly lower than those purchased offline after controlling for all observed risk characteristics. This risk screening effect mainly comes from the inclusion of new low‐risk enrollees. As a consequence, digital channels exhibit lower information asymmetry and greater profitability compared to offline channels.

10.1111/jori.12496.abstractZh: 现有研究表明，数字销售渠道能够提升竞争和服务或商品的可用性，但很少详细探讨随之而来的信息不对称问题。本研究利用大量独特的数据集，考察了消费者在保险购买时可以选择线下或数字渠道的具体情况。研究发现，数字渠道能够筛选出风险较低的消费者。对于定期人寿保险、生存保险和疾病保险产品而言，在控制所有可观测风险特征后，通过数字渠道购买的保单平均风险明显低于线下购买的保单。这种风险筛选效应主要源于新低风险投保人的加入。因此，与线下渠道相比，数字渠道表现出更低的信息不对称和更高的盈利能力。

abstract.text: Many regulated health insurance markets with community‐rated premiums rely on risk adjustment (RA) to mitigate insurer‐incentives to risk select. However, insurers remain typically undercompensated for chronically ill enrollees. We use historical data on health spending and risk adjuster information to identify individuals undercompensated by the Dutch RA model of 2021 and find a selective group (1% of the population) with an average annual undercompensation of €6,050. We supplement the RA model with a risk sharing modality called high‐risk pooling (HRP) to organize residual‐based compensations towards insurers for the identified group to reduce the mean undercompensation to zero. The effects are evaluated on subgroups defined by chronic disease, finding a 42% reduction of their average undercompensation. Therefore, through compensating 1% of the population, the insurer‐incentives to select against chronically ill individuals substantially diminish. These results are compared to outlier‐risk sharing (reinsurance), proving HRP to be more effective at reducing selection incentives.

10.1111/jori.12500.abstractZh: 许多采用社区定价机制的监管性健康保险市场，依赖风险调整机制来减轻保险公司选择高风险客户的动机。然而，对于长期患病的患者，保险公司通常获得的补偿仍然不足。我们利用历史健康支出数据及风险调整相关信息，通过2021年荷兰的风险调整模型，识别出平均每年遭受6,050欧元补偿不足的人群，该群体占人口的1%。我们进一步引入一种称为高风险共保机制的风险分担方式，以对这部分人群进行剩余补偿，从而将平均补偿不足金额降至零。在按慢性疾病分类的亚群中，我们发现平均补偿不足金额减少了42%。因此，通过对人口中的1%进行补偿，显著降低了保险公司选择高风险患者的动机。这些结果与异常风险分担机制相比，证明高风险共保在减少选择动机方面更为有效。

abstract.text: Healthcare providers' implicit bias, based on patients' physical characteristics and perceived identities, negatively impacts healthcare access, care quality, and outcomes. Feedback tools are needed to help providers identify and learn from their biases. To incorporate providers' perspectives on the most effective ways to present such feedback, we conducted semi-structured design critique sessions with 24 primary care providers. We found that providers seek feedback designed with transparent metrics indicating the quality of their communication with a patient and trends in communication patterns across visits. Based on these metrics and trends, providers want this feedback presented in a dashboard paired with actionable, personalized tips about how to improve their communication behaviors. Our study provides new insights for interactive systems to help mitigate the impact of implicit biases in patient-provider communication. New systems that build upon these insights could support providers in making healthcare more equitable, particularly for patients from marginalized communities.

10.1145/3613904.3642756.abstractZh: 基于患者身体特征和身份特征的隐性偏见，对医疗服务提供者的影响是负面的，这会影响医疗服务的获取、护理质量以及治疗效果。需要反馈工具来帮助提供者识别并了解自己的偏见。为了将提供者对于如何有效呈现反馈的看法纳入其中，我们与24位初级保健提供者进行了半结构化设计评审会议。我们发现，提供者希望获得的反馈能够包含透明的指标，以衡量他们与患者沟通的质量以及不同就诊期间的沟通模式趋势。基于这些指标和趋势，提供者希望反馈以仪表板的形式呈现，并附带可操作的、个性化的建议，以帮助他们改进沟通行为。我们的研究为交互式系统提供了新的见解，有助于减轻隐性偏见对患者-提供者沟通的影响。基于这些见解开发的新系统可以支持提供者使医疗服务更加公平，尤其是对于那些来自边缘化社区的患者。

abstract.text: Governments' powerful imperative to support innovation has only grown more urgent amid slowing growth in the developed world and a rapidly changing climate. In this review, I describe the important role that economics and finance play in rigorously evaluating innovation policy. I organize government intervention in innovation into arenas, agendas, and instruments. The arenas are firms, financial intermediaries, universities, and government laboratories. The key agendas are entrepreneurship, defense, climate, health, and education. The instruments fall into three categories: supply-push, demand-pull, and legal. I provide theoretical rationales for government intervention in innovation and discuss how they intersect with government agendas and empirical evidence in practice. One takeaway is that the government has a key role to play in the type of failure-tolerant, open-ended research that yields breakthrough inventions. In contrast, there is less evidence that subsidizing financial intermediaries is useful.

10.1146/annurev-financial-082123-105722.abstractZh: 在发达国家经济增长放缓和气候迅速变化的背景下，政府支持创新的强烈需求愈发紧迫。在这篇综述中，我阐述了经济学和金融在严格评估创新政策中所扮演的重要角色。我将政府对创新的干预分为多个领域、目标和工具。这些领域包括企业、金融中介机构、大学和政府实验室。关键的目标包括创业、国防、气候问题、健康和教育。干预工具可分为三类：供给推动型、需求拉动型和法律手段。我提供了关于政府干预创新的理论依据，并探讨了这些依据如何与政府目标以及实际经验相契合。一个重要的结论是，政府在能够容忍失败、具有开放性的研究中发挥着关键作用，这类研究能够催生突破性发明。相比之下，对金融中介机构的补贴作用则相对有限。

abstract.text: We develop a framework to measure the role of hospital allocation in racial disparities in health care and use it to study Black and white heart attack patients. Black patients receive care at lower-performing hospitals than white patients. However, over two decades, the performance gap between hospitals treating Black and white patients shrank by over two-thirds. This progress is due to more rapid performance improvement at hospitals that tended to treat Black patients rather than reallocation of patients. Hospital improvement is correlated with adoption of a productivity-raising input, beta blockers. Our work highlights reallocation and performance improvement as future disparity-reduction levers.

10.1162/rest_a_01248.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个框架，用于衡量医院分配在医疗健康领域种族差异中的作用，并利用该框架研究黑人和白人心脏病患者的状况。黑人患者在接受治疗的医院表现通常较差，但二十多年来，治疗黑人和白人患者的医院之间的表现差距缩小了三分之二以上。这一进步主要得益于那些倾向于治疗黑人的医院表现更快，而非通过重新分配患者来实现。医院表现的改善与采用能够提高生产力的药物——β阻滞剂——有关。我们的研究强调了重新分配和性能提升作为未来减少种族差异的潜在手段。

abstract.text: Why do cities differ so much in productivity? A long literature has sought out systematic sources, such as inherent productivity advantages, market access, agglomeration forces, or sorting. We document that up to three-quarters of the measured regional productivity dispersion is spurious, reflecting the “luck of the draw” of finite counts of idiosyncratically heterogeneous plants that happen to operate in a given location. The patterns are even more pronounced for new plants, hold for alternative productivity measures, and broadly extend to European countries. This large role for individual plants suggests a smaller role for places in driving regional differences.

10.1162/rest_a_01275.abstractZh: 为什么城市在生产力方面存在如此大的差异？大量文献试图寻找系统性的原因，例如固有的生产力优势、市场准入、集聚效应或排序效应。我们发现，高达四分之三的地域生产力差异是偶然性的结果，反映了在特定地点运营的具有独特异质性的工厂数量有限，从而导致了“抽签运气”的影响。这种差异在新工厂中更为明显，适用于其他生产力指标，并且这一现象广泛存在于欧洲国家。个体工厂在推动区域差异中的作用如此之大，表明地方在驱动区域差异中的作用相对较小。

abstract.text: Worker shortages are common in many industries. This paper examines the effect of government subsidies to address these shortages in the context of a reform that tied Medicaid payments to nursing home staffing levels. We find that the reform substantially increased staffing, especially for facilities serving many Medicaid patients. Facilities responded primarily by hiring workers in lower-wage roles rather than increasing hours of incumbent or high-wage staff. This contrasts with null effects we estimate for a non-incentivized rate increase, suggesting that the incentive structure of government payments—rather than just the level—is key to boosting employment in sectors facing worker shortages.

10.1162/rest_a_01530.abstractZh: 许多行业普遍存在劳动力短缺的问题。本文探讨了政府在补贴方面的措施对解决这些短缺的影响，这些补贴是在一项将医疗补助支付与养老院人员配置水平挂钩的改革背景下实施的。我们发现，这项改革显著增加了人员配置，尤其是为服务大量医疗补助患者的机构。这些机构主要通过雇佣低薪岗位的工作者来应对这一需求，而不是增加现有高薪员工的工作时间。这与我们对无激励性费率提升所估计的零效应形成对比，这表明政府支付的结构——而不仅仅是支付水平——是促进面临劳动力短缺的行业就业的关键。

abstract.text: Health care report cards improve information and are a crucial part of health care reform of the federal government of the United States. I exploit a natural experiment in the home health sector to assess whether a higher rating under the star ratings program affects patient choice. Higher rated agencies increased their market share by 1.4% or 0.25 (95% confidence interval: [-0.63, 1.12]) percentage points, a practically and statistically insignificant amount. I find no evidence of heterogeneous effects across the rating distribution or over time. I also find precise null effects among consumers expected to be more responsive, including community-entry patients and patients in competitive markets with more options and star types. Agencies may have modestly impeded consumer choice by engaging in some patient selection behaviors, although the evidence is only weakly suggestive. The star ratings are unlikely to improve home health quality despite continued policymaker interest.

10.1177/10775587231221852.abstractZh: 健康护理报告卡能够提升信息透明度，是美国联邦政府医疗改革的重要组成部分。我通过家庭健康护理领域的自然实验来研究星级评级制度对病人选择的影响。评级较高的机构市场份额增加了1.4%，即0.25个百分点（95%置信区间：[-0.63, 1.12]），这一增幅在实践和统计上都不显著。我没有发现评级分布或时间变化带来的异质性效应。对于预期反应更敏感的消费者群体，包括社区内患者以及选择更多类型和星级等级的患者，我也未发现显著的零效应。尽管有证据表明机构可能通过某些病人选择行为在一定程度上影响了消费者的选择，但这种影响并不明显。尽管政策制定者持续关注，星级评级制度不太可能改善家庭健康护理的质量。

abstract.text: In health insurance markets with regulated competition, regulators face the challenge of preventing risk selection. This paper provides a framework for analyzing the scope (i.e., potential actions by insurers and consumers) and incentives for risk selection in such markets. Our approach consists of three steps. First, we describe four types of risk selection: (a) selection by consumers in and out of the market, (b) selection by consumers between high- and low-value plans, (c) selection by insurers via plan design, and (d) selection by insurers via other channels such as marketing, customer service, and supplementary insurance. In a second step, we develop a conceptual framework of how regulation and features of health insurance markets affect the scope and incentives for risk selection along these four dimensions. In a third step, we use this framework to compare nine health insurance markets with regulated competition in Australia, Europe, Israel, and the United States.

10.1177/10775587231222584.abstractZh: 在具有监管竞争的医疗保险市场中，监管机构面临着防止风险选择的挑战。本文提供了一个框架，用于分析此类市场中风险选择的范围（即保险公司和消费者的潜在行为）以及激励因素。我们的方法包括三个步骤。首先，我们描述了四种风险选择类型：(a)消费者进出市场的选择；(b)消费者在高价值计划与低价值计划之间的选择；(c)保险公司通过计划设计进行的选择；以及(d)保险公司通过营销、客户服务和补充保险等其他渠道进行的选择。在第二步中，我们构建了一个概念框架，探讨监管和医疗保险市场特征如何影响这四种维度下的风险选择范围和激励因素。在第三步中，我们使用该框架比较了澳大利亚、欧洲、以色列和美国九个具有监管竞争的医疗保险市场。

abstract.text: Over 70% of Medicaid beneficiaries are enrolled in Medicaid managed care (MMC). MMC provider networks therefore represent a critical determinant of access to the Medicaid program. Many MMC insurers also participate in commercial insurance markets where prices are high, and some insurers exercise considerable market power. In this paper, we examined the relationship between commercial insurer market power and MMC physician network breadth using linked national enrollment data and provider directory data. Insurers with more commercial market power had broader Medicaid physician networks. Insurers with over 30% market share had 37.3% broader Medicaid networks than insurers in the same county that had no commercial market share. These differences were driven by greater breadth among primary care providers, as well as other specialists including OB/GYNs, surgeons, neurologists, and cardiologists. Commercial insurance market power may have spillovers on access to care for MMC beneficiaries.

10.1177/10775587241241975.abstractZh: 超过70%的Medicaid受益人参加了Medicaid管理式护理计划。因此，Medicaid管理式护理的提供网络是获取该计划服务的关键因素。许多Medicaid管理式护理的保险公司也参与商业保险市场，而商业保险市场的价格较高，一些保险公司拥有较大的市场影响力。本文利用全国范围内的参保数据和提供方目录数据，研究了商业保险公司市场影响力与Medicaid管理式护理医生网络规模之间的关系。市场影响力较大的保险公司拥有更广泛的Medicaid医生网络。市场份额超过30%的保险公司，其Medicaid医生网络比同一县内没有商业市场影响力的保险公司要广泛37.3%。这些差异主要源于初级保健医生以及其他专科医生（如妇产科医生、外科医生、神经科医生和心脏病专家）的广泛分布。商业保险市场的市场影响力可能会对Medicaid管理式护理受益人的医疗服务获取产生影响。

abstract.text: Kevin Munger argues that, when an agnostic approach is applied to social scientific inquiry, the goal of prediction to new settings is generically impossible. We aim to situate Munger’s critique in a broader scientific and philosophical literature and to point to ways in which gnosis can and, in some circumstances, must be used to facilitate the accumulation of knowledge. We question some of the premises of Munger’s arguments, such as the definition of statistical agnosticism and the characterization of knowledge. We further emphasize the important role of microfoundations and particularism in the social sciences. We assert that Munger’s conclusions may be overly pessimistic as they relate to practice in the field.

10.1177/20531680241307942.abstractZh: 凯文·芒格认为，当将不可知论的方法应用于社会科学研究时，预测新情况的目标通常是不可能的。我们试图将芒格的批评置于更广泛的科学和哲学文献中，并指出在某些情况下，知识认知可以被用来促进知识的积累。我们对芒格论点中的一些前提提出了质疑，例如统计不可知论的定义以及知识的描述方式。我们还强调了微观基础与特殊性在社会科学中的重要作用。我们认为，芒格的结论可能过于悲观，尤其是在实践层面的应用上。

abstract.text: New Public Management-inspired reforms in the Norwegian hospital sector have introduced several features from the private sector into a predominantly public healthcare system. Since the late 1990s, several reforms have been carried out with the intention of improving the utilization of resources. There is, however, limited knowledge about the long-term, and sector-wide effects of these reforms. In this study, using a panel data set of all public hospital trusts spanning nine years, we provide an analysis of the efficiency of hospital trusts using data envelopment analysis (DEA), as well as a Malmquist productivity index. Thereafter we use the efficiency scores as the dependent variable in a second-stage panel data regression analysis. We show that during the period between 2011 and 2019, on average, efficiency has increased over time. Further, in the second-stage analysis, we show that New Public Management features related to incentivization are associated with the level of hospital efficiency. We find no association between degree of competition and efficiency.

10.1186/s12913-023-10479-7.abstractZh: 受新公共管理理念启发的挪威医院部门改革，将私营部门的多项特征引入了一个以公共医疗为主的体系。自20世纪90年代末以来，多项改革旨在提高资源利用效率。然而，关于这些改革对整个行业的长期影响，目前了解甚少。本研究利用涵盖九年时间的所有公立医院信托机构的面板数据，通过数据包络分析（DEA）和马尔克斯quist生产率指数，对医院信托机构的效率进行了分析。随后，我们将效率得分作为第二阶段面板数据回归分析的自变量。研究发现，在2011年至2019年期间，医院机构的效率总体上有所提升。此外，在第二阶段分析中，我们发现与激励措施相关的新公共管理特征与医院效率水平之间存在关联。而竞争程度与效率之间则未发现关联。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Although countries worldwide have launched a series of pro-competition reforms, the literature on the impacts of hospital competition has produced a complex and contradictory picture. This study examined whether hospital competition contributed to an increase in the quality of outpatient care. METHODS: The dataset comprises encounter data on 406,664 outpatients with influenza between 2015 and 2019 in China. Competition was measured using the Herfindahl-Hirschman index (HHI). Whether patients had 14-day follow-up encounter for influenza at any healthcare facility, outpatient facility, and hospital outpatient department were the three quality outcomes assessed. Binary regression models with crossed random intercepts were constructed to estimate the impacts of the HHI on the quality of outpatient care. The intensity of nighttime lights was employed as an instrumental variable to address the endogenous relationship between the HHI and the quality of outpatient care. RESULTS: We demonstrated that an increase in the degree of hospital competition was associated with improved quality of outpatient care. For each 1% increase in the degree of hospital competition, an individual's risk of having a 14-day follow-up encounter for influenza at any healthcare facility, outpatient facility, and hospital outpatient department fell by 34.9%, 18.3%, and 20.8%, respectively. The impacts of hospital competition on improving the quality of outpatient care were more substantial among females, individuals who used the Urban and Rural Residents Basic Medical Insurance to pay for their medical costs, individuals who visited accredited hospitals, and adults aged 25 to 64 years when compared with their counterparts. CONCLUSION: This study demonstrated that hospital competition contributed to better quality of outpatient care under a regime with a regulated ceiling price. Competition is suggested to be promoted in the outpatient care market where hospitals have control over quality and government sets a limit on the prices that hospitals may charge.

10.1186/s13561-024-00516-4.abstractZh:
背景：尽管全球各国纷纷推行一系列促进竞争的改革，但关于医院竞争影响的文献却呈现出复杂且矛盾的现象。本研究旨在探讨医院竞争是否有助于提升门诊护理质量。  
方法：研究数据包含2015至2019年间中国406,664名流感患者的就诊记录。竞争程度通过赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数来衡量。研究评估了患者在任何医疗机构、门诊机构及医院门诊部门是否进行了14天的流感随访治疗，以此作为护理质量的两个指标。通过构建交叉随机截距的二元回归模型，来估算赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数对门诊护理质量的影响。同时，将夜间灯光强度作为工具变量，以解释赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数与门诊护理质量之间的内生关系。  
结果：研究结果表明，医院竞争程度的增加与门诊护理质量的提升相关。医院竞争程度每提高1%，患者在任何医疗机构、门诊机构及医院门诊部门进行14天随访治疗的风险分别降低34.9%、18.3%和20.8%。与男性相比，女性、使用城乡居民基本医疗保险支付医疗费用的人群、前往认证医院就诊的人群，以及25至64岁的成年人，医院竞争对提升门诊护理质量的影响更为显著。结论：本研究表明，在实行有监管上限价格的制度下，医院之间的竞争有助于提升门诊服务的质量。建议在门诊服务市场中促进竞争，因为医院能够控制服务质量，而政府则对医院可以收取的价格设定了上限。

abstract.text: Many health insurance markets are organized by principles of regulated competition. Regulators of these markets typically apply risk equalization (aka risk adjustment) and risk sharing to mitigate risk selection. Risk equalization and risk sharing can have various positive and negative effects on efficiency and fairness. This paper provides a comprehensive framework for ex-ante evaluation of these effects. In a first step, we distinguish 22 potential effects. In a second step, we summarize and discuss quantitative measures used for evaluating risk equalization and risk sharing schemes in academic research. To underline the relevance of our work, we compare our framework with an existing framework that was previously used in the Dutch regulated health insurance market. We conclude that this framework is incomplete and uses inappropriate measures. To avoid suboptimal policy choices, we recommend policymakers (1) to consider the entire spectrum of potential effects and (2) to select their measures carefully.

10.1186/s13561-024-00540-4.abstractZh: 许多健康保险市场都是按照受监管竞争的原则来组织的。这些市场的监管机构通常会采用风险均衡（又称风险调整）和风险分担机制来减轻风险选择带来的负面影响。风险均衡和风险分担对效率和公平性的影响既有积极的一面，也有消极的一面。本文提供了一个全面的框架，用于事前评估这些影响。首先，我们区分了22种潜在影响。其次，我们总结并讨论了学术研究中用于评估风险均衡和风险分担方案的定量指标。为了强调我们工作的重要性，我们将我们的框架与荷兰受监管健康保险市场现有的框架进行了比较。我们发现，现有的框架并不完整，且使用了不恰当的指标。为了避免做出次优的政策选择，我们建议政策制定者：(1) 考虑所有潜在影响；(2) 谨慎选择相关指标。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: The objective of this study is to assess if waiting times for elective surgeries within the Portuguese National Health Service (NHS) are influenced by the waiting times at neighboring hospitals. Recognizing these interdependencies, and their extent, is crucial for understanding how hospital network dynamics affect healthcare delivery efficiency and patient access. METHODS: We utilized patient-level data from all elective surgeries conducted in Portuguese NHS hospitals to estimate a hospital-specific index for waiting times. This index served as the dependent variable in our analysis. We applied a spatial lag model to examine the potential strategic interactions between hospitals concerning their waiting times. RESULTS: Our analysis revealed a significant positive endogenous spatial dependence, indicating that waiting times in NHS hospitals are strategic complements. Furthermore, we found that NHS contracts with private not-for-profit hospitals not only reduce waiting times within these hospitals but also exert positive spillover effects on other NHS hospitals. CONCLUSIONS: The findings suggest that diversifying the organization of the NHS hospital network, particularly through contracts with private entities for marginal patients, can significantly enhance competitive dynamics and reduce waiting times. This effect persists even when patient choice is confined to a small fraction of the patient population, highlighting a strategic avenue for policy optimization in healthcare service delivery.

10.1186/s13561-024-00555-x.abstractZh: 背景：本研究的目的是评估葡萄牙国家卫生服务系统（NHS）中择期手术的等待时间是否受到邻近医院等待时间的影响。认识到这些相互依赖性及其程度对于理解医院网络动态如何影响医疗服务的效率和患者获取至关重要。方法：我们利用葡萄牙NHS医院中所有择期手术患者的数据，估算出医院特定的等待时间指数。这一指数在我们的分析中作为因变量。我们应用空间滞后模型来研究医院之间关于等待时间的潜在战略互动。结果：我们的分析显示存在显著的正向空间依赖性，表明NHS医院的等待时间是战略性的互补关系。此外，我们发现NHS与私人非营利医院签订的合同不仅减少了这些医院的等待时间，还对其他NHS医院产生了积极的溢出效应。结论：研究结果表明，通过与非营利性私人实体签订合同来多样化NHS医院网络的组织方式，可以显著增强竞争活力并减少等待时间。即使患者选择仅限于一小部分人群，这种效应仍然持续存在，这为优化医疗服务提供了一条战略途径。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVES: Patient reported experience measures (PREMs) are tools often utilised in hospitals to support quality improvements and to provide objective feedback on care experiences. Less commonly PREMs can be used to support consumers choices in their hospital care. Little is known about the experience and views of the Australian consumer regarding PREMs nor the considerations these consumers have when they need to make decisions about attending hospital. This study aimed to explore consumer awareness of PREMs, consumer attitudes towards PREMs and the utility of PREMs as a decision-making tool in accessing hospital care. METHODS: Qualitative study involving semi-structured interviews conducted over the phone. Participants (n = 40) were recruited from across Australia and purposively sampled according to key characteristics: holding private health insurance, > 30-years of age, may have accessed private hospital care in the past year, variety of educational and cultural backgrounds, and if urban or rural residing. Interviews were audio-recorded, transcribed, and analysed thematically. RESULTS: Four overarching themes and six subthemes were identified from the data. Major findings were that prior awareness of PREMs was limited; however, many had filled in a PREM either for themselves or for someone they cared for following a hospital stay. Most respondents preferred to listen to experience of self or family/friends or the recommendation of their physician when choosing a hospital to attend. Participants appeared to be more interested in the treating clinician than the hospital with this clinician often dictating the hospital or hospital options. If provided choice in hospital, issues of additional costs, timeliness of treatment and location were important factors. CONCLUSION: While PREMs were considered a possible tool to assist in hospital decision-making process, previous hospital experiences, the doctor and knowing up-front cost are an overriding consideration for consumers when choosing their hospital. Consideration to format and presentation of PREMs data is needed to facilitate understanding and allow meaningful comparisons. Future research could examine the considerations of those consumers who primarily access public healthcare facilities and how to improve the utility of PREMs.

10.1186/s41687-024-00755-3.abstractZh:
研究目的：患者报告体验指标（PREMs）是医院中常用的工具，用于支持质量改进并提供关于护理体验的客观反馈。较少情况下，PREMs也可用于支持消费者在医院护理中的选择。目前对于澳大利亚消费者对PREMs的体验与看法，以及他们在需要决定是否住院时考虑的因素，了解甚少。本研究旨在探讨消费者对PREMs的认知、态度，以及PREMs作为决策工具在获取医院护理中的效用。

研究方法：采用半结构化电话访谈的定性研究方法。参与者共40人，来自澳大利亚各地，并根据以下关键特征进行目的性抽样：持有私人健康保险、年龄超过30岁、过去一年内可能接受过私人医院护理、具有不同教育背景和文化背景，以及居住在城市还是农村。访谈内容被录音、转录，并按主题进行分析。

研究结果：从数据中识别出四个主要主题和六个子主题。主要发现是，参与者对PREMs的认知有限；然而，许多人曾为自己或所关心的人填写过PREMs。大多数受访者在选择医院时，更倾向于听取自己或家人/朋友的体验，或是医生的建议。参与者似乎更关注治疗医生，而非医院本身，因为医生通常会推荐医院或医院选项。如果能在医院中做出选择，额外费用、治疗及时性以及地理位置等因素都是重要的考虑因素。结论：虽然预印医学论文被视为辅助医院决策过程的一种可能工具，但在选择医院时，消费者的首要考虑因素包括医院的过往经验、医生资质以及前期成本。此外，还需要对预印医学论文的数据格式和呈现方式进行优化，以便更好地理解和进行有意义的比较。未来的研究可以探讨那些主要依赖公共医疗设施获取信息的消费者的考虑因素，以及如何提升预印医学论文的实用性。

abstract.text: Now more than ever, there is a growing importance for companies to ramp up their focus on social responsibility. An effective CSR program can have a positive impact on companies, employees, and consumers. This new volume, Corporate Social Responsibility in the Global Business World: A Conceptual, Regulatory, and Illustrative Framework, covers the parameters of corporate social responsibility around the world, elucidating the concepts, evolution, cultural dimensions, key areas, and disclosure and reporting methods and how CSR is being considered and implemented across the globe. The book also offers a future outlook for CSR. The book begins with a thorough introduction to CSR, covering its meaning and definition along with the principles of CSR for effective implementation, its inherent benefits, and its challenges. It goes on to cover the status of CSR in emerging economies with the emphasis on emerging trends in corporate governance, reporting, indexing, and certification. The volume considers the evolution of CSR from voluntary to mandatory along with the underlining advantages and disadvantages while also giving comparisons of CSR in developed versus developing nations. The book looks at the regulations and legislation around the world pertaining to CSR, such as universal GRI standards and legislative framework of countries like UK, USA, India, Germany, France, Canada, China, and Indonesia that have been sketched out covering expenditures, disclosure, and reporting obligations. The authors share case studies of implemented CSR projects, initiatives, and practices, highlighting several societal and environmental issues either through stakeholder relations and collaborations with NGOs or agencies or by adhering to government regulations for CSR compliance. This book provides a valuable overview of CSR and how effective implementation can lead to a corporation’s contribution to worldwide and regional sustainability and the well-being of society and the environment.

10.1201/9781003411000.abstractZh: 如今，企业越来越重视社会责任方面的表现。有效的企业社会责任计划能够对公司、员工和消费者产生积极影响。这本新书《全球商业世界中的企业社会责任：概念性、监管性和说明性框架》涵盖了全球企业社会责任的各个方面，阐述了相关概念、发展脉络、文化维度、关键领域以及披露和报告方法，同时探讨了企业社会责任在全球范围内的实施情况。本书还对未来企业社会责任的发展进行了展望。书中首先对企业社会责任进行了全面介绍，包括其含义和定义，以及有效实施企业社会责任的准则、内在优势及面临的挑战。随后，本书探讨了新兴经济体中企业社会责任的现状，重点介绍了企业治理、报告、指数化和认证方面的新兴趋势。书中还分析了企业社会责任从自愿性到强制性的演变过程，以及其优缺点，并对比了发达国家和发展中国家在企业社会责任方面的差异。此外，本书还介绍了全球范围内与企业社会责任相关的法规和立法，如GRI通用标准，以及英国、美国、印度、德国、法国、加拿大、中国和印度尼西亚等国家的立法框架，涉及支出、披露和报告义务等方面。作者们还分享了实施企业社会责任项目的案例，通过利益相关者关系、与非政府组织或机构的合作，或遵守政府规定的企业社会责任要求，来应对各种社会和环境问题。本书提供了关于企业社会责任的重要概述，并探讨了如何有效实施企业社会责任，从而推动企业为全球和地区可持续发展以及社会和环境的福祉做出贡献。

abstract.text: Targeted price subsidies create a gap between subsidized and unsubsidized prices. The resulting dual pricing can lead to arbitrage opportunities where intermediaries divert subsidized goods to unintended beneficiaries via the black market. I study India’s Direct Benefit Transfer policy for cooking fuel subsidies, which altered the existing subsidy program by transferring subsidies directly to beneficiaries’ bank accounts. The policy decreased subsidized fuel purchases, indicating a reduction in diversion to the black market. Changes in unsubsidized fuel sales and black market prices provide supporting evidence that leakage was reduced. These results suggest that addressing the underlying perverse incentives in welfare delivery can improve efficiency by curbing leakages. (JEL D73, I38, O17, Q41, Q48)

10.1257/aer.20161864.abstractZh: 定向价格补贴会在补贴商品和未补贴商品之间造成价格差距。这种双重定价机制可能导致套利机会，中介机构会通过黑市将补贴商品转移给非目标受益人。我研究了印度直接福利转移政策对烹饪燃料补贴的影响，该政策通过将补贴直接转入受益人的银行账户，改变了原有的补贴体系。这一政策减少了补贴燃料的购买量，表明补贴商品被转移至黑市的情况有所减少。未补贴燃料销售和黑市价格的变化提供了支持性证据，表明补贴资金的实际使用效率有所提高。这些结果表明，解决福利分配中的逆向激励问题可以通过减少资金流失来提高效率。（JEL D73, I38, O17, Q41, Q48）

abstract.text: We study a dynamic contribution game where investors seek private benefits offered in exchange for contributions, and a single, publicly minded donor values project success. We show that donor contributions serve as costly signals that encourage socially productive contributions by investors who face a coordination problem. Investors and the donor prefer different equilibria, but all benefit in expectation from the donor’s ability to dynamically signal his valuation. We explore various contexts in which our model can be applied and delve empirically into the case of Kickstarter. We calibrate our model and quantify the coordination benefits of dynamic signaling in counterfactuals. (JEL C73, D26, D82, G32, L26, M13)

10.1257/aer.20181851.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个动态贡献博弈，其中投资者寻求作为贡献交换的私人收益，而一个单一的、以公共利益为重的捐赠者则关注项目的成功。我们发现，捐赠者的贡献起到了昂贵信号的作用，能够鼓励面临协调问题的投资者做出具有社会价值的贡献。投资者和捐赠者偏好不同的均衡状态，但所有人都能从捐赠者能够动态传递其价值观的能力中受益。我们探讨了该模型可以应用的多种情境，并实证分析了Kickstarter案例。我们校准了模型，并量化了动态信号传递在反事实情境下的协调效益。（JEL C73, D26, D82, G32, L26, M13）

abstract.text: We combine quasi-experimental variation in spousal death and age eligibility for survivors benefits using US tax records to study the effects on American households’ labor supply and the design of social security’s survivors insurance. Benefit eligibility at the exact age of 60 induces sharp reductions in the labor supply of newly widowed households, highlighting the value of survivors benefits and the liquidity they provide following the shock. Among eligible widows, the spousal death event induces no increases in labor supply, suggesting little residual need to self-insure. Using theory, we underscore the program’s protective insurance role and its high valuation among survivors. (JEL D12, D91, G22, G51, H55, J16, J22)

10.1257/aer.20190813.abstractZh: 我们通过使用美国税务记录，结合配偶死亡和年龄资格对幸存者福利的影响，来研究这对美国家庭劳动力供给以及社会保障制度中幸存者保险设计的影响。在60岁这个确切的年龄获得福利资格时，新丧偶家庭的劳动力供给会显著减少，这凸显了幸存者福利的价值及其在冲击后的流动性作用。在符合条件的寡妇中，配偶死亡事件并未导致劳动力供给的增加，表明她们几乎没有自我保险的需求。根据理论分析，我们强调了该计划作为保险制度的保护作用，以及幸存者对其的高度重视程度。（JEL D12, D91, G22, G51, H55, J16, J22）

abstract.text: Across five experiments (N = 1,714), we test whether people engage in wishful thinking to alleviate anxiety about adverse future outcomes. Participants perform pattern recognition tasks in which some patterns may result in an electric shock or a monetary loss. Diagnostic of wishful thinking, participants are less likely to correctly identify patterns that are associated with a shock or loss. Wishful thinking is more pronounced under more ambiguous signals and only reduced by higher accuracy incentives when participants’ cognitive effort reduces ambiguity. Wishful thinking disappears in the domain of monetary gains, indicating that negative emotions are important drivers of the phenomenon. (JEL C91, D12, D83, D91)

10.1257/aer.20191068.abstractZh: 在五项实验中（N=1,714），我们研究了人们是否会通过幻想思维来缓解对未来不利结果的焦虑。参与者需要完成模式识别任务，其中某些模式可能导致电击或金钱损失。在幻想思维的诊断测试中，参与者正确识别与电击或损失相关的模式的可能性较低。在信号更模糊的情况下，幻想思维更为明显；只有当参与者的认知努力减少信号的模糊性时，幻想思维才会有所减少。在金钱收益领域，幻想思维消失了，这表明负面情绪是这一现象的重要驱动因素。（JEL C91, D12, D83, D91）

abstract.text: We study how people change their behavior after being made aware of bias. Teachers in Italian schools give lower grades to immigrant students relative to natives of comparable ability. In two experiments, we reveal to teachers their own stereotypes, measured by an Implicit Association Test (IAT). In the first, we find that learning one’s IAT before assigning grades reduces the native-immigrant grade gap. In the second, IAT disclosure and generic debiasing have similar average effects, but there is heterogeneity: teachers with stronger negative stereotypes do not respond to generic debiasing but change their behavior when informed about their own IAT. (JEL D91, I24, J15, J45)

10.1257/aer.20191184.abstractZh: 我们研究了人们在意识到偏见后行为的变化。意大利学校的教师对能力相当的移民学生给予较低的评分。通过两项实验，我们向教师展示了他们自身的刻板印象，这些印象是通过隐性关联测试来测量的。在第一个实验中，我们发现在评分前了解自己的隐性关联测试可以减少本土与移民之间的评分差距。在第二个实验中，隐性关联测试的披露和一般性消除措施具有类似的平均效果，但存在异质性：具有较强负面刻板印象的教师不会对一般性消除措施作出反应，但在得知自己的隐性关联测试后，他们的行为会发生变化。（JEL D91, I24, J15, J45）

abstract.text: Myriad environments allow for the possibility of confusion. Agents may appeal to such confusion—or the possibility of making an honest mistake—to justify their behavior. In three sets of experiments involving thousands of subjects, we document evidence of such motivated errors. We document this evidence in a simple environment in which the scope for errors is small and in more complex environments in which subjects display correlation neglect and an anchoring bias. (JEL C91, D12, D64, D81, D83, D91)

10.1257/aer.20191849.abstractZh: 多种环境都可能导致混淆。代理人可能会利用这种混淆，或者利用可能犯下的错误来为自己的行为辩护。在涉及数千名受试者的三组实验中，我们发现了这种有动机的错误行为。我们在简单环境中发现了这种错误行为，而在更复杂的环境中，受试者则表现出相关性忽略和锚定偏差。（JEL C91, D12, D64, D81, D83, D91）

abstract.text: Low-income families often live in low-upward-mobility neighborhoods. We study why by using a randomized trial with housing voucher recipients that provided information, financial support, and customized search assistance to move to high-opportunity neighborhoods. The treatment increased the fraction moving to high-upward-mobility areas from 15 to 53 percent. A second trial reveals this treatment effect is driven primarily by customized search assistance. Qualitative interviews show that the intervention relaxed bandwidth constraints and addressed family-specific needs. Our findings imply many low-income families do not have strong preferences to stay in low-opportunity areas and that barriers in housing search significantly increase residential segregation by income. (JEL D83, G51, R21, R23, R31, R38)

10.1257/aer.20200407.abstractZh: 低收入家庭通常居住在向上流动机会较低的社区中。我们通过一项随机试验来研究这一现象，该试验为获得住房券的受助者提供了信息、经济支持以及个性化的寻找住房帮助，以帮助他们迁移到向上流动机会较高的社区。结果显示，迁移到向上流动机会较高的社区的比例从15%增加到了53%。第二项试验表明，这种治疗效果主要得益于个性化的寻找住房帮助。定性访谈显示，该干预措施缓解了家庭间的流动性限制，并满足了家庭特定的需求。我们的研究结果表明，许多低收入家庭并不愿意继续居住在向上流动机会较低的社区中，而住房搜索中的障碍显著增加了按收入划分的居住隔离现象。（JEL D83, G51, R21, R23, R31, R38）

abstract.text: This paper formalizes a classic idea that in second-best environments trade can induce welfare losses: incremental income losses from distortions can outweigh trade gains. In a Melitz model with distortionary taxes, we derive sufficient statistics for welfare gains/losses and show departures from the efficient case (Arkolakis, Costinot, and Rodríguez-Clare 2012) can be captured by the gap between an input and output share and domestic extensive margin elasticities. The loss reflects an endogenous selection of more subsidized firms into exporting. Using Chinese manufacturing data in 2005 and model-inferred firm-level distortions, we demonstrate that a sizable negative fiscal externality can potentially offset conventional gains. (JEL D22, F14, H25, L60, O19, P31, P33)

10.1257/aer.20200596.abstractZh: 本文将一个经典观点形式化：在次优环境下，贸易可能会导致福利损失，因为扭曲带来的收入损失可能超过贸易带来的收益。在包含扭曲性税收的Melitz模型中，我们推导出了福利收益/损失的充分条件，并表明与最优情况相比的偏差（Arkolakis、Costinot和Rodríguez-Clare，2012年）可以通过投入产出份额与国内广泛边际弹性的差距来体现。这种损失反映了更受补贴的企业被选择出口的情况。利用2005年中国制造业的数据以及模型推断出的企业层面的扭曲情况，我们证明，相当大的负面财政外部性可能会抵消传统的收益。（JEL D22, F14, H25, L60, O19, P31, P33）

abstract.text: In 2013, China launched a landmark program to monitor air quality and disclose real-time data, significantly increasing the public’s access to and awareness of pollution information. The program triggered cascading behavioral changes such as stronger avoidance of outdoor pollution exposure and increased spending on protective products. These behavioral responses mitigated the mortality impact of air pollution. Conservative estimates indicate that the program’s health benefits outweigh the costs by an order of magnitude. The findings highlight the benefits of improving public access to pollution information in developing countries which often experience severe air pollution but lack pollution data collection and dissemination. (JEL D83, D91, I12, O13, P28, Q51, Q53)

10.1257/aer.20200956.abstractZh: 2013年，中国启动了一项具有里程碑意义的空气质量监测计划，并公开实时数据，显著提高了公众获取和了解污染信息的机会。该计划引发了连锁行为变化，如更强烈地避免接触室外污染，以及增加对防护产品的支出。这些行为反应减轻了空气污染对死亡率的影响。保守估计表明，该计划带来的健康效益远远超过其成本。这些发现强调了在发展中国家改善公众获取污染信息的重要性，因为这些国家往往面临严重的空气污染问题，但缺乏污染数据的收集与传播。(JEL D83, D91, I12, O13, P28, Q51, Q53)

abstract.text: We experimentally document persistence of suboptimal behavior despite ample opportunities to learn from feedback in a canonical updating problem where people suffer from base-rate neglect. Our results provide insights on the mechanisms hindering learning from feedback. Importantly, our results suggest mistakes are more likely to be persistent when they are driven by incorrect mental models that miss or misrepresent important aspects of the environment. Such models induce confidence in initial answers, limiting engagement with and learning from feedback. We substantiate these insights in an alternative scenario where individuals involved in a voting problem overlook the importance of being pivotal. (JEL D83, D91)

10.1257/aer.20201004.abstractZh: 我们通过实验验证了尽管有充足的机会从反馈中学习，人们仍表现出次优行为的现象。这种现象发生在典型的更新问题中，人们存在基础率忽视的问题。我们的研究结果揭示了阻碍从反馈中学习的机制。重要的是，我们的结果表明，当错误的行为是由错误的心理模型所驱动时，这些错误更有可能持续存在。这样的心理模型会让人对初始答案产生信任，从而限制了对反馈的参与和学习。我们在另一个情景中进一步证实了这些发现，即参与投票问题的个体忽视了成为关键人物的重要性。（JEL D83, D91）

abstract.text: This paper offers a unified explanation for the slowdown of productivity growth, the decline in business dynamism, and the rise of market power. Using a quantitative framework, I show that the rise of intangible inputs, such as software, can explain these trends. Intangibles reduce marginal costs and raise fixed costs, which gives firms with high-intangible adoption a competitive advantage, in turn deterring other firms from entering. I structurally estimate the model on French and US micro data. After initially boosting productivity, the rise of intangibles causes a decline in productivity growth, consistent with the empirical trends observed since the mid-1990s. (JEL D22, D24, E23, L11, O31, O47)

10.1257/aer.20201079.abstractZh: 本文为生产力增长放缓、商业活力下降以及市场力量增强这一现象提供了统一的解释。通过定量分析框架，我指出，诸如软件之类的无形投入的增加可以解释这些趋势。无形投入降低了边际成本并提高了固定成本，这使得那些大量采用无形投入的企业获得竞争优势，从而阻止了其他企业的进入。我在法国和美国的小数据基础上对模型进行了结构性估计。在最初提升生产力之后，无形投入的增加导致了生产力增长的下降，这与自1990年代中期以来观察到的实证趋势一致。（JEL D22, D24, E23, L11, O31, O47）

abstract.text: We investigate the causal impact of public discourse on socially responsible market behavior. Across three laboratory experiments, having market participants engage in public discourse generally increases market social responsibility. These positive impacts are robust to variation in several characteristics of the discourse. We provide evidence that discourse strengthens beliefs that others support socially responsible exchange. However, relaxing requirements to engage in discourse sharply reduces its effectiveness. Our findings suggest that campaigns encouraging discussion of appropriate market behavior can have sizable impacts on addressing inefficiencies due to market failures but that policies encouraging broad public engagement may be important. (JEL C92, D62, D83, D91, P36, M14, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20201361.abstractZh: 我们研究了公共讨论对社会责任市场行为的因果影响。通过三项实验室实验发现，让市场参与者参与公共讨论通常会增加市场的社会责任意识。这些积极影响在讨论的多种特征发生变化时依然保持。我们的研究证明，讨论能够增强人们认为他人支持社会责任交换的信念。然而，放宽参与讨论的要求会显著降低其效果。我们的研究结果表明，鼓励讨论适当市场行为的活动可以对因市场失灵导致的效率低下产生显著影响，但鼓励广泛公众参与的政策可能同样重要。（JEL C92, D62, D83, D91, P36, M14, Z13）

abstract.text: We propose a theory of gradualism in the implementation of good policies, suitable for environments featuring time consistency. We downplay the role of the initial period by allowing agents both to wait for future agents to start equilibrium play and to restart the equilibrium by ignoring past history. The allocation gradually transits toward one that weighs both short- and long-term concerns, stopping short of the Ramsey outcome but greatly improving upon Markovian equilibria. We use the theory to account for the slow emergence of both climate policies and the reduction of global tariff rates. (JEL C73, E21, E61, F13, H30)

10.1257/aer.20201365.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种关于良好政策实施中的渐进主义理论，该理论适用于具有时间一致性的环境。我们通过允许代理人等待未来的代理人开始均衡博弈，并忽略过去的历史来淡化初始阶段的作用。资源配置逐渐转向同时考虑短期和长期因素的方式，虽然未能达到Ramsey均衡，但显著改善了马尔可夫均衡。我们利用这一理论来解释气候政策的缓慢实施以及全球关税率的降低现象。（JEL C73, E21, E61, F13, H30）

abstract.text: We propose a model of optimal decision-making subject to a memory constraint in the spirit of models of rational inattention. Our theory differs from that of Sims (2003) in not assuming costless memory of past cognitive states. The model implies that both forecasts and actions will exhibit idiosyncratic random variation; that average beliefs will exhibit a bias that fluctuates forever; and that more recent news will be given disproportionate weight in forecasts. The model provides a simple explanation for the overreaction to news observed in the laboratory by Afrouzi et al. (2023). (JEL D83, D84, D91, G12, G41)

10.1257/aer.20201806.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个最优决策模型，该模型受到理性忽视模型思想的启发，并受到记忆约束的制约。我们的理论与Sims（2003年）的理论不同，因为不假设对过去认知状态的记忆是免费的。该模型表明，预测和行动都会表现出特有的随机变化；平均信念会表现出一种永远波动的偏差；而且，较新的消息在预测中会被赋予不成比例的权重。该模型为Afrouzi等人（2023年）在实验室中观察到的对新闻的过度反应提供了一个简单的解释。（JEL D83, D84, D91, G12, G41）

abstract.text: We show how a heterogeneous agent New Keynesian (HANK) model with incomplete markets and portfolio choice can be estimated in state space using a Bayesian approach. To render estimation feasible, the structure of the economy can be exploited and the dimensionality of the model automatically reduced based on the Bayesian priors. We apply this approach to analyze how much inequality matters for the business cycle and vice versa. Even when the model is estimated on aggregate data alone and with a set of shocks and frictions designed to match aggregate data, it broadly reproduces observed US inequality dynamics. (JEL D31, D52, E12, E32, E52, E62)

10.1257/aer.20201875.abstractZh: 我们展示了如何使用贝叶斯方法，在状态空间中估计一个具有不完全市场结构和投资组合选择的异质新凯恩斯主义代理模型。为了使估计可行，可以利用经济结构的特点，并基于贝叶斯先验信息自动降低模型的维度。我们应用这种方法来分析不平等程度对商业周期的影响，以及反之亦然。即使模型仅基于总体数据估计，并且所设计的冲击和摩擦因素与总体数据相匹配，该模型仍然能够广泛再现美国观察到的不平等动态。（JEL D31, D52, E12, E32, E52, E62）

abstract.text: Do coordination failures constrain financial technology adoption? Exploiting the Mexican government’s rollout of 1 million debit cards to poor households from 2009 to 2012, I examine responses on both sides of the market and find important spillovers and distributional impacts. On the supply side, small retail firms adopted point-of-sale terminals to accept card payments. On the demand side, this led to a 21 percent increase in other consumers’ card adoption. The supply-side technology adoption response had positive effects on both richer consumers and small retail firms: richer consumers shifted 13 percent of their supermarket consumption to small retailers, whose sales and profits increased. (JEL E42, L25, L81, O14, O33)

10.1257/aer.20201952.abstractZh: 协调失败是否限制了金融技术的采用？通过研究墨西哥政府在2009年至2012年间向贫困家庭发放100万张借记卡的政策，我考察了市场双方的反应，并发现了重要的溢出效应和分配影响。在供应方面，小型零售企业采用了POS终端来接受卡支付。在需求方面，这导致其他消费者的卡使用率增加了21%。供应方面的技术采用对富裕消费者和小型零售企业都有积极影响：富裕消费者将其13%的超市消费转向了小型零售商，从而增加了这些零售商的销售额和利润。（JEL E42, L25, L81, O14, O33）

abstract.text: A prominent argument in the political correctness debate is that people feel pressure to publicly espouse sociopolitical views they do not privately hold, and that such misrepresentations might render public discourse less vibrant and informative. This paper formalizes the argument in terms of social image and evaluates it experimentally in the context of college campuses. The results show that (i) social image concerns drive a wedge between the sensitive sociopolitical attitudes that college students report in private and in public; (ii) public utterances are indeed less informative than private utterances; and (iii) information loss is exacerbated by (partial) audience naïveté. (JEL D72, D83, D91, I23, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20210039.abstractZh: 在政治正确性的辩论中，一个重要的论点是，人们感到有压力要公开表达他们私下并不持有的社会政治观点，而这样的虚假表述可能会使公共讨论变得不够生动和富有信息量。本文以社会形象为框架来形式化这一论点，并在大学校园的背景下对其进行实验性评估。研究结果表明：(i) 社会形象问题导致大学生在私下和公开场合所表达的社会政治态度之间存在分歧；(ii) 公开言论确实比私下言论缺乏信息量；(iii) 信息的缺失因（部分）受众的天真而加剧。(JEL D72, D83, D91, I23, Z13)

abstract.text: We run a field experiment offering graduated microcredit clients the opportunity to finance a business asset worth four times their usual borrowing limit. We implement this using a hire-purchase contract; our control group is offered a zero interest loan at the usual borrowing limit. We find large, significant, and persistent effects: treated microenterprise owners run larger businesses with higher profits; consequently, household consumption increases, particularly on food and children’s education. A dynamic structural model with nonconvex capital adjustment costs rationalizes our results and allows counterfactual analysis; this highlights the potential for welfare improvements through large capital injections that are financially sustainable. (JEL C93, D22, G21, G32, L25, O14, O16)

10.1257/aer.20210169.abstractZh: 我们开展了一项实地实验，为获得微额信贷的客户提供机会，使他们能够融资购买价值为其通常借款限额四倍的商业资产。我们采用分期付款合同的方式实施这一计划；而对照组则获得了按通常借款限额计算的零利息贷款。我们发现了一系列显著且持久的效果：接受微额信贷的客户经营的企业规模更大，利润也更高；因此，家庭消费增加，尤其是在食品和教育方面的支出。一个具有非凸资本调整成本的动态结构模型能够解释我们的研究结果，并允许进行反事实分析；这凸显了通过大规模、财务上可持续的资本注入来提升福利的潜力。（JEL C93, D22, G21, G32, L25, O14, O16）

abstract.text: We propose a simple explanation for the long-run decline in the US start-up rate. It originates from a slowdown in labor supply growth since the late 1970s, largely predetermined by demographics. This channel can explain roughly half of the decline and why incumbent firm survival and average growth over the life cycle have changed little. We show these results in a standard model of firm dynamics and test the mechanism using cross-state variation in labor supply growth. Finally, we show that a longer entry rate series imputed using historical establishment tabulations rises over the 1960s–1970s period of accelerating labor force growth. (JEL D22, D25, E24, J11, J22, J23, M11)

10.1257/aer.20210362.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种简单的解释，用于说明美国初创企业数量长期下降的现象。这一趋势源于自20世纪70年代末以来劳动力供应增长的放缓，这一趋势在很大程度上是由人口统计因素决定的。这一机制可以解释大约一半的下降现象，以及现有企业的生存状况及其生命周期内的平均增长为何变化不大。我们在标准的企业动态模型中展示了这些结果，并通过跨州劳动力供应增长的差异来检验这一机制。最后，我们发现，根据历史企业统计数据推算出的更长的企业进入率曲线，在20世纪60至70年代劳动力增长加速期间有所上升。（JEL D22, D25, E24, J11, J22, J23, M11）

abstract.text: We study robust welfare comparisons of learning biases (misspecified Bayesian and some forms of non-Bayesian updating). Given a true signal distribution, we deem one bias more harmful than another if it yields lower objective expected payoffs in all decision problems. We characterize this ranking in static and dynamic settings. While the static characterization compares posteriors signal by signal, the dynamic characterization employs an “efficiency index” measuring how fast beliefs converge. We quantify and compare the severity of several well-documented biases. We also highlight disagreements between the static and dynamic rankings, and that some “large” biases dynamically outperform other “vanishingly small” biases. (JEL D60, D82, D83, D91)

10.1257/aer.20210410.abstractZh: 我们研究了学习偏差的稳健福利比较（包括误设的贝叶斯模型以及某些非贝叶斯更新方法）。在给定真实信号分布的情况下，如果某种偏差在所有决策问题中都能带来更低的目标预期收益，那么我们认为这种偏差更为有害。我们在静态和动态环境中对这种排序进行了描述。静态描述比较了不同信号下的后验分布，而动态描述则采用“效率指数”来衡量信念收敛的速度。我们量化并比较了几种广为人知的偏差的严重程度。我们还指出了静态和动态排序之间的差异，以及某些“较大”的偏差在动态情况下可能优于其他“微不足道”的偏差。（JEL D60, D82, D83, D91）

abstract.text: This study evaluates the impact of depression treatment on economic behavior in Karnataka, India. We cross-randomize pharmacotherapy and livelihoods assistance among 1,000 depressed adults and evaluate impacts on depression severity, socioeconomic outcomes, and several potential pathways. When combined, the interventions reduce depression severity, with benefits that persist after treatment concludes. Pharmacotherapy alone has a weaker effect that is only marginally significant and dissipates sooner. Depression treatment does not significantly increase earnings, consumption, or human capital investment in children. (JEL I12, I15, I18, J13, J22, J31, O15)

10.1257/aer.20210687.abstractZh: 本研究评估了抑郁症治疗对印度卡纳塔克邦经济行为的影响。我们在1000名抑郁症患者中随机分配患者接受药物治疗和生计援助，并评估这两种干预措施对抑郁症严重程度、社会经济结果以及多种潜在路径的影响。综合来看，这两种干预措施都能降低抑郁症的严重程度，且这些益处在治疗结束后仍然持续。单独使用药物治疗的效果较弱，仅具有轻微显著性，并且效果消失得更快。抑郁症治疗并未显著增加收入、消费或儿童的人力资本投资。（JEL I12, I15, I18, J13, J22, J31, O15）

abstract.text: Experiments suggest that people fail to take into account interdependencies between their choices—they do not broadly bracket. Researchers often instead assume people narrowly bracket, but existing designs do not test it. We design a novel experiment and revealed preference tests for how someone brackets their choices. In portfolio allocation under risk, social allocation, and induced-value shopping experiments, 40–43 percent of subjects are consistent with narrow bracketing, and 0–16 percent with broad bracketing. Adjusting for each model’s predictive precision, 74 percent of subjects are best described by narrow bracketing, 13 percent by broad bracketing, and 6 percent by intermediate cases. (JEL D12, D81, D91)

10.1257/aer.20210877.abstractZh: 实验表明，人们未能充分考虑其选择之间的相互依赖性——他们没有进行广泛的分类。研究人员通常假设人们只是进行狭义的分类，但现有的研究设计并未对此进行验证。我们设计了一项新颖的实验，并通过偏好测试来研究人们如何对选择进行分类。在风险下的投资组合分配、社会分配以及诱导价值购物实验中，40-43%的受试者采用狭义分类，而0-16%的受试者采用广义分类。调整每种模型的预测精度后，74%的受试者被描述为采用狭义分类，13%的受试者采用广义分类，6%的受试者属于中间情况。（JEL D12, D81, D91）

abstract.text: We create a general and tractable theory of increasing sorting in pairwise matching models with monetary transfers. The positive quadrant dependence partial order subsumes Becker (1973) as the extreme cases with most and least sorting and implies increasing regression coefficients. Our theory turns on synergy—the cross-partial difference or derivative of match production. This reflects basic economic forces: diminishing returns, technological convexity, insurance, and learning dynamics. We prove sorting increases if match synergy globally increases, and is cross-sectionally monotone or single crossing. We use our results to derive sorting predictions in major economics sorting papers and in new applications. (JEL C78, D21, D82, D86, J12)

10.1257/aer.20210890.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个通用且易于处理的理论，用于解释在包含货币转移的成对匹配模型中日益加剧的排序现象。正象限依赖性部分顺序理论将Becker（1973）的理论作为极端情况，即出现最多和最少排序的情况，并表明回归系数会随之增加。我们的理论依赖于协同效应——即匹配产生的交叉部分差异或导数。这反映了基本的经济力量：收益递减、技术凸性、保险机制以及学习动态。我们证明，如果匹配协同效应在全球范围内增加，排序现象会加剧，并且在横截面上呈单调或单一交叉趋势。我们利用这些结果，为主要的经济学排序研究提供了新的预测依据，并应用于新的领域。（JEL C78, D21, D82, D86, J12）

abstract.text: Once established, government spending programs tend to continue. A commonly held view is that spending inertia leads to unsustainable debt, ultimately requiring fiscal adjustments such as “sequestration.” We show that by insuring against political turnover, inertia may reduce politicians’ incentives to accumulate debt. However, large preexisting commitments and the prospect of future stabilization can lead to overspending to dilute past administrations’ commitments. Finally, we show that political polarization amplifies incentives to prioritize inertial programs, potentially explaining the increased share of mandatory spending in the US budget. (JEL D72, E62, H61, H63)

10.1257/aer.20210935.abstractZh: 一旦政府支出计划确立，它们往往会持续下去。一种普遍的观点认为，支出的惯性会导致不可持续的债务，最终需要采取诸如“削减支出”之类的财政调整措施。我们指出，通过为政治更替提供保险，惯性可能会减少政客积累债务的动机。然而，预先存在的巨额承诺以及未来稳定的前景可能导致过度支出，从而稀释过去政府的承诺。最后，我们表明，政治两极分化会加剧对惯性项目的优先处理动机，这可能解释了美国预算中强制性支出比例的增加。（JEL D72, E62, H61, H63）

abstract.text: Small firms struggle to grow beyond a few employees. We introduce monitoring devices into commuter minibuses in Kenya and randomize which minibus owners have access to the data using a novel mobile app. We find that treated vehicle owners modify the terms of the contract to induce higher effort and lower risk taking from their drivers. This reduces firm costs and increases firm profitability. There is suggestive evidence that some firms expand. These results suggest that small firms may be able to utilize monitoring technologies to overcome problems of moral hazard and enhance their profitability. (JEL D22, D24, D82, J41, L25, L92, O14)

10.1257/aer.20210987.abstractZh: 小型企业难以在员工数量超过几人后继续扩张。我们在肯尼亚的通勤迷你巴士中引入了监控设备，并通过一款创新的移动应用程序随机分配哪些巴士所有者可以访问这些数据。研究发现，接受监控的车辆所有者会修改合同条款，以促使司机付出更多努力并降低风险承担，从而降低企业成本并提高盈利能力。有迹象表明，一些企业确实实现了扩张。这些结果表明，小型企业可以利用监控技术来克服道德风险问题，并提高其盈利能力。（JEL D22, D24, D82, J41, L25, L92, O14）

abstract.text: To investigate general patterns in news information in the United States, we combine a protocol for identifying major political news stories, 11 monthly surveys with 15,000 participants, and a model of news discernment. When confronted with a true and a fake news story, 47 percent of subjects confidently choose the true story, 3 percent confidently choose the fake story, and the remaining half are uncertain. Socioeconomic differences are associated with large variations in the probability of selecting the true news story. Partisan congruence between an individual and a news story matters, but its impact is up to an order of magnitude smaller. (JEL D72, D83, L82)

10.1257/aer.20211003.abstractZh: 为了研究美国新闻信息的一般模式，我们结合了识别重大政治新闻故事的协议、包含15,000名参与者的11次月度调查，以及新闻辨别模型。当面对真实新闻和虚假新闻时，47%的受试者能够自信地选择真实新闻，3%的受试者选择虚假新闻，其余一半受试者则不确定。社会经济差异与选择真实新闻的概率存在较大差异。个人对新闻事件的党派立场与新闻内容的一致性很重要，但其影响要小一个数量级。（JEL D72, D83, L82）

abstract.text: This paper concerns Saez and Stantcheva’s (2016) generalized social marginal welfare weights, which aggregate losses and gains due to tax policies while incorporating nonutilitarian ethical considerations. The approach evaluates local tax changes without a global social objective. I show that local tax policy comparisons implicitly entail global comparisons. Moreover, whenever welfare weights do not have a utilitarian structure, these implied global comparisons are inconsistent. I argue that broader ethical values cannot in general be represented simply by modifying the weights placed on benefits to different people, and a more thoroughgoing modification of the utilitarian approach is required. (JEL D60, D63, D71, H21, H23, I31)

10.1257/aer.20211025.abstractZh: 本文探讨了Saez和Stantcheva在2016年提出的广义社会边际福利权重方法，该方法整合了因税收政策导致的损失和收益，同时考虑了非功利主义的伦理考量。该方法在不设定全球社会目标的情况下评估局部税收变化。研究表明，局部税收政策的比较实际上隐含了全球层面的比较。此外，当福利权重不具备功利主义结构时，这种隐含的全球比较是不一致的。笔者认为，更广泛的伦理价值观通常无法通过简单地调整不同人群所获得的利益权重来体现，因此需要对功利主义方法进行更为彻底的修改。（JEL D60, D63, D71, H21, H23, I31）

abstract.text: We identify exposure to political risk by exploiting a unique variation around land lease extension protection after 2047 in Hong Kong’s housing market due to historical arrangements. Relative to properties that have been promised an extension protection, those with unprotected leases granted by the current government are sold at a discount of 8 percent; those with colonial leases suffer an additional discount of 8 percent. Incorporating estimated structural parameters that suggest an additional 20 percent ground rent after 2047, our model matches empirical discounts well across lease horizons. Discounts increase over time, particularly in areas with greater pessimism about the city’s future. (JEL D72, G12, R31, R38)

10.1257/aer.20211242.abstractZh: 我们通过利用香港住房市场在2047年之后土地租赁延长保护方面的独特变化来识别政治风险暴露情况。与那些被承诺享有延长保护的土地相比，当前政府未提供保护的租赁土地会以8%的折扣出售；而拥有殖民时期租赁土地的土地则面临额外的8%折扣。考虑到估计的结构性参数表明2047年之后土地租金将增加20%，我们的模型能够很好地匹配各租赁期限内的实际折扣情况。随着时间的推移，折扣幅度逐渐增大，尤其是在对未来城市前景持悲观态度地区。（JEL D72, G12, R31, R38）

abstract.text: We study a business cycle model of the international monetary system featuring a time-varying demand for safe dollar bonds, greater risk-bearing capacity in the United States than the rest of the world, and nominal rigidities. A flight to safety generates a dollar appreciation and decline in global output. Dollar bonds thus command a negative risk premium, and the United States holds a levered portfolio of capital financed in dollars. We quantify the effects of safety shocks and heterogeneity in risk-bearing capacity for global macroeconomic volatility, US external adjustment, and policy transmission, as of dollar swap lines. (JEL E32, E43, E44, E52, F44, G11, G15)

10.1257/aer.20211319.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个国际货币体系的商业周期模型，该模型具有随时间变化的对安全美元债券的需求、美国比世界其他地区具有更强的风险承担能力，以及名义刚性。避险行为导致美元升值，全球产出下降。因此，美元债券需要负的风险溢价，而美国持有的资本组合以美元融资。我们量化了安全冲击和风险承担能力的异质性对全球宏观经济波动性、美国外部调整以及政策传导的影响，这些影响与美元互换关系相关。（JEL E32, E43, E44, E52, F44, G11, G15）

abstract.text: Numerous recently uncovered cartels operated along the supply chain, with firms at one end facilitating collusion at the other—hub-and-spoke arrangements. These cartels are hard to rationalize because they induce double marginalization and higher costs. We examine Canada’s alleged bread cartel and provide the first comprehensive analysis of hub-and-spoke collusion. Using court documents and pricing data, we make three contributions: (i) we show that collusion was effective, increasing inflation by about 50 percent; (ii) we provide evidence that collusion existed at both ends of the supply chain; and (iii) we develop a model explaining why this form of collusion arose. (JEL E31, K21, L12, L14, L22, L42, L81)

10.1257/aer.20211337.abstractZh: 近期发现的多个卡特尔在供应链中运作，其中一方企业协助另一方进行勾结，形成了枢纽与辐条式的合作模式。这些卡特尔难以被合理解释，因为它们会导致双重边缘化现象并增加成本。我们研究了加拿大所谓的面包卡特尔，并首次对枢纽与辐条式勾结进行了全面分析。通过法庭文件和价格数据，我们提出了三项贡献：(i) 我们证明这种勾结是有效的，使通货膨胀率上升了约50%；(ii) 我们提供了证据，证明勾结存在于供应链的两端；(iii) 我们开发了一个模型，解释了为何会出现这种勾结形式。(JEL E31, K21, L12, L14, L22, L42, L81)

abstract.text: We study unanticipated tariffs in a setting with firm-to-firm supply relationships. Firms conduct costly searches and negotiate with potential suppliers that pass a reservation level of match productivity. Global supply chains form in anticipation of free trade. Then, the home government surprises with an input tariff. This can lead to renegotiation with initial suppliers or search for replacements. Calibrating the model’s parameters to match initial import shares and the estimated responses to the US tariffs imposed on China, we find an overall welfare loss of 0.12 percent of GDP, with substantial contributions from changes in input sourcing and search costs. (JEL D72, F13, F14, L14, O19, P33)

10.1257/aer.20211519.abstractZh: 我们研究了在企业间供应关系背景下出现的意外关税问题。企业会进行昂贵的搜索活动，并与潜在供应商进行谈判，这些谈判会形成一个匹配生产率的保留水平。全球供应链的形成是基于对自由贸易的预期。然而，当本国政府突然实施输入关税时，这可能导致与初始供应商重新谈判或寻找替代供应商。通过校准模型参数，以匹配初始进口份额以及美国对中国实施关税后的预期反应，我们发现整体福利损失为GDP的0.12%，其中输入来源和搜索成本的变化起到了重要作用。（JEL D72, F13, F14, L14, O19, P33）

abstract.text: This paper identifies how bank branching benefited local economies during the Great Depression. Using archival data and narrative evidence, I show how Bank of America’s branch network in 1930s California created an internal capital market that diversified away local liquidity shortfalls, allowing the bank to maintain 49 percent higher credit growth from 1929 to 1933 than competing banks. The bank’s presence mitigated cites’ property value contractions and strengthened their recovery through 1940. Linked individual data show that the bank’s proximity to workers hastened the transition from agricultural employment to human-capital–intensive sectors in the 1930s, generating structural change and higher wages. (JEL E32, G01, G21, N12, N22, N92, R23)

10.1257/aer.20211523.abstractZh: 本文探讨了银行分支机构在大萧条时期如何助力当地经济。通过档案数据和历史记载，我展示了1930年代美国银行在加利福尼亚州的分支机构网络如何创建了一个内部资本市场，从而分散了当地流动性不足的问题，使得该银行在1929年至1933年间实现了比竞争对手高出49%的信贷增长。该银行的存在缓解了各城市的房产价值下降，并促进了这些城市在1940年之前的经济复苏。相关的个人数据表明，该银行靠近工人聚居区，加速了1930年代从农业就业向人力资本密集型产业的转型，从而带来了结构性变化和更高的工资水平。（JEL E32, G01, G21, N12, N22, N92, R23）

abstract.text: We study the effects of competition by state-owned firms, leveraging the decentralized entry of public pharmacies to local markets in Chile. Public pharmacies sell the same drugs at a third of private pharmacy prices, because of stronger upstream bargaining and market power in the private sector, but are of lower quality. Public pharmacies induced market segmentation and price increases in the private sector, which benefited the switchers to the public option but harmed the stayers. The countrywide entry of public pharmacies would reduce yearly consumer drug expenditure by 1.6 percent. (JEL D22, I18, L32, L65, O14)

10.1257/aer.20211547.abstractZh: 我们研究了国有企业的竞争效应，通过利用公共药店在智利本地市场的分散式进入来进行分析。由于私营部门在上游谈判和市场力量方面具有更强的优势，公共药店以三分之一的私营药店价格销售相同的药品，但质量较低。公共药店导致了市场的分割和价格的上涨，这有利于转向公共选择方案的用户，但损害了那些继续使用私营药店的用户。全国范围内公共药店的进入将使年度消费者药品支出减少1.6%。（JEL D22, I18, L32, L65, O14）

abstract.text: Using Canadian administrative data, this paper presents evidence of revenue and productivity spillovers across firms at fine spatial scales. Accounting for the endogenous sorting of firms across space, we estimate an average elasticity of firm revenue and productivity with respect to the average quality of other firms within 75 meters of 0.024. We find scant evidence that the average firm benefits from being surrounded by a greater amount of economic activity at this spatial scale. Sorting of higher-quality firms into more productive locations and higher average and aggregate quality peer groups is salient in the data. (JEL D22, D24, G32, L25, R11, R32)

10.1257/aer.20211589.abstractZh: 本文利用加拿大行政数据，展示了企业在精细空间尺度上的收入和生产力溢出效应。在考虑企业空间上的内生排序因素后，我们估计了企业收入和生产力相对于75米范围内其他企业平均质量的弹性，该弹性为0.024。我们发现，几乎没有证据表明平均企业能从这种空间尺度上更丰富的经济活动中获得好处。数据表明，高质量企业更倾向于被分配到更具生产力的区域，以及平均质量和整体质量更高的同类群体中。（JEL D22, D24, G32, L25, R11, R32）

abstract.text: We examine whether adverse selection has unraveled private markets for equity and state-contingent debt contracts for financing higher education. Using survey data on beliefs, we show a typical college-goer would have to repay $1.64 in present value for every $1 of financing to overcome adverse selection in an equity market. We find that risk-averse college-goers are not willing to accept these terms, so markets unravel. We discuss why moral hazard, biased beliefs, and outside credit options are less likely to explain the absence of these markets. We quantify the welfare gains for subsidizing equity-like contracts that mitigate college-going risks. (JEL D82, D83, G51, I22, I23, I26, J24)

10.1257/aer.20211653.abstractZh: 我们研究逆向选择是否导致私人市场无法为高等教育融资提供股权和基于状态的债务合同。通过调查关于人们信念的数据，我们发现典型的大学学生为了克服股权市场的逆向选择，需要偿还相当于1美元融资额1.64美元现值的资金。我们发现，风险厌恶的大学学生不愿意接受这些条款，因此这些市场无法形成。我们探讨了为什么道德风险、偏见信念以及外部信贷选项不太可能解释这些市场的缺失。我们量化了补贴类似股权合同的福利收益，这些合同能够降低上大学的风险。（JEL D82, D83, G51, I22, I23, I26, J24）

abstract.text: We present a proof-of-concept for minimalist market design (Sönmez 2023) as an effective methodology to enhance an institution based on stakeholders’ desiderata with minimal interference. Four objectives— respecting merit, increasing retention, aligning talent, and enhancing trust—guided reforms to the US Army’s centralized branching process of cadets to military specialties since 2006. USMA’s mechanism for the class of 2020 exacerbated challenges in implementing these objectives. Formulating the Army’s desiderata as rigorous axioms, we analyze their implications. Under our minimalist approach to institution redesign, the Army’s objectives uniquely identify a branching mechanism. Our design is now adopted at USMA and ROTC. (JEL D47, H56, J45)

10.1257/aer.20211743.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种基于最小主义市场设计的概念验证（Sönmez 2023），作为一种有效的方法，通过最小的干预来根据利益相关者的需求改进机构。四个目标——尊重功绩、提高保留率、协调人才以及增强信任——指导了对美国陆军自2006年以来对士官按军事专业进行集中分配过程的改革。2020届陆军士官生机制的实施加剧了实现这些目标的挑战。我们将陆军的诉求表述为严格的公理，并分析了其含义。在我们对机构重新设计的最小主义方法中，陆军的目标独特地确定了一种分配机制。我们的设计现已在美国陆军士官学校和后备军官训练队中得到应用。（JEL D47, H56, J45）

abstract.text: We study how social organization shapes patterns of economic interaction and the effects of national policy, focusing on the distinction between age-based and kin-based groups in sub-Saharan Africa. Motivated by ethnographic accounts suggesting that this distinction affects redistribution, we analyze a cash transfer program in Kenya and find that in age-based societies there are consumption spillovers within the age cohort, but not the extended family, while in kin-based societies we find the opposite. Next, we document that social structure shapes the impact of policy by showing that Uganda’s pension program had positive effects on child nutrition only in kin-based societies. (JEL H23, I12, I38, J13, O15, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20211856.abstractZh: 我们研究了社会组织如何塑造经济互动模式以及国家政策的影响，重点关注撒哈拉以南非洲地区基于年龄和基于亲属关系的群体之间的区别。基于民族志研究指出这种区别会影响再分配的观点，我们分析了肯尼亚的一项现金转移计划，发现基于年龄的社会中，年龄群体内部存在消费溢出效应，而扩展家庭内部则没有；而在基于亲属关系的社会中，情况则相反。此外，我们还发现社会结构会影响政策的效果，例如乌干达的养老金计划在基于亲属关系的社会中仅对儿童营养产生了积极影响。（JEL H23, I12, I38, J13, O15, Z13）

abstract.text: While many real-world principal-agent problems have both moral hazard and adverse selection, existing tools largely analyze only one at a time. Do the insights from the separate analyses survive when the frictions are combined? We develop a simple method—decoupling—to study both problems at once. When decoupling works, everything we know from the separate analyses carries over, but interesting interactions also arise. We provide simple tests for whether decoupling is valid. We develop and numerically implement an algorithm to calculate the decoupled solution and check its validity. We also provide primitives for decoupling to work and analyze several extensions. (JEL D82, D86)

10.1257/aer.20220100.abstractZh: 虽然许多现实世界中的委托-代理问题都存在道德风险与逆向选择的问题，现有的工具通常只针对其中一个问题进行分析。当这两种问题相互结合时，从单独分析得出的见解是否仍然适用？我们提出了一种简单的方法——解耦法，用于同时研究这两个问题。当解耦法有效时，我们从单独分析中获得的所有信息仍然适用，但也会产生有趣的相互作用。我们提供了简单的测试来验证解耦法的有效性。我们还开发并数值实现了一种算法来计算解耦后的解决方案，并验证其有效性。此外，我们还为解耦法的有效实施提供了基础，并分析了几种扩展情况。（JEL D82, D86）

abstract.text: How do radical reforms shape economic development over time? In 1790, the French Constituent Assembly overhauled the kingdom’s organization to establish new local capitals. In some departments, the choice of local capitals over rival candidate cities was plausibly exogenous. We study how changes in administrative presence affect state capacity and development in the ensuing decades. In the short run, administrative proximity increases taxation and investments in law enforcement. In the long run, capitals obtain more public goods and grow faster. Our results shed light on the dynamic impacts of state building following one of history’s most ambitious administrative reforms. (JEL D70, H41, H71, O18, O43)

10.1257/aer.20220110.abstractZh: 激进的改革如何随时间塑造经济发展？1790年，法国制宪会议对王国的组织结构进行了彻底改革，建立了新的地方首府。在一些省份，选择某个地方首府而非其他竞争城市的行为似乎是外生因素所致。我们研究了行政存在的变化如何影响随后几十年的国家能力和发展。短期内，行政上的邻近性会增加税收和执法投入。长期来看，地方首府能够获得更多的公共物品，并实现更快的发展。我们的研究结果揭示了历史上最具雄心的行政改革之后，国家建设所受到的动态影响。（JEL D70, H41, H71, O18, O43）

abstract.text: We estimate an equilibrium sorting model of housing location and commuting mode choice with endogenous traffic congestion to evaluate urban transportation policies. Leveraging fine-scale data from travel diaries and housing transactions identifying residents' home and work locations, we recover rich preference heterogeneity over both travel mode and residential location decisions. While different policies produce the same congestion reduction, their impacts on social welfare differ drastically. In addition, sorting undermines the congestion reduction under driving restrictions and subway expansion but strengthens it under congestion pricing. The combination of congestion pricing and subway expansion delivers the greatest congestion relief and efficiency gains. (JEL H76, O18, P25, R23, R31, R41, R48)

10.1257/aer.20220212.abstractZh: 我们建立了一个均衡排序模型，用于分析住房位置选择和通勤模式选择，并考虑交通拥堵的内生性，以评估城市交通政策的效果。通过利用旅行日记和住房交易数据来识别居民的家庭和工作地点，我们发现了关于出行模式和居住位置选择的丰富偏好异质性。虽然不同的政策能够产生相同的拥堵缓解效果，但它们对社会福利的影响却大相径庭。此外，在驾驶限制和地铁扩建的情况下，排序机制会削弱拥堵缓解效果，而在拥堵收费的情况下则能增强这一效果。拥堵收费与地铁扩建的结合能够实现最大的拥堵缓解和效率提升。（JEL H76, O18, P25, R23, R31, R41, R48）

abstract.text: We develop a task-based model of occupational sorting to identify and quantify the effect of discrimination, racial skill gaps, and aggregate task prices on Black-White differences in labor market outcomes over time. At the heart of our framework is the idea that the size and nature of racial barriers faced by Black workers vary by the task requirements of each job. We define a new task that measures the extent to which individuals interact with others as part of their job. We show that this measure is a good proxy for the extent of discrimination in the economy. (JEL J15, J23, J31, J71, M51)

10.1257/aer.20220234.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个基于任务的职业分类模型，以识别和量化歧视、种族技能差距以及总体任务价格对黑人与白人在劳动力市场结果随时间变化的影响。我们框架的核心思想是，黑人工人面临的种族障碍的规模和性质取决于每项工作的任务要求。我们定义了一个新的任务指标，用于衡量个人在工作中与他人互动的程度。我们表明，这一指标是反映经济中歧视程度的一个良好指标。（JEL J15, J23, J31, J71, M51）

abstract.text: We quantify the effects of the political development cycle—the fluctuations between the Left (Maoist) and the Right (pragmatist) development policies—on growth and structural transformation of China in 1953–1978. The left policies prioritized structural transformation toward nonagricultural production and consumption at the expense of agricultural development. The right policies prioritized agricultural consumption through slower structural transformation. The imperfect implementation of these policies led to large welfare costs of the political development cycle in a distorted economy undergoing a structural change. (JEL D72, N15, N45, N55, O21, P21, P24)

10.1257/aer.20220249.abstractZh: 我们量化了政治发展周期——左派（毛主义者）与右派（实用主义者）发展政策之间的波动——对中国1953年至1978年间的经济增长和结构转型的影响。左派政策优先考虑向非农业生产和消费的结构转型，而牺牲了农业发展。右派政策则通过较慢的结构转型来优先发展农业消费。这些政策的不完善实施，导致在政治发展周期中，在一个经历结构变化的扭曲经济体系中，产生了巨大的福利成本。（JEL D72, N15, N45, N55, O21, P21, P24）

abstract.text: Poor entrepreneurs must frequently choose between business investment and children's education. To examine this trade-off, we exploit experimental variation in short-run microenterprise growth among a sample of Indian households and track children's education and business outcomes over eleven years. Treated households, who experience higher initial microenterprise growth, invest more in education and are one-third more likely to send children to college. However, only literate households experience child schooling gains and their enterprises stagnate in the long-run. In contrast, illiterate treatment households experience long-run business gains but declines in children's education. Our findings suggest that microenterprise growth has the potential to reduce relative intergenerational educational mobility.

10.1257/aer.20220296.abstractZh: 贫困的企业家常常需要在商业投资与子女教育之间做出选择。为了研究这一权衡，我们利用实验方法观察了印度家庭在短期内的微型企业发展情况，并追踪了子女教育状况及企业成果长达十一年。那些在初期微型企业发展较为顺利的家庭，会投入更多资金用于教育，并且将子女送入大学的可能性高出三分之一。然而，只有识字的家庭能够享受到子女教育的收益，而他们的企业则会在长期内停滞不前。相反，不识字的对照家庭虽然会在长期内获得商业上的收益，但子女教育状况却会恶化。我们的研究结果表明，微型企业的发展有潜力降低代际间教育机会的流动性。

abstract.text: We present a tractable dynamic general equilibrium model of self-fulfilling bank runs, where banks trade capital in competitive and liquid markets but remain vulnerable to runs due to a loss of creditor confidence. We characterize how the vulnerability of an individual bank depends on its leverage position and the economy-wide asset prices. We study the effect of credit easing policies, in the form of asset purchases. When a banking crisis is generated by runs, credit easing can reduce the number of defaulting banks and enhance welfare. When the crisis is driven by fundamentals, credit easing may have adverse consequences. (JEL E32, E44, E58, G01, G21, G28, G33)

10.1257/aer.20220328.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个可行的动态一般均衡模型，用于分析自我实现的银行挤兑现象。在该模型中，银行在竞争性和流动性强的市场中进行资本交易，但由于债权人信心的丧失，银行仍然容易遭受挤兑。我们研究了单个银行的脆弱性如何取决于其杠杆水平以及整个经济中的资产价格。我们研究了以资产购买形式出现的信贷宽松政策的影响。当银行危机由挤兑引发时，信贷宽松可以减少违约银行的数量并提高福利。而当危机由基本因素驱动时，信贷宽松可能会产生负面后果。（JEL E32, E44, E58, G01, G21, G28, G33）

abstract.text: Little is known about what drives gender disparities in health care and related social insurance benefits. Using data and variation from the Texas workers’ compensation program, we study the impact of gender match between doctors and patients on medical evaluations and associated disability benefits. Compared to differences among their male patient counterparts, female patients randomly assigned a female doctor rather than a male doctor are 5.2 percent more likely to be evaluated as disabled and receive 8.6 percent more subsequent cash benefits on average. There is no analogous gender-match effect for male patients. Our estimates indicate that increasing the share of female patients evaluated by female doctors may substantially shrink gender gaps in medical evaluations and associated outcomes. (JEL H75, I11, I12, J14, J16, J28)

10.1257/aer.20220349.abstractZh: 关于是什么导致了医疗保健及相关社会保障福利中的性别差异，目前了解甚少。我们利用德克萨斯州工伤赔偿计划的数据和差异，研究了医生与患者性别匹配对医疗评估及相关残疾福利的影响。与男性患者相比，被随机分配给女性医生而非男性医生的女性患者，被评估为残疾的可能性高出5.2%，随后获得的现金福利也平均高出8.6%。对于男性患者而言，并不存在类似的性别匹配效应。我们的估计表明，增加由女性医生进行评估的女性患者比例，可能会显著缩小医疗评估及相关结果中的性别差距。（JEL H75, I11, I12, J14, J16, J28）

abstract.text: We study how decades-long exposure to individuals of a given foreign descent shapes natives’ attitudes and behavior toward that group. Using individualized donations data, we show that long-term exposure to a given foreign ancestry leads to more generous behavior specifically toward that group’s ancestral country. Focusing on exposure to Arab Muslims to examine mechanisms, we show that long-term exposure (i) decreases explicit and implicit prejudice against Arab Muslims, (ii) reduces support for policies and political candidates hostile toward Arab Muslims, (iii) increases charitable donations to Arab countries, (iv) leads to more personal contact with Arab Muslims, and (v) increases knowledge of Arab Muslims and Islam. (JEL D64, D83, D91, J15)

10.1257/aer.20220376.abstractZh: 我们研究了长期接触特定外国血统的人群如何塑造当地人对该群体的态度和行为。通过个体捐赠数据，我们发现长期接触特定外国血统会导致对该群体祖先国家的更慷慨行为。针对阿拉伯穆斯林的暴露情况，我们研究发现，长期接触（i）减少了针对阿拉伯穆斯林的显性和隐性偏见；（ii）减少了支持针对阿拉伯穆斯林的敌对政策和政治候选人的倾向；（iii）增加了对阿拉伯国家的慈善捐赠；（iv）增加了与阿拉伯穆斯林的私人接触；（v）增加了对阿拉伯穆斯林和伊斯兰教的了解。（JEL D64, D83, D91, J15）

abstract.text: Why have white, less-educated voters left the Democratic Party? We highlight the role of the 1994 North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA). In event-study analysis, we demonstrate that counties whose 1990 employment depended on industries vulnerable to NAFTA suffered large and persistent employment losses after its implementation. Voters in these counties (and protectionist voters regardless of geography) turned away from the party of President Clinton, who promoted the agreement. This shift is larger for whites (especially men and those without a college degree) and social conservatives, suggesting that racial identity and social-issue positions mediate reactions to economic policies. (JEL D72, F15, F16, J15)

10.1257/aer.20220425.abstractZh: 为什么白人、受教育程度较低的选民离开了民主党？我们重点关注1994年北美自由贸易协定（NAFTA）的作用。通过事件研究分析，我们发现那些在1990年就业依赖于易受NAFTA影响的行业的县，在协定实施后遭受了大规模且持续的就业损失。这些县的选民（以及无论地理位置如何的保守派选民）都离开了支持该协定的克林顿总统所在的政党。这种转变在白人（尤其是男性和无大学学位的人）以及社会保守派中更为明显，这表明种族身份和社会议题立场在对经济政策的反应中起到了中介作用。（JEL D72, F15, F16, J15）

abstract.text: This paper studies the interplay between genetics and family investments in the process of skill formation. We model and estimate the joint evolution of skills and parental investments throughout early childhood. We document three genetic mechanisms: the direct effect of child genes on skills, the indirect effect of child genes via parental investments, and family genetic influences captured by parental genes. We show that genetic effects are dynamic, increase over time, and operate via environmental channels. Our paper highlights the value of integrating biological and social perspectives into a single unified framework. (JEL I24, I26, J12, J13, J24)
