10.1257/aer.20220456.abstractZh: 本文研究了遗传学与家庭投资在技能形成过程中的相互作用。我们建模并估计了技能与父母投资在整个幼儿时期的共同演变过程。我们发现了三种遗传机制：儿童基因对技能的直接影响、通过父母投资对儿童基因产生的间接影响，以及由父母基因体现的家庭遗传影响。我们表明，遗传效应是动态的，随时间增加，并通过环境渠道发挥作用。我们的论文强调了将生物学和社会视角整合到单一统一框架中的价值。（JEL I24, I26, J12, J13, J24）

abstract.text: This paper evaluates a large urban public works program randomly rolled out across neighborhoods of Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. We find the program increased public employment and reduced private labor supply among beneficiaries and improved local amenities in treated locations. We then combine a spatial equilibrium model and unique commuting data to estimate the spillover effects of the program on private sector wages across neighborhoods: under full program rollout, wages increased by 18.6 percent. Using our model, we show that welfare gains to the poor are six times larger when we include the indirect effects on private wages and local amenities. (JEL H76, I38, J22, J31, O15, O18, R23)

10.1257/aer.20220471.abstractZh: 本文评估了埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴多个社区随机实施的重大城市公共工程计划。研究发现，该计划增加了公共就业，减少了受益者的私人劳动力供应，并改善了受项目影响的地区的当地设施。随后，我们通过空间均衡模型与独特的通勤数据，估算了该计划对各个社区私营部门工资的溢出效应：在计划全面实施的情况下，工资水平上升了18.6%。利用我们的模型，我们发现，当考虑对私营部门工资和当地设施的间接影响时，对贫困人口的福利改善幅度是原来的六倍。（JEL H76, I38, J22, J31, O15, O18, R23）

abstract.text: What are the implications of the dramatic fall in IT prices for aggregate technology? When firm-level technologies are continuously differentiable, a factor price shock leads to (i) a substitution between factors and/or (ii) an endogenous response of returns to scale. The second channel is governed by the output elasticity of relative factor demand. Using detailed firm-level data from France, we estimate this elasticity to be positive for IT factor demand. A quantitative exercise accounting for both technological channels shows that falling IT prices can explain much of the changes in concentration and the composition of aggregate labor share in France. (JEL D22, D24, D33, E25, L63, L86)

10.1257/aer.20220522.abstractZh: 信息技术价格大幅下跌对整体技术产业有何影响？当企业层面的技术具有连续可微性时，要素价格的变化会导致（i）要素之间的替代，或（ii）规模报酬的内生响应。第二种效应受相对要素需求产出弹性的影响。利用来自法国的详细企业数据，我们估计信息技术要素需求的弹性为正值。通过综合考虑这两种技术效应，定量分析表明，信息技术价格下跌可以解释法国整体劳动力份额分布和集中程度的变化。（JEL D22, D24, D33, E25, L63, L86）

abstract.text: In the United States, after age 65, households face income and health risks, and a large fraction of these risks are transitory. While consumption significantly responds to transitory income shocks, out-of-pocket medical expenses do not. In contrast, both consumption and out-of-pocket medical expenses respond to transitory health shocks. Thus, most US elderly keep their out-of-pocket medical expenses close to a satiation point that varies with health. Consumption responds to health shocks mostly because adverse health shocks reduce the marginal utility of consumption. The effect of health on marginal utility changes the optimal transfers due to health shocks. (JEL D12, E21, G22, G51, I10, J14, J26)

10.1257/aer.20220555.abstractZh: 在美国，65岁以后，家庭面临收入和健康风险，而这些风险中有很大一部分是暂时的。虽然消费对暂时的收入冲击有显著反应，但自付医疗费用则没有这种反应。相比之下，消费和自付医疗费用都对暂时的健康冲击有反应。因此，大多数美国老年人将自付医疗费用保持在随健康状况变化的饱和点附近。消费对健康冲击的反应主要是因为不良健康冲击会降低消费的边际效用。健康对边际效用的影响改变了因健康冲击而产生的最优转移支付。（JEL D12, E21, G22, G51, I10, J14, J26）

abstract.text: I investigate men’s limited entry into female-dominated sectors through a large-scale field experiment. The design exogenously varies recruitment messages by showing photographs of current workers (male or female) and providing information on the share of workers who received high evaluations in the past (higher or lower). A male photograph has no impact on men’s applications, but informing about a lower share of high evaluations encourages men to apply and enables the employer to hire and retain more talented men. The impact of this informational intervention remains positive for the employer also accounting for its effects on female applicants and hires. (JEL C93, D83, J16, J22, J23, J24, M51)

10.1257/aer.20220582.abstractZh: 我通过一项大规模的实地实验，研究男性进入女性主导领域的限制。实验设计通过展示当前员工的照片（无论男女）以及提供有关过去获得高评价的员工比例的信息，来外源性地改变招聘信息。男性照片对男性的申请没有影响，但提供较低比例的高评价信息则鼓励男性申请，并使雇主能够雇佣和留住更有才华的男性员工。这种信息干预对雇主的影响仍然积极，同时也考虑到其对女性申请者和雇员的影響。（JEL C93, D83, J16, J22, J23, J24, M51）

abstract.text: South Koreans appear to be preoccupied with their offspring's education and also have the lowest total fertility rate in the world. We propose a novel theory with status externalities and endogenous fertility connecting these facts, motivated by novel empirical evidence on private education spillovers. Using a quantitative model calibrated to Korea, we find that fertility would be 28 percent higher without the externality. We explore the effects of government policy: a pro-natal transfer or an education tax can increase fertility and reduce education spending. An education tax of 22 percent together with moderate pro-natal transfers maximizes the current generation's welfare. (JEL D31, D62, E24, I21, I26, I28, J13, O40)

10.1257/aer.20220583.abstractZh: 韩国人似乎非常关注子女的教育问题，同时他们的总生育率也是全球最低的。我们提出了一种新理论，认为地位外部性和内生性生育率这两个因素共同解释了这些现象，这一理论基于关于私人教育溢出效应的新实证证据。通过针对韩国进行量化模型分析，我们发现如果没有这种地位外部性，生育率将高出28%。我们进一步探讨了政府政策的影响：支持生育的转移支付或教育税可以提高生育率并减少教育支出。一项22%的教育税以及适度的支持生育的转移支付，能够最大化当前一代的福利。（JEL D31, D62, E24, I21, I26, I28, J13, O40）

abstract.text: We experimentally study the impact of relatively large enterprise loans in Egypt. Larger loans generate small average impacts, but machine learning using psychometric data reveals “ top performers” (those with the highest predicted treatment effects) substantially increase profits, while profits drop for poor performers. The large differences imply that lender credit allocation decisions matter for aggregate income, yet we find existing practice leads to substantial misallocation. We argue that some entrepreneurs are overoptimistic and squander the opportunities presented by larger loans by taking on too much risk, and show the promise of allocations based on entrepreneurial type relative to firm characteristics. (JEL C45, D22, G21, G32, L25, L26, O16)

10.1257/aer.20220616.abstractZh: 我们通过实验研究埃及较大规模企业贷款的影响。较大规模的贷款产生较小的平均影响，但利用心理测量数据的机器学习分析显示，“表现最佳”的企业（那些预测治疗效果最高的企业）的利润显著增加，而表现较差的企业则利润下降。这种巨大差异表明，贷款人的信用分配决策对整体收入有重要影响，但我们发现现有做法导致了严重的资源错配。我们认为，一些企业家过于乐观，通过承担过多风险而浪费了较大规模贷款带来的机会，并展示了基于企业家类型而非企业特征的分配方式所具有的潜力。（JEL C45, D22, G21, G32, L25, L26, O16）

abstract.text: We collect data on the size distribution of US businesses for 100 years, and use these data to estimate the concentration of production (e.g., asset share or sales share of top businesses). The data show that concentration has increased persistently over the past century. Rising concentration was stronger in manufacturing and mining before the 1970s, and stronger in services, retail, and wholesale after the 1970s. The results are robust to different measurement methods and consistent across different historical sources. Our findings suggest that large firms have become more important in the US economy for a long period of time. (JEL D22, E24, L11, L25, N12)

10.1257/aer.20220621.abstractZh: 我们收集了100年来美国企业的规模分布数据，并利用这些数据来估算生产集中度（例如，顶尖企业的资产份额或销售份额）。数据显示，在过去一个世纪中，企业集中度持续上升。在1970年代之前，制造业和采矿业的企业集中度上升更为显著；而在1970年代之后，服务业、零售业和批发业的企业集中度则上升得更为明显。这些结果在不同测量方法下依然成立，并且来自不同历史来源的数据也显示出一致性的结论。我们的研究发现表明，大型企业在美国经济中一直扮演着越来越重要的角色。（JEL D22, E24, L11, L25, N12）

abstract.text: We consider the market design problem of matching students to schools in the presence of crowding effects. These effects are salient in parents’ decision-making and the empirical literature; however, they cause difficulties in the design of satisfactory mechanisms and, as such, are not currently considered. We propose a new framework and an equilibrium notion that accommodates crowding, no-envy, and respect for priorities. The equilibrium has a student-optimal element that induces an incentive-compatible mechanism and is implementable via a novel algorithm. Moreover, analogs of fundamental structural results of the matching literature (the rural hospitals theorem, welfare lattice, etc.) survive. (JEL D47, H75, I21, I28)

10.1257/aer.20220626.abstractZh: 我们研究了在拥挤效应存在的情况下，将学生与学校进行匹配的市场设计问题。这些效应在家长的决策过程中尤为显著，且已有相关实证文献支持；然而，这些效应给设计令人满意的机制带来了困难，因此目前尚未得到充分考虑。我们提出了一种新的框架和均衡概念，能够适应拥挤、无嫉妒以及尊重优先级的特性。该均衡具有对学生最优化的元素，能够引导出激励相容的机制，并且可以通过一种新颖的算法来实现。此外，匹配文献中的基本结构结果（如农村医院定理、福利格子等）在新的框架下依然成立。（JEL D47, H75, I21, I28）

abstract.text: This paper uses a laboratory experiment to study beliefs and their relationship to action and strategy choices in finitely and indefinitely repeated prisoners’ dilemma games. We find subjects’ elicited beliefs about the other player’s action are generally accurate despite some systematic deviations, and anticipate the evolution of behavior differently between the finite and indefinite games. We also use the elicited beliefs over actions to recover beliefs over supergame strategies played by the other player. We find these beliefs over strategies correctly capture the different classes of strategies played in each game, vary substantially across subjects, and rationalize their strategies. (JEL C72, C73, C92, D83)

10.1257/aer.20220639.abstractZh: 本文通过实验室实验研究信念与行动及策略选择之间的关系，涉及有限重复和无限重复版的囚徒困境游戏。我们发现，受试者对其他玩家的行动所持有的信念通常较为准确，尽管存在一些系统性偏差。同时，我们观察到在有限重复和无限重复游戏中，行为演变的预测方式有所不同。此外，我们还利用这些关于行动的信念来推断其他玩家所采取的超游戏策略。研究发现，这些关于策略的信念能够准确反映每个游戏中不同类别的策略，且在不同受试者之间存在显著差异，这些信念有助于解释他们的策略选择。（JEL C72, C73, C92, D83）

abstract.text: We created experimental variation across markets in China in the share of firms having access to a new loan product. Access to finance had a large positive direct effect on the performance of treated firms but a similar-sized negative indirect effect on that of firms with treated competitors, leading to nondetectable gains in producer surplus. Access to finance had a positive direct effect on business quality and consumer satisfaction and a negative effect on price, which were not offset by indirect effects, implying net gains in consumer surplus. We document other indirect effects and combine effects in a welfare evaluation. (JEL D22, G21, G32, L81, O16, P31, P34)

10.1257/aer.20220711.abstractZh: 我们在中国不同市场间创建了实验性差异，研究企业获得新贷款产品的比例。获得融资对受处理企业的绩效有显著的积极直接影响，但对具有受处理竞争对手的企业则产生了类似的负面间接影响，导致生产者剩余的增加无法被检测到。获得融资对业务质量和消费者满意度有积极影响，但对价格有负面影响，而这些影响并未被间接效应所抵消，这意味着消费者剩余有净收益。我们还记录了其他间接效应，并在福利评估中综合了这些效应。（JEL D22, G21, G32, L81, O16, P31, P34）

abstract.text: I examine whether changing the form of disbursement of a microfinance loan enables female microfinance borrowers to overcome intra-household sharing pressure and grow their businesses. Using a field experiment with 3,000 borrowers in Uganda, I compare the disbursement of a loan as cash to disbursement onto a digital account. After 8 months, women who received their microfinance loan on the digital account had 11 percent higher (US$70) business capital and 15 percent higher (US$18) profits compared to those who received their loan as cash. Impacts were greatest for women who experienced pressure to share money with others in the household at baseline. (JEL C93, D13, G51, J16, O12, O16)

10.1257/aer.20220717.abstractZh: 我研究改变小额信贷的分配方式是否能够帮助女性小额信贷借款人克服家庭内部分配压力，并发展他们的业务。通过乌干达的实地实验，涉及3,000名借款人，我比较了将贷款以现金形式发放与通过数字账户发放的效果。8个月后，通过数字账户获得贷款的女性的业务资本增加了11%（70美元），利润增加了15%（18美元），相比之下，通过现金形式获得贷款的女性的业务资本和利润分别只增加了10%和15%。对于那些在基线阶段就面临家庭内部资金分配压力的女性来说，这种影响最为显著。（JEL C93, D13, G51, J16, O12, O16）

abstract.text: This paper identifies the impact of increasing post-childbirth work incentives on mothers’ long-run careers. We exploit variation in work incentives across mothers based on the timing of a first birth and eligibility for the 1993 expansion of the Earned Income Tax Credit. Ten to nineteen years after a first birth, single mothers who were exposed to the expansion immediately after birth (“early”), rather than 3–6 years later (“late”), have 0.62 more years of work experience and 4.2 percent higher earnings conditional on working. We show that higher earnings are primarily explained by improved wages due to greater work experience. (JEL H24, H31, J16, J22, J31)

10.1257/aer.20220792.abstractZh: 本文探讨了增加产后工作激励对母亲长期职业生涯的影响。我们基于母亲首次生育的时间以及1993年所得税抵免扩展政策的适用情况，分析了不同母亲在工作激励上的差异。研究发现，首次生育后10至19年内，那些在出生后立即享受到该政策优惠的单身母亲，与3至6年后享受该政策优惠的母亲相比，拥有0.62年更多的工作经验，并且工作收入高出4.2%。我们认为，较高的收入主要得益于更丰富的工作经验所带来的工资提升。（JEL H24, H31, J16, J22, J31）

abstract.text: Households in developing countries often face variation in the prices of consumption goods. We develop a model demonstrating that in-kind transfers will provide insurance benefits against price risk if the covariance between the marginal utility of income and price is positive. Using calorie shortfalls as a proxy for marginal utility, we find that this condition holds for low-income Indian households. Expansions in India’s flagship in-kind food transfer program not only increase caloric intake but also reduce caloric sensitivity to prices. Our results contribute to ongoing debates about the optimal form of social protection programs. (JEL D12, H53, I18, I38, O12, O15)

10.1257/aer.20220822.abstractZh: 发展中国家的家庭常常面临消费品价格的变化。我们建立了一个模型，表明如果收入的边际效用与价格之间的协方差为正，实物转移就能提供价格风险的保险效益。以热量不足作为边际效用的代理指标，我们发现这一条件适用于低收入印度家庭。印度旗舰实物食品转移计划的扩展不仅增加了热量摄入，还降低了热量对价格的敏感性。我们的研究结果有助于推动关于社会保障计划最佳形式的持续讨论。（JEL D12, H53, I18, I38, O12, O15）

abstract.text: Firms in developing countries are embedded in supply chains and labor networks. These linkages may propagate or attenuate shocks. Using panel data from Thai villages, we document three facts: as households facing idiosyncratic shocks adjust their production, these shocks propagate to other households on both the production and consumption sides; propagation is greater via labor than supply chain links; and shocks in denser networks and to more central households propagate more, while access to formal or informal insurance reduces propagation. Social benefits from expanding safety nets may be higher than private benefits. (JEL D13, D22, G22, I10, L14, L26, O10)

10.1257/aer.20220892.abstractZh: 发展中国家的企业嵌入在供应链和劳动力网络中。这些联系可能会传播或减弱冲击。利用泰国村庄的面板数据，我们发现了三个事实：当面临特殊冲击的家庭调整生产时，这些冲击会传播到其他家庭，影响生产和消费两方面；通过劳动力联系传播的影响更大；在更密集的网络中，以及对更核心的家庭而言，冲击的传播更为显著，而获得正式或非正式保险则可以减少这种传播。扩大安全网带来的社会效益可能高于私人效益。（JEL D13, D22, G22, I10, L14, L26, O10）

abstract.text: This paper provides insight into a corruption scheme in Kinshasa’s traffic police agency. First, various data collection branches show that the agency’s revenue is five times that from fines and is derived from a coalition of traffic police officials, their managers, and judicial police officers scheming to extort drivers. Second, the analysis of an experiment suggests that the scheme subverts service. Third, the scheme appears to be a rational response to the context, but its logic is widespread. The findings suggest that coalitions of officials, while being socially costly, can yield large illicit revenue, nuancing the notion of state weakness. (JEL D73, H76, K42, O17)

10.1257/aer.20220908.abstractZh: 本文揭示了金沙萨交通警察机构中的一个腐败阴谋。首先，各种数据收集结果显示，该机构的收入是罚款收入的五倍，这些收入来自交通警察官员、他们的管理人员以及司法警察官员之间的合作，他们合谋敲诈司机。其次，一项实验分析表明，这一阴谋实际上破坏了服务的正常运作。第三，这一阴谋似乎是对当前环境的合理应对，但其逻辑模式却具有普遍性。研究结果表明，官员之间的合作虽然会带来社会成本，但能够带来巨大的非法收入，这进一步凸显了国家力量的薄弱。（JEL D73, H76, K42, O17）

abstract.text: Existing theories of media competition imply that advertisers will pay a lower price in equilibrium to reach consumers who multi-home across competing outlets. We generalize and extend this theoretical result and test it using data from television and social media advertising. We find that the model is a good match, qualitatively and quantitatively, to variation in advertising prices across demographic groups, outlets, platforms, and over time. We use the model to quantify the effects of competition within and across platforms. (JEL G34, K21, L13, L82, M37)

10.1257/aer.20220943.abstractZh: 现有的媒体竞争理论表明，广告商在均衡状态下会支付较低的价格来接触那些在竞争媒体渠道间切换的消费者。我们对此理论结果进行了推广和扩展，并使用电视和社交媒体广告的数据进行了验证。我们发现，该模型在定性和定量上都与不同人口群体、媒体渠道、平台以及时间上的广告价格变化相符。我们利用该模型来量化不同平台内部及之间的竞争效应。（JEL G34, K21, L13, L82, M37）

abstract.text: We show that the largest increase in unemployment benefits in US history had large spending impacts and small job-finding impacts. This finding has three implications. First, increased benefits were important for explaining aggregate spending dynamics—but not employment dynamics—during the pandemic. Second, benefit expansions allow us to study the MPC of normally low-liquidity households in a high-liquidity state. These households still have high MPCs. This suggests a role for permanent behavioral characteristics, rather than just current liquidity, in driving spending behavior. Third, the mechanisms driving our results imply that temporary benefit supplements are a promising countercyclical tool. (JEL E21, E24, E32, E62, E71, G51, J65)

10.1257/aer.20220973.abstractZh: 我们指出，美国历史上失业救济金增幅最大的时期，对消费的影响较大，而对就业的影响较小。这一发现有三个意义。首先，救济金的增加对于解释疫情期间的整体消费动态非常重要，但对就业动态的影响则相对较小。其次，救济金的扩大使我们能够研究通常流动性较低的家庭在高流动性状态下的边际消费倾向。这些家庭仍然具有较高的边际消费倾向。这表明，驱动消费行为的不仅仅是当前的流动性，还有持久的行为特征。第三，导致我们这些结果的机制表明，临时性的救济补充是一种有前景的逆周期工具。（JEL E21, E24, E32, E62, E71, G51, J65）

abstract.text: This paper provides empirically implementable sufficient statistics formulas for optimal nonlinear tax systems in the presence of across-income heterogeneity in preferences, inheritances, income-shifting capabilities, and other sources. We characterize optimal smooth tax systems on income and savings (or other commodities), as well as simpler tax systems. We use familiar elasticity concepts and a novel sufficient statistic for heterogeneity correlated with earnings ability: the difference between across-income variation in savings and the causal effect of income on savings. We apply these formulas to the United States and find that the optimal savings tax is mostly positive and progressive. (JEL E21, G51, H21, H24)

10.1257/aer.20221053.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种可实际应用的充分统计量公式，用于描述在偏好、继承、收入转移能力以及其他因素存在跨收入异质性情况下的最优非线性税收体系。我们描述了针对收入和储蓄（或其他商品）的最优平滑税收体系，以及更为简单的税收体系。我们采用了熟悉的弹性概念，并提出了一种针对与收入能力相关的异质性的新颖充分统计量：即跨收入储蓄差异与收入对储蓄的因果效应之间的差异。我们将这些公式应用于美国的情况，发现最优的储蓄税收大多为正面且累进的。（JEL E21, G51, H21, H24）

abstract.text: Universal basic income (UBI) is an increasingly popular policy proposal, but there is no evidence regarding its longer-term consequences. We find that UBI generates large welfare losses in a general equilibrium model with imperfect capital markets, labor market shocks, and intergenerational linkages via skill formation and transfers. This conclusion is robust to various alternative ways of financing UBI. By using observationally equivalent models that eliminate different sources of endogenous dynamic linkages (equilibrium capital market and parental investment in child skills), we show that the latter are largely responsible for the negative welfare consequences. (JEL H24, H31, I38, J22, J24, J62)

10.1257/aer.20221099.abstractZh: 普遍基本收入（UBI）是一种越来越受欢迎的政策提案，但关于其长期影响的证据尚不充分。我们在一个具有不完善资本市场、劳动力市场冲击以及通过技能形成和转移实现代际联系的一般均衡模型中发现，UBI会导致巨大的福利损失。这一结论在采用不同融资方式的UBI模型时依然成立。通过使用在消除不同内生动态联系因素（如均衡资本市场和父母对儿童技能的投资）的情况下仍然具有等效性的模型，我们发现后者是造成负面福利后果的主要原因。（JEL H24, H31, I38, J22, J24, J62）

abstract.text: We study regressions with multiple treatments and a set of controls that is flexible enough to purge omitted variable bias. We show these regressions generally fail to estimate convex averages of heterogeneous treatment effects—instead, estimates of each treatment’s effect are contaminated by nonconvex averages of the effects of other treatments. We discuss three estimation approaches that avoid such contamination bias, including the targeting of easiest-to-estimate weighted average effects. A reanalysis of nine empirical applications finds economically and statistically meaningful contamination bias in observational studies; contamination bias in experimental studies is more limited due to smaller variability in propensity scores. (JEL C21, C31, C51, H75, I21, I28)

10.1257/aer.20221116.abstractZh: 我们研究了具有多个处理组和一组控制变量的回归分析，这些控制变量足够灵活，能够消除遗漏变量偏差。我们发现，这类回归通常无法估计异质处理效应的凸平均值——相反，每个处理效应的估计结果会被其他处理效应的非凸平均值所污染。我们讨论了三种避免这种污染偏差的估计方法，包括选择最容易估计的加权平均效应。对九个实证应用的重新分析发现，在观察性研究中存在经济性和统计上显著的污染偏差；而在实验研究中，由于倾向得分的变异性较小，污染偏差较为有限。（JEL C21, C31, C51, H75, I21, I28）

abstract.text: This paper studies sequential information acquisition by an ambiguity-averse decision-maker (DM), who decides how long to collect information before taking an irreversible action. The agent optimizes against the worst-case belief and updates prior by prior. We show that the consideration of ambiguity gives rise to rich dynamics: compared to the Bayesian DM, the DM here tends to experiment excessively when facing modest uncertainty and, to counteract it, may stop experimenting prematurely when facing high uncertainty. In the latter case, the DM’s stopping rule is nonmonotonic in beliefs and features randomized stopping. (JEL C61, D81, D83, D91)

10.1257/aer.20221149.abstractZh: 本文研究了一种厌恶歧义的决策者如何进行序列信息获取的问题，该决策者在采取不可逆行动之前决定收集信息的时长。该决策者针对最坏情况的信念进行优化，并通过先验信息来更新信念。我们指出，考虑到歧义性会导致丰富的动态现象：与贝叶斯决策者相比，这里的决策者在面对适度不确定性时倾向于过度尝试，而在面对高度不确定性时则可能过早停止尝试。在后一种情况下，决策者的停止规则在信念方面是非单调的，并且具有随机性的停止特征。（JEL C61, D81, D83, D91）

abstract.text: We use randomized treatments that provide different types of information about the first and/or second moments of future economic growth to generate exogenous changes in the perceived macroeconomic uncertainty of treated households. The effects on their spending decisions relative to an untreated control group are measured in follow-up surveys. Our results indicate that, after taking into account first moments, higher macroeconomic uncertainty induces households to significantly and persistently reduce their total monthly spending in subsequent months. Changes in spending are broad based across spending categories and apply to larger durable good purchases as well. (JEL D12, D81, D84, E21, E23, G51)

10.1257/aer.20221167.abstractZh: 我们采用随机化处理，获取关于未来经济增长的首次和/或第二次时刻的不同类型信息，以产生对受处理家庭感知的宏观经济不确定性的外生变化。通过后续调查，测量这些变化对它们的消费决策的影响。我们的结果表明，在考虑首次时刻因素后，较高的宏观经济不确定性会促使家庭在后续月份显著且持续地减少其每月总消费支出。消费支出的变化涉及多个消费类别，并且也适用于较大额耐用品的购买行为。（JEL D12, D81, D84, E21, E23, G51）

abstract.text: Technological advance is often embodied in capital inputs, like computers, airplanes, and robots. This paper builds a framework where capital inputs advance through (i) increased automation and (ii) increased productivity. The interplay of these two innovation dimensions can produce balanced growth, satisfying the Uzawa Growth Theorem even though technological progress is capital-embodied. The framework can further address structural transformation, general-purpose technologies, the limited macroeconomic impact of computing, and declining productivity growth and labor shares. Overall, this tractable framework can help resolve puzzling tensions between micro-level observations of innovation and balanced growth while providing new perspectives on numerous macroeconomic phenomena. (JEL E22, E23, E24, E25, L16, O33, O41)

10.1257/aer.20221180.abstractZh: 技术进步通常体现在资本投入上，如计算机、飞机和机器人。本文构建了一个框架，其中资本投入通过两个方面实现进步：一是自动化程度的提高，二是生产率的提升。这两种创新维度的相互作用可以带来平衡的增长，即使技术进步是以资本形式存在的，也能满足Uzawa增长定理。该框架还可以进一步探讨结构转型、通用技术、计算的有限宏观经济影响，以及生产率增长放缓和劳动力份额下降等问题。总体而言，这一可行的框架有助于解决关于创新与平衡增长之间矛盾的观察问题，并为众多宏观经济现象提供了新的视角。（JEL E22, E23, E24, E25, L16, O33, O41）

abstract.text: We conducted a nationwide field experiment in China to evaluate the direct and indirect impacts of assigning firms to public or private citizen appeals when they violate pollution standards. There are three main findings. First, public appeals to the regulator through social media substantially reduce violations and pollution emissions, while private appeals cause more modest environmental improvements. Second, public appeals appear to tilt regulators’ focus away from facilitating economic growth and toward avoiding pollution-induced public unrest. Third, pollution reductions by treated firms are not offset by control firms, based on randomly varying the proportion of treated firms at the prefecture level. (JEL D22, L82, P28, P31, Q52, Q53, Q58)

10.1257/aer.20221215.abstractZh: 我们在中国进行了一项全国性的实地实验，以评估将企业分配到公共或私人公民申诉程序中的直接和间接影响，这些企业违反了污染标准。主要发现有以下三点：首先，通过社交媒体向监管机构发起的公共申诉显著减少了违规行为和污染排放，而私人申诉则导致较为温和的环境改善。其次，公共申诉似乎使监管机构的关注点从促进经济增长转向避免污染引发的公共动荡。第三，基于在省级层面随机调整处理企业的比例，被处理的企业所实现的污染减少并未被对照组企业所抵消。（JEL D22, L82, P28, P31, Q52, Q53, Q58）

abstract.text: We provide evidence that classic lottery anomalies like probability weighting and loss aversion are not special phenomena of risk. They also arise (and often with equal strength) when subjects evaluate deterministic, positive monetary payments that have been disaggregated to resemble lotteries. Thus, we find, e.g., apparent probability weighting in settings without probabilities and loss aversion in settings without scope for loss. Across subjects, anomalies in these deterministic tasks strongly predict the same anomalies in lotteries. These findings suggest that much of the behavior motivating our most important behavioral theories of risk derive from complexity-driven mistakes rather than true risk preferences. (JEL C91, D44, D81, D91)

10.1257/aer.20221227.abstractZh: 我们提供了证据，表明经典的彩票异常现象，如概率加权效应和损失厌恶现象，并非风险的特殊现象。这些现象同样会在人们评估那些被分解为类似彩票形式的确定性、正向货币支付时出现（且往往以相同的强度出现）。因此，我们发现，在没有概率的情况下会出现表面上的概率加权效应，而在没有损失风险的情况下则会出现损失厌恶现象。在不同受试者中，这些确定性任务中的异常现象与彩票中的异常现象高度一致。这些发现表明，许多驱动我们最重要的风险行为理论背后的行为机制，源于复杂性导致的错误，而非真正的风险偏好。（JEL C91, D44, D81, D91）

abstract.text: The choice of an auction mechanism influences which object characteristics bidders learn about and whether the object is allocated efficiently. Some object characteristics are valued equally by all bidders and thus are inconsequential for the efficient allocation. Others matter only to certain bidders and thus determine the bidder with the highest valuation. I show when the second-price auction is ex ante efficient by inducing bidders to seek socially relevant information. When facing a continuous learning trade-off, bidders learn more about socially relevant components and less about common characteristics of the object in a second-price auction than a first-price auction. (JEL D44, D83)

10.1257/aer.20221297.abstractZh: 拍卖机制的选择会影响竞买人了解哪些物品特征，以及物品是否能被有效分配。有些物品特征被所有竞买人同等重视，因此对于有效分配来说并不重要。而另一些特征则只对特定竞买人有意义，因此决定了具有最高评估价值的竞买人。我展示了第二价格拍卖在事前是有效的，因为它促使竞买人寻求社会相关的信息。在面临持续学习的权衡时，与第二价格拍卖相比，第一价格拍卖让竞买人更多地了解社会相关的特征，而较少了解物品的常见特征。（JEL D44, D83）

abstract.text: Betas from return regressions are commonly used to measure systematic financial market risks. “Good” beta measurements are essential for a range of empirical inquiries in finance and macroeconomics. We introduce a novel econometric framework for the nonparametric estimation of time-varying betas with high-frequency data. The “local Gaussian” property of the generic continuous-time benchmark model enables optimal “finite-sample” inference in a well-defined sense. It also affords more reliable inference in empirically realistic settings compared to conventional large-sample approaches. Two applications pertaining to the tracking performance of leveraged ETFs and an intraday event study illustrate the practical usefulness of the new procedures. (JEL C22, C58, G12, G23)

10.1257/aer.20221338.abstractZh: 回归分析中的贝塔值常被用来衡量系统性金融市场风险。“良好”的贝塔值对于金融学和宏观经济学中的多种实证研究至关重要。我们提出了一种新颖的计量经济学框架，用于高频数据下非参数估计随时间变化的贝塔值。通用连续时间基准模型的“局部高斯”特性使得在明确定义的意义上可以进行最优的“有限样本”推断。与传统的大样本方法相比，这种方法在现实情境下的推断更为可靠。两个应用案例，分别涉及杠杆型ETF的跟踪表现以及日内事件研究，展示了新方法的实际效用。（JEL C22, C58, G12, G23）

abstract.text: Taking advantage of key recent advances in long-run economic and financial data, we analyze the statistical properties of global long-maturity real interest rates over the past seven centuries. In contrast to existing consensus, we find that real interest rates are in fact trend stationary and exhibit a persistent downward trend since the Renaissance. We investigate structural breaks in real interest rates over time and find that overall the Black Death and the 1557 “Trinity default” appear as consistent inflection points. We further show that demographic and productivity factors do not represent convincing drivers of real interest rates over long spans. (JEL E43, F30, N20)

10.1257/aer.20221352.abstractZh: 利用近期在长期经济与金融数据方面的关键进展，我们分析了过去七个世纪全球长期实际利率的统计特性。与现有共识不同，我们发现实际利率实际上呈趋势平稳状态，并且自文艺复兴时期以来一直呈现持续下降的趋势。我们研究了实际利率随时间的变化情况，发现黑死病和1557年的“三一违约事件”似乎都是重要的转折点。此外，我们还指出，人口结构和生产率因素并不能成为长期实际利率的显著驱动因素。（JEL E43, F30, N20）

abstract.text: We investigate how the gender gap in confidence affects the views that evaluators (e.g., employers) hold about men and women. We find the confidence gap is contagious, causing evaluators to form overly pessimistic beliefs about women. This result arises even though the confidence gap is expected and even though the confidence gap shouldn’t be contagious if evaluators are Bayesian. Only an intervention that facilitates Bayesian updating proves (somewhat) effective. Additional results highlight how similar findings follow even when there is no room for discriminatory motives or differences in priors because evaluators are asked about arbitrary, rather than gender-specific, groups. (JEL D82, D83, D91, J16, J22, M51)

10.1257/aer.20221413.abstractZh: 我们研究了性别在信心方面的差异如何影响评估者（如雇主）对男性和女性的看法。我们发现这种信心差异具有传染性，导致评估者对女性持有过于悲观的看法。这一结果的出现，尽管这种信心差异是预期之中的，而且如果评估者是贝叶斯主义者，这种差异本不应具有传染性。只有能够促进贝叶斯更新的干预措施才显示出一定的有效性。此外，研究结果还表明，即使没有歧视动机或先验差异的情况下，只要评估者被问及的是任意而非性别特定的群体，类似的发现仍然会出现。（JEL D82, D83, D91, J16, J22, M51）

abstract.text: This paper analyzes consumption to evaluate the distributional effects of pension reforms. Using Swedish administrative data, we show that on average, workers who retire earlier consume less while retired and experience larger drops in consumption around retirement. Interpreted via a theoretical model, these findings imply that reforms incentivizing later retirement incur a substantial consumption smoothing cost. Turning to other features of pension policy, we find that reforms that redistribute based on early-career labor supply would have opposite-signed redistributive effects, while differentiating on wealth may help to target pension benefits toward those who are vulnerable to larger drops in consumption around retirement. (JEL E21, G51, H23, H55, J22, J26)

10.1257/aer.20221426.abstractZh: 本文通过分析消费行为来评估养老金改革在分配方面的效果。利用瑞典的行政数据，我们发现平均而言，较早退休的工人退休后消费减少，且退休前后消费水平出现较大波动。通过理论模型解释这些发现，表明鼓励较晚退休的改革会带来显著的消费平滑成本。此外，关于养老金政策的其他方面，我们发现基于早期职业生涯劳动供给进行再分配的改革会产生相反方向的再分配效果，而根据财富差异进行再分配则可能有助于将养老金福利分配给那些在退休前后消费水平下降幅度较大的群体。（JEL E21, G51, H23, H55, J22, J26）

abstract.text: How did countries recover from the Great Depression? In this paper, we explore the argument that leaving the gold standard helped by boosting inflationary expectations, lowering real interest rates, and stimulating interest-sensitive expenditures. We do so for a sample of 27 countries, using modern nowcasting methods and a new data-set containing more than 230,000 monthly and quarterly observations for over 1,500 variables. In those cases where the departure from gold happened on well-defined dates, inflationary expectations clearly rose in the wake of departure. Instrumental variable, difference-in-difference, and synthetic matching techniques suggest that the relationship is causal. (JEL E31, E32, E42, E43, F30, N10, N20)

10.1257/aer.20221479.abstractZh: 各国是如何从大萧条中复苏的？本文探讨了退出金本位制有助于经济复苏的论点，具体表现为提升通胀预期、降低实际利率以及刺激对利率敏感的支出。我们选取了27个国家作为样本，利用现代预测方法，并使用了包含超过230,000个月度及季度观测数据的新数据集，涉及1,500个变量。在那些明确规定了退出金本位制的日期的情况下，通胀预期在退出后明显上升。工具变量、差异分解法和合成匹配技术表明，这种关系是因果关系。（JEL E31, E32, E42, E43, F30, N10, N20）

abstract.text: We provide evidence of the existence of debt aversion and its negative implications for financial decisions. In a new experimental design where subjects are assigned debt randomly, we quantify the opportunity cost of subjects’ debt-biased decisions. One-third of our participants neglect high returns and focus instead on debt repayments. In addition, borrowing to invest is 50 percent less likely when it leads to indebtedness. On average, participants perceive $1 less in debt as equivalent to $1.03 in savings. Hence, a debt-averse agent will undertake a 10 percent guaranteed investment only if the cost of borrowing does not exceed 6.80 percent. (JEL C91, D91, G51)

10.1257/aer.20221509.abstractZh: 我们提供了债务厌恶现象存在的证据，以及其对财务决策的负面影响。在一项新的实验设计中，参与者被随机分配债务负担，我们量化了参与者基于债务决策的边际成本。三分之一的参与者忽视了高回报，而专注于债务偿还。此外，当借款用于投资时，其可能性会降低50%，因为这会导致负债。平均而言，参与者认为减少1美元的债务相当于节省1.03美元。因此，一个厌恶债务的个体只有在借款成本不超过6.80%的情况下，才会进行10%的保证投资。（JEL C91, D91, G51）

abstract.text: We study personalized pricing in a general oligopoly model. The impact of personalized pricing relative to uniform pricing hinges on the degree of market coverage. If market conditions are such that coverage is high (e.g., the production cost is low or the number of firms is high), personalized pricing harms firms and benefits consumers, whereas the opposite is true if coverage is low. When only some firms have data to personalize prices, consumers can be worse off compared to when either all or no firms personalize prices. (JEL D21, D43, D82)

10.1257/aer.20221524.abstractZh: 我们研究了一种一般寡头垄断模型中的个性化定价问题。个性化定价与统一定价相比的影响取决于市场的覆盖程度。如果市场条件使得市场覆盖度高（例如，生产成本低或企业数量多），那么个性化定价会对企业造成伤害，而对消费者有利；反之，如果市场覆盖度低，情况则相反。当只有部分企业拥有用于个性化定价的数据时，消费者的状况会比所有或没有企业进行个性化定价时更差。（JEL D21, D43, D82）

abstract.text: Without strong assumptions about how noise manifests in choices, we can infer little from existing empirical observations of the common ratio effect (CRE) about whether there exists an underlying common ratio preference (CRP). We propose to solve this inferential challenge using paired valuations, which yield valid inference under common assumptions. Using this approach in an online experiment with 900 participants, we find no evidence of a systematic CRP. To reconcile our findings with existing evidence, we present the same participants with paired choice tasks and demonstrate how noise can generate a CRE even for individuals without an associated CRP. (JEL C91, D81, D91)

10.1257/aer.20221535.abstractZh: 在不对噪声在选择中的表现做出强假设的情况下，我们无法从现有的关于共同比例效应（CRE）的实证观察中得出太多结论，以确定是否存在一种潜在的共同比例偏好（CRP）。我们提出使用配对估值方法来解决这一推理挑战，这种方法在常见假设下能够产生有效的推断。在一项涉及900名参与者的在线实验中，我们没有发现系统性CRP的证据。为了将我们的发现与现有证据相协调，我们为相同的参与者提供了配对选择任务，并展示了即使在没有相关CRP的个体中，噪声也能产生CRE。（JEL C91, D81, D91）

abstract.text: Most of the rise in overall earnings inequality from 1996 to 2018 is accounted for by rising between-industry dispersion. The contribution of industries is right-skewed with the top 10 percent of four-digit NAICS industries dominating. The top 10 percent are clustered in high-paying high-tech and low-paying retail sectors. In the top industries, high-wage workers are increasingly sorted to high-wage industries with rising industry premia. In the bottom industries, low-wage workers are increasingly sorted into lowwage industries, with rising employment and falling industry wage premia. (JEL J23, J24, J31, L25, M52)

10.1257/aer.20221574.abstractZh: 从1996年到2018年，整体收入不平等的加剧主要归因于行业间收入的差异扩大。不同行业的贡献呈现右偏分布，其中四位数的NAICS行业中的前10%占据主导地位。前10%的从业者主要集中在高薪高科技行业和低薪零售行业。在高端行业中，高薪工人越来越多地分配到高薪行业，行业溢价也随之上升。而在低端行业中，低薪工人越来越多地分配到低薪行业，就业率上升，行业工资溢价则下降。（JEL J23, J24, J31, L25, M52）

abstract.text: Binscatter is a popular method for visualizing bivariate relationships and conducting informal specification testing. We study the properties of this method formally and develop enhanced visualization and econometric binscatter tools. These include estimating conditional means with optimal binning and quantifying uncertainty. We also highlight a methodological problem related to covariate adjustment that can yield incorrect conclusions. We revisit two applications using our methodology and find substantially different results relative to those obtained using prior informal binscatter methods. General purpose software in Python, R, and Stata is provided. Our technical work is of independent interest for the nonparametric partition-based estimation literature. (JEL C13, C14, C18, C51, O31, R32)

10.1257/aer.20221576.abstractZh: Binscatter是一种常用的可视化双变量关系并进行非正式规格测试的方法。我们正式研究了这种方法的特性，并开发了改进的可视化工具和计量经济学Binscatter工具。这些工具包括使用最优分箱法估计条件均值以及量化不确定性。我们还指出了与协变量调整相关的方法论问题，这可能会导致错误的结论。我们重新审视了使用我们的方法的两个应用案例，发现与之前使用非正式Binscatter方法得到的结果相比，结果有了显著的不同。我们提供了适用于Python、R和Stata的通用软件。我们的技术工作对于非参数分区估计领域具有独立的参考价值。（JEL C13, C14, C18, C51, O31, R32）

abstract.text: Two homogeneous-good firms compete for a consumer’s unitary demand. The consumer is rationally inattentive and pays entropy costs to process information about firms’ offers. Compared to a collusion benchmark, competition produces two effects. As in standard models, competition puts downward pressure on prices. But, additionally, an attention effect arises: the consumer engages in trade more often. This alleviates the commitment problem that firms have when facing inattentive consumers and increases trade efficiency. For high enough attention costs, the attention effect dominates the effect on prices: firms’ profits are higher under competition than under collusion. (JEL D11, D21, D43, D83, L12)

10.1257/aer.20221605.abstractZh: 两家同质产品企业竞争以吸引消费者的单一需求。消费者缺乏理性意识，处理企业报价信息时会产生熵成本。与勾结相比，竞争会产生两种效应。正如标准模型所示，竞争会压低价格。此外，还会产生一种“注意力效应”：消费者会更频繁地进行交易。这缓解了企业在面对缺乏理性意识的消费者时所面临的承诺问题，并提高了交易效率。当注意力成本足够高时，注意力效应会主导对价格的影响：在竞争环境下，企业的利润高于勾结情况下的利润。（JEL D11, D21, D43, D83, L12）

abstract.text: This paper studies the long-run economic impact of dismissing city councils infiltrated by organized crime. Applying a matched difference-in-differences design to the universe of Italian social security records, we find that city council dismissals (CCDs) increase employment, the number of firms, and industrial real estate prices. The effects are concentrated in Mafia-dominated sectors and in municipalities where fewer incumbents are reelected. The dismissals generate large economic returns by weakening the Mafia and fostering trust in local institutions. The analysis suggests that CCDs represent an effective intervention for establishing legitimacy and spurring economic activity in areas dominated by organized crime. (JEL D73, H77, K42, R11, R23)

10.1257/aer.20221687.abstractZh: 本文研究了解散被有组织犯罪渗透的城市议会所带来的长期经济影响。通过采用匹配差异-差异设计，基于意大利社会保障记录数据，我们发现城市议会的解散增加了就业人数、企业数量以及工业房地产价格。这些效应主要集中在受黑手党主导的行业和那些现任议员当选人数较少的市镇。解散城市议会通过削弱黑手党势力并增强对地方机构的信任，带来了巨大的经济回报。分析表明，城市议会的解散是建立合法性并促进受有组织犯罪影响地区经济活动的有效手段。（JEL D73, H77, K42, R11, R23）

abstract.text: This study examines the link between credit supply and hospital health outcomes. We use bank stress tests as exogenous shocks to credit access for hospitals that have lending relationships with tested banks. We find that affected hospitals shift their operations to increase resource utilization following a negative credit shock but reduce the quality of their care to patients across a variety of measures, including a significant increase in risk-adjusted readmission and mortality rates. The results indicate that access to credit can affect the quality of health care hospitals deliver, pointing to important spillover effects of credit market frictions on health outcomes. (JEL G21, G32, I11, I18)

10.1257/aer.20221705.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了信贷供应与医院健康结果之间的关系。我们通过银行压力测试作为外生冲击，来模拟医院与特定银行存在借贷关系时的信贷获取情况。研究发现，在受到负面信贷冲击后，受影响的医院会调整其运营方式以提高资源利用率，但其在多个方面的医疗服务质量却有所下降，包括风险调整后的再入院率和死亡率的显著上升。结果表明，信贷获取能力确实会影响医院提供的医疗服务质量，这表明信贷市场摩擦对健康结果有着重要的溢出效应。（JEL G21, G32, I11, I18）

abstract.text: Developing countries have increasingly decentralized power to local governments. This paper studies the implications of a central element of decentralization (polity size) using population-based discontinuities that determine local government boundaries for over 100,000 Indian villages. Over the short and long run, individuals allocated into local governments with smaller populations have better access to public goods. We provide suggestive evidence that these results are related to heightened civic engagement and stronger political incentives, but not to other mechanisms such as elite capture. (JEL D72, H41, H75, H76, O17, O18, R50)

10.1257/aer.20221712.abstractZh: 发展中国家越来越多地将权力下放给地方政府。本文研究了权力下放的一个核心要素——政体的规模，通过基于人口的不连续性来确定超过10万印度村庄的地方政府边界。在短期和长期内，被分配到人口较少的地方政府的个体能够更方便地获取公共物品。我们有证据表明，这些结果与公民参与度的提高和政治激励机制的加强有关，但与精英攫取等其他机制无关。（JEL D72, H41, H75, H76, O17, O18, R50）

abstract.text: We explore how access to modern hospitals and medicine affects mortality by leveraging efforts of the Duke Endowment to modernize hospitals in the early twentieth century. The Endowment helped communities build and expand hospitals, obtain state-of-the-art medical technology, attract qualified medical personnel, and refine management practices. We find that Duke support increased the size and quality of the medical sector, fostering growth in not-for-profit hospitals and high-quality physicians. Duke funding reduced both infant mortality—with larger effects for Black infants than White infants—and long-run mortality. Finally, we find that communities aided by Duke benefited more from medical innovations. (JEL I11, I12, J13, J15, L31, N32, O31)

10.1257/aer.20230008.abstractZh: 我们探讨了获得现代医院和医疗服务的机会如何影响死亡率，通过利用杜克捐赠基金在20世纪初对医院进行现代化改造的努力来实现这一目标。该捐赠基金帮助社区建设并扩展医院，获取最先进的医疗技术，吸引合格的医疗人员，并改进管理实践。我们发现，杜克的支持增加了医疗领域的规模和质量，促进了非营利医院和高质量医生的增长。杜克的资金减少了婴儿死亡率——对黑人婴儿的影响比对白人婴儿更大——同时也降低了长期死亡率。最后，我们发现，受益于杜克支持的社区从医疗创新中获益更多。（JEL I11, I12, J13, J15, L31, N32, O31）

abstract.text: We study the design of negotiation strategies when a principal and agent must decide how to split a pie while the agent's outside option changes over time. The principal's optimal strategy under commitment demonstrates a new, but intuitive, set of negotiation dynamics. When the agent is tempted to leave, the principal gradually promises a larger share (decreasing demands) and more time to explore the outside option (decreasing pressure), illustrating a complementarity between these two tools. Although the principal's expected utility is decreasing in the outside option, his expected utility and demands are increasing in the outside option's drift and volatility. (JEL D63, D82, D86)

10.1257/aer.20230015.abstractZh: 我们研究了当主人与代理人必须决定如何分配资源，而代理人的外部选择随时间变化时，谈判策略的设计问题。在承诺约束下，主人的最优策略展现了一套新颖但直观的谈判动态。当代理人有离开的诱惑时，主人会逐渐承诺更大的份额（降低需求）和更多时间来探索外部选择（减轻压力），这说明了这两种工具之间的互补性。尽管主人的预期效用在外部选择中有所下降，但在外部选择的波动性和不确定性中，他的预期效用和需求却有所上升。（JEL D63, D82, D86）

abstract.text: Scientific evidence has documented we are undergoing a mass extinction of species, caused by human activity. However, allocating conservation resources is difficult due to scarce evidence on damages from losing individual species. This paper studies the collapse of vultures in India, triggered by the expiry of a patent on a painkiller. Our results suggest the functional extinction of vultures—efficient scavengers that removed carcasses from the environment—increased human mortality by over 4 percent because of a large negative shock to sanitation. We quantify damages at $69.4 billion per year. These results suggest high returns to conserving keystone species such as vultures. (JEL I12, O13, O15, Q53, Q57, Q58)

10.1257/aer.20230016.abstractZh: 科学研究已经证明，我们正在经历一场由人类活动引发的物种大规模灭绝。然而，由于关于失去单个物种所带来的损害的证据不足，分配保护资源变得十分困难。本文研究了印度秃鹫的灭绝现象，这一现象是由一种止痛药的专利到期引发的。我们的研究结果表明，作为高效的清道夫，秃鹫在清除环境中的尸体方面发挥着重要作用，但它们的消失导致人类死亡率上升了4%以上，因为卫生状况受到了严重负面影响。我们估算出每年造成的损失为694亿美元。这些结果表明，保护像秃鹫这样的关键物种具有很高的回报价值。（JEL I12, O13, O15, Q53, Q57, Q58）

abstract.text: We use newly digitized records from the post office to study the effects of strengthened state capacity between 1875 and 1901. Exploiting the implementation of the Pendleton Act—a landmark statute that shielded bureaucrats from political interference—across US cities over two waves, we find that civil service reform reduced postal delivery errors and increased productivity. These improvements were most pronounced during election years when the reform dampened bureaucratic turnover. We provide suggestive evidence that reformed cities witnessed declining local partisan newspapers. Separating politics from administration, therefore, not only improved state effectiveness but also weakened the role of local politics. (JEL D24, D73, H83, J45, L82, L87, N41)

10.1257/aer.20230019.abstractZh: 我们利用邮政局新数字化记录来研究1875年至1901年间加强国家能力的效果。通过分析《彭德尔顿法案》的实施情况——这项具有里程碑意义的法规旨在保护官僚免受政治干预——我们发现，这项改革减少了邮政投递错误，并提高了工作效率。这些改进在选举年尤为明显，因为改革减少了官僚的更替。我们有证据表明，改革后的城市当地党派报纸的数量有所减少。因此，将政治与行政分离不仅提升了国家的效率，也削弱了地方政治的作用。（JEL D24, D73, H83, J45, L82, L87, N41）

abstract.text: This paper studies how firms adapt to demand shocks when facing capacity constraints. I show that increases in government purchases raise total factor productivity in quantity units at the production line level. Productivity gains are concentrated in plants facing tighter capacity constraints, a phenomenon I call “learning by necessity.” Evidence is based on newly digitized archival data on US World War II aircraft production. Shifts in demand across aircraft with different strategic roles provide an instrument for aircraft demand. I show that plants adapted to surging demand by improving production methods, outsourcing, and combating absenteeism, primarily when facing tighter capacity constraints. (JEL D22, D24, E62, L93, N12, N42, N62)

10.1257/aer.20230033.abstractZh: 本文研究了企业在面临产能限制时如何适应需求冲击。研究表明，政府采购的增加会提高生产线层面的总要素生产率。生产率提升主要集中在面临更严格产能限制的工厂，我将这一现象称为“因必要而学习”。研究基于美国二战期间飞机生产的新数字化档案数据。不同战略角色飞机的需求变化为分析飞机需求提供了工具。研究发现，通过改进生产方法、外包以及减少缺勤等方式，工厂能够适应激增的需求，尤其是在面临更严格的产能限制时。（JEL D22, D24, E62, L93, N12, N42, N62）

abstract.text: We evaluate a pedagogical intervention aimed at improving learning in elementary school children by fostering their curiosity. We test the effectiveness of the pedagogy using achievement scores and a novel measure of curiosity. The latter involves creating a sense of information deprivation and quantifying the urge to acquire information and retention ability. The intervention increases curiosity, knowledge retention, and science test scores, with the effects persisting into middle school years. It also leads to more information sharing and peer learning in the classroom. The evidence can help design better pedagogical tools to increase pupil engagement and the quality of learning. (JEL D83, I21, I26, J13, O15)

10.1257/aer.20230084.abstractZh: 我们评估了一项旨在通过激发小学生好奇心来提高学习效果的教改措施。我们通过成绩和一项新的好奇心测量方法来测试该教法的有效性。后者包括创造一种信息匮乏的感觉，并量化获取信息的欲望以及信息保留能力。该干预措施能够提升好奇心、知识保留能力以及科学测试成绩，且这些效果会持续至中学阶段。同时，它还促进了课堂上的信息分享和同伴学习。这些研究结果有助于设计更好的教学工具，以提高学生的参与度和学习质量。（JEL D83, I21, I26, J13, O15）

abstract.text: We analyze the effect of transparency of past trading volumes in markets where an informed long-lived seller can repeatedly trade with short-lived uninformed buyers. Transparency allows buyers to observe previously sold quantities. In markets with intraperiod monopsony (single buyer each period), transparency reduces welfare if the ex ante expected quality is low but improves welfare if the expected quality is high. The effect is reversed in markets with intraperiod competition (multiple buyers each period). This discrepancy in the efficiency implications of transparency is explained by how buyer competition affects the seller’s ability to capture rents, which, in turn, influences market screening. (JEL D40, D82, D83, G14, L15)

10.1257/aer.20230114.abstractZh: 我们分析了在市场中，过去交易量的透明度对交易行为的影响。在这种市场中，有信息丰富的长期卖方可以反复与信息不足的短期买方进行交易。透明度使得买方能够观察到之前出售的数量。在每期存在单一买方垄断的市场中，如果事前预期的质量较低，透明度会降低福利；而如果预期的质量较高，透明度则会提高福利。而在每期存在多个买方竞争的市场中，这种效应则相反。这种透明度对效率影响的差异，可以通过买方竞争如何影响卖方获取租金的能力来解释，而后者又会影响市场筛选机制。（JEL D40, D82, D83, G14, L15）

abstract.text: We provide conditions for the feasibility of robust Pareto-improving (RPI) policies when markets are incomplete and the interest rate is below the growth rate. We allow for arbitrary heterogeneity in preferences and income risk and a wedge between the return to capital and bonds. An RPI improves risk sharing and can induce a more efficient level of capital. Elasticities of aggregate savings to changes in interest rates are the crucial ingredients to the feasibility of RPIs. Government debt may complement rather than substitute for capital in an RPI. Our analysis emphasizes the welfare-improving qualities of government bonds versus explicit redistribution. (JEL D52, E43, E62, H20, H63)

10.1257/aer.20230128.abstractZh: 我们为在市场不完善且利率低于增长率时，稳健的帕累托改进政策的可行性提供了条件。我们允许偏好和收入风险存在任意的异质性，并且资本与债券的回报之间存在差异。帕累托改进政策能够改善风险分担，并可能引导资本达到更高效的配置水平。总储蓄对利率变化的弹性是帕累托改进政策可行性的关键要素。在帕累托改进政策中，政府债务可以补充而非替代资本。我们的分析强调了政府债券相对于显性再分配在提升福利方面的优势。（JEL D52, E43, E62, H20, H63）

abstract.text: We propose a parsimonious mechanism for generating premature deindustrialization (PD). In the baseline model, the Baumol effect drives the hump-shaped path of the manufacturing share. Countries follow different paths due to the difference in the sector-specific adoption lags. The condition for PD under which countries differ only in technology gap implies that the cross-country productivity dispersion is the largest in agriculture. Moreover, when calibrated to match Rodrik’s (2016) findings, it is the smallest in manufacturing. In three extensions, we add the Engel effect, international trade, and catching up by late industrializers, to demonstrate the robustness of the mechanism. (JEL F11, L16, L60, O14, O33)

10.1257/aer.20230133.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种简洁的机制，用于解释过早去工业化现象。在基准模型中，Baumol效应导致了制造业份额呈现驼峰状路径。由于各国家在具体行业的采纳滞后存在差异，各国的发展路径也有所不同。当各国仅在技术差距上有所不同时，去工业化的条件意味着农业生产力的分散程度最高。此外，当模型根据Rodrik（2016年）的研究结果进行校准后，制造业的生产力分散程度则最低。在三个扩展模型中，我们加入了Engel效应、国际贸易以及后发工业国的追赶效应，以验证该机制的稳健性。（JEL F11, L16, L60, O14, O33）

abstract.text: We propose a model of strategic experimentation on social networks in which forward-looking agents learn from their own and neighbors’ successes. In equilibrium, private discovery is followed by social diffusion. Social learning crowds out own experimentation, so total information decreases with network density; we determine density thresholds below which agents’ asymptotic learning is perfect. By contrast, agent welfare is single peaked in network density and achieves a second-best benchmark level at intermediate levels that strike a balance between discovery and diffusion. (JEL D82, D83, D86, O31, O33, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20230233.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个关于社交网络中的战略实验模型，其中具有前瞻性意识的个体会从自身及邻近个体的成功中学习。在均衡状态下，私人发现行为之后会伴随着社交传播。社交学习会抑制个体自身的实验行为，因此随着网络密度的增加，总信息量会减少；我们确定了网络密度阈值，低于这些阈值时，个体的渐进学习才能达到完美水平。相比之下，个体福利在一定的网络密度下达到单一峰值，并在介于两者之间时达到次优水平，这种水平实现了发现与传播的平衡。（JEL D82, D83, D86, O31, O33, Z13）

abstract.text: Politicians may target public goods to benefit their constituents, at the expense of others. I study corruption in the context of Indian electricity and estimate the welfare consequences. Using new administrative billing data and close-election regression discontinuities, I show that billed electricity consumption is lower for constituencies of the winning party by almost 40 percent, while actual consumption, measured by nighttime lights, is higher. I document the covert way in which politicians subsidize constituents by manipulating bills. These actions have substantial welfare implications, with an efficiency loss of US$0.9 billion, leading to unreliable electricity supply and significant negative consequences for development. (JEL D72, D73, L94, L98, O13, O17)

10.1257/aer.20230248.abstractZh: 政客们可能会将公共物品作为目标来惠及自己的选民，而牺牲其他人的利益。我在印度电力的背景下研究了腐败现象，并估算了其带来的福利影响。通过新的行政计费数据以及选举临近时的回归不连续性，我发现获胜政党所在选区的计费用电量低了近40%，而实际用电量则因夜间灯光的使用而有所增加。我还记录了政客们通过操纵账单来变相补贴选民的行为。这些行为对福利产生了重大影响，导致效率损失达9亿美元，进而造成电力供应不稳定，并对发展产生严重的负面影响。（JEL D72, D73, L94, L98, O13, O17）

abstract.text: A monotone function interval is the set of monotone functions that lie pointwise between two fixed, -monotone functions. We characterize the set of extreme points of monotone function intervals and apply this to a number of economic settings. First, we leverage the main result to characterize the set of distributions of posterior quantiles that can be induced by a signal, with applications to political economy, Bayesian persuasion, and the psychology of judgment. Second, we combine our characterization with properties of convex optimization problems to unify and generalize seminal results in the literature on security design under adverse selection and moral hazard. (JEL C61, C65, D72, D82, D91, G12)

10.1257/aer.20230330.abstractZh: 单调函数区间是指那些位于两个固定的单调函数之间的单调函数集合。我们描述了单调函数区间的极点集合，并将其应用于多个经济领域。首先，我们利用这一主要结果来描述由信号引发的后验分位数的分布集合，这些结果在政治经济学、贝叶斯说服以及判断心理学等领域有应用价值。其次，我们将这一描述与凸优化问题的性质结合起来，从而统一并推广了关于在逆向选择和道德风险下的安全设计领域的研究成果。（JEL C61, C65, D72, D82, D91, G12）

abstract.text: I propose and test a new channel through which covered interest rate parity (CIP) deviations can affect bank lending in emerging economies. I argue that when CIP deviations exist, banks attempt to arbitrage them. To do so, banks must borrow in a particular currency. When this currency is scarce, bank lending in the currency required to arbitrage decreases, while they use this currency in their arbitrage activities. I test this channel by exploiting differences in the abilities of Peruvian banks to arbitrage CIP deviations. I find evidence that supports the proposed channel. (JEL F31, G01, G13, G21, O16)

10.1257/aer.20230425.abstractZh: 我提出并测试了一种新的渠道，通过该渠道，覆盖的利率平价偏差可以影响新兴经济体的银行信贷。我认为，当存在利率平价偏差时，银行会试图进行套利。为此，银行必须以特定货币进行借贷。当这种货币稀缺时，银行在该货币中进行套利所需的信贷就会减少，而它们则会在套利活动中使用这种货币。我通过利用秘鲁银行进行利率平价偏差套利能力的差异来测试这一渠道。我发现了一些支持这一假设的证据。（JEL F31, G01, G13, G21, O16）

abstract.text: A signal is a description of an information source that specifies both its correlation with the state and its correlation with other signals. Extending Blackwell (1953), we characterize when one signal is more valuable than another regardless of preferences and regardless of access to other signals. This comparison is equivalent to reveal-or-refine: every realization of the more valuable signal reveals the state or refines the realization of the less valuable signal. We also study other comparisons of signals, including sufficiency, martingale dominance, and Lehmann. Reveal-or-refine is also equivalent to making any of these comparisons robust to access to other signals. (JEL C90, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20230430.abstractZh: 信号是对信息源的描述，它既指明了该信息源与状态的关联，也表明了其与其他信号的关联。在扩展Blackwell（1953）的理论基础上，我们描述了在什么情况下一个信号比另一个信号更有价值，这种比较不受偏好影响，也不受其他信号获取能力的影响。这种比较等同于“揭示-或-细化”：每一个更有价值的信号的实现都会揭示出状态，或者细化出价值较低的信号的实现。我们还研究了其他信号之间的比较，包括充分性、鞅优势以及Lehmann理论。揭示-或-细化也意味着这些比较在考虑其他信号获取能力的情况下仍然成立。（JEL C90, D82, D83）

abstract.text: A monopolist platform uses data to match heterogeneous consumers with multiproduct sellers. The consumers can purchase the products on the platform or search off the platform. The platform sells targeted ads to sellers that recommend their products to consumers and reveals information to consumers about their match values. The revenue-optimal mechanism is a managed advertising campaign that matches products and preferences efficiently. In equilibrium, sellers offer higher qualities at lower unit prices on than off platform. The platform exploits its information advantage to increase its bargaining power vis-à-vis the sellers. Finally, privacy-respecting data-governance rules can lead to welfare gains for consumers. (JEL D11, D42, D44, D82, D83, M37)

10.1257/aer.20230478.abstractZh: 一个垄断平台利用数据将异质消费者与多产品卖家进行匹配。消费者可以在平台上购买产品，也可以直接在平台外搜索产品。平台向卖家提供定向广告，这些广告向消费者推荐他们的产品，并向消费者展示关于产品匹配价值的信息。收入最优机制是一种管理性广告活动，能够高效地将产品与偏好进行匹配。在均衡状态下，卖家在平台内以更低的单位价格提供更高品质的产品。平台利用其信息优势，增强与卖家之间的议价能力。最后，遵守隐私保护的数据管理规则可以为消费者带来福利收益。（JEL D11, D42, D44, D82, D83, M37）

abstract.text: We study how performance metrics affect the allocation of talent by exploiting the introduction of the first citation database in science. For technical reasons, it only covered citations from certain journals and years, creating quasi-random variation: some citations became visible, while others remained invisible. We identify the effects of citation metrics by comparing the predictiveness of visible to invisible citations. Citation metrics increased assortative matching between scientists and departments by reducing information frictions over geographic and intellectual distance. Highly cited scientists from lower-ranked departments (“hidden stars”) and from minorities benefited more. Citation metrics also affected promotions and NSF grants, suggesting Matthew effects. (JEL A14, I23, J44)

10.1257/aer.20230515.abstractZh: 我们研究了绩效指标如何影响人才的分配，通过利用首个科学引用数据库的引入来实现这一研究。由于技术原因，该数据库仅涵盖特定期刊和年份的引用记录，从而产生了一种准随机变化：一些引用变得可见，而另一些则保持不可见。我们通过比较可见引用与不可见引用的预测能力，来识别引用指标的影响。引用指标通过减少地理和智力距离上的信息摩擦，增强了科学家与部门之间的选择性匹配。来自较低排名部门的高被引用科学家（“隐藏明星”）以及来自少数群体的科学家受益更多。引用指标还影响了晋升机会和NSF资助，这表明存在马太效应。（JEL A14, I23, J44）

abstract.text: We document large gender disparities within a government program that entitles 46 million poor individuals to free hospital care. We show that care is not free in practice and higher costs are associated with larger disparities. Lowering care costs increases female utilization but does not reduce gender disparities because marginal beneficiaries are as likely to be male as inframarginals. Long-term exposure to local female leaders reduces disparities by addressing factors lowering female care. In the presence of gender bias, subsidizing social services may fail to address gender inequalities without actions that specifically target females. (JEL H51, I12, I13, I14, J16, O15)

10.1257/aer.20230521.abstractZh: 我们记录了一项政府计划中存在严重的性别差异，该计划为4600万贫困人群提供免费医疗护理。我们发现，实际上这种护理并非免费，且成本越高，性别差异越明显。降低护理成本确实增加了女性的使用率，但并未减少性别差异，因为边缘受益者中男性与女性比例相同。长期接触当地女性领导者可以通过解决降低女性接受护理的因素来减少性别差异。在存在性别偏见的情况下，单纯补贴社会服务可能无法解决性别不平等问题，除非采取专门针对女性的措施。（JEL H51, I12, I13, I14, J16, O15）

abstract.text: We assess the employment and income effects of access to credit dedicated to investment in individual mobility by exploiting time-series variation in access to credit through lotteries for participants in a group-lending mechanism in Brazil. We find that access to credit for investment in individual mobility increases formal employment rates and salaries, yielding an annual rate of return of 12 to 15 percent. Consistent with a geographically broader job search, individuals transition to jobs farther from home and public transportation. Our results suggest that accessing distant labor markets through credit for investment in individual mobility yields high and persistent returns. (JEL D44, E24, G21, G51, J61, J64, O15)

10.1257/aer.20230585.abstractZh: 我们评估了通过巴西的群体借贷机制，利用彩票方式获得的信贷用于个人流动性投资所带来的就业和收入效应。研究发现，用于个人流动性投资的信贷能够提高正式就业率及薪资水平，年均回报率为12%至15%。与更广泛的地域性就业趋势一致，人们更倾向于选择离家更远且依赖公共交通的工作岗位。我们的结果表明，通过信贷投资于个人流动性，能够获取高且持续的回报。（JEL D44, E24, G21, G51, J61, J64, O15）

abstract.text: We develop an empirical Bayes ranking procedure that assigns ordinal grades to noisy measurements, balancing the information content of the assigned grades against the expected frequency of ranking errors. Applying the method to a massive correspondence experiment, we grade the race and gender contact gaps of 97 US employers, the identities of which we disclose for the first time. The grades are presented alongside measures of uncertainty about each firm’s contact gap in an accessible report card that is easily adaptable to other settings where ranks and levels are of simultaneous interest. (JEL C11, D22, J15, J16, J71)

10.1257/aer.20230700.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种实证贝叶斯排序方法，该方法为噪声测量数据分配序数值，同时平衡了所分配等级的信息含量与排名错误的预期频率。该方法被应用于一项大规模的调查实验，我们对97家美国雇主的种族和性别接触差距进行了评估，并首次公开了这些雇主的身份信息。这些等级结果与关于每家公司的接触差距的不确定性度量一起被呈现在一个易于理解的报告卡中，该报告卡可以轻松适应其他需要同时关注排名和等级的情况。（JEL C11, D22, J15, J16, J71）

abstract.text: We study how misperceptions of others’ tastes influence beliefs, demand, and prices in markets with observational learning. Consumers infer a good’s quality from the quantity demanded and price paid by others. When consumers exaggerate the similarity between their and others’ tastes, such “taste projection” generates discrepant quality perceptions, which are decreasing in a projector’s taste and increasing in the observed price. These biased inferences produce an excessively elastic market demand. We also analyze dynamic monopoly pricing with short-lived taste-projecting consumers. Optimal pricing follows a declining path: a high initial price inflates future buyers’ perceptions, and lower subsequent prices induce overadoption. (JEL D42, D83, D91, L15)

10.1257/aer.20230814.abstractZh: 我们研究了他人品味认知偏差如何影响市场中的信念、需求和价格，这些市场具有观察性学习的特点。消费者通过他人对商品的需求量和支付价格来推断商品的质量。当消费者夸大自己与他人的品味相似性时，这种“品味投射”会导致质量认知的差异，这种差异随着投射者品味的增强而减小，随着观察到的价格增加而增大。这些有偏见的推断会导致市场需求过度弹性。我们还分析了具有短暂品味投射行为的消费者的动态垄断定价。最优定价呈现下降趋势：较高的初始价格会提升未来买家的认知，而随后较低的定价则会引发过度采用现象。（JEL D42, D83, D91, L15）

abstract.text: A buyer procures a good owned by a group of sellers whose heterogeneous cost of trade is private information. The buyer must either buy the whole good or nothing, and sellers share the transfer in proportion to their share of the good. We characterize the optimal mechanism: trade occurs if and only if the buyer’s benefit of trade exceeds a weighted average of sellers’ virtual costs. These weights are endogenous, with sellers who are ex ante less inclined to trade receiving higher weight. This mechanism always outperforms posted-price mechanisms. An extension characterizes the entire Pareto frontier. (JEL D44, D63, D82, Q15, Q24)

10.1257/aer.20230914.abstractZh: 买家购买由一群卖家拥有的商品，这些卖家的交易成本包含私人信息。买家必须要么购买整个商品，要么一无所获，而卖家则根据他们所占商品的比例来分配交易收益。我们描述了最优机制：只有当买家的交易收益超过卖家的虚拟成本加权平均值时，交易才会发生。这些权重是内生的，即事前不太愿意交易的卖家会获得更高的权重。这种机制始终优于公开价格机制。进一步的扩展描述了整个帕累托前沿。（JEL D44, D63, D82, Q15, Q24）

abstract.text: This paper characterizes the effects of ambiguity aversion under dispersed information. The equilibrium outcome is observationally equivalent to a Bayesian forecast of the fundamental with increased sensitivity to signals and a pessimistic bias. This equivalence result takes a simple form that accommodates dynamic information and strategic interactions. Applying the result, we show that ambiguity aversion helps rationalize the joint empirical pattern between the bias and persistence of inflation forecasts conditional on household income. In a policy game à la Barro and Gordon (1983) with ambiguity-averse agents, the policy rule features higher average inflation and increased responsiveness to fundamentals. (JEL D81, D83, E31, E37, E71)

10.1257/aer.20231012.abstractZh: 本文描述了在分散信息环境下，模糊厌恶效应所带来的影响。从观察结果来看，均衡结果相当于一个贝叶斯预测，该预测对基本面的敏感度增加，并且存在悲观偏差。这一等价性结果采用了一种简单的形式，能够适应动态信息和策略性互动。通过应用这一结果，我们发现模糊厌恶有助于解释在家庭收入条件下，通胀预测偏差与持续性之间的联合实证模式。在遵循Barro和Gordon（1983）提出的政策博弈模型的情况下，具有模糊厌恶倾向的代理人所采用的政策规则表现为更高的平均通胀率以及更强的对基本面的响应能力。（JEL D81, D83, E31, E37, E71）

abstract.text: From 2002 to 2020, there were over 1,000 mergers of US hospitals. During this period, the FTC took enforcement actions against 13 transactions. However, using the FTC’s standard screening tools, we find that 20 percent of these mergers could have been predicted to meaningfully lessen competition. We show that, from 2010 to 2015, predictably anticompetitive mergers resulted in price increases over 5 percent. We estimate that approximately half of predictably anticompetitive mergers had to be reported to the FTC per the Hart–Scott–Rodino Act. We conclude that there appears to be underenforcement of antitrust laws in the hospital sector. (JEL G34, G38, I11, K21)

10.1257/aeri.20230340.abstractZh: 从2002年到2020年，美国有超过1000家医院进行了合并。在此期间，联邦贸易委员会对13笔交易采取了执法行动。然而，通过联邦贸易委员会的标准筛查工具，我们发现其中20%的合并可能会显著减少竞争。我们指出，在2010年至2015年间，那些具有明显反竞争性质的合并导致价格上涨超过5%。根据《哈特-斯科特-罗迪诺法案》，我们估计大约一半具有明显反竞争性质的合并必须向联邦贸易委员会报告。我们得出结论，医院领域的反垄断法律似乎执行不足。（JEL G34, G38, I11, K21）

abstract.text: How do patient and provider incentives affect the provision of long-term care? Our analysis of 551,000 nursing home stays yields three main insights. First, due to limited cost-sharing, Medicaid-covered residents prolong their nursing home stays instead of transitioning to community-based care. Second, when facility capacity binds, nursing homes shorten Medicaid stays to admit more profitable out-of-pocket private payers. Third, providers react more elastically to financial incentives than patients. Thus, targeting provider incentives through alternative payment models, such as episode-based reimbursement, is more effective than increasing patient cost sharing in facilitating transitions to community-based care and generating long-term care savings. (JEL H51, H75, I11, I13, I18, I38, L84)

10.1257/app.20210264.abstractZh: 患者和提供者的激励措施如何影响长期护理的提供？我们对551,000次养老院住院情况的分析得出了三个主要发现。首先，由于费用分摊的限制，接受医疗补助计划的居民会延长在养老院的生活时间，而不是转向社区护理。其次，当养老院的容量有限时，它们会缩短医疗补助患者的住院时间，以接纳更多盈利的私人付费患者。第三，提供者对财务激励的反应比患者更为灵活。因此，通过替代支付模式，如基于病例的报销，来针对提供者的激励措施，比增加患者的费用分摊更有效地促进向社区护理的过渡，并节省长期护理成本。（JEL H51, H75, I11, I13, I18, I38, L84）

abstract.text: Firms often exploit loopholes in government contracts to boost revenues.The welfare consequences of this behavior depend on how firms use the marginal windfall dollar, yet little evidence exists to guide policymakers.This paper studies how hospitals allocated over $3 billion obtained from gaming a Medicare payment loophole.The average gaming hospital increased both Medicare and total revenue by around 10%, implying large spillovers on other payers.Consistent with theories of organizational behavior, nonprofit hospitals deployed most of the windfall toward operating costs, while for-profits deducted the entire amount off their balance sheet, distributing a substantial portion to executives and shareholders.Accordingly, we detect modest reductions in mortality rates at nonprofits but no changes at for-profits.Our results imply that the consequences of such engineered windfalls vary substantially by hospital ownership.

10.1257/app.20240589.abstractZh: 企业经常利用政府合同的漏洞来增加收入。这种行为对福利的影响取决于企业如何使用这些额外的收入，然而目前几乎没有证据可以指导政策制定者。本文研究了医院如何利用从Medicare支付漏洞中获得的超过30亿美元的收入。平均而言，参与这种行为的医院在Medicare收入和总收入上分别增加了约10%，这意味着对其他支付方产生了较大的影响。根据组织行为学的理论，非营利医院将大部分额外收入用于运营成本，而营利性医院则将所有资金从资产负债表上扣除，并将其中一部分分配给高管和股东。因此，我们发现非营利医院的平均死亡率有所降低，而营利性医院则没有变化。我们的研究结果表明，这种人为制造的额外收入所带来的影响因医院性质的不同而大相径庭。

abstract.text: We study the profitability of bundling by an upstream firm that licenses technologies to downstream competitors and that faces competition for one of its technologies. In an otherwise standard “ Chicago-style” model, the existence of downstream competition can make inefficient bundling profitable. Forcing downstream firms to use an inefficient technology reassures each one that it will face weak competition. This allows the upstream firm to extract more profit through its monopolized technology. A similar logic can make it profitable to degrade interoperability with rival technologies, even without foreclosing competition. Bundling is most profitable when downstream competition is intense and technologies complementary. (JEL D21, D24, D43, D45, G34, L24)

10.1257/mic.20230051.abstractZh: 我们研究了通过向下游竞争对手授权技术并面临其技术竞争的上游企业所进行的捆绑行为的盈利能力。在标准的“芝加哥式”模型中，下游的竞争可以使得低效的捆绑行为变得有利可图。迫使下游企业使用低效的技术可以让他们确信自己将面临较弱的竞争，从而让上游企业能够通过其垄断技术获得更多利润。类似的逻辑也可以使得降低与竞争对手技术的互操作性变得有利可图，即使不排除竞争。当下游竞争激烈且技术具有互补性时，捆绑行为最为有利可图。（JEL D21, D24, D43, D45, G34, L24）

abstract.text: We study how closures of maternity wards affect maternal and neonatal health. Using data on all hospital births in Sweden between 1990 and 2004, we compare changes in birth-related outcomes across hospital catchment areas that were differently exposed to ward closures. Our findings show that the closures increased maternal obstetric trauma but also decreased fetal stress and infant trauma among newborns. Adverse maternal outcomes are mainly driven by ward overcrowding, whereas increases in travel distance have no distinguishable effects. Positive effects on infant health reflect a shift of births from smaller to larger wards of higher quality. (JEL D24, G34, I11, I12, I18, J13, J16)

10.1257/pol.20200734.abstractZh: 我们研究了产科病房关闭对孕产妇和新生儿健康的影响。利用1990年至2004年间瑞典所有医院分娩的数据，我们比较了不同医院辖区在产科病房关闭后出生相关结果的变化。研究发现，病房关闭增加了孕产妇的产科创伤，但同时也降低了胎儿的压力和新生儿的创伤。孕产妇的不良结果主要源于病房的过度拥挤，而旅行距离的增加则没有显著影响。对婴儿健康的积极影响反映了出生婴儿从规模较小但质量更高的病房转移到了规模较大且质量更高的病房中。（JEL D24, G34, I11, I12, I18, J13, J16）

abstract.text: Governments face many constraints in attracting talented managers to the public sector, which often lacks high-powered incentives. In this paper, we study how a civil service reform in Chile changed the effectiveness of a vital group of public sector managers: school principals. First, we estimate principal effectiveness by using an extension of the canonical teacher value-added model. Then we evaluate the effect of the reform on principal effectiveness using a difference-in-differences approach. We find that public schools appointed more effective managers and improved their students’ outcomes after increasing the competitiveness and transparency of their selection process. (JEL D73, H83, I21, J24, J45, O15)

10.1257/pol.20220732.abstractZh: 政府在吸引有才华的管理人员进入公共部门时面临许多限制，因为公共部门往往缺乏高层次的激励措施。在本文中，我们研究了智利的一项公务员改革如何改变了公共部门管理者这一重要群体的效率。首先，我们通过扩展经典的教师增值模型来估算管理者的效率。然后，我们使用差异-差异方法评估改革对管理者效率的影响。我们发现，通过提高选拔过程的竞争性和透明度，公立学校能够任命更有效的管理者，并改善学生的学业成绩。（JEL D73, H83, I21, J24, J45, O15）

abstract.text: The healthcare market struggles with information asymmetry, limiting patients’ ability to make informed hospital choices. Aiming to bridge this gap, review platforms like Yelp have begun displaying hospitals’ clinical quality data alongside consumer reviews. However, our research uncovers that Yelp’s introduction of maternity care clinical quality measures unexpectedly resulted in lower subsequent Yelp ratings for high-quality hospitals with insufficient staffing. Employing precise foot traffic data and transfer deep learning, we discovered that high-quality, yet understaffed, hospitals experienced a surge in patient volume, which strained their resources and diminished patient satisfaction, leading to negative reviews. This finding has significant implications, signaling the unintended consequences of revealing clinical quality measures, including potential financial losses for hospitals because of reduced federal funding. This research not only contributes to our understanding the dynamics of patient satisfaction but also, offers actionable insights for high-quality hospitals to mitigate the negative impacts of unexpected visibility on review platforms. Our research underscores the importance for patients to discern between objective clinical quality measures and self-reported subjective ratings in their decision-making process. This research applies machine learning and transfer deep learning techniques to healthcare analytics, offering a deeper understanding of the interplay between information disclosure, online reviews, patient satisfaction, and hospital management.

10.1287/isre.2021.0630.abstractZh: 医疗市场面临着信息不对称的问题，这限制了患者做出明智的医院选择的能力。为了弥补这一缺口，像Yelp这样的评论平台开始展示医院的临床质量数据以及消费者的评价。然而，我们的研究发现，Yelp引入的产科护理临床质量指标，意外地导致那些人员不足的优质医院在Yelp上的评分下降。通过精确的流量数据和深度学习技术，我们发现那些高质量但人员不足的医院患者数量激增，这加剧了资源紧张，降低了患者满意度，从而导致负面评价。这一发现具有重要意义，它揭示了揭示临床质量指标所带来的意外后果，包括医院可能因联邦资金减少而面临财务损失。这项研究不仅有助于我们理解患者满意度的动态变化，还为优质医院提供了可行的建议，以缓解意外曝光对评论平台的影响。我们的研究强调了患者在决策过程中区分客观临床质量指标和主观评价的重要性。这项研究运用机器学习和深度学习技术进行医疗分析，更深入地理解了信息披露、在线评论、患者满意度和医院管理之间的相互作用。

abstract.text: This paper studies how competitive dynamics shape innovative firms’ voluntary disclosure of product quality information. Our empirical context is the pharmaceutical industry, where firms must decide whether to disclose private drug quality information acquired in clinical trials. Using a difference-in-difference strategy, we show that the approval of a competitor’s drug lowers the likelihood of a firm reporting its clinical trial results by 13%. We explore how these effects vary based on the project quality, competitor type, and firm experience. These findings suggest that strategic considerations play a role in firms’ disclosure decisions; in response to a competitor’s drug approval, firms may selectively withhold information to maintain and improve their competitive position. This paper was accepted by Joshua Gans, business strategy. Funding: This work was funded by the National Institute on Aging [Grant T32-AG000186] and the UCLA Society of Hellman Fellows Program. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01161 .

10.1287/mnsc.2022.01161.abstractZh: 本文研究了竞争动态如何影响创新型企业对产品质量信息的自愿披露行为。我们的实证研究对象是制药行业，这些企业必须决定是否披露在临床试验中获得的私人药物质量信息。通过差分回归策略，我们发现竞争对手药物获批会降低企业报告临床试验结果的可能性13%。我们进一步探讨了这些效应如何因项目质量、竞争对手类型以及企业经验的不同而有所差异。研究结果表明，战略考量在企业的披露决策中起着重要作用；在竞争对手药物获批的情况下，企业可能会选择性地隐瞒信息，以维护并提升自身的竞争地位。本文由商业战略领域的Joshua Gans审阅并接受了发表。本研究得到了美国国家老龄化研究所[资助号T32-AG000186]以及加州大学洛杉矶分校Hellman研究员计划的资助。补充材料可访问https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01161获取。

abstract.text: We use clinical data on more than 240,000 surgeries and quasi-experimental methods to examine how physicians respond to the surprise release of a performance “report card.” Such feedback interventions are commonly used to encourage physicians to improve performance yet show limited evidence of success. Our results show that these limited effects mask heterogeneous behavioral responses to feedback valence. In particular, physicians improve more from positive feedback than from negative feedback, with negative feedback even reducing performance for a nontrivial share of patients. Experiments with laypersons replicate these results and show that struggles with negative feedback can be mitigated by giving incentives directly tied to improvement and by adding qualitative information that helps individuals interpret past performance. These results are consistent with behavioral models that suggest cognitive and emotional difficulties limit how well individuals use negative feedback. Thus, feedback interventions in healthcare should be carefully designed to mitigate these counterproductive behavioral responses. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Funding: We acknowledge generous funding provided by Tilburg University and the University of Massachusetts Amherst to run the laboratory experiments. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01340 .

10.1287/mnsc.2023.01340.abstractZh: 我们使用了超过24万例手术的临床数据，并采用准实验方法，来研究医生对突然发布的绩效“报告卡”的反应。这类反馈干预措施通常用于鼓励医生改进绩效，但成功证据有限。我们的研究结果表明，这些有限的效应掩盖了人们对反馈价值的不同行为反应。具体而言，医生从正面反馈中获益更多，而从负面反馈中获益较少，甚至会导致相当一部分患者的绩效下降。针对普通人的实验也证实了这些结果，表明通过提供与改进直接相关的激励措施，以及增加有助于个人解读过去绩效的定性信息，可以减轻负面反馈带来的困扰。这些结果与行为模型一致，该模型认为认知和情绪上的困难限制了个体对负面反馈的有效利用。因此，医疗保健领域的反馈干预措施应精心设计，以缓解这些反效果行为反应。本文由Ranjani Krishnan负责会计工作。资金支持：我们感谢蒂尔堡大学和马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校提供的慷慨资助，用于开展实验室实验。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01340获取。

abstract.text: HIV services for key populations (KP) at higher risk of HIV infection are often delivered by community-based organizations. To achieve HIV epidemic control, countries need to scale up HIV services for KP. Little is known about the management practices of community-based organizations delivering health services. We explored the management practices and facility characteristics of community-based health facilities providing HIV services to key populations as part of the LINKAGES program in Kenya and Malawi. We collected information on management practices from 45 facilities called drop-in centers (DICs) during US Government FY 2019, adapting the World Management Survey to the HIV community-based health service delivery context. We constructed management domain scores for each facility. We then analyzed the statistical correlations between management domains (performance monitoring, people management, financial management, and community engagement) and facility characteristics (e.g., number of staff, organization maturity, service scale) using ordinary least square models. The lowest mean management domain scores were found for people management in Kenya (38.3) and financial management in Malawi (25.7). The highest mean scores in both countries were for performance monitoring (80.9 in Kenya and 82.2 in Malawi). Within each management domain, there was significant variation across DICs, with the widest ranges in scores (0 to 100) observed for financial management and community involvement. The DIC characteristics we considered explained only a small proportion of the variation in management domain scores across DICs. Community-based health facilities providing HIV services to KP can achieve high levels of management in a context where they receive adequate levels of above-facility support and oversight-even if they deliver complex services, rely heavily on temporary workers and community volunteers, and face significant financial constraints. The variation in scores suggests that some facilities may require more above-facility support and oversight than others.

10.1371/journal.pgph.0002813.abstractZh: 针对感染风险较高的关键人群提供HIV服务，通常由社区组织负责。为了实现HIV疫情控制，各国需要扩大对关键人群提供的HIV服务。关于提供健康服务的社区组织的管理实践，目前了解甚少。作为LINKAGES项目的一部分，我们在肯尼亚和马拉维研究了为关键人群提供HIV服务的社区医疗机构的管理实践及设施特征。我们在2019财年收集了45个名为“求助中心”的医疗机构的管理实践信息，并采用了适用于HIV社区医疗服务背景的世界管理调查方法。我们为每个医疗机构构建了管理领域评分。随后，我们使用普通最小二乘法分析了管理领域（绩效监控、人员管理、财务管理及社区参与）与设施特征（如员工数量、组织成熟度、服务规模）之间的统计相关性。结果显示，肯尼亚在人员管理领域的平均评分最低，为38.3；马拉维在财务管理领域的平均评分最低，为25.7。两国的最高平均评分均出现在绩效监控领域，肯尼亚为80.9，马拉维为82.2。在每个管理领域内，不同求助中心之间存在显著差异，其中财务管理及社区参与领域的评分范围最为广泛（0至100）。我们考虑的求助中心特征仅能解释部分管理领域评分的差异。在能够获得足够的设施支持与监督的情况下，以社区为基础的卫生设施在肯尼亚北部能够提供高质量的艾滋病服务。即便这些设施需要提供复杂的服务，严重依赖临时工作人员和社区志愿者，并且面临巨大的财务压力，它们依然能够保持高水平的管理效率。评分结果的不同表明，某些设施可能需要比其他设施更多的支持与监督。

abstract.text: INTRODUCTION: Contradictions remain on the impact of interhospital competition on the quality of care, mainly the mortality. The aim of the study is to evaluate the impact of interhospital competition on postoperative mortality after surgery for colorectal cancer in France. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cross-sectional study from 2015 to 2019. Data were collected from a National Health Database. Patients operated on for colorectal cancer in a hospital in mainland France were included. Competition was measured using number of competitors by distance-based approach. A mixed-effect model was carried out to test the link between competition and mortality. RESULTS: Ninety-five percent (n = 152,235) of the 160,909 people operated on for colorectal cancer were included in our study. The mean age of patients was 70.4 ±12.2 years old, and female were more represented (55%). A total of 726 hospitals met the criteria for inclusion in our study. Mortality at 30 days was 3.6% and we found that the mortality decreases with increasing of the hospital activity. Using the number of competitors per distance method, our study showed that a "highly competitive" and "moderately competitive" markets decreased mortality by 31% [OR: 0.69 (0.59, 0.80); p<0.001] and by 12% respectively [OR: 0.88 (0.79, 0.99); p<0.03], compared to the "non-competitive" market. High hospital volume (100> per year) was also associated to lower mortality rate [OR: 0.74 (0.63, 0.86); p<0.001]. CONCLUSIONS: The results of our studies show that increasing hospital competition independently decreases the 30-day mortality rate after colorectal cancer surgery. Hospital caseload, patients' characteristics and age also impact the post-operative mortality.

10.1371/journal.pone.0291672.abstractZh: 引言：医院间的竞争对护理质量的影响仍然存在矛盾，尤其是死亡率方面。本研究旨在评估医院间竞争对法国结直肠癌术后死亡率的影响。方法：我们进行了2015至2019年的回顾性横断面研究，数据来自国家健康数据库。纳入了在法国大陆某医院接受结直肠癌手术的患者。通过基于距离的方法，以竞争者的数量来衡量竞争程度。采用混合效应模型来检验竞争与死亡率之间的关系。结果：在160,909名接受结直肠癌手术的患者中，有95%（n = 152,235）被纳入本研究。患者的平均年龄为70.4 ±12.2岁，女性占多数（55%）。共有726家医院符合纳入研究的标准。30天内的死亡率为3.6%，我们发现随着医院活动的增加，死亡率下降。使用基于距离的方法，我们的研究表明，“高度竞争”和“中等竞争”的市场分别使死亡率降低了31%[OR: 0.69 (0.59, 0.80); p<0.001]和12%[OR: 0.88 (0.79, 0.99); p<0.03]，相比之下，“非竞争”市场则没有这种效果。高医院手术量（每年100台以上）也与较低的死亡率相关[OR: 0.74 (0.63, 0.86); p<0.001]。结论：我们的研究结果表明，医院间的竞争增加会独立降低结直肠癌手术后的30天死亡率。医院手术量、患者特征和年龄也会影响术后死亡率。

abstract.text: The field of sustainability accounting aims to integrate environmental, social, and governance factors into financial reporting. With the growing importance of sustainability practices, emerging technologies have the potential to revolutionize reporting methods. However, there is a lack of research on the factors influencing the adoption of blockchain and cloud-based sustainability accounting in China. This study employs a mixed-methods approach to examine the key drivers and barriers to technology adoption for sustainability reporting among Chinese businesses. Through a systematic literature review, gaps in knowledge were identified. Primary data was collected through an online survey of firms, followed by in-depth case studies.
