The findings of the study reveal a positive relationship between company size and reporting behaviors. However, size alone is not sufficient to predict outcomes accurately. The industry type also has significant but small effects, although its impact on reporting behaviors varies. The relationship between profitability and reporting behaviors is intricate and contingent, requiring contextual examination. The adoption of blockchain technology is positively associated with capabilities, resources, skills, and regulatory factors. On the other hand, cloud computing adoption is linked to resources, management support, and risk exposures. However, the specific impacts of industry on adoption remain inconclusive. This study aims to offer empirical validation of relationships, shedding light on the intricate nature of interactions that necessitate nuanced conceptualizations incorporating contextual moderators. The findings underscore the importance of providing customized support and adaptable guidance to accommodate the evolving practices in sustainability accounting. Moreover, the assimilation of technology and organizational changes highlights the need for multifaceted stakeholder cooperation to drive responsible innovation and address the challenges posed by digital transformations in this field.

10.1371/journal.pone.0295802.abstractZh: 可持续性会计领域旨在将环境、社会和治理因素融入财务报告之中。随着可持续性实践的重要性日益凸显，新兴技术有潜力彻底改变报告方式。然而，关于影响中国企业采用区块链和基于云的可持续性会计的因素的研究尚不足。本研究采用混合方法研究中国企业在可持续性报告中的技术采用的关键驱动因素和障碍。通过系统的文献回顾，发现了知识上的空白。通过在线调查企业收集原始数据，并进行了深入的案例研究。研究结果表明，公司规模与报告行为之间存在正相关关系。然而，仅靠规模不足以准确预测结果。行业类型虽然也有显著影响，但影响较小，其对报告行为的影响则有所不同。盈利能力与报告行为之间的关系复杂且受情境影响，需要具体分析。区块链技术的采用与能力、资源、技能以及监管因素呈正相关。另一方面，云计算的采用则与资源、管理支持和风险暴露有关。然而，不同行业对技术采用的具体影响仍不明确。本研究旨在提供这些关系的实证验证，揭示需要细致概念化并考虑情境调节因素的复杂互动关系。研究结果表明，为可持续性会计的不断发展提供定制化的支持和适应性指导至关重要。此外，技术的融合与组织变革的推进，凸显了多方利益相关者合作的重要性，以推动负责任的创新，并应对这一领域数字化转型所带来的挑战。

abstract.text: INTRODUCTION: In many tax-based healthcare systems, policymakers have introduced reforms that promote provider competition with the intention of improving the quality and efficiency. Healthcare competition is usually defined spatially, with local markets often being identified as a circle around each provider. We argue that existing local market definitions can be improved to better capture actual local markets. For pro-competition reforms to potentially lead to the gains envisioned by policymakers, a crucial condition is the actual emergence of competitive markets. However, limited research has been conducted on competition in primary care markets, despite primary care constituting a vital part of a healthcare system. AIM: The study aims to contribute to the debate on how to define local markets geographically and to examine provider competition in Swedish primary care. METHODS: A cross-sectional study was conducted using data on all individuals and all primary care providers in Sweden. Local markets were defined as: fixed radius (1 km and 3 km); variable radius; and variable shape-our new local market definition that allows markets to vary in both size and shape. Competition was measured using the Herfindahl-Hirschman index and a count of the number of competitors within the local market. RESULTS: Fixed radius markets fail to capture variation within and across geographical areas. The variable radius and variable shape markets are similar but do not always identify the same competitors or level of competition. Furthermore, competition levels vary significantly in Swedish primary care. Many providers operate in monopoly markets, whereas others face high competition. CONCLUSIONS: While the variable shape approach has the potential to better capture actual markets and more accurately identify competitors, further analyses are needed. Moreover, Swedish policymakers are advised to decide whether to still pursue competition and if so, take measures to improve local market conditions in monopolies.

10.1371/journal.pone.0304994.abstractZh:
引言：在许多基于税收的医疗保健系统中，政策制定者引入了促进医疗服务提供者竞争的改革，旨在提高医疗服务的质量和效率。医疗服务的竞争通常是以空间为单位的，当地市场通常被定义为围绕每个医疗服务提供者的一个区域。我们认为，现有的当地市场定义可以改进，以更好地反映实际的当地市场状况。为了使竞争改革能够带来政策制定者所期望的收益，一个关键条件是实际出现竞争市场。然而，尽管初级医疗服务是医疗保健系统的重要组成部分，但关于初级医疗服务市场中的竞争的研究却很少。

目的：本研究旨在为如何地理上定义当地市场以及考察瑞典初级医疗服务提供者之间的竞争提供见解。

方法：本研究采用横断面研究方法，使用了瑞典所有个人和所有初级医疗服务提供者的数据。当地市场被定义为：固定半径（1公里和3公里）；可变半径；以及可变形状——我们的新当地市场定义允许市场在规模和形状上有所不同。竞争程度通过赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数以及当地市场内竞争者的数量来衡量。

结果：固定半径的市场无法捕捉到不同地理区域内部的差异。可变半径和可变形状的市场虽然相似，但并不总是能识别出相同的竞争者或竞争水平。此外，瑞典初级医疗服务的竞争水平存在显著差异。许多医疗服务提供者处于垄断市场，而另一些则面临激烈的竞争。结论：虽然可变形状方法有潜力更好地捕捉实际市场情况，并更准确地识别竞争对手，但仍需进一步分析。此外，瑞典的政策制定者应决定是否继续推行竞争政策，如果决定继续，则应采取措施改善垄断企业的本地市场状况。

abstract.text: Peru has a fragmented health insurance system in which most insureds can only access the providers in their insurer's network. The two largest sub-systems covered about 53% and 30% of the population at the start of the pandemic; however, some individuals have dual insurance and can thereby access both sets of providers. We use data on 24.7 million individuals who belonged to one or both sub-systems to investigate the effect of dual insurance on COVID-19 mortality. We estimate recursive bivariate probit models using the difference in the distance to the nearest hospital in the two insurance sub-systems as Instrumental Variable. The effect of dual insurance was to reduce COVID-19 mortality risk by 0.23% compared with the sample mean risk of 0.54%. This implies that the 133,128 COVID-19 deaths in the sample would have been reduced by 56,418 (95%CI: 34,894, 78,069) if all individuals in the sample had dual insurance.

10.1371/journal.pone.0309531.abstractZh: 秘鲁的医疗保险体系较为分散，大多数参保者只能使用其保险公司网络内的医疗服务提供者。在疫情初期，两个最大的保险子系统分别覆盖了约53%和30%的人口；然而，一些个体拥有双重保险，因此能够使用两套医疗服务提供者。我们利用2470万个体的数据来研究双重保险对COVID-19死亡率的影响。我们通过使用两个保险子系统中最近医院的距离差异作为工具变量，建立了递归双变量Probit模型。结果表明，双重保险使COVID-19的死亡风险降低了0.23%，而样本平均风险为0.54%。这意味着，如果样本中的所有个体都拥有双重保险，那么样本中的133,128例COVID-19死亡病例将减少56,418例（95%置信区间：34,894至78,069）。

abstract.text: Rising prices are a major cause of increased health care spending and health insurance premiums in the US. Hospital prices, specifically-for both inpatient and outpatient care-are the largest driver of rising health care spending in the commercial insurance market. As a result, policy makers and employers are increasingly interested in understanding the determinants of hospital prices. Hospitals serving as trauma centers are often endowed by regulators with monopoly power over trauma services in their geographic areas, and this monopoly power may spill over to nontrauma services. This study focused on the growing number of designated trauma centers and how trauma center status affects hospital prices for other, nontrauma services. We found that hospitals designated as trauma centers charged higher prices for nontrauma inpatient admissions and nontrauma emergency department visits when compared with hospitals that were not designated as trauma centers, even after controlling for potential confounders.

10.1377/hlthaff.2023.00249.abstractZh: 价格上涨是美国医疗保健支出和医疗保险保费增加的主要原因之一。在医院价格方面，无论是住院还是门诊护理，都是商业保险市场医疗保健支出增长的最大驱动力。因此，政策制定者和雇主越来越关注医院价格的决定因素。作为创伤中心的医院通常拥有监管当局赋予的在其地理区域内对创伤服务的垄断权力，这种垄断权力可能会扩展到非创伤服务领域。本研究重点关注被指定为创伤中心的数量增长，以及创伤中心地位如何影响其他非创伤服务的医院价格。我们发现，被指定为创伤中心的医院在控制潜在混杂因素后，对非创伤住院治疗和非创伤急诊服务的收费仍然高于未被指定为创伤中心的医院。

abstract.text: The use of many services is lower in Medicare Advantage (MA) compared with traditional Medicare, generating cost savings for insurers, whereas the quality of ambulatory services is higher. This study examined the role of selective contracting with providers in achieving these outcomes, focusing on primary care physicians. Assessing primary care physician costliness based on the gap between observed and predicted costs for their traditional Medicare patients, we found that the average primary care physician in MA networks was $433 less costly per patient (2.9 percent of baseline) compared with the regional mean, with less costly primary care physicians included in more networks than more costly ones. Favorable selection of patients by MA primary care physicians contributed partially to this result. The quality measures of MA primary care physicians were similar to the regional mean. In contrast, primary care physicians excluded from all MA networks were $1,617 (13.8 percent) costlier than the regional mean, with lower quality. Primary care physicians in narrow networks were $212 (1.4 percent) less costly than those in wide networks, but their quality was slightly lower. These findings highlight the potential role of selective contracting in reducing costs in the MA program.

10.1377/hlthaff.2023.00803.abstractZh: 与传统医疗保险相比，Medicare Advantage计划中的许多服务使用率较低，这为保险公司带来了成本节约，同时门诊服务的质量更高。本研究探讨了与医疗服务提供方进行选择性签约在实现这些成果中的作用，重点关注初级保健医生。根据初级保健医生为传统医疗保险患者提供的服务与预测成本之间的差距来评估其成本效益，我们发现，在Medicare Advantage计划网络中的初级保健医生，每位患者的平均成本比区域平均水平低433美元（占基线的2.9%），并且更多网络中的初级保健医生的成本更低。Medicare Advantage计划中的初级保健医生选择患者的方式在一定程度上促成了这一结果。这些医生的质量指标与区域平均水平相似。相比之下，被排除在所有Medicare Advantage计划网络之外的初级保健医生，其成本比区域平均水平高出1,617美元（占基线的13.8%），且质量较低。在狭窄网络中的初级保健医生，其成本比在广泛网络中的医生低212美元（占基线的1.4%），但他们的质量略低。这些发现突显了选择性签约在降低Medicare Advantage计划成本方面的潜在作用。

abstract.text: Medicare Part D does not allow plans to exclude drugs in six protected classes from their formularies, which may limit plans' ability to negotiate rebates and lead to higher spending. We estimated the association between protected-class status, US-level estimated rebates, and formulary coverage during the period 2011-19. We found that protected classes indeed had significantly lower exclusion rates in Medicare Part D during this period relative to nonprotected classes, and this difference was larger than the corresponding difference in commercial plans. US-level average rebates grew 22.5 percentage points less in protected than in nonprotected classes during 2011-19, a period when formulary exclusions increased. Relative to nonprotected classes, US-level average rebates in protected classes were especially low among drugs with high Medicare market share. These results suggest that Medicare Part D protected-class policy may reduce rebates.

10.1377/hlthaff.2024.00273.abstractZh: Medicare Part D不允许计划将六大受保护类别的药物排除在处方清单之外，这可能会限制计划协商回扣的能力，并导致更高的支出。我们估算了2011-19年期间，受保护类别状态、美国级别的回扣以及处方清单覆盖情况之间的关联。研究发现，与不受保护类别相比，受保护类别在Medicare Part D中的排除率明显较低，且这一差异大于商业计划中的相应差异。在2011-19年期间，随着处方清单排除范围的扩大，美国级别的回扣在受保护类别中平均减少了22.5个百分点。与不受保护类别相比，受保护类别中的药物在美国级别的回扣尤其低，尤其是那些在Medicare市场中占有较高市场份额的药物。这些结果表明，Medicare Part D的受保护类别政策可能会降低回扣。

abstract.text: Japan and Germany are both facing a rapidly aging population and have similar social insurance-based long-term care systems. However, there are significant differences in utilization and costs. This paper presents a microeconomic decision model validated by regression analysis, Blinder-Oaxaca decomposition, and Data Envelopment Analysis to contrast the utilization patterns in the Japanese and German long-term care sectors. The design of the welfare programs for low-income families has been identified as one of the main reasons. In Germany, the welfare system leads to a demand curve for nursing home care that is comparable to that of an inferior good which makes external long-term care in nursing homes the more attractive, the poorer the respective households are. In addition, the resulting inelastic demand of the population groups in need of social benefits seem to reduces competition among Germany’s long-term care providers, which is associated with a loss of efficiency in how they use production factors. In Japan, this negative outcome is avoided by a comfort segmentation in the nursing home market.

10.1515/roe-2024-0011.abstractZh: 日本和德国都面临着人口迅速老龄化的挑战，并且拥有类似的以社会保险为基础的长期护理体系。然而，在利用情况和成本方面存在显著差异。本文提出了一个微观经济决策模型，并通过回归分析、Blinder-Oaxaca分解和数据包络分析来验证该模型，以对比日本和德国长期护理领域的利用模式。研究发现，针对低收入家庭的福利计划是其中一个主要原因。在德国，福利体系导致对养老院护理的需求曲线类似于劣等商品的需求曲线，这使得对于经济较为贫困的家庭来说，外部养老院提供的长期护理更具吸引力。此外，需要社会救济的人群的非弹性需求似乎减少了德国长期护理提供者之间的竞争，这导致了他们在使用生产要素方面的效率下降。在日本，通过养老院市场的细分市场划分，避免了这种负面结果。

abstract.text: Can better information on the value of diagnostic tests improve adoption and help patients recognize higher quality of care? In a randomized experiment in public clinics in Mali, providers and patients received tailored information about the importance of rapid diagnostic tests (RDT) for malaria. The provider training increased reliance on RDTs and improved the match between a patient’s malaria status and treatment with antimalarials by 15–30 percent. Nonetheless, patients were significantly less satisfied with the care they received, driven by those whose prior beliefs did not match their malaria status. The patient information intervention reduced malaria testing and did not improve treatment outcomes or patient satisfaction. These findings are consistent with highly persistent patient beliefs and distrust of the promoted diagnostic technology, which translate into low demand and limit patients’ ability to recognize improved quality of care.

10.1596/1813-9450-10746.abstractZh: 关于诊断测试价值的更详细信息能否提高患者的接受度，并帮助他们认识到更高质量的护理？在马里的一些公共诊所进行的一项随机实验中，医疗服务提供者和患者都收到了关于快速诊断测试在疟疾诊断中的重要性方面的个性化信息。提供者的培训增加了对快速诊断测试的依赖，并将患者疟疾状况与抗疟药物治疗之间的匹配度提高了15-30%。然而，由于部分患者之前的信念与其疟疾状况不符，他们对所接受的护理满意度显著下降。患者信息干预措施减少了疟疾检测的数量，但并未改善治疗结果或患者的满意度。这些发现与患者信念的顽固性以及他们对推广的诊断技术的不信任有关，这些因素导致需求较低，并限制了患者认识到更高质量护理的能力。

abstract.text: We study the problem of agent selection in causal strategic learning under multiple decision makers and address two key challenges that come with it. Firstly, while much of prior work focuses on studying a fixed pool of agents that remains static regardless of their evaluations, we consider the impact of selection procedure by which agents are not only evaluated, but also selected. When each decision maker unilaterally selects agents by maximising their own utility, we show that the optimal selection rule is a trade-off between selecting the best agents and providing incentives to maximise the agents' improvement. Furthermore, this optimal selection rule relies on incorrect predictions of agents' outcomes. Hence, we study the conditions under which a decision maker's optimal selection rule will not lead to deterioration of agents' outcome nor cause unjust reduction in agents' selection chance. To that end, we provide an analytical form of the optimal selection rule and a mechanism to retrieve the causal parameters from observational data, under certain assumptions on agents' behaviour. Secondly, when there are multiple decision makers, the interference between selection rules introduces another source of biases in estimating the underlying causal parameters. To address this problem, we provide a cooperative protocol which all decision makers must collectively adopt to recover the true causal parameters. Lastly, we complement our theoretical results with simulation studies. Our results highlight not only the importance of causal modeling as a strategy to mitigate the effect of gaming, as suggested by previous work, but also the need of a benevolent regulator to enable it.

10.1609/aaai.v38i14.29466.abstractZh: 我们研究了在多个决策者参与的因果策略学习中的代理人选择问题，并解决了随之而来的两个关键挑战。首先，尽管以往的研究大多集中在固定数量的代理人上，这些代理人无论其评估如何都保持不变，但我们考虑了选择程序的影响，即代理人不仅被评估，还被选择。当每个决策者通过最大化自己的效用单方面选择代理人时，我们发现最优选择规则是在选择最佳代理人和激励代理人改进之间取得平衡。此外，这一最优选择规则依赖于对代理人结果的错误预测。因此，我们研究了决策者的最优选择规则不会导致代理人结果恶化或导致代理人选择机会的不公正减少的条件。为此，我们在某些关于代理人行为的假设下，提供了最优选择规则的分析形式以及从观测数据中获取因果参数的机制。其次，当存在多个决策者时，选择规则之间的干扰引入了估计潜在因果参数的另一个偏差来源。为了解决这个问题，我们提供了一个合作协议，所有决策者必须共同采用该协议以恢复真实的因果参数。最后，我们通过模拟研究补充了我们的理论结果。我们的结果不仅强调了因果建模作为缓解博弈效应策略的重要性，正如以往的研究所建议的，还强调了需要一个仁慈的监管机构来实现这一点。

abstract.text: Bu çalışmanın amacı, sağlık hizmetlerinde mantar yönetim yaklaşımının ekip performansına etkisini tespit etmek ve bu etkileşimde kolektif etkinliğin aracılık rolü ile rekabetin düzenleyici rolünü araştırmaktır. Bu kapsamda çalışmada; Gaziantep’te faaliyet gösteren kamu ve özel sağlık kuruluşlarından kolayda örneklem yöntemiyle anket tekniği kullanılarak 449 sağlık çalışanından veriler elde edilmiştir. Verilerin analizi için yapısal eşitlik modeli (YEM) kullanılmıştır. Yapılan analizler sonucunda; sağlık kuruluşlarında mantar yönetim yaklaşımının ekip performansını pozitif yönde etkilediği ve bu etkileşimde kolektif etkinliğin aracılık rolü olduğu, rekabetin ise düzenleyici etkisinin olduğu görülmüştür.

10.17233/sosyoekonomi.2024.03.14.abstractZh: 本研究的目的是探讨在医疗服务中，蘑菇管理策略对团队绩效的影响，以及在这一互动过程中，集体行动在调解作用与竞争在调节作用中的角色。为此，本研究采用抽样方法，从加济安泰普市的公营和私营医疗机构中选取了449名医护人员作为样本，使用问卷调查技术收集数据。数据分析采用了结构方程模型（YEM）。分析结果显示，蘑菇管理策略对团队绩效有积极影响，其中集体行动在调解作用中发挥了作用，而竞争则起到了调节作用。

abstract.text: La présente étude porte sur le rôle de la concurrence et de la réglementation dans les résultats et expériences des consommateurs dans le secteur du soin (accueil de la petite enfance et soins de longue durée). Ces deux services sont essentiels au bien-être économique et social, notamment au vu de l’évolution démographique et de leurs conséquences transversales sur d’autres composantes de l’économie, comme la participation des femmes à la vie active. L'étude analyse comment la concurrence et la réglementation peuvent favoriser la qualité et les résultats du marché, tout en s’attaquant aux défaillances du marché et aux préoccupations d’équité au sein du secteur, afin d’arriver à une conclusion sur le rôle que peuvent jouer les autorités de la concurrence.

10.1787/1e6ed2d6-fr.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了竞争与监管在护理行业（包括婴幼儿照护和长期护理）中对消费者体验和结果的影响。这两项服务对经济和社会福祉至关重要，尤其是考虑到人口结构的变化及其对其他经济领域的跨部门影响，例如女性参与劳动市场的情况。研究分析了竞争与监管如何促进市场质量和结果，同时解决市场中的缺陷和公平性问题，从而得出关于竞争监管机构可能发挥的作用的结论。

abstract.text: This paper explores the role of competition and regulation in shaping the outcomes and consumer experiences of the care industry (early childhood care and long-term care). Both services are vital to economic and social well-being, particularly in light of demographic change and the cross-cutting implications for other aspects of the economy, such as women’s participation in the labour market. This paper analyses how competition and regulation can drive quality and market outcomes, whilst addressing market failures and equity concerns within the industry, to arrive at a conclusion on the role competition authorities can play.

10.1787/cef35d7c-en.abstractZh: 本文探讨了竞争与监管在塑造护理行业（包括早期儿童护理和长期护理）的成果及消费者体验中的作用。这两种服务对于经济和社会福祉至关重要，尤其是在人口结构变化的情况下，它们对其他经济领域也产生了广泛影响，例如女性参与劳动力市场的情况。本文分析了竞争与监管如何推动服务质量和市场成果，同时解决行业内的市场失灵和公平问题，最终得出关于竞争管理部门可以发挥的作用的结论。

abstract.text: Health services management often goes unrecognized for its career potential and contribution to health care organizations (HCOs). Few children dream of becoming health services managers, instead aspiring to become physicians, nurses, or other clinicians acclaimed for their lifesaving skills. However, after learning more about the day-to-day duties of clinical professions, some people opt to pursue other meaningful careers. In this search, some people discover a talent for management, recognizing that they are planners and organizers, goal oriented, and strategically minded. Because they enjoy working in teams and solving difficult problems, organizations value them for their management potential. Health services managers, also known as healthcare administrators, ensure efficient and effective operational, financial, and administrative functions of HCOs. Employment in these positions is projected to grow several times faster than the average for all occupations and the management positions of other industries.

10.1891/9780826148070.0001.abstractZh: 健康服务管理往往被忽视，因为它在职业发展和对医疗机构的贡献方面具有巨大潜力。很少有孩子梦想成为健康服务管理者，他们更希望成为医生、护士或其他以救命技能著称的临床医生。然而，在了解临床职业的日常职责后，一些人选择追求其他有意义的职业。在这个过程中，一些人发现自己具有管理天赋，他们善于规划、组织，具有目标导向和战略思维。由于他们喜欢团队合作和解决复杂问题，因此组织非常看重他们的管理潜力。健康服务管理者，也被称为医疗保健管理员，负责确保医疗机构在运营、财务和行政方面的高效运作。这些职位的就业增长速度预计将远高于所有职业的平均水平，以及其他行业的管理职位。

abstract.text: Las redes hospitalarias estrechas han proliferado en los sistemas sanitarios con competencia de asistencia gestionada. En este trabajo investigamos el efecto causal de la amplitud de la red hospitalaria en la mortalidad de los pacientes. Para identificar este efecto, aprovechamos las cancelaciones de aseguradoras y las posteriores cancelaciones de hospitales integrados verticalmente. Utilizamos datos del sistema sanitario colombiano, donde la mayor aseguradora de salud (Saludcoop) y sus hospitales fueron dados de baja a finales de 2015. Los resultados muestran que las aseguradoras de red amplia reducen la mortalidad de los pacientes porque incluyen hospitales de alta calidad y pueden tratar más condiciones de salud. Nuestros resultados sugieren que, en un entorno sin competencia de precios, el acceso a la atención sanitaria a través de unas pocas aseguradoras con redes amplias es mejor para la salud de los pacientes que el acceso a la atención sanitaria a través de muchas aseguradoras con redes estrechas.

10.1920/wp.ifs.2024.2124.abstractZh: 在竞争性的医疗体系中，规模较大的医院网络日益增多。本研究探讨了医院网络规模对病人死亡率的因果关系。为了验证这一效应，我们利用了保险公司的退出以及随后垂直整合的医院退出现象。我们采用了哥伦比亚医疗体系的数据，其中最大的健康保险公司Saludcoop及其附属医院在2015年底被撤出市场。研究结果表明，规模较大的保险公司能够降低病人的死亡率，因为它们涵盖了高质量的医院，并且能够处理更多医疗状况。我们的研究结果表明，在价格不竞争的环境中，通过少数几家规模较大的保险公司获得医疗服务，比通过众多规模较小的保险公司获得医疗服务更能保障病人的健康。

abstract.text: Background and Objective: Increased financial strain on health care systems has accelerated attention on reducing health care costs without compromising quality of care. The rapid adoption of video-assisted thoracic surgery (VATS) over the past decade has led to surging operative costs. A review of cost-minimization strategies specific to VATS lobectomy procedures would serve as a useful resource for implementing value-based care in thoracic surgical practice. Methods: A literature review was carried out using MEDLINE, PubMed, Scopus, Google Scholar, and Cochrane databases between January 1990 and November 2022 to identify all studies on cost reduction in VATS lobectomy, using major search terms “VATS”, “VATS lobectomy”, “thoracoscopy” or “thoracoscopic lobectomy” and “cost”. Studies involving benign diseases were excluded. Also removed were comparison studies of VATS vs. other surgical approaches i.e., uniportal, open thoracotomy or robotic pulmonary resections. Key Content and Findings: Principles of value delivery for VATS lobectomy derived from the literature were reviewed and central themes identified, including avoidance of perioperative complications, cost awareness, value stream mapping/standardization, evidence-based value delivery and performance feedback/peer comparison. Successful cost reduction strategies routinely utilized central principles of behavioral economics. Conclusions: A variety of value improvement initiatives have been demonstrated to reduce costs related to VATS lobectomy without compromising quality. It is important for surgeons to take the lead in maximizing value delivery to guide changes that optimize cost efficiency without compromising surgical care.

10.21037/vats-22-59.abstractZh:
背景与目的：医疗系统面临的财务压力不断增加，这促使人们更加关注在不影响护理质量的前提下降低医疗成本。过去十年中，视频辅助胸腔手术（VATS）的迅速普及导致了手术成本的急剧上升。对VATS肺叶切除术成本最小化策略的综述，将为在胸腔外科实践中实施价值导向的护理提供有用的参考。  

方法：通过检索1990年1月至2022年11月间的MEDLINE、PubMed、Scopus、Google Scholar和Cochrane数据库，收集了所有关于VATS肺叶切除术成本降低的研究。主要检索词包括“VATS”、“VATS肺叶切除术”、“胸腔镜手术”或“胸腔镜肺叶切除术”以及“成本”。涉及良性疾病的研究被排除在外。此外，与VATS相比的其他手术方法（如单门路手术、开放式胸腔切开术或机器人肺切除手术）的比较研究也被排除在外。  

主要内容和发现：通过对文献中VATS肺叶切除术价值传递原则的回顾，确定了核心主题，包括避免手术期间并发症、成本意识、价值流映射/标准化、基于证据的价值传递以及绩效反馈/同行比较。成功的成本降低策略通常运用了行为经济学的核心原则。  

结论：多种价值提升措施已被证明能够降低VATS肺叶切除术的成本，同时不影响护理质量。对于外科医生来说，在优化成本效率的同时，引领价值传递的变革至关重要。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Despite growing interest in delivering high-value orthopaedic care, the costs associated with hip arthroscopy remain poorly understood. By employing time-driven activity-based costing (TDABC), we aimed to characterize the cost composition of hip arthroscopy for labral pathological conditions and to identify factors that drive variation in cost. METHODS: Using TDABC, we measured the costs of 890 outpatient hip arthroscopy procedures for labral pathological conditions across 5 surgeons at 4 surgery centers from 2015 to 2022. All patients were ≥18 years old and were treated by surgeons who each performed ≥20 surgeries during the study period. Costs were normalized to protect the confidentiality of internal hospital cost data. Descriptive analyses and multivariable linear regression were performed to identify factors underlying cost variation. RESULTS: The study sample consisted of 515 women (57.9%) and 375 men (42.1%), with a mean age (and standard deviation) of 37.1 ± 12.7 years. Most of the procedures were performed in patients who were White (90.6%) or not Hispanic (93.4%). The normalized total cost of hip arthroscopy per procedure ranged from 43.4 to 203.7 (mean, 100 ± 24.2). Of the 3 phases of the care cycle, the intraoperative phase was identified as the largest generator of cost (>90%). On average, supply costs accounted for 48.8% of total costs, whereas labor costs accounted for 51.2%. A 2.5-fold variation between the 10th and 90th percentiles for total cost was attributed to supplies, which was greater than the 1.8-fold variation attributed to labor. Variation in total costs was most effectively explained by the labral management method (partial R 2 = 0.332), operating surgeon (partial R 2 = 0.326), osteoplasty type (partial R 2 = 0.087), and surgery center (partial R 2 = 0.086). Male gender (p < 0.001) and younger age (p = 0.032) were also associated with significantly increased costs. Finally, data trends revealed a shift toward labral preservation techniques over debridement during the study period (with the rate of such techniques increasing from 77.8% to 93.2%; P trend = 0.0039) and a strong correlation between later operative year and increased supply costs, labor costs, and operative time (p < 0.001 for each). CONCLUSIONS: By applying TDABC to outpatient hip arthroscopy, we identified wide patient-to-patient cost variation that was most effectively explained by the method of labral management, the operating surgeon, the osteoplasty type, and the surgery center. Given current procedural coding trends, declining reimbursements, and rising health-care costs, these insights may enable stakeholders to design bundled payment structures that better align reimbursements with costs. LEVEL OF EVIDENCE: Economic and Decision Analysis Level IV . See Instructions for Authors for a complete description of levels of evidence.

10.2106/jbjs.23.00500.abstractZh:
背景：尽管人们对提供高价值的骨科护理越来越感兴趣，但与髋关节镜检查相关的成本仍然缺乏了解。我们采用时间驱动的活动基础成本计算法，旨在描述髋关节镜检查在髋关节病变情况下的成本构成，并识别导致成本差异的因素。  
方法：利用时间驱动的活动基础成本计算法，我们测量了2015年至2022年间4家手术中心5名外科医生为髋关节病变患者进行的890次门诊髋关节镜检查的成本。所有患者年龄均超过18岁，且均由在研究期间进行了至少20次手术的医生进行治疗。为了保护医院内部成本数据的隐私，所有成本均进行了标准化处理。我们进行了描述性分析和多变量线性回归分析，以识别成本差异的潜在因素。  
结果：研究样本包括515名女性（57.9%）和375名男性（42.1%），平均年龄为37.1岁，标准差为12.7岁。大多数手术是在白人患者（90.6%）或非西班牙裔患者（93.4%）中进行的。每次髋关节镜检查的标准化总成本在43.4元至203.7元之间（平均值为100元，标准差为24.2元）。在护理周期的三个阶段中，手术期间的成本最高，占比超过90%。平均而言，供应成本占总成本的48.8%，而劳动力成本占51.2%。总成本的10分位数与90分位数之间的差异为2.5倍，这一差异主要归因于供应成本，而劳动力成本的差异为1.8倍。总成本的变化最有效地由以下因素解释：髋关节病变的管理方法（部分R²=0.332）、手术医生（部分R²=0.326）、骨成形术类型（部分R²=0.087）以及手术中心（部分R²=0.086）。男性性别（p < 0.001）和年轻年龄（p = 0.032）也与显著增加的费用相关。最后，数据趋势显示，在研究期间，采用盂唇保留技术而非清创技术的比例有所上升（从77.8%增加到93.2%；P趋势 = 0.0039），并且手术年份与供应成本、劳动力成本以及手术时间的增加之间存在强烈相关性（每项指标均达到p < 0.001）。结论：通过将TDABC应用于门诊髋关节镜检查，我们发现患者间的费用差异很大，而这一差异最有效的解释因素包括盂唇管理方式、手术医生、骨成形术类型以及手术中心。鉴于当前的程序编码趋势、报销率的下降以及医疗成本的上升，这些发现可能有助于相关方设计更合理的捆绑支付结构，从而更好地将报销与成本相匹配。证据等级：经济与决策分析IV级。有关证据等级的完整描述，请参阅作者指南。

abstract.text: We identify a puzzling management practice gap in China. In the South, a one standard deviation increase in firms’ management competency is associated with a 7.5 percent improvement in sales productivity and a 29.2 increase in profitability. But such associations are muted for firms located in the North. The southern firms outperformed the northern firms by 8.1 percent in management practices and in all aspects of administration. We conjecture this is partially related to the convenience of accessing a larger export market in the South. The gap persists even after controlling for known sources of heterogeneity such as firm characteristics and resources. After decomposition, a difference of 6.6 percent in management quality remains unexplained. Remarkably, Northern firms’ management is correlated with mitigating environmental externalities but not for Southern firms. Our study contributes to the understanding of management that is potentially due to regional differences in social norms and institutional factors.

10.2139/ssrn.4739901.abstractZh: 我们发现中国存在一种令人困惑的管理实践差异。在南方，企业管理能力的提升一个标准差，与销售生产力的提高7.5%以及盈利能力提高29.2%之间存在关联。然而，对于位于北方的企业来说，这种关联则较为微弱。南方企业在管理实践以及所有管理方面都优于北方企业，其优势幅度为8.1%。我们认为，这在一定程度上与南方拥有更大的出口市场这一便利条件有关。即使在控制了企业特征和资源等已知异质性因素后，这种差异仍然存在。经过分析，管理质量的6.6%差异仍然无法解释。值得注意的是，北方企业的管理行为与减轻环境外部性之间存在关联，而南方企业则没有这种关联。我们的研究有助于理解这种管理差异，这可能是由于地区社会规范及制度因素的差异所导致的。

abstract.text: How responsive to health shocks are healthcare systems in the developing world? Developing countries are known to have both lower levels of hospital infrastructure and serious health shocks driven by air pollution. These shocks are transitory and may be marginal relative to other health demands, so healthcare systems might be able to manage them. On the other hand, with limited capacity hospitals may not be able to respond rapidly, possibly exacerbating health damages from pollution. In this study, we examine the consequences of health shocks induced by air pollution in a megacity in the developing world: Sao Paulo, Brazil. Using daily data on pediatric hospitalizations from 2015-2017, an instrumental variable approach based on wind speed, and a plausibly exogenous measure of hospital capacity constraints, we show that such transitory health shocks can disrupt healthcare services due to limited capacity, including for conditions seemingly unrelated to air pollution. Also, we cannot rule out severe deterioration of health outcomes.

10.2139/ssrn.4754769.abstractZh: 发展中国家的医疗体系对健康冲击的响应如何？众所周知，发展中国家的医院基础设施水平较低，且受到空气污染等健康冲击的严重影响。这些冲击通常是暂时的，相对于其他健康需求而言可能微不足道，因此医疗体系或许能够应对这些冲击。然而，由于医院能力有限，它们可能无法迅速应对这些冲击，从而可能加剧由污染造成的健康损害。在这项研究中，我们考察了空气污染在发展中国家大都市圣保罗引发的健康冲击所带来的后果。通过利用2015年至2017年间关于儿童住院情况的每日数据，结合基于风速的工具变量分析以及看似外生的医院能力限制因素，我们发现这种暂时的健康冲击可能会因医院能力有限而破坏医疗服务，即使这些影响似乎与空气污染无关。此外，我们也不能排除健康结果严重恶化的可能性。

abstract.text: We study the housing market response to a country-wide policy that mandated the provision of energy efficiency information with all marketing material at the time of listing. Using the near universe of housing sales in England and Wales, we match in the energy efficiency status of the property from Energy Performance Certificates data. We develop a conceptual framework that makes clear the key channels through which the policy may impact house prices – an information-driven salience channel and a market valuation channel. We provide causal evidence of homebuyers’ willingness to pay for a higher energy rated property, documenting a 1-3% premium to a higher energy efficiency rating at the national level, and a 3-6% premium in the London market. We explore a set of key margins along which homebuyers can respond, ruling out as explanations both a consumption channel and an information channel. We conclude that the elevated EPC-rating premiums are driven by a market valuation channel, a conclusion for which we provide empirical support. Such a conclusion is of key policy importance, as it suggests market-facing energy efficiency regulations can increase demand for more energy efficient housing, even in absence of any discernible demand-side consumption or information effects.

10.2139/ssrn.4774498.abstractZh: 我们研究了住房市场对于一项全国性政策的反应，该政策要求在所有营销材料中都提供能源效率信息。利用英格兰和威尔士的近实住房销售数据，我们将房产的能源效率状态与能源性能证书数据进行了匹配。我们构建了一个概念框架，明确了该政策可能影响房价的几个关键渠道——信息驱动的显著性渠道和市场估值渠道。我们提供了关于购房者愿意为更高能源效率的房产支付更多费用的因果证据，发现全国范围内，能源效率等级提高1-3%的房产价格会上涨，而在伦敦市场，这一溢价达到3-6%。我们探讨了一系列购房者可以响应的关键因素，排除了消费渠道和信息渠道作为解释的可能性。我们得出结论，能源性能等级溢价是由市场估值渠道驱动的，并提供了实证支持。这一结论对于政策制定具有重要意义，因为它表明面向市场的能源效率法规可以增加对更节能住房的需求，即使在没有明显的需求侧消费或信息效应的情况下也是如此。

abstract.text: The criminal justice system affects millions of Americans through criminal convictions and incarceration. In this paper, we introduce a new method for credibly estimating the effects of both conviction and incarceration using randomly assigned judges as instruments for treatment. Misdemeanor convictions, especially for defendants with a shorter criminal record, cause an increase in the number of new offenses committed over the following five years. Incarceration on more serious felony charges, in contrast, reduces recidivism during the period of incapacitation, but has no effect after release. Our method allows the researcher to isolate specific treatment effects of interest as well as estimate the effect of broader policies; we find that courts could reduce crime by dismissing marginal charges against defendants accused of misdemeanors, with larger reductions among first-time defendants and those facing more serious charges.

10.2139/ssrn.4777635.abstractZh: 刑事司法系统通过刑事定罪和监禁影响着数百万美国人。在本文中，我们提出了一种新方法，利用随机分配的法官作为处理变量的工具，来可信地估计定罪和监禁的影响。对于犯罪记录较短的被告来说，轻罪定罪会导致在接下来的五年中犯下新的违法行为的数量增加。相比之下，对于涉及严重重罪的案件，监禁在限制自由期间确实可以减少再犯率，但在释放后则没有这种效果。我们的方法使研究人员能够分离出特定的处理效果，并估计更广泛政策的影响；我们发现，法院可以通过驳回对轻罪被告的边际指控来减少犯罪，尤其是首次犯罪者和面临更严重指控的被告。

abstract.text: We develop an empirical Bayes ranking procedure that assigns ordinal grades to noisy measurements, balancing the information content of the assigned grades against the expected frequency of ranking errors. Applying the method to a massive correspondence experiment, we grade the race and gender contact gaps of 97 U.S. employers, the identities of which we disclose for the first time. The grades are presented alongside measures of uncertainty about each firm’s contact gap in an accessible report card that is easily adaptable to other settings where ranks and levels are of simultaneous interest.

10.2139/ssrn.4787404.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种经验贝叶斯排名方法，该方法为噪声数据赋予序数等级，同时平衡了所赋予等级的信息含量与排名错误的预期频率。该方法被应用于一项大规模的数据对比实验，我们对97家美国雇主的种族和性别接触差距进行了排名，并首次公开了这些雇主的身份信息。这些等级结果被呈现出来，同时附有关于每家公司的接触差距不确定性的衡量指标，这些信息都包含在一个易于理解的报告中，该报告可以轻松适应其他需要同时关注排名和等级的情况。

abstract.text: Human discretion is a defining feature of legal and regulatory decision-making. While discretion lets professionals incorporate subtle soft information that rules or algorithms may miss, it also introduces noise---disagreement among decision-makers, such that the same case could yield different outcomes depending on who handles it. We study this trade-off in U.S. bank supervision, where examiners issue CAMELS ratings that shape bank capitalization and lending. Using confidential supervisory data, we model final ratings as weighted sums of component issues. We find that disagreement arises through three channels: (1) examiners treat all issues, even relatively objective ones, as subjective; (2) they disproportionately weight more subjective issues, with management quality alone accounting for nearly 50% of the total weight; and (3) they disagree on the weights applied to each issue, even when agreeing on the issues themselves. We measure discretion as the residual in ratings unexplained by bank fundamentals---this residual captures both soft information and examiner-specific judgment. Because examiner assignment is quasi-random, systematic variation in this residual isolates noise rather than signal. This noise has real consequences: tougher examiners cause banks to raise capital and cut lending for years, and the expectation of unpredictable supervision can prompt banks to preemptively reduce lending. Yet discretion is not purely negative; the discretionary rating predicts future bank deterioration more accurately than a simple model based solely on hard data. Using machine learning models as a high-dimensional benchmark, we further show that algorithms outperform supervisory ratings in narrowly targeted forecasting tasks but do not replicate supervisory assessments themselves. Nonetheless, excessive discretion adds noise without extra signal. Moderately constraining how subjective components are weighted improves predictive accuracy and reduces costly disagreement.

10.2139/ssrn.4788290.abstractZh: 人类的判断能力是法律与监管决策中的一个关键特征。虽然判断能力让专业人士能够纳入那些规则或算法可能忽略的细微信息，但它也带来了不确定性——决策者之间的分歧使得同一案件可能会因处理者的不同而得出不同的结果。我们研究了美国银行监管中的这一权衡问题，监管机构通过CAMELS评级来影响银行的资本结构和贷款行为。利用保密的监管数据，我们将最终评级模型化为各个因素加权的总和。研究发现，分歧主要通过三种途径产生：(1) 监管机构将所有因素，包括相对客观的因素，都视为主观因素；(2) 他们对主观因素给予了不成比例的重视，仅管理质量就占总权重的近50%；(3) 他们对每个因素的权重分配存在分歧，即使他们对这些因素本身的意见一致。我们将这种不受银行基本面影响的剩余部分视为判断能力，这部分包含了软信息和监管机构特有的判断。由于监管人员的分配具有准随机性，这种剩余部分的系统性变化能够分离出噪声而非信号。这种噪声具有实际影响：更严格的监管可能导致银行多年内增加资本并减少贷款，而不可预测的监管预期则可能促使银行提前减少贷款。然而，判断能力并非完全负面；基于判断的评级能够比单纯基于硬数据的模型更准确地预测银行的未来状况。通过机器学习模型作为高维基准，我们进一步证明，算法在狭义的预测任务中表现优于监管评级，但并不能复制监管评估本身的效果。尽管如此，过度的自由裁量权只会增加噪音，而不会带来额外的信号。适度限制主观因素的权重分配可以提高预测准确性，并减少不必要的分歧。

abstract.text: We examine how private equity (PE) firms generate value in markets where prices are regulated and do not reflect costs.  Using novel, comprehensive data from Arizona's ambulance industry, we find PE-owned companies increase their operating profits by 50% by cream-skimming: through strategically exploiting regulations, and avoiding minimum service requirements, PE firms are able to shift unprofitable customers to the government while retaining high-profit customers. They accomplish this by firing paramedics, which, due to nationwide staffing regulations, forces local fire departments to take high-cost runs. This strategic reallocation only occurs where PE firms overlap with a sufficient number of fire departments, which allows them to avoid minimum timing requirements. These operational changes increase total call time by 6%, contributing to a significant increase in traffic fatalities in Arizona, with effects magnified in areas where PE firms face non-PE competition, and a 7% increase nationally. Our findings demonstrate how regulatory arbitrage by PE in mixed public-private markets can create substantial negative externalities for public balance sheets and for public health.

10.2139/ssrn.4792828.abstractZh: 我们研究了私募股权公司如何在价格受到监管且无法反映成本的市场中创造价值。通过利用亚利桑那州救护车行业的全面数据，我们发现私募股权公司通过策略性利用法规以及规避最低服务要求，能够将无利可图的客户转交给政府，同时保留高利润客户。他们通过解雇急救人员来实现这一目标，由于全国性的人员配备规定，当地消防部门不得不承担高成本的救援任务。这种战略性重新分配仅在私募股权公司与足够数量的消防部门存在重叠的情况下才会发生，这使他们能够规避最低时间要求。这些运营上的变化使总呼叫时间增加了6%，导致亚利桑那州的交通事故死亡人数显著增加，在私募股权公司面临非私募股权竞争的地区，这一影响更为严重，全国范围内则增加了7%。我们的研究结果表明，私募股权公司在混合公私市场中通过监管套利行为，会对公共资产负债表和公共健康造成严重的负面影响。

abstract.text: While reliance on human discretion is a pervasive feature of institutional design, human discretion can also introduce costly noise (Kahneman, Sibony, and Sunstein 2021). We evaluate the consequences, determinants, and trade-offs associated with discretion in high-stake decisions assessing bank safety and soundness. Using detailed data on the supervisory ratings of US banks, we find that professional bank examiners exercise significant personal discretion—their decisions deviate substantially from algorithmic benchmarks and can be predicted by examiner identities, holding bank fundamentals constant. Examiner discretion has a large and persistent causal impact on future bank capitalization and supply of credit, leading to volatility and uncertainty in bank outcomes, and a conservative anticipatory response by banks. We identify a novel source of noise: weights assigned to specific issues. Disagreement in ratings across examiners can be attributed to high average weight (50%) assigned to subjective assessment of banks’ management quality, as well as heterogeneity in weights attached to more objective issues such as capital adequacy. Replacing human discretion with a simple algorithm leads to worse predictions of bank health, while moderate limits on discretion can translate to more informative and less noisy predictions.

10.2139/ssrn.4794393.abstractZh: 虽然对人类判断的依赖是机构设计中的一个普遍特征，但人类判断也可能引入昂贵的干扰因素（Kahneman、Sibony和Sunstein，2021年）。我们评估了在评估银行安全性和稳健性这一高风险决策中，人类判断所带来的后果、决定因素以及权衡。通过详细分析美国银行的监管评级数据，我们发现专业的银行审查员拥有相当大的个人判断空间——他们的决策与算法基准存在显著偏差，并且这种偏差可以通过审查员的身份来预测，前提是银行的基本面保持不变。审查员的判断对银行未来的资本结构和信贷供应有着显著且持久的影响，这导致了银行结果的波动性和不确定性，同时也促使银行采取保守的应对策略。我们发现了一个新的干扰源：对特定问题的权重分配。不同审查员在评级上的分歧可以归因于对银行管理质量的主观评估所分配的平均权重较高（50%），以及对于更客观的问题如资本充足率所分配的权重存在差异。用简单的算法替代人类判断可以带来更糟糕的银行健康状况预测结果，而适度限制人类判断则能够带来更具信息量的、更少干扰的预测结果。

abstract.text: We examine how competitive pressure shapes employee perceptions of supervisors’ behavior, an  informal component of management control systems. Using 262,249 current-employee reviews from  Kununu, we apply a large language model to measure supervisors’ management- and leadership oriented behavior at the firm-department-year level. We distinguish between output market pressure, reflecting more competitive product markets and tighter operating constraints, and input  market pressure, reflecting labor market competition. We also distinguish between structural  pressure, capturing persistent competitive conditions, and disruptive pressure. Structural output  market pressure is associated with lower evaluations of both management and leadership behavior, whereas structural input market pressure is associated with higher evaluations. By contrast,  disruptive pressures primarily reduce leadership behavior, while management behavior is largely  unchanged or stronger, suggesting that leadership is the more fragile supervisory margin under  competitive disruption.

10.2139/ssrn.4827928.abstractZh: 我们研究了竞争压力如何影响员工对主管行为的看法，这是管理控制系统中的一个非正式组成部分。利用Kununu公司提供的262,249份员工评价数据，我们运用大型语言模型来测量公司部门年度层面主管的管理和领导行为。我们区分了输出市场压力与输入市场压力：输出市场压力源于竞争激烈的产品市场以及严格的运营限制，而输入市场压力则源于劳动力市场的竞争。此外，我们还区分了结构性压力与破坏性压力：结构性输出市场压力与对管理和领导行为的负面评价相关，而结构性输入市场压力则与正面评价相关。相比之下，破坏性压力主要抑制了领导行为，而管理行为则基本保持不变或有所增强，这表明在竞争激烈的背景下，领导地位变得更加脆弱。

abstract.text: We propose a new specification test to assess the validity of the judge leniency design. We characterize a set of sharp testable implications, which exploit all the relevant information in the observed data distribution to detect violations of the judge leniency design assumptions. The proposed sharp test is asymptotically valid and consistent and will not make discordant recommendations. When the judge’s leniency design assumptions are rejected, we propose a way to salvage the model using partial monotonicity and exclusion assumptions, under which a variant of the Local Instrumental Variable (LIV) estimand can recover the Marginal Treatment Effect. Simulation studies show our test outperforms existing non-sharp tests by significant margins. We apply our test to assess the validity of the judge leniency design using data from Stevenson (2018), and it rejects the validity for three crime categories: robbery, drug selling, and drug possession.

10.2139/ssrn.4833932.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的规范测试，用于评估法官宽大设计的有效性。我们提出了一组尖锐的测试性假设，这些假设利用了观测数据分布中的所有相关信息，以检测对法官宽大设计假设的违反。所提出的尖锐测试具有渐近有效性和一致性，并且不会提出不一致的建议。当拒绝法官的宽大设计假设时，我们提出了一种利用部分单调性和排除假设来挽救模型的方法，在这种情况下，局部工具变量估计量可以恢复边际处理效应。模拟研究表明，我们的测试在显著程度上优于现有的非尖锐测试。我们应用该测试来评估法官宽大设计的有效性，使用Stevenson（2018年）的数据，结果显示该设计在三个犯罪类别——抢劫、毒品贩卖和毒品持有——中无效。

abstract.text: Despite being widely used in health economics, dynamic models of health and healthcare typically assume that the persistence in these outcomes is the same for every individual. Understanding the extent and drivers of heterogeneity in persistence is essential for the design and evaluation of health interventions because persistence determines the dynamics and overall long-run effects of such interventions. This paper explores individual-level heterogeneity in the persistence of health outcomes. Using simple regression methods that do not place any restriction on the distribution of the heterogeneity in persistence, the paper documents substantial heterogeneity in health, medical expenditures, and healthcare use. We show that neglecting this heterogeneity leads to estimates that overstate the average persistence and can bias the coefficients of covariates. We find that between 75% and 87% of individuals display persistence and that this persistence is related to the individuals' personality and socio-economic characteristics.

10.2139/ssrn.4844530.abstractZh: 尽管动态健康与医疗保健模型在健康经济学中得到了广泛应用，但这些模型通常假设这些结果的持续性对每个人都是相同的。了解持续性异质性的程度和驱动因素对于设计和评估健康干预措施至关重要，因为持续性决定了这些干预措施的动态发展和长期效果。本文探讨了健康结果持续性的个体层面异质性。通过使用不限制持续性异质性分布的简单回归方法，本文发现健康状况、医疗支出和医疗使用存在显著的异质性。我们发现，忽略这种异质性会导致估计出的平均持续性过高，并可能使协变量的系数产生偏差。研究发现，75%到87%的个体表现出持续性，而这种持续性与个体的性格和社会经济特征有关。

abstract.text: Consumers in high-stakes product markets such as healthcare or finance often rely on experts' recommendations before making a purchase decision. However, how an expert constructs a specific set of recommendations and how it subsequently affects consumer choices and outcomes have been understudied. We propose an empirical framework that econometrically recovers experts' recommendations and combines them with heterogeneous consumers' choice of products or services. We then apply the framework to examine kidney disease patients' choice of dialysis facilities. Using detailed data on more than 16,900 U.S. patients with kidney disease who had consultations with over 750 physicians between 2015 and 2017, we study physicians' dialysis facility recommendations, and the patients' subsequent choice of facilities. We find that physicians are more likely to recommend facilities with which they are affiliated and those close to patients. Policy simulations suggest that quality information provision through Five Star ratings has likely lowered mortality, thereby helping patients. In contrast, reducing conflicts of interest by banning the usage of affiliation as a basis for physician's facility recommendations can inadvertently hurt patients, as evidenced by an increase in mortality. The study provides relevant consumer-centric insights into recent efforts to change market regulations and policies in this healthcare market.

10.2139/ssrn.4850261.abstractZh: 在诸如医疗保健或金融等高风险产品市场中，消费者在做出购买决策之前通常会依赖专家的建议。然而，专家如何构建具体的推荐方案，以及这些方案如何影响消费者的选择和结果，这些方面尚未得到充分研究。我们提出了一个实证框架，通过计量经济学方法分析专家的建议，并将其与异质消费者的产品或服务选择相结合。随后，我们将该框架应用于研究肾病患者对透析设施的选择。我们利用2015年至2017年间超过16,900名美国肾病患者的详细数据，这些数据涉及他们与750多名医生的咨询情况，研究医生对透析设施的推荐以及患者后续选择的设施。我们发现，医生更倾向于推荐与他们有联系或靠近患者的设施。政策模拟表明，通过五星评级等方式提供高质量的信息可能降低了死亡率，从而帮助了患者。相反，通过禁止将医生与设施的联系作为推荐依据来减少利益冲突，可能会无意中伤害患者，正如死亡率的增加所显示的那样。这项研究为改变该医疗市场的监管和政策提供了具有相关性的以消费者为中心的见解。

abstract.text: We examine the efficacy of performance-based managerial practices in enhancing judicial performance. Leveraging the Judge Quota reform in China that implemented a Key Performance Indicator system to evaluate judge performance and employing a staggered Difference-in-Differences approach, we find that the judicial efficiency in delivering verdicts significantly improved without compromising their quality. The probability of delays in case resolution decreased by 18% and the appeal rate of verdicts decreased by 20%. However, we also find that following the reform, judges strategically shifted from issuing verdicts to mediation, a case-resolving process that is less resource-intensive and less accountable under the KPI system. This change led to a significantly higher proportion of cases being resolved through mediation post-reform, albeit with a decline in mediation quality.

10.2139/ssrn.4925678.abstractZh: 我们研究了基于绩效的管理实践在提升司法绩效方面的效果。通过利用中国实施的法官配额改革，该改革采用了关键绩效指标系统来评估法官的绩效，并采用差异分解法进行分析，我们发现，在不影响判决质量的前提下，司法效率得到了显著提升。案件解决的延迟概率下降了18%，判决的上诉率也下降了20%。然而，我们也发现，在改革之后，法官们从判决转向了调解，这是一种资源消耗较少、责任更明确的案件解决方式。这一转变使得改革后通过调解解决的案件比例显著增加，尽管调解的质量有所下降。

abstract.text: Responding to the rise of hydraulic fracturing (HF) and risks to water quality, U.S. states mandated disclosure for HF wells. We study whether and how such targeting of corporate externalities with transparency regulation reduces environmental impact. We examine salt concentrations considered HF signatures and find significant reductions in surface water impact between 9-17%, mostly along the intensive margin. Consistent with these findings, we document improvements in operator practices, including fewer wastewater spills . We unpack the transparency mechanism and show that transparency regulation enables social movements and increases public pressure, which in turn drives the documented changes in practices and water quality .

10.2139/ssrn.4959265.abstractZh: 面对水力压裂技术的兴起以及对水质的影响，美国各州强制要求对水力压裂井进行信息披露。我们研究通过透明度监管来针对企业的外部性，是否以及如何减少环境影响。我们分析了被视为水力压裂标志的盐浓度，发现地表水影响的减少幅度在9%到17%之间，尤其是在水力压裂活动频繁的地区。与这些发现一致的是，我们观察到操作人员的操作方式有所改善，包括废水泄漏事件的减少。我们还分析了透明度监管机制，发现该机制能够推动社会运动，并增加公众压力，从而推动实际操作方式和水质方面的改善。

abstract.text: Labor economists increasingly work in empirical contexts with large numbers of unit-specific parameters. These settings include a growing number of value-added studies measuring causal effects of individual units like firms, managers, neighborhoods, teachers, schools, doctors, hospitals, police officers, and judges. Empirical Bayes (EB) methods provide a powerful toolkit for value-added analysis. The EB approach leverages distributional information from the full population of units to refine predictions of value-added for each individual, leading to improved estimators and decision rules. This chapter offers an overview of EB methods in labor economics, focusing on properties that make EB useful for value-added studies and practical guidance for EB implementation. Applications to school value-added in Boston and employer-level discrimination in the US labor market illustrate the EB toolkit in action.

10.2139/ssrn.5001380.abstractZh: 劳动经济学领域的研究人员越来越多地需要在大量具有特定参数的实证背景下进行工作。这些研究包括越来越多的增值研究，旨在衡量单个单位（如企业、管理者、社区、教师、学校、医生、医院、警察和法官）的因果效应。实证贝叶斯方法为增值分析提供了强大的工具。该方法利用来自整个单位群体的分布信息来优化对个体增值的预测，从而改进估计方法和决策规则。本章概述了劳动经济学中的实证贝叶斯方法，重点介绍了使该方法适用于增值研究的特点，并提供了实施方法的实用指导。以波士顿的学校增值研究以及美国劳动力市场中的雇主级歧视为例，展示了实证贝叶斯方法的实际应用效果。

abstract.text: The Random Utility Model (RUM) is a workhorse model for valuing new products or changes in public goods. But RUMs have been faulted along two lines. First, for including idiosyncratic errors that imply unreasonably high values for new alternatives and unrealistic substitution patterns. Second, for involving strong restrictions on functional forms for utility. This paper shows how, instead, starting with a revealed preference framework, one can partially identify nonparametrically the answers to policy questions about discrete alternatives. When the Generalized Axiom of Revealed Preference (GARP) is satisfied, the approach weakly identifies a pure characteristics model. When GARP is violated, it recasts the RUM errors as departures from GARP (critical cost efficiency), to be minimized using a minimum-distance criterion. This perspective provides an alternative avenue for nonparametric identification of discrete choice models. The paper illustrates the approach by estimating bounds on the values of ecological improvements in the Southern Appalachian Mountains using survey data.

10.2139/ssrn.5048598.abstractZh: 随机效用模型（RUM）是一种用于评估新产品或公共物品变化的重要模型。然而，该模型存在两个主要缺陷：首先，由于包含一些特殊的误差，导致对新替代方案的估值过高，且替代模式也不切实际。其次，该模型对效用函数的形式有严格的限制。本文展示了一种方法：从揭示性偏好框架出发，可以非参数地部分确定关于离散替代方案的决策问题答案。当满足揭示性偏好广义公理时，该方法能够弱式识别一个纯特征模型。当违反该公理时，可以将RUM的误差视为偏离公理的情况，并通过最小距离准则来最小化这些误差。这一视角为非参数识别离散选择模型提供了另一种途径。本文通过利用调查数据来估计南阿巴拉契亚山脉生态改善的价值范围，从而说明了这一方法的应用。

abstract.text: Introduction: Although the importance of leader–member relationships in teamwork is acknowledged in literature, a deeper understanding of this relationship is lacking, especially in rural areas. The impact of leader–member relationships on team outcomes is especially important in rural Chinese hospitals as improving teamwork forms a national health reform priority in these hospitals. This study investigates how leader-member relationships (ie leader-member perceived similarity and power distance orientation) influence team outcomes (ie perceived quality of care and job satisfaction) via speaking up and silence. Methods: An online questionnaire was completed by 1017 team members (ie doctors, nurses and other healthcare professionals) of 300 teams in four rural Chinese hospitals in October 2022. The questionnaire measured leader-member perceived similarity, power distance orientation, speaking up, silence, perceived quality of care, job satisfaction and control variables. Multilevel mediation analysis was conducted to test the hypotheses. Results: Leader–member perceived similarity and power distance orientation are positively related to speaking up ( β =0.61, p < 0.01; β =0.17, p < 0.01 respectively) and to silence ( β =0.41, p < 0.01; β =0.63, p < 0.01 respectively). Speaking up is positively related to the perceived quality of care ( β =0.24, p < 0.01; β =0.46, p < 0.01) and job satisfaction ( β =0.30, p < 0.01; β =0.54, p < 0.01), while the impact of silence is not significant. Finally, speaking up mediates the associations of both leader-member perceived similarity and power distance orientation with perceived quality of care ( β =0.15, p < 0.01; β =0.08, p < 0.01 respectively) and job satisfaction ( β =0.30, p < 0.01; β =0.54, p < 0.01 respectively). Conclusion: Speaking up, rather than silence, contributes to team functioning by mediating the impact of leader–member relationships to team outcomes. Hospital management may therefore seek to stimulate speaking up by focussing on leader-member relationships: increasing leader-member similarity and promoting members’ power distance orientation. However, any unintended effect of increased silence through these leader–member relationships is an important area of future research, which can adopt multidimensional models of speaking up and silence.

10.2147/jhl.s460900.abstractZh:
引言：尽管文献中承认了领导与成员关系在团队合作中的重要性，但人们对这种关系的深入理解仍然不足，尤其是在农村地区。在乡村中国医院中，领导与成员关系对团队成果的影响尤为重要，因为改善团队合作是这些医院国家卫生改革的重点。本研究探讨了领导与成员关系（即领导与成员的感知相似性和权力距离取向）如何通过“发声”和“沉默”来影响团队成果（即护理质量的感知和工作满意度）。  
方法：2022年10月，对四家乡村中国医院的300个团队的1017名成员（包括医生、护士和其他医疗专业人员）进行了在线问卷调查。问卷测量了领导与成员的感知相似性、权力距离取向、“发声”行为、“沉默”行为、护理质量的感知、工作满意度以及控制变量。采用多层次中介分析来检验假设。  
结果：“发声”行为与领导与成员的感知相似性（β=0.61，p<0.01）和权力距离取向（β=0.17，p<0.01）呈正相关；“沉默”行为与护理质量的感知（β=0.24，p<0.01）和工作满意度（β=0.30，p<0.01）呈正相关，而“沉默”的影响并不显著。最后，“发声”行为中介了领导与成员的感知相似性和权力距离取向与护理质量感知（β=0.15，p<0.01）和工作满意度（β=0.30，p<0.01）之间的关联。结论：与沉默相比，主动发言有助于团队运作，因为它能够调节领导者与成员关系对团队成果的影响。因此，医院管理可以采取措施，通过关注领导者与成员的关系来促进主动发言：增加领导者与成员的相似性，并提升成员的权力距离倾向。然而，通过这些领导者与成员关系导致沉默程度增加所带来的潜在影响，是未来研究的一个重要领域，未来研究可以采用多维度模型来探讨主动发言与沉默之间的关系。

abstract.text: This Spotlight is part of the AARP Public Policy Institute's LTSS Choices initiative.This initiative includes a series of reports, blogs, videos, podcasts, and virtual convenings that seeks to spark ideas for immediate, intermediate, and long-term options for transforming long-term services and supports (LTSS).We will explore a growing list of innovative models and evidence-based solutions-at both the national and international levels-to achieve system-wide LTSS reform.We recognize the importance of collaborating and partnering with others across the array of sectors, disciplines, and diverse populations to truly transform and modernize the LTSS system.We invite new ideas and look forward to opportunities for collaboration.

10.26419/ppi.00218.001.abstractZh: 这篇报道是AARP公共政策研究所“LTSS选择”计划的一部分。该计划包括一系列报告、博客、视频、播客以及线上会议，旨在提出即时、中期和长期性的方案，以改革长期服务和支持体系。我们将探讨一系列创新模式和基于证据的解决方案，这些方案适用于国家和国际层面，以推动整个系统的改革。我们认识到与各个行业、学科以及不同人群合作的重要性，这样才能真正改革并现代化长期服务和支持体系。我们欢迎新的想法，并期待有机会进行合作。

abstract.text: In the new era, can enterprises take advantage of digital transformation to alleviate the current severe overcapacity problems? Based on A-share listed companies from 2004 to 2020, this paper finds that: First, digital transformation of enterprises will significantly reduce their overcapacity. This result is still very robust with alternative measures and by using an instrumental variable. Second, by further exploring the mechanism, we find that the enterprise digital transformation reduces overcapacity by alleviating the degree of information asymmetry and improving the level of corporate governance. Third, the effect is stronger among firms with lower market competition, higher capital intensity and high firm performance volatility. Our results have policy implications for digital development and help resolve overcapacity problem.

10.26599/cje.2024.9300210.abstractZh: 在新时代，企业能否通过数字化转型来缓解当前严重的产能过剩问题？本文基于2004至2020年的A股上市公司数据，发现：首先，企业的数字化转型将显著减少其产能过剩。这一结果在采用替代措施和工具变量分析后依然非常稳健。其次，通过进一步探讨机制，我们发现企业的数字化转型通过减少信息不对称程度和提高公司治理水平来降低产能过剩。第三，在市场竞争较低、资本密集度较高且企业绩效波动较大的企业中，这种效应更为显著。我们的研究结果对数字经济发展具有政策意义，并有助于解决产能过剩问题。

abstract.text: This thesis investigates empirically how the innovation and adaptation practices and capabilities of New Zealand firms relate to long-term firm performance and growth. Understanding of these issues at the whole-economy level remains incomplete. Endogenous growth models in economics have long placed innovation at the core of the economic growth process. But they do not usually represent the actual firm behaviours, practices and capabilities that drive innovation in much, if any, detail beyond R&D investment choices. They also tend to abstract from aspects of innovation that relate to adaptation to a changing environment. Some more recent papers have shown that management capabilities are important to firm performance in a static-efficiency sense, but do not explore in much detail the performance implications of capabilities specifically related to change. By contrast, the “dynamic capabilities” literature from the strategic management discipline focuses squarely on firms’ purposeful and diverse efforts to drive and adapt to change. This literature shares common conceptual ideas with the endogenous growth literature. In both approaches, firms are motivated to innovate by the prospect of economic rents, and new ideas render old ones obsolete in a process of creative destruction. The dynamic capabilities literature also draws parallels with successful adaptation. I empirically investigate and test the proposition that dynamic capabilities underpin long-term firm performance, as claimed by the literature. I also look at whether dynamic capabilities affect intermediate outcomes for the firm - profitability, sales, productivity, wages and employment - that are important for economic performance and public policy. I proceed by first using the dynamic capabilities framework to guide the selection of 87 innovation- and change-related business practices and attitudes from an official, nationally representative survey of 14,146 New Zealand firms from 2005 to 2017. I extract five common factors explaining the correlations in the data on the selected practices. The factors represent the underlying dynamic capabilities of the firms. Using survival and linear regression models, I then test whether these dynamic capabilities factors are positively associated with the firm performance measures, in the presence of a range of controls. Finally, I test whether dynamic capabilities improve firm adaptation and resilience in the face of a major shock, when a firm’s challenge is to adapt rapidly in the context of diverse disruption across and within industries. I use the natural experiment of the earthquakes that devastated the city of Christchurch, New Zealand in February 2011, with a subsequent large-scale government response. I find that dynamic capabilities related to external cooperation, proactive reorientation of marketing, openness to internal process change, expertise-intensive internationalisation, and situational awareness and responsiveness are all significantly positively associated in various contexts with long-term performance, and with sales and employment growth in the shorter term. I find that higher dynamic capabilities enabled superior performance of construction and infrastructure firms exposed to the earthquake shock, compared to their exposed peers with lower capabilities. The study goes beyond existing literature by using a large, highly granular dataset of business practices from a nationally representative official survey to test the relationship of dynamic capabilities with firm survival, with careful attention to identification of dynamic capabilities effects on firm performance after a natural disaster.

10.26686/wgtn.26370319.abstractZh: 本论文通过实证研究探讨新西兰企业的创新与适应实践及能力如何与企业的长期绩效和增长相关。对整个经济体系的这些问题的理解仍然不完整。经济学中的内生增长模型长期以来将创新置于经济增长过程的核心位置。但这些模型通常未能详细反映推动创新的真实企业行为、实践和能力，尤其是研发投资选择之外的方面。它们也倾向于忽略与适应环境变化相关的创新方面。一些较新的研究指出，管理能力在静态效率层面上对企业绩效至关重要，但并未详细探讨与变革相关的能力的绩效影响。相比之下，战略管理领域的“动态能力”文献则专注于企业为应对和适应变革而进行的有目的且多样化的努力。这一文献与内生增长文献有着共同的概念基础。在这两种方法中，企业因经济租金的潜力而受到创新的激励，而新想法则通过创造性破坏的过程使旧想法过时。动态能力文献还将动态能力与成功的适应过程联系起来。我通过实证研究来验证动态能力是否确实能够支撑企业的长期绩效，正如文献所声称的那样。我还研究了动态能力是否会影响企业的中间结果——盈利能力、销售额、生产率、工资和就业——这些结果对经济绩效和公共政策具有重要意义。首先，我采用动态能力框架来指导对2005至2017年间新西兰14,146家企业的官方全国代表性调查数据中与创新和变革相关的87种商业实践及态度的筛选。我提取了五个共同因素，这些因素能够解释所选实践数据中的相关性。这些因素代表了企业的潜在动态能力。接着，我使用生存分析和线性回归模型，检验在一系列控制变量存在的情况下，这些动态能力因素是否与企业的绩效指标呈正相关。最后，我研究在面临重大冲击时，动态能力如何提升企业的适应性和韧性，特别是当企业需要在不同行业内部及行业之间发生多重颠覆时，需要迅速适应。我以2011年2月新西兰基督城遭受地震这一自然实验为案例，该事件引发了大规模的政府应对措施。研究发现，与外部合作相关的动态能力、主动的营销调整、对内部流程变革的开放态度、以专业知识为基础的国际化战略，以及情境感知和响应能力，在多种情境下都与长期绩效呈显著正相关，并且在短期内与销售和就业增长也有正相关关系。研究还发现，相较于能力较低的同行企业，具有较高动态能力的建筑及基础设施企业在遭受地震冲击后，其表现更为出色。本研究通过利用一项具有全国代表性的官方调查所收集的大量、高度详细的商业实践数据集，超越了现有文献的研究范围，旨在探讨动态能力与企业生存之间的关系。同时，研究还特别关注在自然灾害发生后，动态能力对企业绩效的影响。

abstract.text: Цель: Выявить конкурентные преимущества региональных социально-экономических систем регионов Республики Казахстан, а именно систему здравоохранения, так как одной из цепочек социально-экономических систем регионов является здравоохранение. Методы: С помощью анализа статистических данных системы здравоохранения Республики Казахстан за 4-летний период раскрыть проблемы и конкурентные преимущества, произошедшие в каждом из регионов страны.Результаты: Показаны региональные показатели, особое внимание сосредоточено на статистических по-казателях, которые предоставляют государственные органы. Результаты исследований в данном направлении могут быть использованы национальными и региональными врачами-медиками, учеными, представителями систем здравоохранения и политиками в области общественного здравоохранения.Выводы: Абсолютные показатели здравоохранения отражают количество больничных организаций и коек для больных, количество врачей дает динамическую картину обеспеченности населения медицинским обслу-живанием в каждом из регионов Казахстана. На основе анализа динамической картины относительных показа-телей здравоохранения авторами сформирован рейтинг конкурентоспособности регионов Республики Казах-стан. Кроме того, определены направления дальнейших поисковых исследований, отражающих развитие реги-ональной конкурентоспособности.

10.31489/2022ec3/217-227.abstractZh: 目的：揭示哈萨克斯坦各地区的区域社会经济系统的竞争优势，特别是医疗卫生系统。因为医疗卫生系统是各地区社会经济系统中的一个环节。方法：通过分析哈萨克斯坦医疗卫生系统4年间的统计数据，揭示各地区的问题和竞争优势。结果：展示了各地区的相关指标，特别关注了由政府部门提供的统计数据。这些研究结果为国家和地区的医生、学者、医疗卫生系统代表以及公共卫生政策专家提供了参考。结论：医疗卫生的绝对指标反映了各地区的医院数量和病床数量，医生数量则反映了各地区的医疗服务供应情况。通过对医疗卫生相对指标的动态分析，作者们制定了哈萨克斯坦各地区的竞争力排名。此外，还确定了进一步研究的方向，以反映地区竞争力的发展。

abstract.text: Identifying the impact of physicians on health outcomes is a challenging task due to the nonrandom sorting between physicians, hospitals, and patients. We overcome this challenge by exploiting a Colombian government program that randomly assigned 2,126 physicians to 618 small hospitals. We estimate the impact on the 256,806 children whose mothers received care in those hospitals during their pregnancy, using administrative data from the program, hospitals’ vital statistics records, and physicians’ records from mandatory health-specific graduation exams. We find that more-skilled physicians improve health at birth outcomes. That is, being assigned a physician with a one standard deviation higher performance in the health graduation exam scores decreases the probability of giving birth to an unhealthy baby by 6.31 percent. We present evidence that an underlying mechanism includes improving the targeting of care toward the more vulnerable mothers.

10.32468/be.1269.abstractZh: 识别医生对健康结果的影响是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为医生、医院和患者之间并非随机分配。我们通过利用哥伦比亚政府的一项计划来克服这一挑战，该计划随机将2,126名医生分配到618家小型医院。我们利用该计划的行政数据、医院的生命统计记录以及医生在强制性健康毕业考试中的记录，来估计那些在怀孕期间在这些医院接受治疗的256,806名儿童的健康状况。我们发现，技术更娴熟的医生能够改善新生儿的出生状况。也就是说，如果医生在健康毕业考试中的成绩高出一个标准差，那么生下不健康婴儿的概率就会降低6.31%。我们的研究还表明，这种改善机制可能包括更好地针对那些更为脆弱的母亲提供护理。

abstract.text: Purpose: the demand for firms to disclose their corporate social responsibility (CSR) activities has risen steeply over the last two decades, pushing many jurisdic-tions to implement mandatory non-financial reporting. We exploit the European non-financial reporting directive (NFRD) to study how companies change their cash management policies in response to additional mandatory CSR disclosure requirements. Methodology: we adopted a difference-in-differences (DID) approach, which is designed to estimate causality between the mandatory adoption of the NFRD and firms' cash holdings. We implemented a two-way fixed effect model in the context of mandatory disclosure and staggered adoption of regulation, in order to study how firms changed their cash holdings following the introduction of the NFRD. Findings: we find that firms increased cash holdings following enactment of the NFRD, which is in line with the theory that cash is held for precautionary reasons. The growth in cash holdings is not equally distributed, as it is less pronounced in firms that are in a high-investment phase. Our findings reveal that mandatory non-financial disclosure can have real effects. Originality/value: This research shows that, in the short-term, mandatory CSR disclosure can have real effects on cash holding. Long-term effects should be con-sidered further by future research. Practical implications (optional): Policymakers should consider that additional CSR requirements are costly to firms, and thus find mechanisms that induce firms to adopt these requirements despite their costs

10.3280/fr2024-001006.abstractZh: 目的：在过去二十年里，企业披露其企业社会责任活动的需求急剧增加，这促使许多司法管辖区实施了强制性的非财务信息披露要求。我们利用欧洲非财务信息披露指令来研究公司在面临额外的强制性企业社会责任披露要求时，如何改变其现金管理政策。方法：我们采用了差异-差异法（DID）来估计强制性实施非财务信息披露指令与公司现金持有量之间的因果关系。我们在强制性信息披露和分阶段实施法规的背景下，采用了双向固定效应模型，以研究公司在非财务信息披露指令出台后如何改变其现金持有量。研究发现：我们发现，在非财务信息披露指令实施之后，公司的现金持有量有所增加，这与现金持有是为了预防风险的理论观点一致。现金持有量的增长并非均匀分布，特别是在处于高投资阶段的公司中，这种增长较为不明显。我们的研究结果表明，强制性的非财务信息披露确实能够产生实际影响。原创性/价值：这项研究表明，在短期内，强制性的企业社会责任信息披露确实会对现金持有量产生实际影响。未来的研究应进一步考虑其长期影响。实践意义（可选）：政策制定者应考虑，额外的企业社会责任要求对企业来说成本较高，因此应寻找机制来促使企业尽管面临成本，但仍需遵守这些要求。

abstract.text: Health plans in the U.S. increasingly use cost-sharing to steer demand for prescription drugs. However, the effectiveness of these incentives depends both on physicians’ price sensitivity and their knowledge of patient costs. We employ a moment inequality model to identify physician preferences without fully specifying their information. Applying this model to diabetes care, we find that physicians generally lack detailed price information and are more price sensitive than full-information models imply. We also identify substantial heterogeneity in preferences and information by physician training, suggesting a benefit from targeted information interventions.

10.3386/w32014.abstractZh: 美国的健康计划越来越多地采用费用分摊机制来引导对处方药的需求。然而，这些激励措施的有效性取决于医生对价格的态度以及他们对患者成本的了解程度。我们采用矩不等式模型来识别医生的偏好，而无需完全指定他们的信息。将这一模型应用于糖尿病护理领域，我们发现医生通常缺乏详细的 price 信息，并且他们对价格的态度比完全信息模型所暗示的要敏感得多。我们还发现，不同医生的偏好和信息获取能力存在显著的差异，这表明有针对性的信息干预措施是有益的。

abstract.text: Nonprofits supply many tax-financed services like healthcare and education. Yet nonprofits are absent from the canonical property rights theory of ownership. Extending the government “make or buy” decision to nonprofits and ex post frictions based on contracts as reference points suggests that contracting out to a nonprofit can be optimal when “mission” alignment credibly signals adherence to the spirit and not just the letter of the contract in unforeseen contingencies. The model sheds light on differential nonprofit presence across the spectrum of basic services, as illustrated by an application to the health sector.

10.3386/w32020.abstractZh: 非营利组织提供许多由税收资助的服务，如医疗保健和教育。然而，在典型的财产权利所有权理论中，非营利组织并未被纳入。将政府的“制造或购买”决策扩展到非营利组织，并以合同中的事后摩擦作为参考点，表明在“使命”一致性能够可信地表明遵守合同精神而非仅仅文字时，将业务外包给非营利组织可能是最优选择。该模型揭示了不同领域非营利组织存在的差异，例如通过应用于医疗行业得到了说明。

abstract.text: Trust is widely viewed as central to health care, yet “trust in the health care system” is not a single relationship: patients rely on many distinct entities (doctors, nurses, pharmacists, hospitals, insurers, and public health and regulatory bodies), and trust in these entities can diverge sharply. We ask how trust in a system’s constituent entities combines into overall trust, and what this composition implies for care-seeking. We develop an economic model in which overall system trust is produced from entity-specific trust through a nested CES “trust technology” that allows components to act as complements or substitutes, and we field a nationally representative U.S. survey to estimate it. In reduced form, higher trust is robustly associated with more preventive care and less avoidance, comparable in magnitude to education and income gradients. Structurally, trust is relatively substitutable across the system’s broad domains (individual providers, institutional providers and payers, and broad institutions), so high trust in some components can partially offset low trust in others. Counterfactual simulations, which we interpret as descriptive implications of the estimated model, show that among individual entities, trust in doctors is the most consequential: reducing it produces the largest declines in preventive care and the largest increases in planning no care, while comparable losses for insurers and the CDC imply smaller changes. However, a simultaneous erosion of trust across federal health institutions (CDC, FDA, and Medicare/Medicaid) carries the largest behavioral implications, underscoring the systemic stakes when trust declines broadly rather than in any single entity.

10.3386/w32028.abstractZh: 信任被广泛认为是医疗保健的核心要素，然而“对医疗系统的信任”并非单一的关系：患者依赖于许多不同的实体（医生、护士、药剂师、医院、保险公司以及公共卫生和监管机构），而这些实体之间的信任程度可能会存在显著差异。我们探讨了医疗系统各组成部分的信任如何融合成整体信任，以及这种组合对寻求医疗服务的行为有何影响。我们建立了一个经济模型，该模型通过嵌套的CES“信任技术”将各组成部分的信任转化为整体信任，并允许各组成部分以互补或替代的方式相互作用。随后，我们开展了一项具有全国代表性的美国调查来估算这一模型。结果显示，较高的信任水平与更多的预防性护理和较少的规避行为密切相关，其影响程度与教育水平和收入梯度相当。从结构上看，信任在医疗系统的各个领域之间相对可替代（个体提供者、机构提供者和支付者以及大型机构），因此某些组成部分的高信任度可以部分抵消其他组成部分的低信任度。通过反事实模拟，我们得出以下结论：在个体实体中，对医生的信任最为重要；降低医生的信任水平会导致预防性护理的减少和计划不采取任何措施的行为的增加，而保险公司和公共卫生局的信任下降则会导致较小的变化。然而，联邦医疗机构（如公共卫生局、食品药品监督管理局和医疗保险/医疗补助计划）的信任同时下降所带来的行为影响最为显著，这凸显了信任广泛下降时的系统性风险，而非仅某一特定实体的信任下降。

abstract.text: We conducted a field experiment that randomized advertisements, advertisement content, and prices across 2,204 counties in the United States to study the impacts on online purchases of naloxone, an opioid overdose reversal drug. Advertising increased website users but only impacted purchases when combined with a price reduction. Messages emphasizing the discreet nature of online sales had no additional impact on purchases. Comparing counties with advertisements featuring a highly discounted price to those featuring the full price, we estimate a price elasticity of demand for online naloxone of -1.3. Price is a significant barrier to online purchases of this life-saving medication

10.3386/w32029.abstractZh: 我们开展了一项实地实验，通过随机分配广告内容、广告投放位置和价格，在美国的2,204个县进行了研究，以探讨纳洛酮（一种用于逆转阿片类药物过量中毒的药物）在线购买行为的影响。广告确实增加了网站用户数量，但只有在价格降低的情况下才对购买行为产生显著影响。强调在线销售隐蔽性的信息对购买行为没有额外影响。通过比较那些广告中提供大幅折扣的县与那些保持全价的县，我们估计纳洛酮在线购买的需求弹性为-1.3。价格仍然是阻碍这种救命药物在线购买的重要障碍。

abstract.text: The role of friends in the US opioid epidemic is examined. Using data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Adolescent Health (Add Health), adults aged 25-34 and their high school best friends are focused on. An instrumental variable technique is employed to estimate peer effects in opioid misuse. Severe injuries in the previous year are used as an instrument for opioid misuse in order to estimate the causal impact of someone misusing opioids on the probability that their best friends also misuse. The estimated peer effects are significant: Having a best friend with a reported serious injury in the previous year increases the probability of own opioid misuse by around 7 percentage points in a population where 17 percent ever misuses opioids. The effect is driven by individuals without a college degree and those who live in the same county as their best friends.

10.3386/w32032.abstractZh: 本文探讨了朋友在美国阿片类药物滥用事件中的作用。研究基于《全国青少年健康纵向调查》的数据，重点关注25-34岁的成年人及其高中时期最好的朋友。采用工具变量技术来估计同伴对阿片类药物滥用的影响。研究以过去一年中的严重伤害作为工具变量，以评估某人滥用阿片类药物对其最好朋友同样滥用阿片类药物的概率的影响。估计出的同伴效应是显著的：在那些有17%的人曾经滥用阿片类药物的人群中，拥有过去一年中有严重伤害记录的最好朋友的人，自身滥用阿片类药物的概率增加了约7个百分点。这种效应主要受到没有大学学位的个体以及与最好朋友同住在同一县的人的影响。

abstract.text: This paper introduces the concept of a "trimmed aggregate ATT," which is a weighted average of a set of group-time average treatment effect on the treated (ATT) parameters identified in a staggered adoption difference-in-differences (DID) design. The set of identified group-time ATTs that contribute to the aggregate is trimmed to achieve compositional balance across an event window, ensuring that comparisons of the aggregate parameter over event time reveal dynamic treatment effects and differential pre-trends rather than compositional changes. Taking the trimmed aggregate ATT as a target parameter, we investigate the performance of stacked DID estimators. We show that the most basic stacked estimator does not identify the target aggregate or any other average causal effect because it applies different implicit weights to treatment and control trends. The bias can be eliminated using corrective sample weights. We present a weighted stacked DID estimator, and show that it correctly identifies the target aggregate, providing justification for using the estimator in applied work.

10.3386/w32054.abstractZh: 本文介绍了“修剪后汇总ATT”的概念，这是一种加权平均值，由分阶段采用差异中差异（DID）设计中确定的一组群体时间平均处理效应参数构成。为了在事件窗口内实现组合平衡，对这组汇总ATT参数进行了修剪，从而确保对事件时间推移的汇总参数比较能够揭示动态处理效应和差异性的前期趋势，而非组合变化。以修剪后的汇总ATT作为目标参数，我们研究了堆叠DID估计器的性能。研究表明，最基本的堆叠估计器无法识别目标汇总参数或其他平均因果效应，因为它对处理效应和对照效应采用了不同的隐含权重。通过使用修正样本权重可以消除这种偏差。我们提出了一种加权堆叠DID估计器，并证明它能够正确识别目标汇总参数，为在应用工作中使用该估计器提供了依据。

abstract.text: U.S. opioid overdose death rates rose nearly continuously from 1990 to 2022, claiming over 750,000 lives. The persistence of the epidemic is surprising, as policy and behavioral responses to the epidemic would be expected to reduce harm. We examine four explanations for why death rates instead rose so greatly and for so long: exogenous and continuing increases in demand or supply of opioids, dynamic spillovers stemming from prescription opioid addiction, and spatial spillovers due to thick market externalities. We find that spillovers across time and space are the main explanation. Without them, there would have been 88 percent fewer deaths.

10.3386/w32055.abstractZh: 从1990年到2022年，美国的阿片类药物过量死亡人数几乎持续上升，导致超过750,000人丧生。这一流行病的持续存在令人惊讶，因为针对该流行病的政策和行为反应本应减少危害。我们探讨了四个导致死亡率如此大幅且长期上升的原因：阿片类药物的需求或供应持续增加、由处方阿片类药物成瘾引发的动态溢出效应，以及由于市场外部性导致的空间溢出效应。我们发现，时间和空间上的溢出效应是主要的原因。如果没有这些溢出效应，死亡人数将减少88%。

abstract.text: The quality and inequality of US drinking water investments have gained attention after recent environmental disasters in Flint, Michigan, and elsewhere. We compare the formula-based targeting of subsidized loans provided under the Safe Drinking Water Act with the targeting of congressional drinking water earmarks (“pork barrel” spending). Earmarks are often critiqued for potentially privileging wealthier and more politically connected communities. We find that earmarks target Black, Hispanic, and low-income communities, partly due to targeting water systems serving large populations. Earmark and loan targeting differ significantly across all the demographics we analyze. Compared to Safe Drinking Water Act loans, earmarks disproportionately target Hispanic communities but not Black or low-income communities.

10.3386/w32058.abstractZh: 美国饮用水投资的质量和不平等问题在密歇根州弗林特及其他地区发生环境灾难后受到了关注。我们将《安全饮用水法》下提供的以项目为基础的补贴贷款与国会针对饮用水项目的拨款（所谓的“ pork barrel”支出）进行了比较。这些拨款常常因可能偏袒更富裕且政治关系更紧密的社区而受到批评。我们发现，这些拨款主要针对黑人、西班牙裔和低收入社区，部分原因是这些项目针对的是服务大量人口的供水系统。在我们分析的所有人群中，拨款和贷款的目标选择存在显著差异。与《安全饮用水法》下的贷款相比，拨款更多地针对西班牙裔社区，而较少针对黑人或低收入社区。

abstract.text: A booster of the COVID-19 vaccine targeting the prevailing Omicron variant did not become available in the United States until a year after the variant was first detected. This pattern of developing, testing, and distributing a variant-specific booster may become the default response to further waves of COVID-19 caused by new variants. An innovation with realistic scientific potential—a universal COVID-19 vaccine, effective against existing and future variants—could provide much more value by preempting new variants. Averaged across Monte Carlo simulations, we estimate the incremental value to the U.S. population of a universal COVID-19 vaccine to be $1.5–$2.6 trillion greater than variant-specific boosters (depending on how the arrival rate of variants is modeled). This social value eclipses the cost of an advance market commitment to incentivize the universal vaccine by several orders of magnitude.

10.3386/w32059.abstractZh: 针对当前流行的奥密克戎变种的加强针在美国直到该变种首次被发现一年后才得以提供。这种针对特定变种开发、测试和分发加强针的做法，可能会成为应对由新变种引起的进一步疫情浪潮的默认响应。一种具有实际科学潜力的创新——一种对现有和未来变种都有效的通用新冠疫苗——可以通过预防新变种来带来更大的价值。通过蒙特卡洛模拟，我们估计，与针对特定变种的加强针相比，通用新冠疫苗对美国人口带来的增量价值高达1.5至2.6万亿美元（具体数值取决于对变种出现率的建模方式）。这一社会价值远远超过通过提前市场承诺来激励使用通用疫苗所需的成本。

abstract.text: This paper uses administrative tax records linked to Census demographic data and high-resolution measures of fine small particulate (PM2.5) exposure to study the evolution of the Black-White pollution exposure gap over the past 40 years. In doing so, we focus on the various ways in which income may have contributed to these changes using a statistical decomposition. We decompose the overall change in the Black-White PM2.5 exposure gap into (1) components that stem from rank-preserving compression in the overall pollution distribution and (2) changes that stem from a reordering of Black and White households within the pollution distribution. We find a significant narrowing of the Black-White PM2.5 exposure gap over this time period that is overwhelmingly driven by rank-preserving changes rather than positional changes. However, the relative positions of Black and White households at the upper end of the pollution distribution have meaningfully shifted in the most recent years.

10.3386/w32060.abstractZh: 本文利用与人口普查人口统计数据相关的行政税务记录以及高分辨率的小颗粒物（PM2.5）暴露数据，研究过去40年间黑人与白人之间的污染暴露差距变化。在研究中，我们重点关注收入因素对这些变化的各种影响，并通过统计分解来分析。我们将黑人与白人之间的PM2.5暴露差距的整体变化分解为两部分：（1）由于污染分布的整体压缩而导致的排名变化；（2）由于黑人与白人家庭在污染分布中的重新排序而导致的变化。我们发现，在这段时间内，黑人与白人之间的PM2.5暴露差距显著缩小，而这一缩小主要源于排名的变化，而非位置的变化。不过，近年来黑人与白人家庭在污染分布中较高位置的相对位置发生了显著变化。

abstract.text: University-based scientific research has long been argued to be a central source of commercial innovation and economic growth. Yet at the same time, there have been long-held concerns that many university-based discoveries never realize their potential social benefits. Looking across universities, research and commercialization activities such as start-up formation vary tremendously – variation that could reflect the composition and orientation of faculty research, university-level factors such as patenting and licensing efforts, or broader place-based factors such as location in a technology cluster. We take a first step towards unpacking this heterogeneity in university commercialization by analyzing how the propensity of academic research to spill over to commercial innovation changes when academics move across universities. Our estimates suggest that at least 15–25% of geographic variation in commercial spillovers from university-based research is attributable to place-specific factors.

10.3386/w32069.abstractZh: 长期以来，基于大学的科学研究一直被认为是商业创新和经济增长的核心源泉。然而，与此同时，人们也一直担心许多基于大学的发现未能充分发挥其潜在的社会效益。从整体来看，不同大学在研究与商业化活动方面的表现差异巨大——这种差异可能反映了教师研究的组成和方向、大学层面的因素如专利和许可努力，或是更广泛的地方因素，如所在技术集群的位置。我们通过分析学者在大学之间流动时，学术研究向商业创新的转化倾向如何变化，来尝试揭示这种差异性的本质。我们的估计表明，至少15%到25%的基于大学的研究所产生的商业溢出效应差异，可以归因于特定地点的因素。

abstract.text: Can better information on the value of diagnostic tests improve adoption and help patients recognize higher quality of care? In a randomized experiment in public clinics in Mali, providers and patients received tailored information about the importance of rapid diagnostic tests (RDT) for malaria. The provider training increased reliance on RDTs and improved the match between a patient’s malaria status and treatment with antimalarials by 15-30 percent.
