Using a cohort based difference in difference (DID) design and commercial claims data, we find an increase in maternal anti-depressant use by 1.5%, in zip codes with above median school closures; there are no statistically significant effects for paternal antidepressant use, and we are able to rule out fairly small values. Some parents may "self-medicate" as a coping mechanism rather than seek formal medical care. Using a county based DID design and retail scanner data, we find alcohol sales increased by 2% in counties with above median school closures. Both anti-depressant prescriptions and alcohol sales returned to base line levels as in-person schooling resumed. We explore whether the burdens of school closures were disparately concentrated in minoritized communities, and find that anti-depressant and alcohol use increases were concentrated in zip codes with above median Black and Asian populations, but not in zip codes with a predominantly White or Hispanic population. Overall, these results suggest that the school system plays an important role in maintaining population mental well-being outcomes and in helping families cope with stress.

10.3386/w32516.abstractZh: 学校以多种方式提升家庭的生活质量，而学校关闭可能导致的后果之一是父母福祉的恶化。我们通过测量常用于应对压力增加的产品的消费情况，来研究COVID-19大流行期间学校关闭对父母心理健康的影响。利用基于队列的差异对比设计以及商业宣传数据，我们发现，在学校关闭比例高于中位数的地区，母亲的抗抑郁药物使用量增加了1.5%；而父亲的抗抑郁药物使用量没有统计学上的显著变化，我们还能排除较小值的干扰。一些父母可能会通过自我用药作为应对机制，而不是寻求正式的医疗帮助。利用基于县的差异对比设计以及零售扫描数据，我们发现，在学校关闭比例高于中位数的县，酒精销售增加了2%。随着面对面教学的恢复，抗抑郁药物处方和酒精销售都回到了基线水平。我们进一步探讨了学校关闭的负担是否在不同少数族裔社区中分布不均，结果发现，抗抑郁药物和酒精使用的增加集中在学校关闭比例高于中位数的黑人和亚裔人口较多的地区，而在以白人或西班牙裔人口为主的地区则没有这种现象。总体而言，这些结果表明，学校系统在维持人口心理健康以及帮助家庭应对压力方面发挥着重要作用。

abstract.text: Between 2000 and 2008, access to high-speed, broadband internet grew significantly in the United States, but there is debate on whether access to high-speed internet improves or harms wellbeing. We find that a ten percent increase in the proportion of county residents with access to broadband internet leads to a 1.01 percent reduction in the number of suicides in a county, as well as improvements in self-reported mental and physical health. We further find that this reduction in suicide deaths is likely due to economic improvements in counties that have access to broadband internet. Counties with increased access to broadband internet see reductions in poverty rate and unemployment rate. In addition, zip codes that gain access to broadband internet see increases in the numbers of employees and establishments. In addition, heterogeneity analysis indicates that the positive effects are concentrated in the working age population, those between 25 and 64 years old. This pattern is precisely what is predicted by the literature linking economic conditions to suicide risk.

10.3386/w32517.abstractZh: 在2000年至2008年间，美国的高速宽带互联网接入显著增长，但关于高速互联网接入是否有助于改善或损害幸福感，仍存在争议。我们发现，拥有宽带互联网接入的县居民比例增加10%，会导致该县自杀人数减少1.01%，同时自我报告的心理健康和身体健康状况也有所改善。进一步分析表明，这种自杀死亡率的下降可能是由于拥有宽带互联网接入的县的经济状况有所改善。拥有更多宽带互联网接入的县，贫困率和失业率都有所下降。此外，获得宽带互联网接入的邮政编码区，其企业和员工数量也有所增加。异质性分析还表明，这些积极影响主要集中在工作年龄人口中，即25至64岁的人群。这一模式与文献中经济条件与自杀风险之间的关联预测结果完全一致。

abstract.text: We use data from the Population Assessment of Tobacco Use and Health (PATH), a longitudinal data set including self-reported and biomarker measures of tobacco use, to examine the effects of state-level tobacco 21 (T21) laws on smoking and vaping. T21 laws reduce self-reported cigarette smoking among 18-to-20 year olds, concentrated in males. Initial non-users who “age-out” of treatment are less likely to subsequently initiate self-reported smoking or vaping. Treated smokers are less likely to buy their own cigarettes and more likely to buy cigarettes in a different state. Biomarker results are mixed, and we find some evidence of a reduction in nicotine exposure but less evidence for a reduction in exposure to tobacco. Finally, we test for non-classical measurement error. T21 laws reduce the probability that clinically identified likely cigarette smokers self-report as smokers, which may increase the apparent effect of T21 laws on cigarette smoking as measured by self-reports.

10.3386/w32520.abstractZh: 我们使用了“烟草使用与健康人口评估”（PATH）的数据集，该数据集包含自我报告和生物标志物测量数据，以研究州级烟草21（T21）法律对吸烟和吸电子烟的影响。T21法律减少了18至20岁人群中自我报告的吸烟行为，且这一影响主要集中在男性身上。最初不吸烟但“随着年龄增长不再接受干预”的人群，后续开始自我报告吸烟或吸电子烟的可能性较低。接受干预的吸烟者更不愿意自己购买香烟，而更倾向于在另一个州购买香烟。生物标志物结果不一，我们发现有证据表明尼古丁暴露有所减少，但关于烟草暴露减少的证据则较少。最后，我们检验了非经典测量误差的影响。T21法律降低了临床认定可能为吸烟者的人群自我报告为吸烟者的概率，这可能增加了T21法律对吸烟行为的实际影响。

abstract.text: The vast majority of youth e-cigarette users consume flavored e-cigarettes, raising concerns from public health advocates that flavors may drive youth initiation and continued use of e-cigarettes. Flavors drew further notice from the public health community following the sudden outbreak of lung injury among vapers in 2019, prompting several states to enact sweeping bans on flavored e-cigarettes. In this study, we examine the effects of these comprehensive bans on e-cigarette use and potential spillovers into other tobacco use by youth, young adults, and adults. We utilize both standard difference-in-differences (DID) and synthetic DID methods, in conjunction with four national data sets. We find evidence that young adults decrease their use of the banned flavored e-cigarettes as well as their overall e-cigarette use, by about two percentage points, while increasing cigarette use. For youth, there is some suggestive evidence of increasing cigarette use, though these results are contaminated by pre-trend differences between treatment and control units. The bans have no effect on e-cigarette and smoking participation among older adults (ages 25+). Our findings suggest that statewide comprehensive flavor bans may have generated an unintended consequence by encouraging substitution towards traditional smoking in some populations.

10.3386/w32534.abstractZh: 绝大多数青少年电子香烟使用者使用有香味的电子香烟，这引发了公共卫生倡导者的担忧，他们认为香味可能会促使青少年开始使用并持续使用电子香烟。2019年，电子香烟使用者突然出现肺部损伤事件后，香味问题再次受到公共卫生界的关注，促使多个州实施了全面禁止有香味电子香烟的禁令。在这项研究中，我们考察了这些全面禁令对电子香烟使用的影响，以及它们可能对青少年、年轻人和成年人其他烟草使用行为产生的溢出效应。我们采用了标准差异-差异法（DID）和合成DID方法，并结合了四个全国性的数据集进行分析。我们发现，年轻人在使用被禁止的有香味电子香烟方面有所减少，整体电子香烟使用量也减少了约两个百分点，同时增加了香烟的使用量。对于青少年来说，有一些迹象表明香烟使用量有所增加，但这些结果受到了处理组和对照组之间趋势差异的干扰。这些禁令对25岁以上成年人的电子香烟和吸烟参与行为没有影响。我们的研究结果表明，全州范围内的全面禁止香味电子香烟的禁令可能在某些人群中产生了意想不到的后果，即促使人们转向传统吸烟方式。

abstract.text: Advocates for sales restrictions on flavored e-cigarettes argue that flavors appeal to young people and lead them down a path to nicotine addiction. This study is among the first to examine the effect of state and local restrictions on the sale of flavored electronic nicotine delivery system (ENDS) products on youth and young adult tobacco use. Using data from the State and National Youth Risk Behavior Surveys, we find that the adoption of an ENDS flavor restriction reduces frequent and everyday youth ENDS use by 1.2 to 2.5 percentage points. Auxiliary analyses of the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System show similar effects on ENDS use for young adults ages 18-20. However, we also detect evidence of an unintended effect of ENDS flavor restrictions that is especially clear among 18-20-year-olds: inducing substitution to combustible cigarette smoking. Finally, there is no evidence that ENDS flavor restrictions affect ENDS use among adults aged 21 and older or non-tobacco-related health behaviors such as binge drinking and illicit drug use.

10.3386/w32535.abstractZh: 支持对含味电子香烟实施销售限制的人士认为，这些口味吸引年轻人，并可能导致他们陷入尼古丁成瘾。本研究是首批探讨州级和地方政府对含味电子尼古丁输送系统产品销售限制对青少年和年轻成人烟草使用影响的研究之一。通过《州级和国家青少年风险行为调查》的数据分析，我们发现，对含味电子香烟实施销售限制可使青少年日常使用这类产品的频率降低1.2%至2.5%。对《行为风险因素监测系统》的辅助分析显示，对18-20岁年轻成人的影响同样显著。然而，我们同时也发现了一种意外的效果：含味电子香烟限制可能促使人们转向燃烧型香烟的吸烟方式。最后，没有证据表明含味电子香烟限制对21岁及以上成年人的使用行为，或诸如酗酒和非法药物使用等非烟草相关健康行为产生任何影响。

abstract.text: There is growing evidence on the importance of sleep for productivity, but little is known about the impact of interventions targeting sleep. In a field experiment among U.S. university students, we show that incentives for sleep increase both sleep and academic performance. Motivated by theories of cue-based habit formation, our primary intervention couples personalized bedtime reminders with morning feedback and immediate rewards for sleeping at least seven hours on weeknights. The intervention increases the share of nights with at least seven hours of sleep by 26 percent and average weeknight sleep by an estimated 19 minutes during a four-week treatment period, with persistent effects of about eight minutes per night during a one to five-week post-treatment period. Comparisons to secondary treatments show that immediate incentives have larger impacts on sleep than delayed incentives or reminders and feedback alone during the treatment period, but do not have statistically distinguishable impacts on longer-term sleep habits in the post-treatment period. We estimate that immediate incentives im- prove average semester course performance by 0.075 - 0.089 grade points, a 0.10 - 0.11 standard deviation increase. Our results demonstrate that incentives to sleep can be a cost-effective tool for improving educational outcomes.

10.3386/w32550.abstractZh: 越来越多的证据表明睡眠对生产力的重要性，但关于针对睡眠的干预措施的影响却知之甚少。在美国大学生中进行的一项实地实验中，我们发现激励措施能够增加睡眠时间和学业表现。基于基于提示的习惯形成理论，我们的主要干预措施包括个性化就寝提醒、早晨反馈以及对于每周夜晚至少睡眠七小时的即时奖励。在四周的干预期间，至少睡眠七小时的夜晚比例增加了26%，平均每周夜晚的睡眠时间增加了约19分钟。在一到五周的后干预期间，每晚的睡眠时间持续增加了约8分钟。与次要干预措施相比，即时激励措施对睡眠的影响更大，而在后干预期间，即时激励措施对长期睡眠习惯的影响并不具有统计学上的显著差异。我们估计，即时激励措施可以使平均学期课程成绩提高0.075至0.089个成绩点，即增加0.10至0.11个标准差。我们的结果表明，激励措施可以成为改善教育成果的一种具有成本效益的工具。

abstract.text: The opioid crisis generates broader societal harms beyond direct health and economic effects, impacting non-users through adverse spillovers on children, families, and communities. We study the spillover effects of a supply-side policy aimed at reducing the over-prescribing of opioids on women’s wellbeing by examining its effects on intimate partner violence (IPV). Using administrative data on incidents reported to law enforcement, in conjunction with quasi-experimental variation in the adoption of stringent mandatory access prescription drug monitoring programs, we find that these policies have generated a downstream benefit for women by significantly reducing their overall exposure to IPV and IPV-involved injuries by 9 to 10 percent. Strongest effects are experienced by groups with higher rates of opioid consumption at baseline, including non-Hispanic Whites. However, we also find a significant uptick in heroin-involved IPV incidents, suggesting substitution into illicit drug consumption. Our results highlight the need to identify high-risk groups prone to switching to illicit opioids and to address this risk through evidence-based policies. Accounting for effects on IPV adds to the estimated societal burden of the opioid epidemic.

10.3386/w32563.abstractZh: 阿片类药物危机不仅带来直接的健康和经济影响，还会通过负面溢出效应对非使用者造成更广泛的社会危害，包括对儿童、家庭和社区的影响。本研究探讨了旨在减少阿片类药物过度处方对女性福祉影响的供应侧政策对亲密伴侣暴力影响的溢出效应。通过利用向执法部门报告的事件行政数据，并结合严格强制性的处方药监控计划的采用情况，我们发现这些政策显著减少了女性遭受亲密伴侣暴力及因暴力导致的伤害的风险，降低了9%至10%。在基线时阿片类药物消费率较高的群体，如非西班牙裔白人，受到的影响最为显著。然而，我们也发现与非法药物消费相关的亲密伴侣暴力事件有所增加，这表明人们可能转向了非法阿片类药物。我们的研究结果强调了识别容易转向非法阿片类药物的高风险群体，并通过基于证据的政策来应对这一风险的必要性。考虑到对亲密伴侣暴力的影响，阿片类药物危机的社会负担得到了进一步加重。

abstract.text: Firms often exploit loopholes in government contracts to boost revenues. The welfare consequences of this behavior depend on how firms use the marginal windfall dollar, yet little evidence exists to guide policymakers. This paper studies how hospitals allocated over $3 billion obtained from gaming a Medicare payment loophole. The average gaming hospital increased both Medicare and total revenue by around 10%, implying large spillovers on other payers. Consistent with theories of organizational behavior, nonprofit hospitals deployed most of the windfall toward operating costs, while for-profits deducted the entire amount off their balance sheet, distributing a substantial portion to executives and shareholders. Accordingly, we detect modest reductions in mortality rates at nonprofits but no changes at for-profits. Our results imply that the consequences of such engineered windfalls vary substantially by hospital ownership.

10.3386/w32564.abstractZh: 企业经常利用政府合同的漏洞来增加收入。这种行为的福利后果取决于企业如何使用这些额外的收入，然而目前几乎没有证据可以指导政策制定者。本文研究了医院如何利用从Medicare支付漏洞中获得的超过30亿美元的收入。平均而言，利用这一漏洞的医院使Medicare收入和总收入分别增加了约10%，这意味着对其他支付方产生了较大的影响。与组织行为理论一致，非营利医院将大部分额外收入用于运营成本，而营利性医院则将所有资金从资产负债表上扣除，并将相当一部分分配给高管和股东。因此，我们发现非营利医院死亡率有所降低，而营利性医院则没有变化。我们的研究结果表明，这种人为制造的额外收入所带来的后果因医院性质的不同而大相径庭。

abstract.text: The rich live longer than the poor, but relatively little is known about the evolution of health inequality across the lifecycle. Using rich administrative data from the Netherlands, we develop an index of chronic disease burden based on the projected contribution to old-age mortality. Chronic conditions account for one-third of the mortality gap in old age. Using our index we demonstrate that health inequality arises much earlier in life; by age 35, the bottom half of the income distribution has the same disease burden as those age 50 in the top half. Approximately 60% of the divergence across income groups is due to low-income individuals developing chronic illness at a faster rate, rather than chronically ill individuals sorting into lower-income groups. Using linked health survey data, we then examine the contributions of various mediators to the incidence of chronic diseases over the life cycle. Socioeconomic and geographic factors explain most of the variation, while individual health behaviors play a moderate role. Our findings align with calls to target health policies toward early-life social determinants of health.

10.3386/w32577.abstractZh: 富人比穷人寿命更长，但关于健康不平等在整个生命周期中的演变，我们知之甚少。利用荷兰的丰富行政数据，我们开发了一个基于慢性病对老年死亡率预测贡献的慢性病负担指数。慢性病占老年时期死亡率差距的三分之一。通过我们的指数，我们发现健康不平等在生命早期就出现了；到35岁时，收入分配最低的一半人群所承受的慢性病负担与收入分配最高的一半中50岁人群相当。大约60%的收入群体差异是由于低收入个体更快地患上慢性病，而不是慢性病患者被分配到较低收入的群体。接着，我们利用关联健康调查数据，研究了各种中介因素对慢性病发病率在整个生命周期中的影响。社会经济和地理因素解释了大部分变异，而个人健康行为则起到了中等作用。我们的发现与将健康政策重点放在生命早期的社会健康决定因素上的呼吁相一致。

abstract.text: Medical provider price transparency is often touted as a way to lower health care spending. But the impact of price transparency is theoretically ambiguous: it could lower health care spending via increased consumer price shopping or improved insurer bargaining but could also raise health care prices via improved provider bargaining or provider collusion. We conduct a randomized-controlled trial to examine the impact of a state-wide medical charge transparency tool in outpatient provider markets in New York State. In the experiment, individual providers’ billed charges (list prices) were released randomly at the level of the procedure and three-digit zipcode. We use a comprehensive commercial claims database to assess the impact of this intervention and find that it leads to a small increase in overall billed charges (+0.75%). This effect is concentrated among low-priced providers in markets with low out-of-network spending, suggesting that the transparency tool improves provider pricing information. We find no evidence of quantity effects. Results do not vary consistently across specialty groups, market concentration, frequency of service use, or frequency of website use. These results are consistent with price transparency having a minimal effect on consumer shopping while slightly improving provider information about competitors’ charges.

10.3386/w32580.abstractZh: 医疗提供者价格透明度常被视为降低医疗支出的一种方式。但从理论上来看，价格透明度的效果并不明确：它可以通过增加消费者的价格选择或改善保险公司的议价能力来降低医疗支出，但也可能通过改善提供者的议价能力或提供者之间的勾结来提高医疗价格。我们开展了一项随机对照试验，以研究纽约州门诊医疗服务市场中一项全州范围的医疗收费透明度工具的影响。在实验中，个别提供者的计费金额（标价）在手术级别和三位数的邮政编码级别随机公布。我们利用全面的商业索赔数据库来评估这一干预措施的效果，发现它导致总体计费金额略有增加（+0.75%）。这种效应主要集中在网络费用较低的市场中的低价提供者身上，这表明透明度工具改善了提供者的定价信息。我们没有发现数量效应的证据。结果在不同专科群体、市场集中度、服务使用频率或网站使用频率方面并不一致。这些结果与价格透明度对消费者选择的影响较小，同时略微改善了提供者对竞争对手收费信息的了解。

abstract.text: Health insurance is increasingly provided through managed competition, in which subsidies for consumers and risk adjustment for insurers are key market design instruments. We illustrate theoretically that, in markets with adverse selection, subsidies provide greater flexibility in tailoring premiums to heterogeneous buyers, and produce equilibria with lower markups and greater enrollment. We assess these effects quantitatively using estimates from the California ACA marketplace.

10.3386/w32586.abstractZh: 健康保险越来越多地通过管理式竞争来提供，其中对消费者的补贴和对保险公司的风险调整是市场设计的关键手段。我们从理论上说明，在存在逆向选择的市场中，补贴能够更灵活地调整保费，以适应不同消费者的需求，并促成具有较低加价率和更高参保率的均衡状态。我们通过加州ACA市场的数据定量评估这些效应。

abstract.text: Current proposals aimed at reducing U.S. pharmaceutical prices would have immediate benefits (particularly for low-income and elderly populations), but are likely to dramatically reduce firms’ investment in highly welfare-improving R&D. The U.S. subsidizes the worldwide pharmaceutical market: U.S. drug prices are more than 250% of those in other OECD countries. If each drug had a single international price across the highest-income OECD countries and total pharmaceutical firm profits were held fixed: U.S. prices would fall by half; every other country’s prices would increase (by 28 to over 300%); and R&D incentives would be maintained. We propose a potential lever for the U.S. government to influence worldwide drug pricing: access to the Medicare market.

10.3386/w32606.abstractZh: 目前旨在降低美国药品价格的提案将立即带来好处（尤其是对低收入和老年人群体），但可能会大幅减少企业用于提高福利的研发投入。美国对全球药品市场进行补贴：美国药品价格比其他经合组织国家的价格高出250%以上。如果每种药品在最高收入经合组织国家都有一个统一的国际价格，并且制药公司的总利润保持不变，那么美国的价格将下降一半；其他国家的价格则将上升28%至300%以上；同时，研发激励措施仍会保持。我们建议美国政府可以利用一个潜在的手段来影响全球药品价格：进入医疗保险市场。

abstract.text: We analyze the economic consequences of rising US health care prices. By increasing the cost of employer-sponsored health insurance, rising prices serve as a de facto payroll tax on labor. Using exposure to hospital mergers as an instrument, we estimate that a 1% increase in health care prices lowers payroll and employment at non-health-care employers by 0.4%. At the county level, a 1% increase in health care prices reduces labor income by 0.27%, increases flows into unemployment by 1%, and lowers federal income tax receipts by 0.4%. The disemployment effects of rising prices are concentrated among lower- and middle-income workers.

10.3386/w32613.abstractZh: 我们分析了美国医疗保健价格上升的经济后果。通过增加雇主提供的健康保险成本，价格上涨实际上相当于对劳动力征收的一种工资税。以医院合并风险作为衡量指标，我们估计医疗保健价格每上升1%，非医疗保健雇主的薪资和就业人数将分别减少0.4%。在县级层面，医疗保健价格每上升1%，劳动力收入将减少0.27%，失业人数将增加1%，联邦所得税收入将减少0.4%。价格上涨导致的劳动力流失主要影响的是低收入和中等收入工人。

abstract.text: This study exploits experimental variation in parent human capital (early-life school-based deworming) and a shock to schooling (extended Covid closures) to estimate how these factors interact in the production of child human capital within a sample of 3,500 Kenyan 3-8 year olds. Parents with additional exposure to childhood deworming have children with improved human capital, including in health, non-cognitive development, and cognition; cognitive scores are +0.26 standard deviation units higher among treated parents' school-age children, only prior to school closures. Findings are interpreted through a model where home-based and school inputs are complements in the production of child cognition.

10.3386/w32617.abstractZh: 本研究利用实验性变量——父母的人力资本（早期通过学校进行驱虫治疗）以及教育环境的冲击（因新冠疫情而延长的中断教育时间）——来估计这些因素如何相互作用，从而影响肯尼亚3至8岁儿童的人力资本发展。研究发现，那些在儿童时期接受过驱虫治疗的父母所生子女，在健康、非认知发展和认知能力方面都表现出更好的表现；在学龄儿童中，接受驱虫治疗的父母所生子女的认知分数比未接受驱虫治疗的父母所生子女高出0.26个标准差单位，且这一优势仅在教育中断期间显现。研究通过模型分析，表明家庭教育和学校教育在儿童认知发展中的作用是相互补充的。

abstract.text: We provide novel evidence on the role of social comparisons in shaping adolescent body misperception. Using an instrumental variables approach leveraging variation in relative age generated by school entry cutoff months and data from the Health Behaviour in School-Aged Children study, we show that relatively older students are more likely to misperceive their weight harshly relative to their BMIs compared to their same-age counterparts who are relatively younger within their classrooms. Meanwhile, relatively younger students are more likely to misperceive their weight leniently relative to their BMIs. We then show that relatively older students are less likely to be overweight or obese, consume more low-calorie foods, and report higher levels of physical activity. Overall, our results suggest that relatively older students base their weight-related expectations and behaviors on their younger peers, while relatively younger students compare themselves to their older peers.

10.3386/w32629.abstractZh: 我们提供了关于社会比较在塑造青少年身体认知偏差中的作用的新的证据。通过利用学校入学截止日期导致的相对年龄变化，并结合《学龄儿童健康行为研究》的数据，我们发现相对年龄较大的学生更有可能对自己的体重相对于BMI产生过重的认知偏差，而同龄中相对较年轻的学生则更有可能对自己的体重产生较轻的认知偏差。同时，相对年龄较小的学生更有可能对自己的体重相对于BMI产生较轻的认知偏差。我们还发现，相对年龄较大的学生不太可能超重或肥胖，他们更可能摄入更多的低热量食物，并且报告的体育活动水平也更高。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，相对年龄较大的学生基于同龄人的认知来形成与体重相关的期望和行为，而相对年龄较小的学生则通过比较自己与年龄较大的同龄人来形成这些认知。

abstract.text: Two million Mexicans were granted lawful permanent residency in the U.S. under the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986 (IRCA). We find that a prominent proxy for legal status poorly detects this event. A decade after legalization, the share of Mexicans who are likely legal according to this proxy shows little change in survey data. Estimates rule out increases of three and eight percentage points relative to comparison groups of Mexican Americans and non-Hispanic Blacks, respectively – figures well below expectations based on administrative data. In contrast, an actual measure of status, citizenship, does rise in line with administrative facts.

10.3386/w32632.abstractZh: 根据1986年的《移民改革与控制法》，有200万墨西哥人在美国获得了合法永久居留权。我们发现，一种常用的法律地位指标未能很好地反映这一变化。在合法化十年后，根据这一指标判断墨西哥人可能具有合法身份的比例在调查数据中几乎没有变化。估计结果显示，与墨西哥裔美国人和非西班牙裔黑人对照组相比，这一比例分别只增加了3个百分点和8个百分点——这一数字远低于基于行政数据的预期。相比之下，实际的法律地位指标——公民身份——确实与行政数据相符。

abstract.text: We estimate the effects of permanent legal status on the health of children born to immigrants in the United States using variation from the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986 (IRCA). Our empirical approach compares trends in birth outcomes for foreign-born Mexican mothers across counties with different application rates under IRCA’s large-scale legalization programs. Maternal legalization raised birthweight. Effects arose immediately after the application process began – five years before affected women became Medicaid-eligible – suggesting causal mechanisms besides improved access to early prenatal care. Changes in the composition of births, stemming from changes in fertility and family reunification, contribute to but far from fully explain the birthweight impacts. The more likely mechanisms were instead the increases in family income and reductions in stress that came from gaining legal status.

10.3386/w32635.abstractZh: 我们利用1986年《移民改革与控制法》的变更，估算了永久合法身份对在美国出生的移民子女健康的影响。我们的实证方法比较了在《移民改革与控制法》大规模合法化计划下，不同申请率的县中，外国出生的墨西哥母亲所生子女的出生结果趋势。母亲获得合法身份后，婴儿的出生体重有所提高。这种影响在申请过程开始后的五年内就显现出来——这比受影响的女性获得医疗补助资格的时间要早五年——这表明除了改善早期产前护理外，还有其他因果机制在起作用。出生构成的改变，源于生育率和家庭团聚的变化，对出生体重的影响有所贡献，但远不足以完全解释这一现象。更可能的机制是，获得合法身份后，家庭收入增加，压力减轻。

abstract.text: Australia had adopted a novel approach to e-cigarette policy by requiring a physician’s prescription to lawfully obtain nicotine e-cigarettes. We conducted an online discrete choice experiment to gauge how adult Australian smokers made hypothetical choices between cigarettes, prescription e-cigarettes, non-prescription e-cigarettes, and quitting. We estimate a mixed logit model, which allows us to predict the market shares under different policy scenarios. The mixed logit model also provides estimates of consumer willingness to pay for the benefits from the prescription status of e-cigarettes and the costs of illegal e-cigarette markets. We estimate that the average utility loss from an illegal retail market is worth AU$7.90 per pack-equivalent. We use the corresponding estimates of the compensating variations in income to conduct cost-benefit analyses of possible reforms to Australian e-cigarette regulation. In aggregate, we estimate that the benefits of allowing but not requiring prescriptions of e-cigarettes are AU$1.8 billion per year. Our paper provides a novel contribution to research on e-cigarette regulation and provides a case-study for the policy implementation in Australia. Our paper is also part of our research agenda to explore and develop methods to conduct policy analysis and cost-benefit analysis of regulatory policies that might create illegal markets.

10.3386/w32654.abstractZh: 澳大利亚采用了一种新颖的电子烟政策，要求持有医生处方才能合法获取含尼古丁的电子烟。我们进行了在线离散选择实验，以了解澳大利亚成年烟民在香烟、处方电子烟、非处方电子烟以及戒烟之间的假设选择。我们采用混合逻辑模型进行估计，该模型使我们能够预测不同政策情景下的市场份额。混合逻辑模型还提供了关于消费者愿意为电子烟的处方状态带来的好处以及非法电子烟市场带来的成本的成本效益分析。我们估计，非法零售市场带来的平均效用损失相当于每包equivalent 7.90澳元。我们利用相应的收入补偿变化估计值，对澳大利亚电子烟监管可能的改革进行了成本效益分析。总体而言，我们估计，允许电子烟销售但不要求处方的情况每年可带来18亿澳元的收益。我们的论文为电子烟监管研究提供了新的视角，并为澳大利亚的政策实施提供了案例研究。此外，我们的论文也是我们研究议程的一部分，旨在探索和发展方法，以对可能创造非法市场的监管政策进行政策分析和成本效益分析。

abstract.text: What happens when the findings of a prominent medical study are overturned? Using a medical trial on breech births, we estimate the effect of the reversal of such a medical study on physician choices and infant health outcomes. Using the United States Birth Certificate Records from 1995-2010, we employ a difference-in-differences estimator for C-sections, low Apgar, and low birth weight measures. We find that the reversal of a multi-site, high profile, randomized control trial on the appropriate delivery of term breech births, the Term Breech Trial (TBT), led to a 15-23 percent decline in C-sections for such births at a time when the overall trend in C-sections was rising. We find our largest estimated effects amongst traditionally disadvantaged groups. However, we do not find that such a change in practice had significant impacts on infant health. Contrary to prior studies, we find that physicians updated their beliefs quickly, and do indeed adjust to new medical research, particularly young physicians, prior to mandatory policy or professional guidelines.

10.3386/w32656.abstractZh: 当一项著名的医学研究的结论被推翻时，会发生什么？我们通过一项关于臀位分娩的医学试验，估计了此类研究结论的逆转对医生选择及婴儿健康结果的影响。利用1995至2010年的美国出生证明记录，我们采用了差异估计方法来计算剖宫产、低Apgar评分和低出生体重等指标的影响。研究发现，一项关于适时处理臀位分娩的多中心、高知名度的随机对照试验的结论被推翻后，此类分娩的剖宫产率下降了15-23%，而此时整体剖宫产率呈上升趋势。我们发现，传统上处于不利地位的群体受到的影响最大。然而，我们并未发现这种实践方式的改变对婴儿健康有显著影响。与先前的研究不同，我们发现医生迅速更新了他们的信念，并且确实会适应新的医学研究，尤其是年轻医生，在强制性的政策或专业指南出台之前。

abstract.text: Enrollment in one public benefit program often affects enrollment in others. We study life-course spillovers by examining how access to publicly subsidized health insurance prior to age 65 affects public benefit choices at the age of Medicare eligibility. We use administrative data to examine several Medicare enrollment choices: the heavily under-subscribed Medicaid “dual” coverage as a supplement to Medicare; Medicare Part D; the Part D Low Income Subsidy (LIS); and Medicare Advantage. Focusing on people living in low-income zip codes, we find a large increase in dual Medicaid among new Medicare beneficiaries in Medicaid expansion states relative to non- expansion states, as well as corresponding increases in healthcare use and reductions in out-of-pocket spending. The dual Medicaid increase exerts a bonus effect: greater take-up of LIS and Part D programs, which we attribute to the accompanying automatic enrollment in these programs. Our results on Medicare Advantage enrollment are inconclusive. Overall, our results suggest that experience with Medicaid before age 65 causes meaningful behavioral responses among the lowest-income beneficiaries when they age into Medicare; this emphasizes the importance of longitudinal spillovers also present in other public programs with eligibility criteria that differ by applicant age (e.g., Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) and Supplemental Security Income (SSI)).

10.3386/w32675.abstractZh: 参与一项公共福利计划通常会影响其他计划的参与情况。我们通过研究65岁之前获得公共补贴的医疗保险对进入Medicare资格年龄时的公共福利选择的影响，来探讨生命历程中的溢出效应。我们利用行政数据来考察几种Medicare的参与选择：严重短缺的Medicaid“双重”覆盖作为Medicare的补充；Medicare Part D；Part D低收入补贴；以及Medicare Advantage。重点关注生活在低收入邮政编码区的人们，我们发现，在Medicaid扩展州，新加入Medicare的受益者中，双重Medicaid的覆盖率显著增加，同时医疗保健的使用也相应增加，自付支出则有所减少。双重Medicaid的增加还产生了额外的效应：Part D和低收入补贴项目的参与率也相应增加，我们认为这是由于这些项目具有自动加入的特性。关于Medicare Advantage的参与情况，我们的研究结果并不明确。总体而言，我们的结果表明，65岁之前使用Medicaid的经历会在低收入受益者进入Medicare时引发显著的行为反应；这强调了纵向溢出效应的重要性，这种效应也存在于其他具有不同申请人年龄资格标准的公共项目中（例如，补充营养援助计划（SNAP）和补充安全收入计划（SSI））。

abstract.text: Individuals of Middle Eastern and North African (MENA) ancestry in the US have been targeted by anti-immigrant and counterterrorism policies and have been the focus of vitriolic political rhetoric. Despite this, lack of data identifying MENA individuals has prevented systematic evaluation of the impact of these policies and rhetoric on MENA communities’ wellbeing, including investment in health capital. This paper begins to address this gap in knowledge using a large, longitudinal medical records database with expanded race and ethnicity measures to describe disparities and evaluate the impact of immigration policies and anti-MENA rhetoric on preventive care use among MENA children in the US. Specifically, we evaluate the election of Donald Trump, and find that the election decreased MENA children’s utilization of vaccinations and well visits. Documenting MENA health and outcomes following official US policy and rhetoric is paramount for understanding the full consequences of policies that target underrepresented groups.

10.3386/w32676.abstractZh: 在美国，中东和北非血统的个人一直成为反移民和反恐政策的目标，也成为激烈政治言论的焦点。然而，由于缺乏识别中东和北非血统个人的数据，这些政策和言论对中东和北非社区福祉的影响，包括健康资本的投入，一直未能得到系统的评估。本文利用一个大型的纵向医疗记录数据库，通过扩展的种族和族裔指标来描述差异，并评估移民政策和反中东和北非言论对美国中东和北非儿童预防保健使用的影响。具体而言，我们评估了唐纳德·特朗普的当选，发现这次选举导致中东和北非儿童接种疫苗和定期体检的频率下降。记录中东和北非人在美国官方政策和言论下的健康状况和结果，对于理解针对少数群体的政策的全部后果至关重要。

abstract.text: Unlike most developed countries, the U.S. lacks a federal paid sick leave policy. As a result, many workers must choose between losing earnings and attending to childcare responsibilities. To date, 17 states and the District of Columbia have adopted or announced paid sick leave mandates that provide up to seven days of paid leave per year that can be used for family responsibilities and healthcare. In this study, we estimate the effects of state paid sick leave mandates on parents’ time spent providing childcare using time diaries from the 2004-2023 American Time Use Survey. Findings from difference-in-differences estimators suggest that post-mandate, parental time spent providing childcare increases by 5.8%. Effects are stronger among women with younger children. Overall, our findings suggest that paid sick leave mandates allow parents to better balance work and family responsibilities.

10.3386/w32710.abstractZh: 与大多数发达国家不同，美国缺乏联邦层面的带薪病假政策。因此，许多工人必须在收入损失和照顾孩子责任之间做出选择。截至目前，已有17个州和哥伦比亚特区采纳或宣布了带薪病假规定，每年提供最多7天的带薪假期，用于家庭责任和医疗保健。本研究利用2004-2023年美国时间使用调查的数据，估算了各州带薪病假规定对父母照顾孩子时间的影响。差异估计结果表明，在实行带薪病假规定后，父母用于照顾孩子的时间增加了5.8%。这一影响在子女年龄较小的女性中更为明显。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，带薪病假规定有助于父母更好地平衡工作与家庭责任。

abstract.text: We study a randomized trial in which 1,000 low-income U.S. adults age 21 to 40 received $1,000 per month for three years, from November 2020 until October 2023, while 2,000 control participants received $50 monthly over that same period. The transfer produced large but short-lived improvements in stress and food security and increased hospital, emergency department, and dental care use. However, it did not improve self-reported physical health, clinical biomarkers, or mental health after the first year, and we can rule out small effects on many outcomes. We also find no effects on the health of children in participants’ households.

10.3386/w32711.abstractZh: 我们研究了一项随机试验，其中1000名年龄在21至40岁的美国低收入成年人，在2020年11月至2023年10月期间，每月获得1000美元的资金支持，为期三年。同时，还有2000名对照组参与者在同一时期每月仅获得50美元的资金。这项资助在压力和食品安全方面产生了显著但短暂的提升，并增加了医院、急诊部门和牙科护理的使用。然而，在第一年后，它并未改善参与者自我报告的身体健康状况、临床生物标志物或心理健康状况，我们还可以排除许多结果受到微小影响的可能性。此外，我们也没有发现这项资助对参与者家庭中的儿童健康产生任何影响。

abstract.text: The U.S. healthcare system requires substantial out-of-pocket payments by most consumers, which can prevent some from receiving needed medical services. Recent policy proposals seek to address this problem by increasing government health care spending in order to reduce out-of-pocket costs. The social value of these policies rests in part on the extent to which consumers face credit constraints in financing medical spending. We present a novel analysis of whether elderly households face such credit constraints by estimating the effects of wealth variation from home price changes on out-of-pocket medical expenditures. Using data from the Health and Retirement Study and various measures of home price changes, we find no evidence that housing wealth impacts out-of-pocket medical spending. The estimates are universally small and precise, allowing us to rule out even modest-sized effects. Effects are zero across the expenditure distribution, for specific categories of expenditure, and for different types of consumers split by health insurance status and SES. Our results suggest that further subsidizing health care for elderly homeowners, the majority of older Americans, would increase moral hazard costs without increasing access to needed care.

10.3386/w32729.abstractZh: 美国的医疗保健体系要求大多数消费者承担较大的自付费用，这可能会阻碍一些人获得必要的医疗服务。最近的政策提案试图通过增加政府医疗保健支出来降低自付费用。这些政策的社会价值部分在于消费者在融资医疗支出时面临的信用限制程度。我们通过对房价变化导致的财富差异对自付医疗支出影响的估计，对老年家庭是否面临此类信用限制进行了新颖的分析。利用《健康与退休研究》的数据以及各种房价变化指标，我们发现住房财富对自付医疗支出没有影响。估计值非常小且精确，使我们能够排除即使是较小的影响。在支出分布、特定支出类别以及按健康保险状态和社会经济地位划分的不同消费者群体中，这种影响均为零。我们的结果表明，进一步为老年房主提供医疗补贴，虽然不会增加获得必要护理的机会，但会增加道德风险成本。

abstract.text: Early fertility is thought to be one of the key barriers to female human capital attainment in sub-Saharan Africa, yet contraceptive take-up remains puzzlingly low among women in critical periods for human capital investment. We study a barrier to hormonal contraceptive uptake among young, nulliparious women that, while recognized in the qualitative literature, has not been causally tested: the persistent (incorrect) belief — grounded in medical mistrust and an adverse history of population control policies — that these contraceptives cause later infertility. This belief creates a perceived tradeoff between current and future reproductive control. We use a randomized controlled trial with female undergraduates at the flagship university in Zambia to test two interventions to increase contraceptive use. Despite high rates of sexual activity, low rates of condom-use, and near zero desire for current pregnancy, only 5% of this population uses hormonal contraceptives at baseline. Providing a voucher to visit a local clinic — greatly reducing access costs — only temporarily increases contraceptive use. However, pairing this transfer with a carefully-designed treatment to change persistent incorrect beliefs that contraceptives cause infertility doubles the initial effect, persistently increases contraceptive take-up over 6 months, and reduces reported pregnancies by as much as 71%. This treatment reduces self-reports that contraceptives cause infertility, and compliers are more likely to cite fear of infertility as the reason for not using contraceptives at baseline. IV estimates indicate that eliminating the belief that contraceptives cause infertility would more than triple contraceptive use.

10.3386/w32735.abstractZh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲地区，早期生育能力被认为是女性人力资本积累的主要障碍之一，然而，在人力资本投资的关键时期，女性对避孕措施的采用率却低得令人费解。我们研究了一个阻碍年轻无子女女性使用激素避孕措施的障碍，这一障碍虽然在相关文献中有所提及，但并未经过因果验证：基于医学不信任以及过去人口控制政策的负面影响，人们一直认为这些避孕措施会导致后期不孕。这种观念使得人们认为当前的生育控制与未来的生育控制之间存在权衡。我们在赞比亚的一所顶尖大学对女性本科生进行了随机对照试验，尝试通过两种干预措施来提高避孕措施的采用率。尽管性活动率较高，但避孕套的使用率较低，且几乎没有怀孕的意愿，但基线时只有5%的人使用激素避孕措施。提供代金券以前往当地诊所，虽然大大降低了使用成本，但仅能暂时增加避孕措施的采用率。然而，将这种代金券与精心设计的治疗措施相结合，以改变人们认为避孕措施会导致不孕的顽固观念，则能够翻倍增加避孕措施的采用率，并在6个月内将报告的怀孕率降低多达71%。这种治疗减少了关于避孕措施会导致不孕的自我报告，并且接受治疗的女性更有可能将害怕不孕作为不采用避孕措施的原因。实验结果表明，消除“避孕措施会导致不孕”的观念将使避孕措施的采用率增加三倍以上。

abstract.text: The purpose of this paper is to conduct a theoretical and empirical analysis of how the behavior of parents and children is affected by the presence or absence of long-term care insurance (LTCI). In our empirical analysis, we use micro data from the Japan Household Panel Survey on Consumer Preferences and Satisfaction (JHPS-CPS), formerly known as the Preference Parameter Study, conducted by Osaka University. Japan is an interesting case to analyze because a public LTCI system was introduced there in 2000. Our analysis shows that, in the case of Japan, if parents are eligible for public LTCI benefits, their children will be less likely to be their primary caregiver and that this, in turn, will reduce their children’s perceived likelihood of receiving a bequest from them. This result implies that bequests are selfishly or strategically motivated (i.e., that parents leave bequests to their children in order to elicit care from them) and that the introduction of a public LTCI system will reduce the likelihood of children providing care to their parents and through this channel reduce their perceived likelihood of receiving a bequest from them.

10.3386/w32744.abstractZh: 本文旨在对父母与子女的行为如何受到长期护理保险（LTCI）存在或不存在的影响进行理论和实证分析。在实证分析中，我们采用了大阪大学先前进行的“日本家庭面板调查关于消费者偏好与满意度”（JHPS-CPS）中的微观数据。选择日本作为分析对象的原因在于，该国在2000年引入了公共LTCI制度。我们的分析表明，在日本，如果父母有资格享受公共LTCI福利，他们的子女就不太可能成为他们的主要照顾者，这反过来会降低子女从父母那里获得遗产的可能性。这一结果意味着，遗产的分配是出于自私或策略性的动机（即父母将遗产留给子女是为了获得他们的照顾），而公共LTCI制度的引入将减少子女照顾父母的可能性，从而降低子女从父母那里获得遗产的可能性。

abstract.text: We develop a framework for distinguishing between two competing mechanisms of habit formation and apply it to a three-year randomized experiment on annual health screenings among 4,799 university employees. Annually re-randomized incentives generate exogenous variation in early, late, and repeated screening, allowing us to test whether habits are strengthened by additional consumption or instead form discretely once consumption crosses a threshold. We find strong habit formation from initial exposure: completing a first screening raised subsequent screening rates by 32.4–36.1 percentage points (90%–111%). In contrast, completing a second screening had no detectable additional effect. Our results reject reinforcement models, including addiction, which predict repeated participation should strengthen the habit, and instead support a threshold model in which a single exposure is sufficient to establish and sustain the habit. Observational estimates imply the opposite conclusion, showing the value of rigorous research design in identifying mechanisms of habit formation.

10.3386/w32745.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个框架，用于区分两种竞争性的习惯形成机制，并将其应用于一项为期三年的随机实验，该实验针对4,799名大学员工进行了年度健康筛查。每年重新随机分配的激励措施产生了早期、晚期和重复筛查的外生变化，使我们能够测试习惯是通过额外消费加强的，还是一旦消费超过某个阈值就会形成。我们发现，从初次接触开始，习惯的形成就非常明显：完成第一次筛查后，后续筛查率提高了32.4%至36.1%（90%至111%）。相比之下，完成第二次筛查并没有显示出明显的额外效果。我们的研究结果否定了强化模型，包括成瘾模型，这些模型预测重复参与应该会加强习惯，而我们的结果则支持一个阈值模型，即一次接触就足以建立并维持习惯。观察性估计则得出了相反的结论，这表明严谨的研究设计对于识别习惯形成机制至关重要。

abstract.text: Social insurance programs shield individuals from specific risks, but these programs are not necessarily independent of each other. The existence and scope of one program can potentially influence the use of others, especially when the risks covered by the programs are related. This study investigates the relationship between two mandated benefit programs in the United States: state paid sick leave (PSL) mandates and workers’ compensation. Unlike most developed countries, the U.S. lacks a federal PSL mandate; however, 15 states have implemented such policies. PSL mandates require firms to provide compensated time off for employee health-related needs, while workers’ compensation offers benefits to help workers recover from workplace injuries or illnesses. Using a difference-in-differences analysis, the study explores the impact of state PSL mandates on the usage of workers’ compensation benefits. The findings reveal meaningful spillover effects: when states adopt PSL requirements, there is a decrease in workers’ compensation benefit receipt. While some evidence suggests possible improvements in health, there are no observed reductions in workplace injury rates specifically, indicating that workers may substitute PSL benefits directly for workers’ compensation.

10.3386/w32751.abstractZh: 社会保险计划能够保护个人免受特定风险的影响，但这些计划之间并不一定相互独立。一个计划的存在和范围可能会影响其他计划的使用，尤其是在这些计划所涵盖的风险相互关联的情况下。本研究探讨了美国两个强制性福利计划之间的关系：州级支付的病假福利要求和工伤赔偿。与大多数发达国家不同，美国没有联邦层面的病假福利要求；不过，有15个州已经实施了此类政策。病假福利要求要求企业为员工提供与健康相关的补偿性休假，而工伤赔偿则提供帮助员工从工伤或疾病中恢复所需的福利。通过差异-差异分析，本研究探讨了州级病假福利要求对工伤赔偿福利使用的影响。研究结果表明存在显著的溢出效应：当各州实施病假福利要求时，工伤赔偿福利的领取量会下降。虽然有一些证据表明健康状况可能有所改善，但并没有观察到工作场所受伤率的明显下降，这表明员工可能会直接选择使用病假福利而非工伤赔偿。

abstract.text: SHARE, the “Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe”, is a large population-based panel survey among people aged 50 and over with data from 28 European countries and Israel. It investigates individual, economic, health-related, and social life-course circumstances in order to shed light on the challenges of population aging for individuals and society as a whole. Understanding aging per se, and how we age differently over the life course given our individual backgrounds, current health, and socio-economic factors, are the aims of SHARE. In order to maintain intertemporal, international and intercultural comparability, SHARE has adopted collection of objective data in the health domain. SHARE measures physical performance, such as grip strength, peak expiratory flow, walking speed, chair stand, word recall, and Euro-D depression among others in the physical, cognitive and mental health modules. In 2015, SHARE collected dried blood spot (DBS) samples as an additional objective measure of health. Eleven European countries and Israel participated in the DBS collection. The collection was harmonized in terms of designing documents, gaining consent, procuring blood-collection material, and training interviewers how to collect DBS samples while observing the national ethic and administrative regulations in all countries. Altogether, approximately 27,200 respondents consented, resulting in an overall participation rate of 67% with considerable differences between countries and interviewers. This report describes the carefully monitored processes of gaining consent for DBS collection and for the implementation, collection and evaluation of the to-date largest DBS-based study of a representative adult population in Europe. We also describe the choice of blood biomarkers, the assays employed to determine the blood biomarker concentrations in DBS collected in the home of survey respondents and the validation and adjustment of the laboratory results for the impact of sample collection in a non-medical environment. Finally, we present the data obtained for seven out of 17 blood biomarkers. The data for the remaining ten biomarkers analyzed at the Statens Serum Institut will follow in a separate release.

10.3386/w32764.abstractZh: SHARE，即“欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查”，是一项针对50岁及以上人群的大规模基于人口的面板调查，数据来自28个欧洲国家和以色列。该调查旨在探究个人、经济、健康相关以及社会生活历程中的各种情况，以揭示人口老龄化对个人和社会整体的挑战。了解老龄化本身，以及我们在生命历程中因个人背景、当前健康状况和社会经济因素而表现出不同的衰老方式，是SHARE的研究目标。为了保持时间、国际和跨文化上的可比性，SHARE在健康领域采用了客观数据收集方法。在身体、认知和心理健康模块中，SHARE测量了诸如握力、峰值呼气流速、步行速度、站立时间、词汇回忆能力以及Euro-D抑郁指数等身体表现指标。2015年，SHARE还收集了干血斑样本作为额外的健康指标。11个欧洲国家和以色列参与了干血斑样本的收集工作。这些样本的收集在文件设计、获得同意、采购采血材料以及培训调查员如何收集干血斑样本等方面都进行了统一，同时遵守了各国的伦理和行政规定。共有约27,200名受访者同意参与调查，整体参与率为67%，但不同国家和调查员之间的参与率存在显著差异。本报告详细描述了为干血斑样本收集而进行的严格同意过程，以及迄今为止在欧洲进行的规模最大的基于干血斑样本的代表性成人人口研究实施、收集和评估的过程。我们还描述了血液生物标志物的选择、用于测定家庭调查中受访者采集的血液中生物标志物浓度的检测方法，以及针对非医疗环境样本采集影响对实验室结果的验证和调整。最后，我们展示了17种血液生物标志物中7种的数据。其余10种生物标志物的数据将在Statens Serum Institut的分析中公布。

abstract.text: This study examines the link between abortion access and child maltreatment using data from the National Incident-Based Reporting System, National Child Abuse and Neglect Data System (NCANDS), and the Myers abortion facility database from 2011 to 2018. A 100-mile increase in travel distance to the nearest abortion facility increases maltreatment reports by 8.5%, driven by child neglect and physical abuse, with strongest effects for infants, non-White children, and those in disadvantaged, minority, and rural areas. Analyses with NCANDS data and eviction records highlight economic stability and housing security as mediators. These findings highlight the importance of reproductive healthcare access in reducing maltreatment and alleviating associated socioeconomic challenges.

10.3386/w32771.abstractZh: 本研究利用2011至2018年的国家基于事件的报告系统、国家儿童虐待和忽视数据系统以及迈尔斯堕胎设施数据库的数据，探讨了堕胎机会与儿童虐待之间的关系。研究发现，距离最近的堕胎设施每增加100英里，儿童虐待报告就会增加8.5%，其中儿童被忽视和身体虐待的情况尤为严重，对婴儿、非白人儿童以及处于弱势、少数族裔和农村地区的儿童影响最为显著。通过NCANDS数据和驱逐记录的分析，发现经济稳定性和住房安全是促成这一关系的因素。这些发现强调了生殖健康服务的可及性在减少儿童虐待和缓解相关社会经济挑战中的重要性。

abstract.text: The FDA is responsible for the approval of new drugs, biological products and medical devices in the United States. As part of the approval process, the FDA relies on advisory committees, which provide independent advice from outside experts. We combine a structural approach with newly collected data from meetings' transcripts to study the process of collective learning and policy recommendation in advisory committees. We quantify the effectiveness of advisory panels, and evaluate changes to its institutional framework. We find that deliberation significantly increases the accuracy of decision-making. Changes in deliberation rules or committee membership do not uniformly improve outcomes.

10.3386/w32787.abstractZh: 美国食品药品监督管理局负责在美国批准新药物、生物制品和医疗器械。作为审批流程的一部分，FDA依靠咨询委员会提供外部专家的独立建议。我们结合结构化的分析方法以及从会议记录中收集的新数据，研究咨询委员会中的集体学习及政策建议过程。我们量化了咨询小组的有效性，并评估其制度框架的变化。研究发现，审议过程显著提高了决策的准确性。然而，改变审议规则或委员会成员结构并不能普遍改善结果。

abstract.text: Doctors often treat similar patients differently, which affects health outcomes and medical spending. We assess the recent literature on doctor decision making through the lens of a model that incorporates diagnostic and procedural skills, beliefs, incentives, and differences in patient pools. Decision making is affected by beliefs, training, experience, peer effects, financial incentives, and time constraints. Interventions to improve decision making include providing information, guidelines, and technologies like electronic medical records and algorithmic decision tools. Economists have made progress in understanding doctor decision making, but applications of that knowledge to improving health care are still limited.

10.3386/w32788.abstractZh: 医生常常对相似的患者采取不同的治疗方法，这会影响患者的健康结果和医疗支出。我们通过一种模型来评估关于医生决策制定的最新研究，该模型考虑了诊断与操作技能、信念、激励因素以及患者群体的差异。决策制定受到信念、培训、经验、同伴效应、财务激励和时间限制的影响。改善决策制定的干预措施包括提供信息、指导方针，以及使用电子病历和算法决策工具等技术。经济学家在理解医生决策制定方面取得了进展，但将这些知识应用于改善医疗保健方面仍然有限。

abstract.text: We investigate how formularies used by pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) can affect manufacturer rebates for branded drugs.We first present a theoretical model of multidimensional contracting in which a PBM negotiates with drug manufacturers over menus of formularycontingent rebate payments and then selects a formulary.We then estimate how formulary placement affects drug demand for statins using data from Princeton University, a large employer that contracts with a single PBM to offer prescription drug coverage to its employees.Using our theoretical model and demand estimates, we predict how rebates are affected by the use of a preferred tier in the formulary or the ability to exclude a drug from coverage.Our predictions align with aggregate rebate data, and we find that allowing a PBM to place branded drugs on preferred and non-preferred tiers can substantially increase negotiated rebate payments.

10.3386/w32790.abstractZh: 我们研究了药品福利管理公司所使用的处方格式如何影响品牌药物的制造商回扣。首先，我们提出了一个多维契约的理论模型，其中药品福利管理公司与药品制造商就处方格式相关的回扣支付方案进行协商，然后选择一种处方格式。接着，我们利用普林斯顿大学的数据来估计处方格式的设定对他汀类药物需求的影响。普林斯顿大学是一个大型雇主，它与单一的药品福利管理公司合作，为其员工提供处方药覆盖服务。通过我们的理论模型和需求估计数据，我们预测了回扣如何受到处方格式中优先级别的使用或排除某些药物从覆盖范围中移除的影响。我们的预测与总体回扣数据一致，我们发现允许药品福利管理公司将品牌药物分为优先级别和非优先级别，可以显著提高协商得到的回扣支付金额。

abstract.text: Since the 2000s, economists across fields have increasingly used consumer credit reporting data for research. We introduce readers to the economics of and the institutional details of these data. Using examples from the literature, we provide practical guidance on how to use these data to construct economic measures of borrowing, consumption, credit access, financial distress, and geographic mobility. We explain what credit scores measure, and why. We highlight how researchers can access credit reporting data via existing datasets or by creating new datasets, including by linking credit reporting data with surveys and external datasets.

10.3386/w32791.abstractZh: 自2000年代以来，各个领域的经济学家越来越多地利用消费者信用报告数据进行研究。我们向读者介绍这些数据的经济学原理以及相关的制度细节。通过文献中的实例，我们提供了如何利用这些数据来构建关于借贷、消费、信用获取、财务困境和地理流动性等经济指标的实用指导。我们解释了信用评分所衡量的内容及其背后的原因。我们还强调了研究人员如何通过现有的数据集或创建新的数据集来获取信用报告数据，包括将信用报告数据与调查和外部数据集相结合的方法。

abstract.text: We study the labor market impacts of unions by accounting for their effects on employers’ insurance provision and examine how social insurance policies, in turn, affect unionization and labor market outcomes. We document that unions increase employer-sponsored insurance provision and that expansions in social insurance reduce unionization in the United States. We then develop and estimate an equilibrium labor search model where unionization, wages, and non-wage benefits are endogenously determined. We demonstrate that unionization, as well as the threat of unionization, increases employer-sponsored insurance provision in both unionized and nonunionized firms. We find that social insurance policies can affect labor market inequality through (de)unionization, and inequality may increase or decrease depending on how social insurance is targeted. Social insurance expansions, along with technological changes, contribute to the long-term decline of unions in the U.S. in the last fifty years. Although historical deunionization driven by these forces increased overall welfare, we find that subsidizing unions in the current economy can improve welfare.

10.3386/w32793.abstractZh: 我们研究了工会对劳动力市场的影响，通过考察其对雇主保险提供的影响，并探讨社会保险政策如何反过来影响工会化程度和劳动力市场结果。我们发现，工会会增加雇主提供的保险，而社会保险的扩展则减少了美国的工会化现象。随后，我们建立并估计了一个均衡劳动搜寻模型，在该模型中，工会化、工资和非工资福利都是内生决定的。我们证明，工会化以及工会化的威胁都会增加工会化企业和非工会化企业的雇主提供的保险。我们发现，社会保险政策可以通过工会化的减少或增加来影响劳动力市场的不平等现象，而不平等程度可能会因社会保险政策的针对性而有所不同。在过去五十年中，社会保险的扩展以及技术变革共同导致了美国工会数量的长期减少。尽管历史上这些力量推动了工会化的减少，从而提升了整体福利，但我们发现，在当前经济环境下，对工会的补贴反而能够改善福利状况。

abstract.text: Despite the fact that 30 percent of opioid overdoses also involve a benzodiazepine, there is little policy guidance on how to curb concurrent misuse and even less evidence on how changes to co-prescribing practices can affect patients' economic trajectories. In 2012, Austria restricted access to flunitrazepam, one of the most potent, and most heavily misused, benzodiazepines. We use linked individual-level data to identify opioid users and estimate the reform's impact on their health and labor market outcomes relative to a randomly selected comparison group of non-opioid users. Estimates indicate a 12.7 percent drop in employment, a 13.1 percent increase in unemployment insurance claims, and a 26.5 percent increase in overall healthcare expenditures. We provide suggestive evidence that these effects are due to incapacitating withdrawal symptoms, rather than substitution to other drugs, including heroin or alcohol.

10.3386/w32804.abstractZh: 尽管30%的阿片类药物过量事件同时涉及苯二氮卓类药物，但关于如何遏制这两种药物的并发滥用，目前的政策指导非常有限。关于改变处方实践对患者的经济轨迹的影响，更是缺乏研究证据。2012年，奥地利限制了氟尼定这种效力最强且滥用最严重的苯二氮卓类药物的供应。我们利用关联的个人数据来识别阿片类药物使用者，并评估该改革措施对他们健康和劳动力市场结果的影响，与随机选取的非阿片类药物使用者对照组进行比较。研究结果显示，就业率下降了12.7%，失业保险申请数量增加了13.1%，整体医疗支出增加了26.5%。我们有理由认为，这些影响是由于戒断症状导致的，而非由于替代其他药物，如海洛因或酒精所致。

abstract.text: Operation Warp Speed (OWS) was a U.S. government-led program to accelerate the development, production, and administration of COVID-19 vaccines. The program cut the typical ten-year timeline needed to develop a new vaccine down to ten months and began vaccinating vulnerable populations within a year after launch. OWS’s success has led to calls for a similar mission model to accelerate innovations addressing other pressing social needs, including a cure for Alzheimer’s disease or atmospheric-carbon removal to combat global warming. We provide a framework to understand which innovations call for a mission approach and apply economic principles to identify key design features that contributed to the success of OWS.

10.3386/w32831.abstractZh: “ warp speed 行动”是美国政府主导的一项计划，旨在加速新冠疫苗的研发、生产和分发。该计划将研发新疫苗通常需要十年的时间缩短至十个月，并在启动后一年内开始为易感人群接种。该计划的成功促使人们呼吁采用类似的模式来推动其他紧迫社会需求的创新，例如阿尔茨海默病的治愈方法或用于应对全球变暖的大气碳去除技术。我们提供了一个框架，用于识别哪些创新需要采用任务式的方法，并运用经济原理来确定对“warp speed 行动”成功起关键作用的设计要素。

abstract.text: We study the impacts of vertical integration between insurers and hospitals. We develop a bilateral oligopoly model of competition with endogenous plan design and hospital prices, and estimate it using administrative data from Chile. Integrated insurers offer plan networks that favor integrated hospitals, and non-integrated insurers restrict access to integrated hospitals to limit the raising rivals’ costs threat. These skewed networks restrict substitution across hospitals, softening price competition. Whereas vertical integration reduces double marginalization, plan design distortions and weaker hospital competition more than compensate. Vertical integration leads to a misallocation of demand across hospitals, higher healthcare spending, and lower welfare.

10.3386/w32833.abstractZh: 我们研究了保险公司与医院之间垂直整合的影响。我们建立了一个具有内生计划设计和医院价格的双边寡头竞争模型，并使用智利的行政数据对其进行估计。整合的保险公司提供的计划网络有利于整合的医院，而非整合的保险公司则限制了对整合医院的访问，以限制竞争对手的成本上升威胁。这些偏斜的网络限制了医院之间的替代性，从而削弱了价格竞争。虽然垂直整合减少了双重边缘化、计划设计的扭曲以及较弱的医院竞争，但这些负面影响超过了其带来的好处。垂直整合导致了医院之间需求的错配、更高的医疗支出以及更低的福利水平。

abstract.text: Private equity (PE) plays an increasingly important role in the modern US economy. However, its impacts on owned-firms are incompletely understood. We exploit a historically large leveraged buyout of a national hospital chain to examine how the full life cycle of PE influences hospital-level revenues, technology sourcing, labor use, and financial performance. We find permanent improvements in hospital volumes and revenues. PE also reduces growth in full-time employees, with a suggestive partial substitution toward part-time workers. Technology adoption is restrained, but the number of vendors expands. Overall, PE has nuanced effects on hospital management, which translate to improved operating margins.

10.3386/w32840.abstractZh: 私募股权在现代美国经济中发挥着越来越重要的作用。然而，其对被投资企业的影响尚未得到充分理解。我们借助一个历史悠久的杠杆收购案例，来研究私募股权在整个生命周期中对医院收入、技术采购、劳动力使用和财务绩效的影响。研究发现，医院的业务量和收入得到了持续改善。私募股权还减少了全职员工的增长，并可能部分替代了全职员工的位置。技术采用受到了限制，但供应商数量有所增加。总体而言，私募股权对医院管理产生了细微的影响，这些影响最终转化为更高的运营利润率。

abstract.text: Poverty is strongly associated with worse health across countries and within countries across individuals. However, not all poor individuals suffer from poor health: the effects of poverty on health vary across place and time. In this review, we discuss the evidence documenting these patterns, and the reasons for the associations. We then provide an overview of what is known about policies that may improve the health of the poor. We focus primarily on the modern-day United States, but also discuss evidence from historical experiences and low- and middle-income countries. Throughout we discuss areas in need of future research.

10.3386/w32866.abstractZh: 贫困与各国以及个体内部的健康状况恶化之间存在强烈关联。然而，并非所有贫困者都患有健康问题：贫困对健康的影响因地区和时间而异。在这篇综述中，我们讨论了这些模式的证据，以及这些关联的原因。随后，我们概述了有关可能改善贫困者健康状况的政策的相关信息。我们的重点主要放在现代美国，但也讨论了历史经验以及低收入和中等收入国家的相关情况。整篇综述还指出了未来研究需要关注的领域。

abstract.text: Career Technical Education (CTE) programs have been proposed as a valuable strategy for supporting transition to independence among students with disabilities. We exploit a discontinuity created by admissions thresholds to estimate the causal impact of attending a CTE high school on the short- and long-term outcomes of students with disabilities. Our findings suggest attending CTE high schools has large positive effects on completing high school on time, employment, and earnings. Attending CTE schools also results in more time spent with non-disabled peers and higher 10th grade test scores. These results appear concentrated among male students, but the sample of female students is too small to support strong conclusions about outcomes. Notably, these estimated effects appear broad based over disability type, time spent with non-disabled peers in 8th grade, and previous academic performance.

10.3386/w32867.abstractZh: 职业技术教育（CTE）项目被提出作为支持残疾学生向独立过渡的宝贵策略。我们利用招生门槛造成的不连续性，来估算就读于CTE高中对残疾学生短期和长期成果的影响。研究发现，就读于CTE高中对按时完成高中学业、就业和收入有显著的正面影响。此外，就读于CTE学校的学生与非残疾同龄人相处的时间更多，且十年级的考试成绩也更高。这些结果主要出现在男性学生中，但女性学生的样本规模较小，无法得出强有力的结论。值得注意的是，这些估计出的影响在残疾类型、八年级与非残疾同龄人相处的时间以及之前的学业表现方面都普遍存在。

abstract.text: Black mothers with a trial of labor are 25 percent more likely to deliver by C-section than non-Hispanic White mothers. The gap is largest among mothers with the lowest risk and is reduced by only one-fifth when controlling for observed medical risk factors, sociodemographic characteristics, hospital, and physician or medical practice group. Remarkably, the gap disappears when performing a C-section is more costly due to a concurrent pre-labor C-section limiting surgical resources. This finding is consistent with provider discretion—rather than differences in unobserved medical risk—accounting for persistent racial disparities in delivery method. The additional intrapartum C-sections that occur among low-risk women when hospitals are unconstrained negatively impact infant health.

10.3386/w32891.abstractZh: 经历分娩阵痛的黑人母亲比非西班牙裔白人母亲更有可能选择剖宫产。这种差距在风险最低的母亲中最为明显，但在控制了观察到的医疗风险因素、社会人口学特征、医院以及医生或医疗团队后，这一差距仅减少了五分之一。值得注意的是，当剖宫产手术的成本因同时进行的分娩手术而上升时，这种差距就会消失。这一发现表明，持续的种族差异可能源于医疗服务提供者的自由裁量权，而非未观察到的医疗风险差异。在医院资源有限的情况下，低风险女性所经历的额外剖宫产手术会对婴儿健康产生负面影响。

abstract.text: Child maltreatment is a pressing concern in the United States, with more than four million children referred to child protective services in 2022. Reducing child maltreatment is a national health objective given the substantial, negative consequences for children who experience maltreatment, both in the short- and long-term. Parental mental health and substance use disorders are strongly associated with child maltreatment. In this study, we use administrative data over the period 2004 to 2021 to study the relationship between the number of mental health and substance use treatment centers per county and child maltreatment reports. Our findings provide evidence that better access to mental health and substance use treatment reduces child maltreatment reports. In particular, an 8% increase in the supply of treatment would reduce maltreatment reports by 1%. These findings suggest that recent and ongoing efforts by the federal government to expand mental health and substance use treatment availability may lead to reduced child maltreatment.

10.3386/w32895.abstractZh: 儿童虐待在美国是一个紧迫的问题，2022年有超过四百万儿童被转介给儿童保护服务机构。减少儿童虐待是一个国家性的健康目标，因为儿童在遭受虐待后，无论是在短期内还是长期内，都会面临严重的负面影响。父母的精神健康和物质使用障碍与儿童虐待之间存在密切关联。在这项研究中，我们利用了2004年至2021年的行政数据，来研究每个县拥有心理健康和物质使用治疗中心的数量与儿童虐待报告之间的关系。我们的研究发现表明，更好的心理健康和物质使用治疗服务可以减少儿童虐待报告。具体来说，治疗资源增加8%，就可以减少1%的虐待报告。这些发现表明，联邦政府近期和持续努力扩大心理健康和物质使用治疗服务的可用性，可能会减少儿童虐待现象。

abstract.text: Whether monetary incentives to change behavior work and how they should be structured are fundamental economic questions. We overcome typical data limitations in a large-scale field experiment on vaccination (N = 5,324) with a unique combination of administrative and survey data. We find that guaranteed incentives of $20 increase uptake by 13 percentage points in the short run and 9 in the long run. Guaranteed incentives are more effective than lottery-based, prosocial, or individually-targeted incentives, though all boost vaccinations. There are no unintended consequences on future vaccination or heterogeneities based on vaccination attitudes and incentivized economic preferences. Further, administrative data on relatives shows substantial positive spillovers. Our findings demonstrate the great potential of incentives for improving public health and provide guidance on their design.

10.3386/w32899.abstractZh: 货币激励是否能够有效改变行为，以及其结构应如何设计，都是重要的经济问题。我们通过一种独特的行政数据与调查数据结合的方法，克服了大规模疫苗接种实验中的典型数据限制问题（实验样本量为5,324人）。研究发现，短期内，20美元的保证激励可使疫苗接种率提高13个百分点，长期则提高9个百分点。与基于抽奖、亲社会激励或针对个人的激励措施相比，保证激励更为有效，尽管所有激励措施都能促进疫苗接种。此外，这些激励措施并未对未来的疫苗接种或基于疫苗接种态度的异质性产生意外影响。另外，关于亲属的行政数据表明，这种激励措施具有显著的积极溢出效应。我们的研究结果展示了激励措施在改善公共健康方面的巨大潜力，并为激励措施的设计提供了指导。

abstract.text: We estimate how acute air pollution exposure from wildfire smoke impacts human health in the U.S., allowing for nonlinear effects. Wildfire smoke is pervasive and produces air quality shocks of varying intensity, depending on wind patterns and plume thickness. Using administrative Medicare records for 2007–2019, we estimate that wildfire smoke accounts for 18% of ambient PM2.5 concentrations, 0.42% of deaths, and 0.69% of emergency room visits among adults aged 65 and over. Smaller pollution shocks have outsized health impacts, indicating significant health benefits from improving air quality, even in areas meeting current regulatory standards.

10.3386/w32924.abstractZh: 我们估算了野火烟雾造成的空气污染暴露对美国人类健康的影响，并考虑了非线性效应。野火烟雾普遍存在，其造成的空气质量冲击强度各不相同，这取决于风向和烟雾浓度。利用2007至2019年的医疗保险行政记录，我们估计野火烟雾占环境PM2.5浓度的18%，导致65岁及以上成年人死亡人数的0.42%，以及急诊就诊人数的0.69%。较小的污染冲击却会产生更大的健康影响，这表明即使是在符合当前监管标准的地区，改善空气质量也能带来显著的健康效益。

abstract.text: This chapter synthesizes and critically reviews the modern instrumental variables (IV) literature that allows for unobserved heterogeneity in treatment effects (UHTE).We start by discussing why UHTE is often an essential aspect of IV applications in economics and we explain the conceptual challenges raised by allowing for it.Then we review and survey two general strategies for incorporating UHTE.The first strategy is to continue to use linear IV estimators designed for classical constant (homogeneous) treatment effect models, acknowledge their likely misspecification, and attempt to reverse engineer an attractive interpretation in the presence of UHTE.This strategy commonly leads to interpretations of linear IV that involve local average treatment effects (LATEs).We review the various ways in which the use and justification of LATE interpretations have expanded and contracted since their introduction in the early 1990s.The second strategy is to forward engineer new estimators that explicitly allow for UHTE.This strategy has its roots in the Gronau-Heckman selection model of the 1970s, ideas from which have been revitalized through marginal treatment effect (MTE) analysis.We discuss implementation of MTE methods and draw connections with related control function and bounding methods that are scattered throughout the econometric and causal inference literature.

10.3386/w32927.abstractZh: 本章综合并批判性地回顾了现代工具变量（IV）文献，这些文献能够处理治疗效应中的未观测异质性问题。我们首先探讨了为什么UHTE通常是经济学中IV应用的一个重要方面，并解释了允许UHTE所带来的概念挑战。接着，我们回顾并探讨了两种纳入UHTE的一般策略。第一种策略是继续使用为经典恒定（同质）治疗效应模型设计的线性IV估计器，承认这些估计器可能存在误设，并尝试在存在UHTE的情况下逆向推导出有吸引力的解释。这种策略通常会导致对线性IV的解释涉及局部平均治疗效应（LATEs）。我们回顾了自20世纪90年代初引入LATE解释以来，其使用与合理性如何扩展和收缩。第二种策略是向前设计新的估计器，这些估计器明确允许UHTE的存在。这种策略起源于20世纪70年代的Gronau-Heckman选择模型，其中的一些思想通过边际治疗效应（MTE）分析得到了复兴。我们讨论了MTE方法的实施，并将其与散见于计量经济学和因果推断文献中的相关控制函数和边界方法联系起来。

abstract.text: We study gender discrimination in an online health care market. Statistical discrimination implies that the impact of gender on prices should decline, and the impact of reviews increase, as reviews accumulate. However, in our context this implication does not hold, because doctors choose how strongly to signal gender. We develop a new test for the implications of statistical discrimination based on this choice. We find evidence consistent with statistical discrimination against female doctors in male-dominated fields, and vice versa. For example, female doctors mask gender more strongly initially in male-dominated fields, and the gender gap in signaling declines as reviews accumulate.

10.3386/w32929.abstractZh: 我们研究了在线医疗市场中性别歧视的问题。统计性歧视意味着性别对价格的影响应该会下降，而随着评论的积累，评论对价格的影响应该会上升。然而，在我们的情境中，这一假设并不成立，因为医生可以选择如何强烈地体现性别特征。我们基于这一选择，开发了一种新的方法来检验统计性歧视的影响。我们发现，在男性主导的领域，女性医生更容易受到统计性歧视，反之亦然。例如，在男性主导的领域，女性医生最初会更强地隐藏自己的性别特征，而随着评论的积累，性别差异在信号传递上的差距会逐渐缩小。

abstract.text: There has been a dramatic rise in disability employment since the pandemic. At the same time, work from home (WFH) has risen four-fold. This paper asks whether the two are causally related. Controlling for compositional changes and labor market tightness, a 1 percentage point increase in WFH increases full-time employment by 1.0% for individuals with a physical disability. The post-pandemic increase in working from home explains 68%-85% of the rise in full-time employment. Wage data suggests that WFH increased the supply of workers with a physical disability, likely by reducing commuting costs and enabling better control of working conditions.

10.3386/w32943.abstractZh: 自疫情以来，残疾人的就业率出现了显著上升。与此同时，居家办公的比例也增加了四倍。本文探讨了这两者之间是否存在因果关系。在控制了结构变化和劳动力市场紧张程度后，居家办公比例每增加1个百分点，身体残疾人士的全职就业率就会增加1.0%。疫情后居家办公的增加解释了全职就业率上升的68%-85%。工资数据表明，居家办公增加了身体残疾人士的劳动力供应，这可能是由于减少了通勤成本，并使得工作条件更加可控。

abstract.text: The COVID-19 pandemic led to unprecedented levels of federal transfers to state governments. Did this funding increase benefit incumbent politicians electorally? Identifying the effect of revenue windfalls on voting is challenging because whatever conditions led to the influx of cash might also benefit or harm incumbents for other reasons. We develop an instrument that allows us to predict allocations to states based on variation in congressional representation. We find that incumbents in state-wide races in 2020, 2021, and 2022 performed significantly better in states that received more relief funding due to their overrepresentation in Congress. These results are robust across specifications and after adjusting for a variety of economic and political controls. We consistently find that the pandemic-period electoral advantage of incumbent politicians in states receiving more aid substantially exceeds the more modest advantage politicians in these states enjoyed before the pandemic. This paper contributes to our understanding of economic voting and the incumbency advantage during times of crisis as well as the downstream electoral consequences of both the COVID-19 pandemic and of unequal political representation at the federal level.

10.3386/w32962.abstractZh: COVID-19疫情导致联邦政府向州政府提供了前所未有的资金援助。这种资金援助是否增加了现任政治人物的选举优势？识别收入意外之财对投票的影响具有挑战性，因为导致资金流入的条件也可能出于其他原因对现任政治人物产生利弊影响。我们开发了一种工具，可以根据国会代表的变化来预测对各州的拨款情况。我们发现，在2020年、2021年和2022年的州级选举中，那些因在国会中代表名额较多而获得更多援助的州，其现任政治人物表现显著优于其他州。这些结果在多种假设条件下依然成立，并且在调整了多种经济和政治因素后依然有效。我们一致发现，在获得更多援助的州，现任政治人物在疫情期间的选举优势远远超过了疫情之前这些州中政治人物所享有的较为温和的优势。本文有助于我们理解经济投票现象，以及危机时期现任政治人物的优势，以及COVID-19疫情和联邦层面政治代表不平等所带来的后续选举后果。

abstract.text: Increases in “deaths of despair” have been hypothesized to provide an important source of the adverse mortality experiences of some groups at the beginning of the 21st century. This study examines this possibility and uncovers the following primary findings. First, mental health deteriorated between 1993 and 2019 for all population subgroups examined. Second, these declines raised death rates and contributed to the adverse mortality trends experienced by prime-age non-Hispanic Whites and, to a lesser extent, Blacks from 1999-2019. However, worsening mental health is not the predominant explanation for them. Third, to extent these relationships support the general idea of “deaths of despair”, the specific causes comprising it should be both broader and different than previously recognized: still including drug mortality and possibly alcohol deaths but replacing suicides with fatalities from heart disease, lower respiratory causes, homicides, and conceivably cancer. Fourth, heterogeneity in the consequences of a given increase of poor mental health are generally more important than the sizes of the changes in poor mental health in explaining Black-White differences in the overall effects of mental health on mortality.

10.3386/w32978.abstractZh: 有研究假设，“绝望死亡”现象的增加是21世纪初某些群体出现不良死亡状况的一个重要原因。本研究探讨了这一可能性，并得出以下主要发现：首先，在1993年至2019年间，所有被研究的群体亚群的心理健康状况均有所恶化。其次，这些恶化现象导致了死亡率上升，并对1999年至2019年间非西班牙裔白人的不良死亡趋势产生了影响，黑人的情况则相对较轻。然而，心理健康状况的恶化并非导致这些现象的主要原因。第三，这些关系在一定程度上支持了“绝望死亡”这一概念，但其具体原因可能比之前认为的更为复杂：仍然包括药物相关死亡和可能的酒精死亡，同时自杀行为被心脏病、下呼吸道疾病、凶杀以及癌症导致的死亡所取代。第四，不同情况下心理健康状况恶化的后果差异，比心理健康状况变化幅度本身对解释黑人与白人之间心理健康对死亡率影响的差异更为重要。

abstract.text: This paper evaluates the social value of investing in vaccine research, development, and manufacturing capacity for pandemic preparedness and response. Rapid vaccination during pandemics can significantly reduce mortality, economic losses, and societal disruptions. However, vaccine manufacturers often lack sufficient incentives for speed and capacity expansion. Strategic policies by governments and international organizations could enhance these incentives and improve equitable vaccine distribution.

10.3386/w32984.abstractZh: 本文评估了投资于疫苗研究、开发和制造能力在应对大流行病中的社会价值。在大流行期间，快速接种疫苗可以显著减少死亡人数、经济损失以及社会动荡。然而，疫苗制造商往往缺乏足够的激励措施来推动生产速度和产能扩张。政府和国际组织的战略政策可以加强这些激励措施，并改善疫苗的公平分配。

abstract.text: Digital technologies are bringing vast improvements to modern society but also carry the risk of perpetuating disparities if adopted at lower rates by underserved communities. We investigate the efficiency and equity aspects of technological advancement in digital health by studying an intervention of “remote patient monitoring” that enabled patients to transmit real-time clinical data for timely treatment. The program was deployed at the Academic Medical Center UC San Diego Health among a diverse population of patients and targeted hypertension management to reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease. From an efficiency standpoint, we find significant and persistent reductions in cardiovascular risk, which are notable across all subgroups of gender, age, race/ethnicity, and geographic affluence. Evidence suggests both reduced frictions in the provision of care and improved health behaviors as mechanisms. The program also led to significant reductions in healthcare utilization costs from improved hypertension control. From an equity standpoint, however, we find that the longer-run health gains from the program fell short among underserved patient subpopulations, inducing inequities in the reductions in cardiovascular risk. The new technology was systematically adopted at lower rates by Black/Hispanic patients and by patients from disadvantaged geographic communities, who were less likely to either take up or adhere to the program. Overall, our analysis highlights the simultaneous promise and hazards of digital health technologies. We further provide evidence that primary care physicians and the nature of their relationship with patients can have a promising role in promoting greater and more equitable adoption of digital health.

10.3386/w32992.abstractZh: 数字技术为现代社会带来了巨大的改进，但如果欠发达社区以较低的比例采用这些技术，则有可能加剧不平等现象。我们通过研究“远程患者监测”这一干预措施，来探讨数字健康技术进步在效率和公平方面的影响。该措施使患者能够实时传输临床数据，从而实现及时治疗。该计划在加州大学圣地亚哥健康医学中心实施，针对不同患者群体，特别是高血压患者，以降低心血管疾病的风险。从效率的角度来看，我们发现心血管风险显著且持续降低，这一效果在性别、年龄、种族/民族以及地理经济状况不同的所有子群体中均显著。证据表明，减少护理过程中的摩擦和改善健康行为是降低风险的有效机制。此外，通过改善高血压控制，该计划还显著降低了医疗成本。然而，从公平的角度来看，我们发现该计划带来的长期健康收益在欠发达患者群体中未能充分实现，导致心血管风险降低方面的不平等现象。黑人和西班牙裔患者以及来自地理位置较差的社区的患者，由于这些群体更难以接受或坚持使用该计划，因此新技术的采用率较低。总体而言，我们的分析揭示了数字健康技术的同时具有的潜力与风险。我们还发现，初级保健医生及其与患者的关系在促进数字健康技术的更广泛和更公平采用方面可以发挥重要作用。

abstract.text: We present a model where social media platforms offer plans that intermix entertaining content with digital advertising (“ads”). Users derive utility from entertainment and learn about their valuation for a product from ads. While some users are fully rational, others naïvely perceive digital ads as more informative than they actually are. We characterize the profit-maximizing business model of the platform and show that welfare is lower when the platform monetizes through advertising instead of subscription both for naïfs (because they are targeted by intense digital advertising, which makes them over-optimistic about product quality and over-purchase the product) and for sophisticates (because the inflated demand from naïfs increases the firm’s price). This negative welfare effect is intensified when the platform can offer mixed business models that separate the naïve and sophisticated users into different plans. Our results are robust to firm-level and platform-level competition, because digital ads soften competition between both firms and platforms. We also show how digital ad taxes can improve welfare.

10.3386/w33017.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个模型，其中社交媒体平台提供将娱乐内容与数字广告相结合的套餐。用户从娱乐中获得效用，并通过广告了解自己对产品的评价。虽然一些用户完全理性，但另一些用户则天真地认为数字广告比实际更具信息性。我们描述了平台利润最大化的商业模式，并表明当平台通过广告而非订阅来盈利时，无论是对于天真用户（因为他们受到大量数字广告的轰炸，导致对产品质量的期望过高并过度购买产品），还是对于成熟用户（因为天真用户的过度需求推高了平台的价格），社会福利都会降低。当平台能够提供将天真用户和成熟用户区分开来的混合套餐时，这种负面福利效应会进一步加剧。我们的研究结果不受企业层面和平台层面竞争的影响，因为数字广告可以缓和企业和平台之间的竞争。我们还展示了数字广告税如何改善社会福利。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a method to estimate treatment effects in difference-in-differences designs for repeated cross-section data in which the treatment start is staggered over time and treatment effects are heterogeneous by group, time, and observation-level covariates. We show that a linear-in-parameters regression specification with a sufficiently flexible functional form consisting of group-by-time treatment effects, two-way fixed effects, and interaction terms yields consistent estimates of heterogeneous treatment effects under general conditions. We also show that our method is identical to an imputation estimator. Under homoskedasticity assumptions the estimators are efficient, and aggregation of the treatment effects and inference are straightforward. We illustrate the use of this flexible linear model estimated by OLS with covariates (X) – FLEX – with an empirical example and provide comparisons to some benchmark estimators.

10.3386/w33026.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种方法，用于估计差异中差异设计中重复横截面数据的治疗效果。在这种设计中，治疗的开始时间会随时间错开，且治疗效果会因组别、时间和观测层面的协变量而呈现异质性。我们证明，采用具有足够灵活函数形式的线性参数回归模型，结合按组别和时间划分的治疗效果、双向固定效应以及交互项，可以在一般条件下得到一致的治疗效果估计值。我们还表明，我们的方法与一种插补估计器是相同的。在假设同方差性的情况下，这些估计器是高效的，并且治疗效果的汇总和推断过程也很简单。我们通过一个实证案例来说明这种灵活线性模型的使用，该模型通过OLS方法估计，并与其他基准估计器进行了比较。

abstract.text: When mortality risks of a job increase, economic theory predicts that wages will rise to compensate workers. COVID-19 became a new source of mortality risk from close contact with other workers and customers. Real wages have risen during the COVID-19 era, but research to date has been sparse on how much of this increase reflects compensating wage differentials for COVID-19 risk on the job. We use 2020- 2021 death certificate data which for the first time includes the decedent’s occupation and industry, together with other occupational and industry mortality for previous years from the Census of Fatal Occupational Injuries (CFOI) and wage data from the Current Population Survey (CPS) to examine whether compensating wage differentials for COVID-19 occupational risks are in line with prior estimates of Values of Statistical Life (VSL). First, we find that there are substantial differences in the compensating differentials associated with COVID-19 vs other sources of job-related mortality risk. Full time workers’ pay is higher by $24 per week in jobs with a 1 in 1,000 higher risk of COVID-19 mortality, but their pay is $320 higher in jobs with 1 in 1,000 higher risk of non-COVID-19 workplace mortality. The non-COVID-19 mortality wage premiums imply that workers trade off money and mortality risk using a VSL of about $18 million, which is near the upper range of the most cited VSL estimates in the literature. In contrast, the COVID-19 wage premium implies that workers make decisions using a VSL of the range $1.24 - $1.54 million, much lower than standard VSL measures. The results are consistent with workers substantially underestimating or undervaluing the risk of COVID-19 mortality.

10.3386/w33031.abstractZh: 当某项工作的死亡风险增加时，经济理论预测工资会上升以补偿工人。COVID-19成为与同事和顾客密切接触带来的新的死亡风险来源。在COVID-19时期，实际工资有所上升，但迄今为止关于这种增长有多少反映了因工作风险而增加的工资差异的研究相对较少。我们利用2020-2021年的死亡证明数据，这些数据首次包含了死者的职业和行业信息，同时参考了《致命职业伤害普查》中前几年的职业和行业死亡数据以及《当前人口调查》中的工资数据，来研究因COVID-19职业风险而增加的工资差异是否与先前对统计生命值的估计相符。首先，我们发现与因其他工作相关死亡风险相比，因COVID-19导致的死亡风险所带来的工资差异存在显著差异。在每千人中有一人面临较高COVID-19死亡风险的工作中，全职工人的工资每周高出24美元；而在每千人中有一人面临较高非COVID-19工作场所死亡风险的工作中，他们的工资则高出320美元。非COVID-19死亡风险带来的工资溢价意味着工人以大约1800万美元的统计生命值来权衡金钱和死亡风险，这一数值接近文献中引用最多的统计生命值估计的上限。相比之下，COVID-19带来的工资溢价意味着工人以124万至154万美元的统计生命值来做出决策，这一数值远低于标准的统计生命值衡量标准。这些结果与工人严重低估或低估COVID-19死亡风险的事实一致。

abstract.text: Previous studies document the potential links between early-life exposures and life-cycle outcomes. However, fewer studies examine the effects of local labor market shocks during early-life on old-age male mortality. This article empirically investigates this link using a large-scale deindustrialization as a source of shocks to local labor markets: the decline in New England’s textile industry during the 1920s and 1930s. Consistent with prior studies, we find small impacts on migration and changes in sociodemographic composition of counties post-deindustrialization. Using Social Security Administration death records linked with historical censuses 1900-1940 and difference-in-difference event studies, we find reductions in longevity for those born in highly-exposed counties whose families are categorized as non-migrants and those residing in non-urban areas. The results suggest intent-to-treat effects of about 3.6 months while the treatment-on-treated calculations suggest reductions of about 4.2 years in longevity of children of affected families. Using 1950-1960 census data, we find that those born in highly-exposed counties post-deindustrialization reveal large reductions in schooling, decreases in high school completion, and significant decreases in measures of socioeconomic standing. We further discuss the policy implications of these findings.

10.3386/w33039.abstractZh: 先前的研究记录了早期生活经历与生命周期结果之间的潜在联系。然而，较少的研究探讨了早期生活阶段当地劳动力市场冲击对老年男性死亡率的影响。本文以大规模的去工业化作为劳动力市场冲击的来源，具体研究1920年代和1930年代新英格兰纺织业的衰落对这一过程的影响。与先前的研究一致，我们发现去工业化后，迁移和县内社会人口结构的变化都受到了较小的影响。通过结合1900-1940年历史人口普查数据以及差异处理事件研究，我们发现那些出生在高度受冲击的县、家庭未迁移且居住在非城市地区的人，其寿命有所缩短。研究结果显示，接受处理的儿童寿命减少了约4.2年。利用1950-1960年的人口普查数据，我们发现出生在去工业化后高度受冲击的县的人，其受教育程度显著降低，高中毕业率下降，社会经济地位也显著下降。我们进一步讨论了这些发现的政策意义。

abstract.text: In contrast to earlier United States policies of open war, forcible removal, and relocation to address the “Indian Problem,” the Dawes Act of 1887 focused on assimilation and land severalty—making American Indians citizens of the United States with individually-titled plots of land rather than members of collective tribes with communal land. Considerable scholarship shows that the consequences of the policy differed substantially from its stated goals, and by the time of its repeal in 1934, American Indians had lost two-thirds of all native land held in 1887 (86 million acres)—and nearly two-thirds of American Indians had become landless or unable to meet subsistence needs. Complementing rich qualitative history, this paper provides new quantitative evidence on the impact of the Dawes Act on mortality among American Indian children and adults. Using 1900 and 1910 U.S. population census data to study both household and tribe-level variation in allotment timing, we find that assimilation and allotment policy increased the American Indian child mortality ratio by a little more than 15%. In secondary analyses (requiring additional assumptions) focused on total mortality, we find increases among young American Indians of nearly one-third (implying a decline in life expectancy at birth of about 20%). These results confirm contemporary critics’ adamant concerns about the Dawes Act.

10.3386/w33057.abstractZh: 与早期美国针对“印第安问题”采取的开放战争、强制迁移等政策不同，1887年的《道斯法案》侧重于同化和土地分配——使美国印第安人成为拥有个人土地的美国公民，而非拥有共同土地的部落成员。大量研究表明，该政策的实际效果与其既定目标存在显著差异。到1934年该政策被废除时，美国印第安人已失去了1887年持有的三分之二的本土土地（8600万英亩），近三分之二的印第安人变得无地或无法维持基本生活需求。本文结合丰富的定性研究，提供了关于《道斯法案》对美国印第安儿童和成人死亡率影响的新量化证据。通过利用1900年和1910年美国人口普查数据，研究家庭层面和部落层面的土地分配时间差异，我们发现同化和土地分配政策使美国印第安儿童死亡率增加了约15%。在针对总死亡率的二次分析中，我们发现年轻美国印第安人的死亡率增加了近三分之一，这意味着出生时的预期寿命减少了约20%。这些结果证实了当时批评者对《道斯法案》的强烈担忧。

abstract.text: Health care facilities considering mandating staff vaccination face a difficult tradeoff.
