Factories with worse practices did not improve, and workers in these factories reported lower job satisfaction; this finding suggests complementarity between external enforcement and internal capacity in determining the efficacy of regulation.

10.3982/ecta19408.abstractZh: 每年，与工作相关的死亡占全球死亡人数的5-7%，至少有九分之一的工人遭遇非致命性职业事故（国际劳工组织，2019a,b）。职业安全与健康委员会被视为改善工作场所安全与健康的关键机构，是工人表达意见的重要渠道（国际劳工组织，1981）。我提供了关于职业安全与健康委员会对工人和工厂影响的证据。为此，我与29家跨国服装采购商合作，他们承诺在孟加拉国的供应商中强制实施职业安全与健康委员会的相关规定。通过与这些采购商合作，我们对84家供应商工厂进行了近一年的实地实验，随机对其中一半工厂实施该规定。采购商的干预提高了对职业安全与健康委员会规定的遵守程度。通过利用实验中的职业安全与健康委员会实力差异，我发现实力较强的委员会对安全指标的改善效果较小且为正。这些改进并未给工人带来工资或就业方面的损失，也未对工厂的生产力产生负面影响。在管理实践较好的工厂中，对遵守规定、安全状况以及工人表达意见的影响最为显著。而管理实践较差的工厂则没有改善，这些工厂的工人报告称工作满意度较低；这一发现表明，外部强制性与内部能力在决定法规效力方面具有互补性。

abstract.text: We propose new confidence sets (CSs) for the regression discontinuity parameter in fuzzy designs. Our CSs are based on local linear regression, and are bias‐aware, in the sense that they take possible bias explicitly into account. Their construction shares similarities with that of Anderson–Rubin CSs in exactly identified instrumental variable models, and thereby avoids issues with “delta method” approximations that underlie most commonly used existing inference methods for fuzzy regression discontinuity analysis. Our CSs are asymptotically equivalent to existing procedures in canonical settings with strong identification and a continuous running variable. However, they are also valid under a wide range of other empirically relevant conditions, such as setups with discrete running variables, donut designs, and weak identification.

10.3982/ecta19466.abstractZh: 我们为模糊设计中的回归不连续参数提出了新的置信集。我们的置信集基于局部线性回归，并且具有偏差意识，即它们明确考虑了可能的偏差。它们的构建方式与Anderson–Rubin置信集在精确识别的工具变量模型中的方式相似，从而避免了“delta方法”近似所带来的问题，而“delta方法”是大多数常用的模糊回归不连续分析方法的理论基础。在我们的假设下，这些置信集与现有方法在具有强识别性和连续运行变量的规范设置中渐近等价。然而，它们在其他许多具有实际意义的条件下同样有效，例如具有离散运行变量的设置、甜甜圈设计以及弱识别性情况。

abstract.text: In a setting of many‐to‐one two‐sided matching with nontransferable utilities, for example, college admissions, we study conditions under which preferences of both sides are identified with data on one single market. Regardless of whether the market is centralized or decentralized, assuming that the observed matching is stable, we show nonparametric identification of preferences of both sides under certain exclusion restrictions. To take our results to the data, we use Monte Carlo simulations to evaluate different estimators, including the ones that are directly constructed from the identification. We find that a parametric Bayesian approach with a Gibbs sampler works well in realistically sized problems. Finally, we illustrate our methodology in decentralized admissions to public and private schools in Chile and conduct a counterfactual analysis of an affirmative action policy.

10.3982/ecta19636.abstractZh: 在一个多对多、双方都有不可转让效用的匹配环境中，例如大学录取，我们研究了在单一市场数据下双方偏好能够相互识别的条件。无论市场是集中式还是分散式，假设观察到的匹配是稳定的，我们展示了在某些排除限制下双方偏好的非参数识别。为了将我们的结果应用于实际数据，我们使用蒙特卡洛模拟来评估不同的估计方法，包括那些直接从识别结果构建出来的方法。我们发现，在实际规模的问题中，使用带有吉布斯采样器的参数化贝叶斯方法效果很好。最后，我们在智利公立和私立学校的分散式录取案例中展示了我们的方法论，并对一项平权行动政策进行了反事实分析。

abstract.text: A seller trades with q out of n buyers who have valuations a 1 ≥ a 2 ≥ ⋯ ≥ a n > 0 via sequential bilateral bargaining. When q < n, buyer payoffs vary across equilibria in the patient limit, but seller payoffs do not, and converge to maxl≤q+1[(a1+a2+⋯+al−1)/2+al+1+⋯+aq+1]. If l * is the (generically unique) maximizer of this optimization problem, then each buyer i < l * trades with probability 1 at the fair price a i /2, while buyers i ≥ l * are excluded from trade with positive probability. Bargaining with buyers who face the threat of exclusion is driven by a sequential outside option principle: the seller can sequentially exercise the outside option of trading with the extra marginal buyer q + 1, then with the new extra marginal buyer q, and so on, extracting full surplus from each buyer in this sequence and enhancing the outside option at every stage. A seller who can serve all buyers ( q = n) may benefit from creating scarcity by committing to exclude some remaining buyers as negotiations proceed. An optimal exclusion commitment, within a general class, excludes a single buyer but maintains flexibility about which buyer is excluded. Results apply symmetrically to a buyer bargaining with multiple sellers.

10.3982/ecta19675.abstractZh: 一名卖家通过顺序双边谈判与n名买家进行交易，这些买家的估值分别为a1 ≥ a2 ≥ ⋯ ≥ an > 0。当q < n时，不同均衡状态下的买家收益会有所不同，但卖家的收益则不会变化，最终收敛于maxl≤q+1[(a1+a2+⋯+al−1)/2+al+1+⋯+aq+1]。如果l*是该优化问题的（通常唯一的）最大值，那么每个买家i < l*都会以公平价格ai/2进行交易，而买家i ≥ l*则大概率不会被纳入交易。与面临被排除威胁的买家进行谈判，是受到顺序外部选项原则的驱动：卖家可以依次选择与额外的边际买家q+1进行交易，然后再与新的额外边际买家q进行交易，以此类推，从每个买家那里获取全部收益，并在每个阶段增强外部选项。能够服务所有买家的卖家（当q = n时），可以通过在谈判过程中承诺排除部分剩余买家来创造稀缺性，从而获益。在一般类别中，最优的排除承诺是排除单个买家，但同时对哪些买家被排除保持灵活性。这些结果同样适用于买家与多个卖家进行谈判的情况。

abstract.text: This paper shows that matching frictions and a thick market externality in firm‐to‐firm trade shape the agglomeration of economic activity. Using panel data of firm‐to‐firm trade in Japan, I demonstrate that firms gradually match with alternative suppliers following an unanticipated supplier bankruptcy, and that the rate of rematching increases in the geographic density of alternative suppliers. Motivated by these empirical findings, I develop a general equilibrium model of firm‐to‐firm matching in input trade across space. The model reveals that the thick market externality gives rise to an agglomeration externality affecting regional production and welfare. Using the calibrated model to the reduced‐form patterns of firm‐to‐firm matching, I estimate that the elasticity of a region's real wage with respect to population density due to the thick market externality is approximately 0.02. This finding highlights the substantial impact of the thick market externality on the overall agglomeration benefit.

10.3982/ecta19697.abstractZh: 本文指出，企业间贸易中的匹配摩擦以及市场的高外部性，共同塑造了经济活动的集聚现象。通过日本企业间贸易的面板数据，我证明了企业在替代供应商出现意外破产后，会逐渐与新的供应商进行匹配，且这种重新匹配的频率随着替代供应商的地理密度增加而上升。基于这些实证发现，我构建了一个关于企业间投入贸易空间匹配的一般均衡模型。该模型表明，市场的高外部性会导致集聚外部性，进而影响区域生产和福利。利用该模型对企业间匹配的模式进行校准后，我估计由于市场的高外部性，一个地区实际工资对人口密度的弹性约为0.02。这一发现凸显了市场高外部性对整体集聚效益的显著影响。

abstract.text: We formulate an order over constraint sets A ⊆ R ℓ , called the parallelogram order , which guarantees that argmin{ p ⋅ x : x ∈ A } increases in the product order as A increases in the parallelogram order, for any vector p ∈ R ℓ . Using this result, we characterize the utility/production functions that lead to normal demand as well as the closely related class of production functions with marginal costs that increase with factor prices. By generalizing the concept of supermodularity, we also characterize the class of production functions for which factors are complements. In the context of decision‐making under uncertainty, our new set order leads to natural generalizations of first‐order stochastic dominance in multi‐prior models.

10.3982/ecta19738.abstractZh: 我们定义了一个关于约束集合A ⊆ Rℓ的序，称为平行四边形序。该序保证了对于任意向量p ∈ Rℓ，当A在平行四边形序中增加时，argmin{ p ⋅ x : x ∈ A }在乘积序中也会增加。利用这一结果，我们描述了导致正常需求的效用/生产函数，以及与它们密切相关的、边际成本随要素价格增加的生产函数类。通过推广超模块性的概念，我们还描述了要素为互补关系的生产函数类。在不确定性下的决策背景下，我们的新序导致了多先验模型中一阶随机优势的自然推广。

abstract.text: This paper develops a model of private bilateral contracting, in which an exogenous network determines the pairs of players who can communicate and contract with each other. After contracting, the players interact in an underlying game with globally verifiable productive actions and externally enforced transfers. The paper investigates whether such decentralized contracting can internalize externalities that arise due to parties being unable to contract directly with others whose productive actions affect their payoffs. The contract‐formation protocol, called the “contracting institution,” is treated as a design element. The main result is positive: There is a contracting institution that supports efficient equilibria for any underlying game and connected network. A critical property is that the institution allows for sequential contract formation or revision. The equilibrium construction features assurance contracts and cancellation penalties .

10.3982/ecta19797.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个私人双边契约模型，其中外部网络决定了能够相互沟通和签订契约的参与者配对。契约签订后，参与者会参与一个具有全球可验证生产行为的底层游戏，以及由外部强制执行的转移支付。本文探讨了这种去中心化契约是否能够内部化由于参与者无法直接与那些其生产行为影响其收益的人进行契约而产生的外部性。被称为“契约机构”的契约形成协议被视为一个设计要素。主要结论是积极的：存在一个契约机构，能够支持任何底层游戏和连接网络的有效均衡。一个关键特性是，该机构允许顺序性的契约形成或修订。均衡构建过程中采用了保证契约和取消惩罚机制。

abstract.text: The allocation of decision‐making power is a critical choice that organizations make to mitigate agency problems and information frictions. This paper investigates the role of delegation for organizations where the agency problem is both pervasive and has potentially high welfare consequences: state‐owned enterprises (SOEs). I use a natural experiment in India to uncover the causal effects of granting SOE managers more autonomy over strategic decisions. Managers meaningfully exercise this autonomy, which results in greater value added, but also a reduced emphasis on outcomes valued by the government, such as a reduction in worker amenities (employee housing), and an increase in markups. Returns to autonomy are higher for firms with higher baseline incentive conflict.

10.3982/ecta19872.abstractZh: 决策权力的分配是组织为缓解代理问题和信息摩擦而做出的关键选择。本文研究了在代理问题普遍存在且可能带来重大福利影响的国有企业中，授权的作用。通过印度的一项自然实验，本文揭示了给予国有企业管理者更多战略决策自主权所带来的因果效应。当管理者能够真正行使这种自主权时，企业的附加值会有所增加，但同时也会减少对政府重视的结果的强调，例如减少员工住房设施，以及增加价格溢价。对于初始激励冲突较高的企业来说，自主权的回报更高。

abstract.text: This paper investigates how tax rates and tax enforcement jointly impact fiscal capacity in low‐income countries. We study a policy experiment in the D.R. Congo that randomly assigned 38,028 property owners to the status quo tax rate or to a rate reduction. This variation in tax liabilities reveals that the status quo rate lies above the revenue‐maximizing tax rate (RMTR). Reducing rates by about one‐third would maximize government revenue by increasing tax compliance. We then exploit two sources of variation in enforcement—randomized enforcement letters and random assignment of tax collectors—to show that the RMTR increases with enforcement. Including an enforcement message on tax letters or replacing tax collectors in the bottom quartile of enforcement capacity with average collectors would raise the RMTR by about 40%. Tax rates and enforcement are thus complementary levers. Jointly optimizing tax rates and enforcement would lead to 10% higher revenue gains than optimizing them independently. These findings provide experimental evidence that low government enforcement capacity sets a binding ceiling on the revenue‐maximizing tax rate in some developing countries, thereby demonstrating the value of increasing tax rates in tandem with enforcement to expand fiscal capacity.

10.3982/ecta19959.abstractZh: 本文研究了税率和税收执法如何共同影响低收入国家的财政能力。我们研究了刚果民主共和国的一项政策实验，该实验随机将38,028名财产所有者分配到现状税率或降低税率的组别。这种税收负担的变化表明，现状税率高于实现收入最大化的税率。将税率降低约三分之一可以通过提高税收遵从性来最大化政府收入。接着，我们通过利用执法方面的两种变化因素——随机发送的执法通知和税收征收人员的随机分配——来证明，执法能力的提升会提高实现收入最大化的税率。在税收通知中加入执法信息，或者用执法能力最差的税收征收人员替换平均水平较高的征收人员，可以将实现收入最大化的税率提高约40%。因此，税率和执法是互补的手段。同时优化税率和执法所带来的收入增长，比单独优化它们高出10%。这些发现提供了实验性证据，表明在一些发展中国家，低水平的政府执法能力会为实现收入最大化的税率设定一个上限，从而证明了在执法的同时提高税率对于扩大财政能力的重要性。

abstract.text: The expectation is an example of a descriptive statistic that is monotone with respect to stochastic dominance, and additive for sums of independent random variables. We provide a complete characterization of such statistics, and explore a number of applications to models of individual and group decision‐making. These include a representation of stationary monotone time preferences, extending the work of Fishburn and Rubinstein (1982) to time lotteries. This extension offers a new perspective on risk attitudes toward time, as well as on the aggregation of multiple discount factors. We also offer a novel class of non‐expected utility preferences over gambles which satisfy invariance to background risk as well as betweenness, but are versatile enough to capture mixed risk attitudes.

10.3982/ecta19967.abstractZh: 期望是一种描述性统计量，它对于随机优势具有单调性，并且对于独立随机变量的总和是可加的。我们提供了这类统计量的完整表征，并探讨了其在个体和群体决策模型中的多种应用。这些应用包括对静态单调时间偏好情况的表征，将Fishburn和Rubinstein（1982年）的工作扩展到时间彩票领域。这一扩展为时间风险态度以及多个折现因子的聚合提供了新的视角。我们还提出了一种新型的非期望效用偏好类，这类偏好满足对背景风险的不变性以及介于性，但足够灵活以捕捉混合风险态度。

abstract.text: The gains from agglomeration economies are believed to be highly localized. Using confidential Census plant‐level data, we show that large industrial plant openings raise the productivity not only of local plants but also of distant plants hundreds of miles away, which belong to large multi‐plant, multi‐region firms that are exposed to the local productivity spillover through one of their plants. This “global” productivity spillover does not decay with distance and is stronger if plants are in industries that share knowledge with each other. To quantify the significance of firms' plant‐level networks for the propagation and amplification of local productivity shocks, we estimate a quantitative spatial model in which plants of multi‐region firms are linked through shared knowledge. Counterfactual exercises show that while large industrial plant openings have a greater local impact in less developed regions, the aggregate gains are greatest when the plants locate in well‐developed regions, which are connected to other regions through firms' plant‐level (knowledge‐sharing) networks.

10.3982/ecta20029.abstractZh: 集聚经济带来的收益被认为具有高度局部性。利用保密的普查工厂层面数据，我们发现大型工业工厂的开设不仅提升了当地工厂的生产力，还提升了数百英里之外的工厂的生产力，这些工厂属于大型多工厂、多区域企业，它们通过其中一个工厂能够享受到当地生产力的溢出效应。这种“全球”生产力溢出效应不会随着距离的增加而减弱，并且如果工厂所在的行业能够相互分享知识，这种效应会更加显著。为了量化企业工厂层面网络对局部生产力冲击传播和放大作用的重要性，我们建立了一个定量空间模型，该模型假设多区域企业的工厂通过共享知识相互连接。反事实分析表明，虽然大型工业工厂的开设在欠发达地区具有更大的局部影响，但当工厂位于发达地区，并且通过企业工厂层面的知识共享网络与其他地区相连时，整体收益最大。

abstract.text: Measuring the effect of peers on individuals' outcomes is a challenging problem, in part because individuals often select peers who are similar in both observable and unobservable ways. Group formation experiments avoid this problem by randomly assigning individuals to groups and observing their responses; for example, do first‐year students have better grades when they are randomly assigned roommates who have stronger academic backgrounds? In this paper, we propose randomization‐based permutation tests for group formation experiments, extending classical Fisher Randomization Tests to this setting. The proposed tests are justified by the randomization itself, require relatively few assumptions, and are exact in finite samples. This approach can also complement existing strategies, such as linear‐in‐means models, by using a regression coefficient as the test statistic. We apply the proposed tests to two recent group formation experiments.

10.3982/ecta20134.abstractZh: 衡量同伴对个体结果的影响是一个具有挑战性的问题，部分原因是个体通常会选择在可观察和不可观察方面都相似的同伴。群体形成实验通过随机将个体分配到不同的小组并观察他们的反应来避免这个问题；例如，当一年级学生被随机分配与学术背景更强的室友时，他们的成绩是否会更好？在本文中，我们提出了基于随机化的排列检验方法，用于群体形成实验，将经典的费舍尔随机化检验扩展到这一场景。所提出的检验方法由随机化本身来支撑，需要相对较少的假设，并且在有限样本情况下是精确的。这种方法还可以补充现有的策略，例如线性均值模型，通过以回归系数为检验统计量来实现。我们将所提出的检验方法应用于两项最近的群体形成实验。

abstract.text: This paper studies how social media affects the dynamics of protests and strikes in China during 2009–2017. Based on 13.2 billion microblog posts, we use tweets and retweets to measure social media communication across cities and exploit its rapid expansion for identification. We find that, despite strict government censorship, Chinese social media has a sizeable effect on the geographical spread of protests and strikes. Furthermore, social media communication considerably expands the scope of protests by spreading events across different causes (e.g., from anticorruption protests to environmental protests) and dramatically increases the probability of far‐reaching protest waves with simultaneous events occurring in many cities. These effects arise even though Chinese social media barely circulates content that explicitly helps organize protests.

10.3982/ecta20146.abstractZh: 本文研究了中国2009年至2017年间社交媒体如何影响抗议和罢工的动态。基于132亿条微博帖子，我们通过推文和转发来衡量不同城市之间的社交媒体交流，并利用其迅速扩张的特性进行数据分析。研究发现，尽管中国政府实施了严格的审查制度，中国社交媒体对抗议和罢工的地理扩散仍产生了显著影响。此外，社交媒体交流大大扩展了抗议活动的范围，将事件扩展到不同的原因（例如，从反腐败抗议到环境抗议），并显著增加了多个城市同时发生大规模抗议的可能性。这些效应即便在社交媒体上几乎没有传播明确帮助组织抗议的内容的情况下依然存在。

abstract.text: We study the design of optimal mechanisms when the designer is uncertain both about the form of information held by the agents and also about which equilibrium will be played. The guarantee of a mechanism is its worst performance across all information structures and equilibria. The potential of an information structure is its best performance across all mechanisms and equilibria. We formulate a pair of linear programs, one of which is a lower bound on the maximum guarantee across all mechanisms, and the other of which is an upper bound on the minimum potential across all information structures. In applications to public expenditure, bilateral trade, and optimal auctions, we use the bounding programs to characterize guarantee‐maximizing mechanisms and potential‐minimizing information structures and show that the max guarantee is equal to the min potential.

10.3982/ecta20240.abstractZh: 我们研究了在设计者对于代理人持有的信息形式以及将执行的均衡情况均不确定的情况下，最优机制的设计问题。机制的最坏性能是指其在所有信息结构和均衡中的最低表现。信息结构的潜力则是指在所有机制和均衡中的最佳表现。我们构建了一对线性规划模型，其中一个是确定所有机制下最大保证的下限，另一个则是确定所有信息结构下最小潜力的上限。在应用于公共支出、双边贸易和最优拍卖问题时，我们利用这些边界规划来刻画保证最大化的机制和潜力最小化的信息结构，并证明最大保证等于最小潜力。

abstract.text: Freedman (2008a,b) showed that the linear regression estimator is biased for the analysis of randomized controlled trials under the randomization model. Under Freedman's assumptions, we derive exact closed‐form bias corrections for the linear regression estimator. We show that the limiting distribution of the bias corrected estimator is identical to the uncorrected estimator. Taken together with results from Lin (2013), our results show that Freedman's theoretical arguments against the use of regression adjustment can be resolved with minor modifications to practice.

10.3982/ecta20289.abstractZh: Freedman (2008a,b) 指出，在随机化模型下，线性回归估计量存在偏差。在Freedman的假设条件下，我们推导出了线性回归估计量的精确封闭形式偏差修正公式。我们证明，经过偏差修正后的估计量的极限分布与未修正的估计量相同。结合Lin (2013)的研究结果，我们的研究表明，Freedman关于不使用回归调整的理论论点可以通过对实践进行微小的修改而得到解决。

abstract.text: We provide a unified approach to stochastic dynamic programming with recursive utility based on an elementary application of Tarski's fixed point theorem. We establish that the exclusive source of multiple values is the presence of multiple recursive utilities consistent with the given aggregator, each yielding a legitimate value of the recursive program. We also present sufficient conditions ensuring a unique value of the recursive program in some circumstances. Overall, acknowledging the unavoidable failure of uniqueness in general, we argue that the greatest fixed point of the Bellman operator should have a privileged position.

10.3982/ecta20386.abstractZh: 我们提供了一种基于Tarski不动点定理的递归效用随机动态规划的统一方法。我们证明了多个值的唯一来源在于存在多个与给定聚合器一致的递归效用，每个效用都能产生递归程序的合法值。我们还提出了一些充分条件，在某些情况下可以确保递归程序有一个唯一的值。总体而言，尽管我们承认一般情况下唯一性难以实现，但我们认为Bellman算子的极大不动点应该具有特殊的地位。

abstract.text: We develop a framework for quantifying barriers to labor force participation (LFP) and entrepreneurship faced by women in India. We find substantial barriers to LFP, and higher costs of expanding businesses through hiring workers for women entrepreneurs. However, there is one area where female entrepreneurs have an advantage: the hiring of female workers. We show that this is not driven by the sectoral composition of female employment. Consistent with this pattern, policies promoting female entrepreneurship can significantly increase female LFP even without explicitly targeting female LFP. Counterfactual simulations indicate that removing all excess barriers faced by women entrepreneurs would substantially increase the fraction of female‐owned firms, female LFP, earnings, and generate substantial gains for the economy. These gains are due to higher LFP, higher real wages and profits, and reallocation: low productivity male‐owned firms previously sheltered from female competition are replaced by higher productivity female‐owned firms previously excluded from the economy.

10.3982/ecta20396.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个框架，用于量化印度女性在劳动力参与和创业方面面临的障碍。我们发现，女性劳动力参与和创业存在显著障碍，通过雇佣女性创业者来扩大业务的企业成本也更高。然而，有一个领域女性创业者具有优势：雇佣女性工人。研究表明，这一优势并非由女性就业的行业构成所驱动。与这一模式一致的是，促进女性创业的政策即使不明确针对女性劳动力参与，也能显著增加女性劳动力参与率。反事实模拟表明，消除女性创业者面临的所有额外障碍将大幅增加女性拥有的企业比例、女性劳动力参与率以及收益，并为经济带来显著收益。这些收益源于更高的劳动力参与率、更高的实际工资和利润，以及资源的重新分配：原本因缺乏女性竞争而低效率的男性拥有的企业将被更高效率的女性拥有的企业所取代。

abstract.text: We estimate and trace a credit demand curve for households that recently experienced damage to their homes from a natural disaster. Our administrative data include over one million applicants to a federal recovery loan program for households. We estimate extensive‐margin demand over a large range of interest rates. Our identification strategy exploits 24 natural experiments, leveraging exogenous, time‐based variation in the program's offered interest rate. Interest rates meaningfully affect consumer demand throughout the distribution of rates. On average, a 1 percentage point increase in the interest rate reduces loan take‐up by 26%. We find a large impact of applicants' credit quality on demand and evidence of monthly payment targeting. Using our estimated demand curve and information on program costs, we find that the program generates an average social surplus of $2900 per borrower.

10.3982/ecta20417.abstractZh: 我们估算并追踪了那些因自然灾害而房屋受损的家庭的信贷需求曲线。我们的行政数据包括超过一百万名申请联邦恢复贷款计划的家庭。我们估算了在广泛利率范围内的需求情况。我们的识别策略利用了24个自然实验，利用程序提供的利率在时间上的外生变化。利率对消费者需求有着显著的影响，不同利率区间都有这种影响。平均而言，利率每上升1个百分点，贷款申请量就会减少26%。我们发现申请人的信用质量对需求有显著影响，并且存在按月支付的目标行为。利用我们估算的需求曲线和关于程序成本的信息，我们发现该计划为每位借款人创造了平均2900美元的社会收益。

abstract.text: We consider social learning in a changing world. With changing states, societies can be responsive only if agents regularly act upon fresh information, which significantly limits the value of observational learning. When the state is close to persistent, a consensus whereby most agents choose the same action typically emerges. However, the consensus action is not perfectly correlated with the state, because societies exhibit inertia following state changes. When signals are precise enough, learning is incomplete, even if agents draw large samples of past actions, as actions then become too correlated within samples, thereby reducing informativeness and welfare.

10.3982/ecta20475.abstractZh: 我们探讨了在变化世界中的社会学习。随着状态的不断变化，社会只有在个体定期根据新信息采取行动时才能做出响应，这大大限制了观察学习的价值。当状态趋于稳定时，通常会出现一种共识，即大多数个体选择相同的行动。然而，这种共识行动并不与状态完全一致，因为社会在状态变化后表现出惯性。当信号足够精确时，即使个体收集了大量过去的行为样本，学习仍然是不完整的，因为行为在样本内部变得过于相关，从而降低了信息的有效性和福利。

abstract.text: We use high‐frequency data on fine particulate matter air pollution (PM 2.5) at the locality level to study the effects of high pollution on daily labor supply decisions in the metropolitan area of Mexico City. We document a negative, non‐linear relationship between PM 2.5 and same‐day labor supply, with strong effects on days with extremely high pollution levels. On these days, the average worker experiences a reduction of around 7.5% of working hours. Workers partially compensate for lost hours by increasing their labor supply on days that follow high‐pollution days. We find that low‐income workers reduce their labor supply significantly less than high‐income workers. Unequal responses to high pollution along other dimensions (job quality, flexibility, gender) matter, but less than income. We provide suggestive evidence that reductions in labor supply due to high pollution are consistent with avoidance behavior.

10.3982/ecta20484.abstractZh: 我们利用地方级别的细颗粒物空气污染（PM 2.5）高频数据，研究高污染对墨西哥城大都市区日常劳动力供应决策的影响。我们发现，PM 2.5与当日劳动力供应之间存在负相关关系，且在污染严重的日子里，这种影响更为显著。在这些日子里，平均工人工作时间会减少约7.5%。工人会在污染严重的日子之后增加工作时间，以部分弥补失去的工作时间。我们发现，低收入工人减少劳动力供应的幅度明显低于高收入工人。在其他维度（如工作质量、灵活性、性别）上，对高污染的反应并不均衡，但影响程度低于收入因素。我们的研究提供了一些证据，表明因高污染导致的劳动力供应减少与回避行为有关。

abstract.text: The government budget constraint ties the market value of government debt to the expected present discounted value of fiscal surpluses. We find evidence that U.S. Treasury investors fail to impose this no‐arbitrage restriction in the United States. Both cyclical and long‐run dynamics of tax revenues and government spending make the surplus claim risky. In a realistic asset pricing model, this risk in surpluses creates a large gap between the market value of debt and its fundamental value, the PDV of surpluses, suggesting that U.S. Treasuries may be overpriced.

10.3982/ecta20497.abstractZh: 政府预算约束将政府债务的市场价值与财政盈余的预期现值折现价值联系起来。我们发现，美国国债投资者并未在市场中实施这种无套利限制。税收收入和政府支出的周期性与长期动态使得盈余主张变得风险重重。在现实的资产定价模型中，这种盈余风险导致债务的市场价值与其基本价值——即盈余的PDV之间存在巨大差距，这表明美国国债可能被高估了。

abstract.text: Does self‐governance, a hallmark of democratic societies, foster norms of generalized cooperation? Does this effect persist, and if so, why? I investigate these questions using a natural experiment in Switzerland. In the Middle Ages, the absence of an heir resulted in the extinction of a prominent noble dynasty. As a result, some Swiss municipalities became self‐governing, whereas the others remained under feudalism for another 600 years. Evidence from a behavioral experiment, the World Values Survey and the Swiss Household Panel consistently show that individuals from historically self‐governing municipalities exhibit stronger norms of cooperation today. Referenda data on voter‐turnout allow me to trace these effects on individually costly and socially beneficial actions for over 150 years. Furthermore, norms of cooperation map into prosocial behaviors like charitable giving and environmental protection. Uniquely, Switzerland tracks every family's place of origin in registration data, which I use to demonstrate persistence from cultural transmission in a context of historically low migration.

10.3982/ecta20579.abstractZh: 自治是民主社会的特征之一，它是否有助于培养普遍的合作规范？这种效应是否持久，如果持久，原因是什么？我通过瑞士的一个自然实验来研究这些问题。在中世纪，由于没有继承人，一个著名的贵族王朝便消失了。结果，一些瑞士市镇开始实行自治，而其他的则继续处于封建制度下，又持续了600年。来自行为实验、世界价值观调查以及瑞士家庭面板调查的证据一致表明，历史上实行自治的市镇的居民，如今表现出更强的合作规范。关于选民投票率的数据让我能够追踪这些效应超过150年，涉及个人成本高昂但对社会有益的行为。此外，合作规范还体现在诸如慈善捐赠和环境保护等亲社会行为上。独特的是，瑞士的登记数据能够追踪每个家庭的起源地，我利用这些数据来证明，在历史上移民较少的情况下，这种文化传承的效应仍然持续存在。

abstract.text: We document significant gaps in wealth across health status over the life cycle in Germany—a country with a universal healthcare system and negligible out‐of‐pocket medical expenses. To investigate the underlying sources of these wealth‐health gaps, we build a heterogeneous‐agent life‐cycle model in which health and wealth evolve endogenously. In the model, agents exert efforts to lead a healthy lifestyle, which helps maintain good health status in the future. Effort choices, or lifestyle behaviors, are subject to adjustment costs to capture their habitual nature in the data. We find that our estimated model generates the great majority of the empirical wealth gaps by health and quantify the role of earnings and savings channels through which health affects these gaps. We show that variations in individual health efforts account for around a quarter of the model‐generated wealth gaps by health, illustrating their role as an amplification mechanism behind the gaps.

10.3982/ecta20603.abstractZh: 我们记录了德国在生命周期内不同健康状况下的财富差距——德国拥有全民医疗体系，个人医疗支出微乎其微。为了探究这些财富与健康差距的潜在原因，我们构建了一个异质代理人生命周期模型，其中健康与财富通过内生方式演变。在模型中，代理人会努力保持健康的生活方式，这有助于未来维持良好的健康状况。努力选择或生活方式行为受到调整成本的约束，以反映其习惯性特征。我们发现，我们估算的模型能够解释大部分基于健康状况的财富差距，并量化了收入与储蓄渠道在影响这些差距中的作用。研究还表明，个体健康努力的差异占模型生成的基于健康状况的财富差距的约四分之一，这说明健康努力在形成这些差距的过程中起到了放大作用。

abstract.text: This paper studies the role of fiscal capacity in European state consolidation. Our analysis is organized around novel data on the territories and cities of the Holy Roman Empire in the early modern period. Territories implementing an early fiscal reform were more likely to survive, increased in size, and achieved a more compact extent. We provide evidence for the causal interpretation of these results and show key mechanisms: revenues, military investments, and marriage success. The imposition of Imperial taxes, quasi‐random in timing and size, increased the benefits of an efficient tax administration on the side of rulers, driving the implementation of fiscal centralization. Within territories, Chambers became the dominant administrative institution, tilting the consolidating states toward absolutism.

10.3982/ecta20612.abstractZh: 本文研究了财政能力在欧洲国家整合中的作用。我们的分析以关于早期现代时期神圣罗马帝国的领土和城市的新型数据为基础。实施早期财政改革的地方更有可能存续，规模扩大，并实现了更为紧凑的疆域。我们为这些结果的因果解释提供了证据，并揭示了关键机制：税收、军事投资以及婚姻成功。帝国税收的征收，其时间和规模具有近似随机性，增加了高效税收管理对统治者带来的好处，从而推动了财政中央化的实施。在领土内部，议会成为主导的行政机构，使得整合中的国家更倾向于走向专制主义。

abstract.text: Supply chain disturbances can lead to substantial increases in production costs. To mitigate these risks, firms may take steps to reduce their reliance on volatile suppliers. We construct a model of endogenous network formation to investigate how these decisions affect the structure of the production network and the level and volatility of macroeconomic aggregates. When uncertainty increases in the model, producers prefer to purchase from more stable suppliers, even though they might sell at higher prices. The resulting reorganization of the network tends to reduce macroeconomic volatility, but at the cost of a decline in aggregate output. The model also predicts that more productive and stable firms have higher Domar weights—a measure of their importance as suppliers—in the equilibrium network. We provide a basic calibration of the model using U.S. data to evaluate the importance of these mechanisms.

10.3982/ecta20629.abstractZh: 供应链的动荡可能导致生产成本大幅上升。为了降低这些风险，企业可能会采取措施减少对波动较大的供应商的依赖。我们构建了一个内生网络形成模型，以研究这些决策如何影响生产网络的结构以及宏观经济总量的水平和波动性。在模型中，当不确定性增加时，生产者更倾向于从更稳定的供应商处采购，即使这可能意味着以更高的价格出售。这种网络重组有助于降低宏观经济波动性，但代价是总产出下降。该模型还预测，在均衡网络中，更高效且稳定的企业具有更高的Domar权重——这是衡量其作为供应商重要性的指标。我们使用美国数据对模型进行了基本校准，以评估这些机制的重要性。

abstract.text: The maximum‐likelihood estimator of nonlinear panel data models with fixed effects is asymptotically biased under rectangular‐array asymptotics. The literature has devoted substantial effort to devising methods that correct for this bias as a means to salvage standard inferential procedures. The chief purpose of this paper is to show that the (recursive, parametric) bootstrap replicates the asymptotic distribution of the (uncorrected) maximum‐likelihood estimator and of the likelihood‐ratio statistic. This justifies the use of confidence sets and decision rules for hypothesis testing constructed via conventional bootstrap methods. No modification for the presence of bias needs to be made.

10.3982/ecta20712.abstractZh: 在矩形数组渐近假设下，带有固定效应的非线性面板数据模型的最大似然估计量存在渐近偏差。相关文献已经投入了大量精力来设计方法来纠正这种偏差，以便保留标准的推断程序。本文的主要目的是证明（递归的、参数的）自助法能够复制（未校正的最大似然估计量）和似然比统计量的渐近分布。这证明了使用通过传统自助法构建的置信区间和决策规则进行假设检验是合理的。无需对存在偏差的情况进行任何修改。

abstract.text: We examine identification of differentiated products demand when one has “micro data” linking the characteristics and choices of individual consumers. Our model nests standard specifications featuring rich observed and unobserved consumer heterogeneity as well as product/market‐level unobservables that introduce the problem of econometric endogeneity. Previous work establishes identification of such models using market‐level data and instruments for all prices and quantities. Micro data provides a panel structure that facilitates richer demand specifications and reduces requirements on both the number and types of instrumental variables. We address identification of demand in the standard case in which nonprice product characteristics are assumed exogenous, but also cover identification of demand elasticities and other key features when these product characteristics are endogenous and not instrumented. We discuss implications of these results for applied work.

10.3982/ecta20731.abstractZh: 我们研究了在拥有能够连接个体消费者特征和选择的“微观数据”的情况下，如何识别差异化产品需求。我们的模型采用了标准设定，其中包含了丰富的观测和未观测的消费者异质性，以及产品/市场层面的不可观测因素，这些因素引入了计量经济学内生性的问题。先前的研究利用市场层面的数据和工具变量，成功识别了这类模型。微观数据提供了一种面板结构，有助于构建更丰富需求模型，并减少对工具变量数量和类型的需求。我们探讨了在标准情况下，当非价格产品特征被假设为外生变量时，需求的识别问题；同时也研究了当这些产品特征为内生且未被工具变量处理时，需求的弹性及其他关键特征的识别问题。我们讨论了这些结果对实际应用工作的意义。

abstract.text: We study how long‐lived, rational agents learn in a social network. In every period, after observing the past actions of his neighbors, each agent receives a private signal, and chooses an action whose payoff depends only on the state. Since equilibrium actions depend on higher‐order beliefs, it is difficult to characterize behavior. Nevertheless, we show that regardless of the size and shape of the network, the utility function, and the patience of the agents, the speed of learning in any equilibrium is bounded from above by a constant that only depends on the private signal distribution.

10.3982/ecta20806.abstractZh: 我们研究了在社交网络中，长期存在的理性代理人是如何学习的。在每个时期，每个代理人都会观察邻居们过去的行为，然后收到一个私人信号，并选择一个仅取决于状态的行动。由于均衡行动依赖于更高阶的信念，因此很难描述这种行为。尽管如此，我们证明，无论网络的大小和形状、效用函数以及代理人的耐心如何，任何均衡下的学习速度都受到一个仅取决于私人信号分布的常数的上限限制。

abstract.text: We exploit a natural experiment involving a randomization of votes across parties within coalitions in all local elections in Italy for over a decade. A lottery on the position of party symbols in the ballot papers allows estimating the causal effect of increasing votes to parties for coalition policies. A non‐marginal random boost of votes shifts budgetary spending towards the treated party's platform, but only for issues that are salient in that party's political manifesto. We study the chains of mechanisms mapping votes into policies and link it to an increase in bargaining power within legislative majorities. Parties leverage their higher electoral support to gain the appointment of politically affiliated cabinet members. Empowering different parties also leads to the selection of cabinets with different socio‐demographic characteristics. The unintentional experiment helps shed new light on mechanisms mapping votes to parties into coalition policies.

10.3982/ecta20942.abstractZh: 我们利用了一个自然实验，该实验涉及在意大利所有地方选举中，对各政党在联盟内的投票进行随机分配，这一实验持续了十多年。通过在选票上随机分配政党标志的位置，我们可以估算增加政党投票数对联盟政策的影响。非边际的随机投票增加使得预算支出倾向于受影响的政党所支持的议题，但仅限于那些在该政党的政治宣言中尤为重要的议题。我们研究了将投票转化为政策的一系列机制，并将其与立法多数党内部谈判能力的增强联系起来。各政党利用更高的选举支持来获得与政治立场相关的内阁成员的任命。不同政党的参与还导致内阁成员具有不同的社会人口特征。这一非故意的实验有助于揭示将投票转化为政党联盟政策的机制。

abstract.text: This paper studies the effect of a restorative justice intervention targeted at 143 youth ages 13 to 17 facing felony charges of medium severity (e.g., burglary, assault). Eligible youths were randomly assigned to participate in the Make‐it‐Right (MIR) restorative justice program or a control group where they faced standard criminal prosecution. We estimate the effects of MIR on the likelihood that a youth will be rearrested in the four years following randomization. Assignment to MIR reduces the probability of a rearrest within six months by 19 percentage points, a 44 percent reduction relative to the control group. Moreover, the reduction in recidivism persists even four years after randomization. Thus, our estimates show that restorative justice conferencing can reduce recidivism among youth charged with relatively serious offenses and can be an effective alternative to traditional criminal justice practices.

10.3982/ecta20996.abstractZh: 本文研究了针对143名年龄在13至17岁之间、面临中等严重程度重罪指控（如入室盗窃、袭击）的青少年的恢复性司法干预措施的效果。符合条件的青少年被随机分配参加“Make‐it‐Right”（MIR）恢复性司法项目，或者参加对照组，后者则面临常规的刑事起诉。我们估计了MIR对青少年在随机分组后四年内再次被捕的可能性所产生的影响。参与MIR的青少年在六个月内再次被捕的概率降低了19个百分点，与对照组相比降低了44%。此外，这种减少再犯现象的效果在随机分组四年后仍然持续。因此，我们的估计表明，恢复性司法会议可以有效减少被指控犯有较严重罪行的青少年的再犯率，并且可以成为传统刑事司法实践的有效替代方案。

abstract.text: There is substantial empirical evidence showing that peer effects matter in many activities. The workhorse model in empirical work on peer effects is the linear‐in‐means (LIM) model, whereby it is assumed that agents are linearly affected by the mean action of their peers. We develop a new general model of peer effects that relaxes the linear assumption of the best‐reply functions and the mean peer behavior and that encompasses the spillover, conformist model, and LIM model as special cases. Then, using data on adolescent activities in the United States, we structurally estimate this model. We find that for many activities, individuals do not behave according to the LIM model. We run some counterfactual policies and show that imposing the mean action as an individual social norm is misleading and leads to incorrect policy implications.

10.3982/ecta21048.abstractZh: 有大量实证证据表明，同伴效应在许多活动中起着重要作用。在关于同伴效应的实证研究中，最常用的模型是线性均值模型（LIM模型），该模型假设个体会受到其同伴的平均行为的线性影响。我们提出了一种新的同伴效应通用模型，该模型放宽了最佳反应函数和同伴平均行为的线性假设，并将溢出效应、从众模型和线性均值模型作为特殊情况纳入其中。随后，利用美国青少年活动的数据，我们对该模型进行了结构性估计。研究发现，对于许多活动而言，个体的行为并不符合线性均值模型的描述。我们模拟了一些反事实政策，结果表明将同伴的平均行为作为个体社会规范的做法具有误导性，并会导致错误的政策结论。

abstract.text: Central banks wish to avoid self‐fulfilling fluctuations. Interest rate rules with a unit response to real rates achieve this under the weakest possible assumptions about the behavior of households and firms. They are robust to household heterogeneity, hand‐to‐mouth consumers, non‐rational household or firm expectations, active fiscal policy, and to any form of intertemporal or nominal‐real links. They are easy to employ in practice, using inflation‐protected bonds to infer real rates. With a time‐varying short‐term inflation target, they can implement an arbitrary inflation path, including optimal policy. This provides a way to translate policy makers' desired path for inflation into one for nominal rates. U.S. Federal Reserve behavior is remarkably close to that predicted by a real rate rule, given the desired inflation path of U.S. monetary policy makers. Real rate rules work thanks to the key role played by the Fisher equation in monetary transmission.

10.3982/ecta21069.abstractZh: 中央银行希望避免自我实现的波动。对实际利率有单位响应率的利率规则，在关于家庭和企业的行为的最弱假设下也能实现这一目标。这些规则能够应对家庭异质性、手边消费者、非理性的家庭或企业预期、积极的财政政策，以及任何形式的跨时或名义-实际联系。在实践中，这些规则易于实施，可以通过使用通胀保护债券来推断实际利率。在存在时变短期通胀目标的情况下，这些规则可以实施任意的通胀路径，包括最优政策。这提供了一种方法，将政策制定者期望的通胀路径转化为名义利率的路径。鉴于美国联邦储备委员会的政策制定者所期望的通胀路径，其行为与基于实际利率规则预测的行为非常接近。实际利率规则之所以有效，是因为费雪方程在货币传导过程中起着关键作用。

abstract.text: We propose a theory of how market power affects wage inequality. We ask how goods and labor market power jointly determine the level of wages, the skill premium, and wage inequality. We then use detailed microdata from the U.S. Census Bureau between 1997 and 2016 to estimate the parameters of labor supply, technology, and the market structure. We find that a less competitive market structure lowers the average wage of high‐skilled workers by 11.3%, and of low‐skilled workers by 12.2%, contributes 8.1% to the rise in the skill premium, and accounts for 54.8% of the increase in between‐establishment wage variance.

10.3982/ecta21157.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种关于市场力量如何影响工资不平等的理论。我们探讨了商品市场和劳动力市场的力量如何共同决定工资水平、技能溢价以及工资不平等程度。随后，我们利用美国人口普查局在1997年至2016年间的详细微观数据来估算劳动力供给、技术因素以及市场结构的相关参数。研究发现，竞争较弱的市场结构会使高技能工人的平均工资降低11.3%，低技能工人的平均工资降低12.2%；同时，这种结构对技能溢价的上升贡献了8.1%，并导致了企业间工资差异的54.8%的变化。

abstract.text: This paper considers a moral hazard problem where the agent can choose any output distribution with a support in a given compact set. The agent's effort‐cost is smooth and increasing in first‐order stochastic dominance. To analyze this model, we develop a generalized notion of the first‐order approach applicable to optimization problems over measures. We demonstrate each output distribution can be implemented and identify those contracts that implement that distribution. These contracts are characterized by a simple first‐order condition for each output that equates the agent's marginal cost of changing the implemented distribution around that output with its marginal benefit. Furthermore, the agent's wage is shown to be increasing in output. Finally, we consider the problem of a profit‐maximizing principal and provide a first‐order characterization of principal‐optimal distributions.

10.3982/ecta21383.abstractZh: 本文探讨了一个道德风险问题，其中代理人可以选择任何在给定紧凑集内的输出分布。代理人的努力成本具有平滑性，并且随着一阶随机优势的增加而递增。为了分析这一模型，我们提出了一种适用于测度优化问题的广义一阶方法。我们证明了每个输出分布都可以被实现，并确定了实现该分布的契约。这些契约的特点是一个简单的一阶条件，该条件将代理人改变所选输出分布的边际成本与其边际收益相等。此外，代理人的工资被证明随着输出量的增加而增加。最后，我们考虑了利润最大化委托人的问题，并提供了委托最优分布的初步描述。

abstract.text: This paper introduces and analyzes sequentially stable outcomes in extensive‐form games. An outcome ω is sequentially stable if, for any ε > 0 and any small enough perturbation of the players' behavior, there is an ε ‐perturbation of the players' payoffs and a corresponding equilibrium with outcome close to ω . Sequentially stable outcomes exist for all finite games and are outcomes of sequential equilibria. They are closely related to stable sets of equilibria and satisfy versions of forward induction, iterated strict equilibrium dominance, and invariance to simultaneous moves. In signaling games, sequentially stable outcomes pass the standard selection criteria, and when payoffs are generic, they coincide with outcomes of stable sets of equilibria.

10.3982/ecta21402.abstractZh: 本文介绍并分析了扩展形式博弈中的序列稳定结果。如果一个结果ω满足以下条件：对于任意ε > 0以及任何对玩家行为的微小扰动，都存在一种ε-扰动后的玩家收益，并且相应的均衡结果接近ω，那么这个结果就是序列稳定的。序列稳定结果存在于所有有限博弈中，是序列均衡的结果。它们与稳定均衡集合密切相关，并满足前向归纳、迭代严格均衡优势以及对同时行动不变性等条件。在信号传递博弈中，序列稳定结果符合标准的选择标准；当收益具有通用性时，它们与稳定均衡集合的结果是一致的。

abstract.text: When does society eventually learn the truth, or take the correct action, via observational learning? In a general model of sequential learning over social networks, we identify a simple condition for learning dubbed excludability . Excludability is a joint property of agents' preferences and their information. We develop two classes of preferences and information that jointly satisfy excludability: (i) for a one‐dimensional state, preferences with single‐crossing differences and a new informational condition, directionally unbounded beliefs; and (ii) for a multi‐dimensional state, intermediate preferences and subexponential location‐shift information. These applications exemplify that with multiple states, “unbounded beliefs” is not only unnecessary for learning, but incompatible with familiar informational structures like normal information. Unbounded beliefs demands that a single agent can identify the correct action. Excludability, on the other hand, only requires that a single agent must be able to displace any wrong action, even if she cannot take the correct action.

10.3982/ecta21470.abstractZh: 社会究竟何时能够通过观察学习了解到真相或采取正确的行动？在一个关于社交网络中的序列学习的通用模型中，我们找到了一个被称为“排他性”的简单学习条件。排他性是代理人的偏好和信息的共同属性。我们提出了两类同时满足排他性的偏好和信息：(i)对于一维状态，偏好具有单一交叉差异，并且具有新的信息条件，即方向无界的信念；以及(ii)对于多维状态，中间偏好和亚指数级的位置偏移信息。这些例子表明，在多个状态的情况下，“无界信念”不仅对于学习来说是不必要的，而且与正常信息等熟悉的信息结构不兼容。无界信念要求单个代理人能够识别出正确的行动。而排他性则只要求单个代理人能够消除任何错误的行动，即使她无法采取正确的行动。

abstract.text: Most empirical work in economics has considered only a narrow set of measures as meaningful and useful to characterize individual behavior, a restriction justified by the difficulties in collecting a wider set. However, this approach often forces the use of strong assumptions to estimate the parameters that inform individual behavior and identify causal links. In this paper, we argue that a more flexible and broader approach to measurement could be extremely useful and allow the estimation of richer and more realistic models that rest on weaker identifying assumptions. We argue that the design of measurement tools should interact with, and depend on, the models economists use. Measurement is not a substitute for rigorous theory, it is an important complement to it, and should be developed in parallel to it. We illustrate these arguments with a model of parental behavior estimated on pilot data that combines conventional measures with novel ones.

10.3982/ecta21528.abstractZh: 在经济学中，大多数实证研究仅考虑了一组有限的指标来衡量和描述个体行为，这种限制是出于收集更广泛数据的困难而做出的。然而，这种方法往往迫使研究者使用强假设来估计描述个体行为的参数，并识别因果关系。在本文中，我们认为采用更灵活、更广泛的测量方法会非常有用，能够构建更丰富、更现实的模型，而这些模型基于的是更弱的识别假设。我们认为，测量工具的设计应该与经济学家使用的模型相互作用，并依赖于这些模型。测量并不是严格理论的替代品，而是对其的重要补充，应该与理论发展同步进行。我们通过一个基于试点数据估计的家长行为模型来说明这些观点，该模型结合了传统的测量方法和新颖的方法。

abstract.text: We investigate optimal project management in a setting plagued by an indefinite number of setbacks that are discovered en route to project completion. The contractor can cover up delays in progress due to shirking either by making false claims of setbacks or by postponing the reports of real ones. The sponsor optimally induces work and honest reporting via a soft deadline and a reward for completion that specifies a bonus for early delivery. Late‐stage setbacks trigger randomization between minimally feasible project extension and (inefficient) cancellation. Because extensions may be granted repeatedly, arbitrarily large overruns in schedule and budget are possible after which the project may still be canceled.

10.3982/ecta21548.abstractZh: 我们研究了在存在大量不可预测的中断情况下的最优项目管理问题，这些中断在项目完成过程中不断被发现。承包商可以通过虚假报告或推迟真实的中断报告来掩盖进度延误。通过设定软截止日期和提供提前完成的奖励，项目发起人能够促使承包商进行工作并如实报告。在后期出现中断时，项目可以选择进行最小可行的延期操作，或者选择（低效的）取消项目。由于延期可以反复进行，因此项目在时间和预算上可能会出现极大的超支，最终仍可能被取消。

abstract.text: This paper studies certification design and its implications for information disclosure. Our model features a profit‐maximizing certifier and the seller of a good of unknown quality. We allow for common values as the seller's opportunity cost may depend on the quality of the good. We compare certifier‐optimal with transparency‐maximizing certification design. Certifier‐optimal certification design implements the evidence structure of Dye (1985)—a fraction of sellers acquire information while the remaining sellers are uninformed—and results in partial disclosure to the market. A transparency‐maximizing regulator prefers a less precise signal, which conveys more information to the market through a higher rate of certification and unraveling (Grossman (1981), Milgrom (1981)) at the disclosure stage.

10.3982/ecta21653.abstractZh: 本文研究了认证设计及其对信息披露的影响。我们的模型包含一个以利润最大化为目标的认证者以及一个质量未知的商品的销售者。我们允许共同价值存在，因为销售者的机会成本可能取决于商品的质量。我们比较了以利润最大化为目标的认证设计与以透明度最大化为目标的认证设计。以利润最大化为目标的认证设计实现了Dye（1985）提出的证据结构——部分销售者获得信息，而其余销售者则保持无知——这种设计导致市场获得部分信息。而以透明度最大化为目标的监管机构则更倾向于使用不太精确的信号，通过更高的认证率和信息披露来向市场传递更多信息（Grossman（1981），Milgrom（1981））。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a model for, and investigates the consequences of, strong spatial dependence in economic variables. Our findings echo those of the corresponding “unit root” time series literature: Spatial unit root processes induce spuriously significant regression results, even with clustered standard errors or spatial HAC corrections. We develop large‐sample valid unit root and stationarity tests that can detect such strong spatial dependence. Finally, we use simulations to study strategies for valid inference in regressions with persistent spatial data, such as spatial analogues of first‐differencing transformations. Regressions from Chetty, Hendren, Kline, and Saez (2014) are used to illustrate the issues and methods.

10.3982/ecta21654.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个模型，用于研究经济变量中强烈空间依赖性的后果。我们的研究结果与相应的“单位根”时间序列文献一致：即使采用聚类标准误差或空间HAC校正方法，空间单位根过程仍会导致具有虚假显著性的回归结果。我们开发了大样本有效的单位根和稳定性检验方法，能够检测这种强烈的空间依赖性。最后，我们通过模拟实验来研究在具有持久性空间数据的回归分析中，如何进行有效的推断，例如使用空间类似的第一差分变换方法。文中引用了Chetty、Hendren、Kline和Saez（2014）的研究结果来说明这些问题和方法。

abstract.text: We introduce Cautious Utility, a new model based on the idea that individuals are unsure of trade‐offs between goods and apply caution. The model yields an endowment effect, even when gains and losses are treated symmetrically. Moreover, it implies either loss aversion or loss neutrality for risk, but in a way unrelated to the endowment effect, and it captures the certainty effect, providing a novel unified explanation of all three phenomena. Cautious Utility can help organize empirical evidence, including some that directly contradicts leading alternatives.

10.3982/ecta21748.abstractZh: 我们提出了“谨慎效用”这一新模型，该模型基于这样一个观点：个体在权衡不同商品之间的利弊时往往持谨慎态度。该模型能够揭示“禀赋效应”，即使收益与损失被对称处理时也是如此。此外，该模型还暗示了风险下的损失厌恶或损失中性现象，但这些现象与禀赋效应并无关联。同时，该模型还捕捉到了“确定性效应”，为这三种现象提供了全新的统一解释。谨慎效用有助于整理实证证据，包括一些与主流理论直接相悖的实证结果。

abstract.text: We ask how fiscal deficits are financed in environments with two key features: (i) nominal rigidity, and (ii) a violation of Ricardian equivalence due to finite lives or liquidity constraints. In such environments, deficits can contribute to their own financing through two channels: a boom in real economic activity, which expands the tax base; and a surge in inflation, which erodes the real value of nominal government debt. Our main theoretical result establishes that this mechanism becomes more potent as fiscal adjustment is delayed, leading to full self‐financing in the limit: if the monetary authority does not lean too heavily against the fiscal stimulus, then the government can run a deficit today, refrain from tax hikes or spending cuts in the future, and still see its debt converge back to its initial level. We further demonstrate that a significant degree of self‐financing is achievable when the theory is disciplined by empirical evidence on marginal propensities to consume, nominal rigidities, the monetary policy reaction, and the speed of fiscal adjustment.

10.3982/ecta21791.abstractZh: 我们探讨了在具有以下两个关键特征的环境中，财政赤字是如何被融资的：(i) 名义刚性，以及(ii) 由于有限的生命周期或流动性限制而导致的李嘉图等价性被违反。在这种环境下，赤字可以通过两个途径实现自我融资：一是实际经济活动的繁荣，这扩大了税收基础；二是通货膨胀的加剧，这降低了名义政府债务的实际价值。我们的主要理论结果表明，随着财政调整被推迟，这种机制变得更加有效，最终可以实现完全的自我融资：如果货币当局不会过度抑制财政刺激，那么政府今天可以实施赤字政策，未来不必进行增税或削减支出，其债务仍可以恢复到初始水平。我们进一步证明，当理论受到关于边际消费倾向、名义刚性、货币政策反应以及财政调整速度的经验证据约束时，可以实现相当程度的自我融资。

abstract.text: A signal is privacy‐preserving with respect to a collection of privacy sets if the posterior probability assigned to every privacy set remains unchanged conditional on any signal realization. We characterize the privacy‐preserving signals for arbitrary state space and arbitrary privacy sets. A signal is privacy‐preserving if and only if it is a garbling of a reordered quantile signal . Furthermore, distributions of posterior means induced by privacy‐preserving signals are exactly mean‐preserving contractions of that induced by the quantile signal . We discuss the economic implications of our characterization for statistical discrimination, the revelation of sensitive information in auctions and price discrimination.

10.3982/ecta22017.abstractZh: 如果一个信号在任意一组隐私集合下，分配给每个隐私集合的后验概率在任意信号实现条件下保持不变，那么这个信号就是保护隐私的。我们描述了对于任意状态空间和任意隐私集合而言，保护隐私的信号。一个信号是保护隐私的，当且仅当它是重新排序的分位数信号的混淆版本。此外，由保护隐私的信号引起的后验均值分布，正是由分位数信号引起的均值保持收缩。我们讨论了我们的描述对于统计区分、拍卖中敏感信息的披露以及价格歧视的经济学意义。

abstract.text: We explore the deliberate infusion of ambiguity into the design of contracts. We show that when the agent is ambiguity‐averse and hence chooses an action that maximizes their minimum utility, the principal can strictly gain from using an ambiguous contract, and this gain can be arbitrarily high. We characterize the structure of optimal ambiguous contracts, showing that ambiguity drives optimal contracts toward simplicity. We also provide a characterization of ambiguity‐proof classes of contracts, where the principal cannot gain by infusing ambiguity. Finally, we show that when the agent can engage in mixed actions, the advantages of ambiguous contracts disappear.

10.3982/ecta22687.abstractZh: 我们探讨了在合同设计中故意引入模糊性的做法。我们发现，当代理人厌恶模糊性，因此选择能够最大化其最小效用的行动时，委托人可以通过使用模糊合同获得显著的收益，且这种收益可以非常高。我们描述了最优模糊合同的结构，表明模糊性促使最优合同趋向于简单化。我们还对无法证明合同模糊性的类别进行了描述，这类合同不会给委托人带来任何收益。最后，我们指出，当代理人能够采取混合行动时，模糊合同的优势就会消失。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a new approach to identification of the semiparametric multinomial choice model with fixed effects. The framework employed is the semiparametric version of the traditional multinomial logit with the fixed‐effects model (Chamberlain (1980)). This semiparametric multinomial choice model places no restrictions on either the joint distribution of the random utility disturbances across choices or their within group (or across time) correlations. We show that a novel within‐group comparison leads to a set of conditional moment inequalities. Our main finding shows that the derived conditional moment inequalities yield the sharp identified set for the random utility covariate index, while avoiding the incidental parameter problem. Specializing this result to the binary choice case shows that Manski (1987)'s conditional moment inequalities still lead to sharp bounds without restrictions on covariates.

10.3982/qe1776.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种用于识别具有固定效应的半参数多项式选择模型的新方法。所采用的框架是传统多项式逻辑模型的半参数版本，并加入了固定效应模型（Chamberlain, 1980）。这种半参数多项式选择模型不对随机效用扰动在各个选择之间的联合分布或它们在组间（或时间上的）相关性施加任何限制。我们展示了一种新颖的组内比较方法，该方法能够推导出一组条件矩不等式。我们的主要发现表明，所推导出的条件矩不等式能够为随机效用协变量索引提供精确的识别集，同时避免了偶然参数问题。将这一结果推广到二元选择情况，可以发现Manski（1987）的条件矩不等式同样能够在不对协变量施加限制的情况下得出精确的界限。

abstract.text: Precision farming is becoming crucial in the ongoing agricultural revolution due to its enhanced economic and ecological sustainability in food production compared to conventional farming. However, only a limited number of studies have focused on consumer acceptance of food produced through precision farming. To address this gap, an online experiment (n = 276) was conducted to investigate how production method information influences consumer beliefs of food quality (i.e., health, sustainability, and safety values), ultimately affecting consumer attitudes and purchase intentions toward precision-grown food. The findings suggest consumers exhibit higher quality beliefs, leading to more favorable attitudes and purchase intentions, toward precision-grown food compared to conventional food. This trend was observed when participants were presented with detailed information about the production methods employed in each farming system. In addition, according to the Elaboration Likelihood Model, our study reveals consumer innovativeness has the potential to amplify positive responses in terms of quality beliefs, attitudes, and purchase intentions toward precision-grown food compared to conventional food. Furthermore, our findings suggest that when detailed production methods are presented, precision-grown food may receive favorable quality beliefs, attitudes, and purchase intentions comparable to those for organic food, regardless of consumer innovativeness.

10.4148/1051-0834.2535.abstractZh: 精准农业在当前的农业革命中变得越来越重要，因为它在食品生产方面比传统农业具有更高的经济性和生态可持续性。然而，关于消费者是否接受通过精准农业生产的食品的研究却相对较少。为了填补这一空白，我们进行了一项在线实验（样本量276人），以研究生产方法信息如何影响消费者对食品质量的信念（即健康、可持续性和安全性价值），进而影响消费者对精准种植食品的态度和购买意愿。研究结果表明，当参与者了解到每种农业系统所采用的生产方法的详细信息后，他们对精准种植食品的质量信念、态度和购买意愿都会更加积极。此外，根据详述-可能性模型，我们的研究揭示出消费者的创新性有可能增强消费者对精准种植食品的质量信念、态度和购买意愿，使其优于对传统农业食品的态度。此外，我们的研究还表明，当详细的生产方法被呈现时，精准种植食品可能会获得与有机食品相当的良好质量信念、态度和购买意愿，而无需考虑消费者的创新性。

abstract.text: From the social sciences to machine learning, it has been well documented that metrics to be optimized are not always aligned with social welfare. In healthcare, Dranove et al. (2003) showed that publishing surgery mortality metrics actually harmed the welfare of sicker patients by increasing provider selection behavior. We analyze the incentive misalignments that arise from such average treated outcome metrics, and show that the incentives driving treatment decisions would align with maximizing total patient welfare if the metrics (i) accounted for counterfactual untreated outcomes and (ii) considered total welfare instead of averaging over treated patients. Operationalizing this, we show how counterfactual metrics can be modified to behave reasonably in patient-facing ranking systems. Extending to realistic settings when providers observe more about patients than the regulatory agencies do, we bound the decay in performance by the degree of information asymmetry between principal and agent. In doing so, our model connects principal-agent information asymmetry with unobserved heterogeneity in causal inference.

10.48550/arxiv.2305.14595.abstractZh: 从社会科学到机器学习领域，已有大量文献表明，需要优化的指标并不总是与社会福利相一致。在医疗保健领域，Dranove等人（2003年）的研究表明，公布手术死亡率指标实际上会损害患者福利，因为这会促使医生更倾向于选择高风险手术。我们分析了这种基于平均治疗结果指标的激励偏差，并发现，如果指标能够考虑未治疗情况下的结果，并且以整体福利而非治疗患者的平均值作为衡量标准，那么驱动治疗决策的激励措施将能够最大化患者福利。通过实际操作验证，我们展示了如何调整这些指标，使其在面向患者的排名系统中能够合理运作。在现实情况下，当医生比监管机构更了解患者的情况时，我们可以通过主从信息不对称的程度来限制性能下降。通过这种方式，我们的模型将主从信息不对称与因果推断中的未观测异质性联系起来。

abstract.text: We revisit the problem of online learning with individual fairness, where an online learner strives to maximize predictive accuracy while ensuring that similar individuals are treated similarly. We first extend the frameworks of Gillen et al. (2018); Bechavod et al. (2020), which rely on feedback from human auditors regarding fairness violations, as we consider auditing schemes that are capable of aggregating feedback from any number of auditors, using a rich class we term monotone aggregation functions. We then prove a characterization for such auditing schemes, practically reducing the analysis of auditing for individual fairness by multiple auditors to that of auditing by (instance-specific) single auditors. Using our generalized framework, we present an oracle-efficient algorithm achieving an upper bound frontier of $(\mathcal{O}(T^{1/2+2b}),\mathcal{O}(T^{3/4-b}))$ respectively for regret, number of fairness violations, for $0\leq b \leq 1/4$. We then study an online classification setting where label feedback is available for positively-predicted individuals only, and present an oracle-efficient algorithm achieving an upper bound frontier of $(\mathcal{O}(T^{2/3+2b}),\mathcal{O}(T^{5/6-b}))$ for regret, number of fairness violations, for $0\leq b \leq 1/6$. In both settings, our algorithms improve on the best known bounds for oracle-efficient algorithms. Furthermore, our algorithms offer significant improvements in computational efficiency, greatly reducing the number of required calls to an (offline) optimization oracle per round, to $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(α^{-2})$ in the full information setting, and $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(α^{-2} + k^2T^{1/3})$ in the partial information setting, where $α$ is the sensitivity for reporting fairness violations, and $k$ is the number of individuals in a round.

10.48550/arxiv.2403.06812.abstractZh: 我们重新审视了在线学习中的个体公平性问题，即在线学习者在追求预测准确性的同时，还要确保相似个体受到相同的对待。我们首先扩展了Gillen等人（2018年）和Bechavod等人（2020年）的框架，这些框架依赖于人类审计员对公平性的违规行为的反馈。我们考虑了能够整合来自任意数量审计员反馈的审计方案，使用我们称之为单调聚合函数的丰富类。然后，我们为这类审计方案提供了一个特征描述，实际上将多个审计员的个体公平性审计分析简化为单一审计员的审计分析。利用我们的通用框架，我们提出了一种高效的算法，对于 regret 和公平性违规数量，分别达到了 $(\mathcal{O}(T^{1/2+2b}),\mathcal{O}(T^{3/4-b}))$ 的上界，其中 $0\leq b \leq 1/4$。接着，我们研究了一个在线分类场景，其中只有对预测结果为正的人才能获得标签反馈，并提出了一种高效的算法，对于 regret 和公平性违规数量，分别达到了 $(\mathcal{O}(T^{2/3+2b}),\mathcal{O}(T^{5/6-b}))$ 的上界，其中 $0\leq b \leq 1/6$。在这两种场景中，我们的算法都优于已知的最佳高效算法。此外，我们的算法在计算效率上也有显著改进，大大减少了每轮需要调用（离线）优化预言机的数量，在完整信息设置下为 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(α^{-2})$，在部分信息设置下为 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(α^{-2} + k^2T^{1/3})$，其中 $α$ 是报告公平性违规的敏感度，$k$ 是每轮中的个体数量。

abstract.text: We propose sharp testable implications and tests to jointly assess the random assignment, exclusion, and monotonicity assumptions in judge leniency designs. Our procedures accommodate various data scenarios in which the number of defendants handled by a judge may be either small or large, and allow for discrete or continuous instrumental variables. When the validity of the design is rejected, a variant of the marginal treatment effect can be identified under weaker assumptions. We apply our test to the Philadelphia court data studied by Stevenson (2018) and demonstrate that it outperforms non-sharp joint tests by significant margins in simulation studies

10.48550/arxiv.2405.06156.abstractZh: 我们提出了一些具有可检验性的假设，用于共同评估法官宽大处理设计中的随机分配、排除和单调性假设。我们的方法能够适应各种数据场景，其中法官处理的被告数量可能很少或很多，并且可以处理离散或连续的工具变量。当设计的有效性被否定时，可以在较弱的假设下识别出边际处理效应的变体。我们将我们的测试应用于Stevenson（2018）研究的费城法院数据，并证明它在模拟研究中显著优于非尖锐的联合测试。

abstract.text: This paper develops an econometric test for whether an unobservable factor jointly influences a choice among multiple alternatives and a subsequent binary outcome. Because only transformed versions of the choice model's unobservables are identified, we combine a copula-based joint model with results on the covariance between ordered and unordered normal variables to recover the covariance between structural shocks, yielding a simulation-based test for a common unobserved factor. Applying it to the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1997, we find unobserved marriage prospects significantly influence college major choice. Supporting this, the dependence disappears once stated marriage expectations, elicited before major selection, are included.

10.48550/arxiv.2410.19947.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种计量经济检验方法，用于判断是否存在一个不可观测的因素，该因素共同影响了多个选择方案以及随后的二元结果。由于只能识别选择模型中的不可观测变量的转换版本，我们结合了一种基于copula的联合模型，并利用了有序与无序正态变量之间的协方差关系，从而推导出结构冲击之间的协方差，进而构建了一个基于模拟的检验方法，用于识别常见的不可观测因素。将该方法应用于1997年青年纵向调查数据，我们发现未观测到的婚姻前景显著影响了大学专业选择。支持这一结论的是，一旦在专业选择之前就明确婚姻期望被纳入模型中，这种依赖性就会消失。

abstract.text: This dissertation provides a comprehensive exploration of the strategic formation and outcomes of horizontal Mergers and Acquisitions (M&As) in the US nursing home industry. We delve into two central themes that underpin the strategic decisions and implications of M&A activities in the U.S. nursing home industry.

10.54014/gt67-335f.abstractZh: 本论文全面探讨了美国养老院行业中的横向合并与收购的战略形成及其结果。我们深入研究了支撑美国养老院行业合并与收购活动战略决策的两个核心主题及其影响。

abstract.text: This thesis delves into the various factors influencing economic growth, aiming to provide valuable insights for policymakers. It comprises four chapters, each exploring different aspects of growth using accessible methods and empirical data. This summary offers a non-technical overview and potential future directions for each chapter. In Chapter 2, I challenge the traditional view that productivity growth follows an exponential pattern. By examining data from 53 countries, the results reveal that high-income countries may exhibit an additive growth pattern, contrary to the well-established exponential assumption. However, limited evidence of additive growth is found for middle-income countries. Future research could explore the hypothesis of a productivity function evolving over time from exponential to linear by considering time-varying parameters. Chapter 3 introduces a multi-sector, multi-country model to disentangle growth spillovers within and between countries, demonstrating how domestic and external policies influence growth. We propose a novel econometric approach that allows for time-varying spillovers, challenging standard literature. By understanding these growth spillovers, policymakers can better target their efforts to enhance economic performance. Further research could delve deeper to generate sector-specific spillover effects. The last two chapters focus on Peru. In Chapter 4, we investigate the impact of removing bureaucratic barriers on firm productivity. A legislative change in 2013 empowered the Peruvian competition authority to eliminate these barriers nationwide. The study reveals that this removal led to a substantial 10 percent boost in productivity for affected firms. This finding is particularly relevant for developing countries, as it underscores the importance of reducing bureaucratic obstacles to foster economic growth. Future analyses could explore the impact of competition on other relevant variables, such as employment or wages. Chapter 5 examines the effects of natural disasters on food prices in Peru. We demonstrate that when disasters like heavy rain or drought occur, food prices tend to rise. Interestingly, this increase is driven more by declines in production rather than changes in consumer demand, challenging some existing theories about price reactions during crises. Throughout the thesis, I emphasize the need for sophisticated analysis to understand the complexities of economic growth. By employing various empirical methods, this research aims to equip policymakers with the tools necessary to design effective economic policies. Several chapters have been published in reputable academic journals, highlighting their relevance and contribution to the field of economic growth research. Overall, the work underscores the intricate relationship between policies, productivity, and external factors in shaping economic outcomes.

10.5463/thesis.919.abstractZh: 本论文深入探讨了影响经济增长的各种因素，旨在为政策制定者提供有价值的见解。全书共四章，每一章都使用易于理解的方法和实证数据来探讨经济增长的不同方面。本摘要提供了每章的非技术性概述以及潜在的未来研究方向。在第二章中，我挑战了生产率增长遵循指数型模式的传统观点。通过对53个国家的数据分析，结果表明，高收入国家可能表现出加法型增长模式，这与公认的指数型假设相反。然而，对于中等收入国家而言，加法型增长的证据较为有限。未来的研究可以通过考虑时间变化参数，探索生产率函数随时间从指数型演变为线性的假设。第三章引入了一个多部门、多国家的模型，以解析国家内部及国家之间的增长溢出效应，说明国内政策和外部政策如何影响经济增长。我们提出了一种新颖的计量经济学方法，该方法允许时间变化的溢出效应，挑战了传统文献的观点。通过理解这些增长溢出效应，政策制定者可以更好地定位他们的努力，以提升经济绩效。进一步的研究可以更深入地探讨特定行业的溢出效应。最后两章聚焦于秘鲁。在第四章中，我们研究了消除官僚障碍对企业生产率的影响。2013年的立法变更使秘鲁竞争机构有权在全国范围内消除这些障碍。研究表明，这一举措使受影响企业的生产率提高了10%。这一发现对发展中国家尤其具有相关性，因为它强调了减少官僚障碍以促进经济增长的重要性。未来的研究可以探讨竞争对其他相关变量（如就业或工资）的影响。第五章探讨了自然灾害对秘鲁食品价格的影响。我们发现，当发生暴雨或干旱等灾害时，食品价格往往会上升。有趣的是，这种上涨更多是由生产下降而非消费者需求变化所驱动，这挑战了一些关于危机期间价格反应的现有理论。在整个论文中，我强调了进行复杂分析以理解经济增长复杂性的必要性。通过采用各种实证方法，本研究旨在为政策制定者提供设计有效经济政策所需的工具。一些章节已发表在知名学术期刊上，突显了它们对经济增长研究领域的相关性和贡献。总体而言，这项工作强调了政策、生产力和外部因素在塑造经济成果中的复杂关系。

abstract.text: Tujuan penelitiajn ini adalah menganalisis strategi pengembangan inovasi dan diversifikasi produk bumbu masak tradisional pada CV. Budi Lestari Jaya. Metode penelitian menggunakan jenis penelitian deskriptif kualitatif . Lokasi penelitian di CV. Budi Lestari Jaya, Kelurahan Geluran, Kecamatan Taman, Sidoarjo. Teknik pengumpulan data yaitu 1. Wawancara Mendalam (In Depth Interview), 2. Focus Group Discussion (FGD), 3. Observasi dan 4. Dokumentasi. Analisis data meliputi data penyajian data, reduksi data dan verifikasi atau penerikan kesimpulan. Hasil penelitian Inovasi Pengalengan Bumbu Masak meliputi : Pemasaran Online, Teknologi Sterilisasi dan Label dan Branding sedangkan Diversifikasi Produk meliputi : Produk Berdasarkan Rasa dan Kebutuhan, Format Baru. . Dengan inovasi dan diversifikasi produk merupakan strategi penting bagi CV. Budi Lestari Jaya untuk mempertahankan daya saing dan keberlanjutan bisnis. Dengan menghadirkan berbagai varian bumbu masak khas tradisional, baik dari segi cita rasa, kemasan, maupun manfaat kesehatan, perusahaan tidak hanya dapat memenuhi kebutuhan konsumen yang beragam, tetapi juga memperkuat posisinya sebagai produsen bumbu masak berkualitas di pasar lokal maupun nasional.

10.56799/ekoma.v4i1.6075.abstractZh: 本研究的目的在于分析CV. Budi Lestari Jaya在传统调味品创新和产品多样化方面的策略。研究方法采用质性描述性研究。研究地点位于CV. Budi Lestari Jaya的Geluran社区，隶属于Taman区，Sidoarjo县。数据收集方法包括：1.深度访谈，2.焦点小组讨论，3.观察，4.文献资料分析。数据分析包括数据呈现、数据整理以及结论验证。研究发现，调味品创新方面包括在线营销、消毒技术以及标签和品牌设计；产品多样化方面则包括基于口味和需求的系列产品以及新的产品形式。通过创新和产品多样化，CV. Budi Lestari Jaya能够保持竞争力并提升企业的可持续性。通过提供各种具有传统特色的调味品，无论是从口味、包装还是健康效益方面，该公司不仅能够满足不同消费者的需求，还能加强其作为本地及全国优质调味品生产者的地位。

abstract.text: This research paper examines changes in patient care management in acute care hospitals between 2001 and 2011. During this time, there were two opposing factors at play: the competition effect of the reform and the policymaker’s decision to reduce public hospitals across France. By studying the trends, it is evident that there has been a significant overall shift in patient care management during this period. This change could be attributed to the global competition effect and the concentration of in-patients in specific public facilities. Through the difference-in-difference method, the study analyzed time variations in the intensity of local competition. It was found that local competition had a negligible impact on patient care management. Additionally, the study revealed that there was a significant positive competition effect on high-technical procedures for the private sector, which is in line with the market segment where private sector hospitals have a leadership position and the pro-competitive reform intensified this position. The study also uncovered a negative competition effect on the length of stay for public hospitals. Prior to the implementation of the DRG-based payment reform, public sector hospitals were paid a global budget. However, after the reform was implemented, they had to shorten the length of stay to increase the number of stays. For-profit hospitals have always been paid based on the number of stays. The results are robust and consistent when alternative measures of local competition are used.

10.58567/jea04010003.abstractZh: 本研究论文探讨了2001年至2011年间急性护理医院在患者护理管理方面的变化。在此期间，存在两个相互对立的因素：改革的竞争效应以及政策制定者决定削减法国各地的公立医院。通过研究这些趋势，可以明显看出，在此期间患者护理管理发生了显著的变化。这种变化可能归因于全球竞争效应以及住院患者集中在特定公立医疗机构的现象。通过差异分解法，研究分析了地方竞争强度的变化，发现地方竞争对患者护理管理的影响微乎其微。此外，研究还发现，对于技术含量较高的手术项目，私营部门的竞争效应显著，这与私营医院在市场上的主导地位相符，而有利于竞争的改革进一步巩固了这一地位。研究还发现，竞争效应对公立医院的住院时间产生了负面影响。在基于DRG的支付改革实施之前，公立医院的支付是依据全球预算进行的。然而，改革实施后，公立医院不得不缩短住院时间以增加住院次数。营利性医院则一直依据住院次数来支付费用。当使用其他衡量地方竞争的指标时，研究结果依然稳健且一致。

abstract.text: Introduction: Hospital accreditation globally is conducted through two different approaches: employing specific standards for various types of hospitals, or applying the same standards across all hospital types, as seen in Iran and many other countries. This study explored the benefits and challenges of using the same standards for all types of hospitals from the perspective of accreditation experts. Methods: This qualitative descriptive study was conducted with the participation of 30 employees of the target hospitals, national accreditation assessors, and experts from the Ministry of Health's monitoring and accreditation office. The interviews were semi-structured and conducted during individual sessions. The data was analyzed using content analysis using MaxQDA software. Results: The benefits of the same standards were emereged in three themes ("competitive", "functional”, and "financial"), and the challenges were also emereged in three themes ("challenges related to the nature of the hospital", "challenges related to the accreditation process", and "financial challenges"). “The motivation to compete with other hospitals” and “not paying enough attention to the specific conditions of each hospital” were the most frequent mentioned benefits and challenges, respectively. The “financial” theme was emerged as both benefits and challenges, albeit with different sub-themes. Conclusion: To optimize accreditation as much as possible, in addition to the existing standards, accreditation organizations should move towards developing and adding specific standards according to the type of hospitals in order to reduce the challenges of accreditation in addition to maintaining the existing benefits.

10.61186/jha.27.1.55.abstractZh:
引言：全球医院认证采用两种不同的方法：为不同类型的医院制定特定标准，或对所有类型的医院采用相同的标准，如伊朗和其他许多国家所采用的。本研究从认证专家的角度探讨了对所有类型医院采用相同标准所带来的好处和挑战。  
方法：这项定性描述性研究涉及目标医院的30名员工、国家认证评估员以及卫生部监测和认证办公室的专家参与。访谈采用半结构化方式，在单独进行的会话中进行。数据通过MaxQDA软件进行内容分析。  
结果：相同标准带来的好处被归纳为三个主题：“竞争力”、“功能性”和“财务性”，而挑战也被归纳为三个主题：“与医院性质相关的挑战”、“与认证过程相关的挑战”以及“财务挑战”。其中，“与其他医院竞争的动力”和“未能充分关注每所医院的具体状况”分别是最常被提及的好处和挑战。 “财务性”这一主题既被视为好处也被视为挑战，尽管其子主题有所不同。  
结论：为了尽可能优化认证过程，除了现有的标准外，认证机构还应根据医院的类型制定具体的标准，以减少认证过程中的挑战，同时保留现有的好处。

abstract.text: Essais en organisation industrielle empirique Les deux premiers chapitres étudient l'effet de la structure du marché sur les prix et les offres de produits dans les secteurs des boissons énergétiques et des télécommunications mobiles. Le troisième chapitre examine comment mesurer l'impact des programmes de clémence sur les cartels.Le premier chapitre développe un modèle de négociation pour évaluer l'impact d'une consolidation des entreprises en amont sur les prix et le bien-être. Le modèle considère que les entreprises en amont et en aval négocient des prix de gros pour plusieurs marchés simultanément, appelés négociation multi-marché (NMM). Une consolidation affecte le processus de négociation et, via la NMM, impacte les prix en aval. En appliquant ce modèle à une consolidation des distributeurs régionaux de boissons énergétiques aux États-Unis, il est prévu que les prix changent dans toutes les régions, pas seulement celles affectées par la consolidation. Les preuves empiriques montrent que les détaillants ont réduit leurs prix de 1,5 % dans les régions directement touchées et de 1,6 % dans les régions indirectement affectées. Le modèle montre que l'expansion des distributeurs affaiblit leur position de négociation, ce qui conduit à des baisses de prix pour les détaillants.Le deuxième chapitre, en collaboration avec Nicolas Martinez, analyse les effets de l'entrée de nouvelles entreprises et des progrès technologiques sur les offres et les prix dans le marché des télécommunications mobiles au Pérou. L'entrée de deux nouvelles entreprises et l'introduction de la technologie 4G ont bouleversé un marché dominé par deux acteurs. Les entreprises établies ont commencé à offrir plus de plans avec des variations dans les allocations de données. La connectivité 4G a modifié la valeur des données pour les consommateurs. Les tarifs prépayés ont baissé, tandis que les forfaits postpayés sont restés constants ou ont légèrement augmenté. Un modèle structurel de l'offre et de la demande montre une augmentation de la volonté de payer des consommateurs pour les données après l'introduction de la 4G, soulignant le rôle du progrès technologique. Les résultats montrent que la concurrence et les avancées technologiques influencent les résultats du marché, avec des offres plus variées et une valorisation accrue des données.Le troisième chapitre traite des défis de la poursuite des cartels et de l'efficacité des programmes de clémence. Ces programmes encouragent les membres des cartels à fournir des preuves, déstabilisant ainsi les cartels existants et dissuadant la formation de nouveaux. Cependant, il est difficile de mesurer leur efficacité car la totalité des cartels n'est pas observable. J'utilise des modèles de Markov cachés (MMC) pour estimer les effets des programmes de clémence, en analysant des données qui indiquent des processus sous-jacents non observables. Ce chapitre souligne l'importance de mesurer ces effets et de veiller à ce que d'autres changements de politique ne perturbent pas leur fonctionnement.

10.70675/d9549364z597cz4d4fzb15fz5fdac3d.abstractZh: 《工业组织经验研究》的前两章探讨了市场结构对能源饮料和移动通信领域产品价格及产品供应的影响。第三章则研究了优惠政策对卡特尔的影响。第一章提出了一个谈判模型，用于评估企业合并对价格和消费者福利的影响。该模型假设上下游企业同时针对多个市场进行大宗价格谈判，这种多市场谈判机制会影响下游的价格。将这一模型应用于美国地区性能源饮料分销商的合并案例，发现价格变化会波及所有地区，而不仅仅是受合并影响的地区。实证数据表明，直接受影响的地区零售商价格下降了1.5%，而间接受影响的地区则下降了1.6%。模型显示，分销商的扩张削弱了他们的谈判地位，从而导致零售商的价格下降。第二章与Nicolas Martinez合作，分析了新企业的进入以及技术进步对秘鲁移动通信市场产品供应和价格的影响。两家新企业的进入以及4G技术的引入，改变了由两个企业主导的市场格局。现有企业开始提供更多套餐，并调整了数据分配方案。4G网络的普及改变了消费者的数据价值。预付费费率有所下降，而后付费套餐则保持稳定或略有上升。供给与需求的结构性模型显示，随着4G的引入，消费者对于数据服务的支付意愿有所提升，这凸显了技术进步的作用。研究结果表明，竞争和技术进步影响着市场表现，使得产品更加多样化，数据的价值也得到了提升。第三章探讨了防止卡特尔形成以及优惠政策效果的问题。这些政策鼓励卡特尔成员提供证据，从而破坏现有卡特尔的稳定性，并阻止新卡特尔的形成。然而，由于并非所有卡特尔都能被观察到，因此很难衡量这些政策的实际效果。我采用隐马尔可夫模型来估算优惠政策的效应，通过分析那些表明存在不可观测底层过程的数据。本章强调了衡量这些效应的重要性，以及确保其他政策变化不会干扰其运作机制的重要性。

abstract.text: This dissertation consists of three chapters studying supply chains in low-income countries. The first chapter studies firm responses to contracting frictions, which lead firms to rely on vertical integration or relational contracts rather than spot markets. Empirical evidence highlights that vertical integration and relational contracts co-exist both within industries and individual firms. What are the economic and policy implications of this co-existence? I identify and quantify a new mechanism called the threat point effect, which is the contract change from firms improving their bargaining position through partial vertical integration. I build and estimate a structural model to quantify the threat point effect in the context of a large Indian garment manufacturer that adds integrated capacity bargaining with relational fabric suppliers. Model estimation uses the universe of the manufacturer’s fabric purchase transaction data. The threat point effect reduces input prices by 6.7% for small constrained suppliers that highly value the reduced exposure to demand shocks in the relational contract. Policy analysis using the model shows that supporting small firms’ ability to smooth is more effective at reducing relational discounts that increasing downstream buyer competition. The second chapter studies whether firms consider vertical integration and relational contracts to be alternatives, as empirical evidence shows these governance regimes result in similar transactions. Therefore, vertical integration and relational contracts are likely to be substitutes–an exogenous increase in the price of procuring inputs through one form increases the quantity procured through the other. However, vertical integration and relational contracts might not be substitutes. Different transaction governance forms could be specifically matched to different frictions or transaction characteristics, increased competition from the integrated supplier could break the relational contract, or the integrated firm may not be able to simultaneously meet commitments under the relational contract and achieve targeted internal capacity utilization. I test for substitutability using novel data on the universe of fabric transactions from a large Indian garment manufacturer. I find strong evidence of substitutability, leveraging exogenous variation at the product level to mitigate concerns about omitted variable bias. I conclude by discussing the policy implications of substitutability, highlighting that substitutability raises concerns that relational contracts can result in anticompetitive behavior. The third chapter studies quality upgrading as many low and middle-income countries (LMICs) include upgrading to attain export premia in their development strategies. In LMIC supply chains, producers rarely sell directly to world markets; instead, products travel through intermediaries. We study how intermediation affects incentives for quality production and quality investments in the context of a Ugandan coffee supply chain. First, we map the supply chain, documenting that coffee changes hands, on average, twice before reaching exporters. Next, leveraging high-frequency transaction-level data, including lab quality assessments, we show that quality premium diminishes up the supply chain. To rationalize the diminished quality premium, we build a model with two key economic mechanisms. First, barriers to entry for intermediation in the high-quality segment result in less demand and more buyer power. Second, both producers and intermediaries engage in quality investments, with the substitutability of these investments reducing intermediary demand for high quality upstream. Both mechanisms can explain the reduced quality premium but have different implications for efficiency and distribution of surplus. We use a loosely calibrated version of the model to examine the efficiency implications and distributional consequences of barriers to entry and productive substitutability.

10.7302/24038.abstractZh: 本论文包含三个章节，分别研究低收入国家的供应链问题。第一章探讨企业对于契约摩擦的应对方式，发现企业更倾向于依赖垂直整合或关系契约，而非现货市场。实证证据表明，垂直整合与关系契约在行业内部及单个企业中都存在并存现象。这种并存对经济和政策有何影响？我提出并量化了一种新的机制——威胁点效应，即企业通过部分垂直整合来提高自身议价能力，从而改变契约形式。我构建并估计了一个结构模型，以量化在印度一家大型服装制造商的案例中，垂直整合与关系契约之间的相互作用。模型估计使用了该制造商的织物采购交易数据。研究发现，对于重视减少需求冲击的小型企业来说，威胁点效应可使投入成本降低6.7%。模型分析还表明，支持小型企业平滑供需关系的能力，比增加下游买家竞争更能有效降低关系契约中的折扣。第二章探讨企业是否将垂直整合与关系契约视为替代方案，因为实证数据显示这两种治理机制下的交易结果相似。因此，垂直整合与关系契约更可能是替代品——一种形式的投入成本上升会促使企业选择另一种形式来获取资源。不过，垂直整合与关系契约也可能并非完全替代品。不同的交易治理形式可以针对不同的摩擦或交易特征进行匹配。来自集成供应商的竞争可能会打破关系契约，或者集成企业可能无法同时履行关系契约中的承诺并实现目标内部产能的利用。我利用来自一家大型印度服装制造商的织物交易数据，对可替代性进行了测试。我发现可替代性存在强烈证据，通过利用产品层面的外部变量变化来减轻遗漏变量偏差的问题。最后，我讨论了可替代性的政策含义，指出可替代性引发了关系契约可能导致反竞争行为的担忧。第三章研究了质量提升问题，因为许多低收入和中等收入国家将质量提升纳入其发展战略中，以获得出口溢价。在低收入和中等收入国家的供应链中，生产者很少直接向世界市场销售产品，而是通过中间商进行销售。我们研究了中介行为如何影响质量生产和质量投资的激励因素，以乌干达咖啡供应链为例。首先，我们绘制了供应链图，发现咖啡在到达出口商之前平均经过两次交易。接下来，利用高频交易数据，包括实验室质量评估数据，我们表明质量溢价在供应链中逐渐降低。为了解释质量溢价降低的原因，我们构建了一个模型，包含两个关键的经济机制。首先，高质量领域中介行为的进入壁垒导致需求减少，而买方力量增强。其次，生产者和中间商都进行质量投资，这些投资的替代性降低了中间商对高质量上游产品的需求。这两种机制都可以解释质量溢价的降低，但它们对效率和剩余分配的影响各不相同。我们使用一个经过适度调整的模型版本来研究进入壁垒和生产性替代性对效率的影响以及分配后果。

abstract.text: Accessibility to public hospitals in Brazil is a serious problem and there is much to be done to improve the quality of care. The private care system is expensive and only a small percentage of the population can afford health care. The consequence is that most emergency hospitals are constantly overcrowded. Patients must wait to start treatment and delays can lead to an increased risk of sequelae or even represent the difference between life and death. Reducing waiting times for treatment is considered an important measure to control costs and improve service efficiency.
