The objective of this article is to present a method that aims to improve the access and quality of the emergency hospitalization system of a municipal public hospital in the State of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The method is based on the authors' experience in health services operational research and combines the theory of constraints and discrete event simulation. It is hoped that this article will contribute to administrative knowledge and the results can be implemented in other national public hospitals

10.9790/0837-2909041524.abstractZh: 巴西公立医院的可及性是一个严重的问题，需要采取许多措施来提高医疗服务的质量。私立医疗体系费用高昂，只有少数人口能够负担得起医疗服务。因此，大多数急诊医院经常人满为患。患者必须等待才能开始治疗，而治疗时间的延迟可能导致后遗症的风险增加，甚至关系到患者的生死。缩短治疗等待时间被认为是控制成本和提高服务效率的重要措施。本文旨在提出一种方法，以改善巴西里约热内卢州某市公立医院的急诊住院系统的可及性和服务质量。该方法基于作者们在医疗服务运营研究方面的经验，结合了约束理论和离散事件仿真技术。希望本文能为行政知识做出贡献，并且其成果可以应用于其他国家公立医院。

abstract.text: We analyze the effects of a mixed compensation (MC) scheme for specialists on the quality of their healthcare services. We exploit a reform implemented in Quebec (Canada) in 1999. The government introduced a payment mechanism combining a per diem with a reduced fee per clinical service. Using a large patient/physician panel dataset, we estimate a multi-state multi-spell hazard model analogous to a difference-in-differences approach. We compute quality indicators from our model. Our results suggest that the reform reduced the quality of MC specialist services measured by the risk of re-hospitalization and mortality after discharge. These effects vary across specialties.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.04472.abstractZh: 我们分析了针对专业人员的混合补偿方案对医疗服务质量的影响。我们利用了1999年加拿大魁北克实施的一项改革措施。政府引入了一种支付机制，将每日津贴与每次临床服务的费用相结合。通过利用一个包含大量患者与医生的数据集，我们建立了一个多状态、多阶段的危险模型，该模型类似于差异中的差异方法。我们从模型中计算出质量指标。研究结果表明，这项改革降低了专业医疗服务质量，具体表现为患者再次住院的风险和出院后的死亡率。这些影响在不同专业领域中存在差异。

abstract.text: Certificate-of-need (CON) laws require that healthcare providers receive approval from a state board before offering additional services in a given community. Proponents of CON laws claim that these laws are needed to prevent the oversupply of healthcare services in urban areas and to increase access in rural areas, which are predominantly underserved. Yet, the policy could lower rural access if used by incumbents to limit entry from competitors. We explore the repeal of these regulations in five U.S. states to offer the first estimate of the causal effects of CON laws on rural and urban healthcare access. We find that repealing CON laws causes a substantial increase in hospitals in both rural and urban areas. We also find that the repeal leads to fewer beds and smaller hospitals on average, suggesting an increase in entry and competition in both rural and urban areas.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.08168.abstractZh: 需求确认法要求医疗服务提供者必须在获得州委员会批准后才能在特定社区提供额外服务。该法律的支持者认为，这些法律旨在防止城市地区医疗服务供应过剩，并增加主要服务不足的农村地区的医疗服务获取机会。然而，如果现有企业利用这些法规限制竞争对手进入，该政策可能会降低农村地区的医疗服务获取机会。我们研究了美国五个州废除这些法规的情况，首次估算了需求确认法对农村和城市医疗服务获取机会的因果效应。研究发现，废除需求确认法导致农村和城市地区的医院数量显著增加。此外，废除该法规还导致医院床位数量减少，医院规模缩小，这表明农村和城市地区的医疗服务进入和竞争都有所增加。

abstract.text: en anglais] Economics hinges on trade-offs and resource allocation, with Cost-Benefit Analysis serving as a pivotal tool.My research centers on health valuation, addressing the challenge of quantifying non-pecuniary benefits like health and safety.Focusing on France, I aim to provide accurate valuation metrics for policy decision-making.Additionally, I explore the impact of mergers on hospital competition and study energy efficiency policies in housing.Delving into consumer behaviour in the grocery retail sector, I analyze the interplay between price and non-price strategies and their implications for market dynamics.By shedding light into these economic questions, my research contributes to informed policymaking and stakeholder understanding.

https://openalex.org/W4406559468.abstractZh: 经济学依赖于权衡和资源配置，成本效益分析是其中的关键工具。我的研究专注于健康价值评估，致力于量化诸如健康和安全等非货币性利益。以法国为例，我旨在为政策决策提供准确的评估指标。此外，我还探讨了合并对医院竞争的影响，以及住房领域的能源效率政策。在食品零售领域，我分析了价格策略与非价格策略之间的相互作用及其对市场动态的影响。通过对这些经济问题的研究，我的工作有助于促进明智的政策制定，并加深利益相关者的理解。

abstract.text: Chapter one utilizes data from the Mexican Family Life Survey (MxFLS) to conduct an empirical analysis within the framework of the Roy Model, examining whether Mexican emigrants to the United States are positively selected in terms of health. Understanding whether emigrants are favorably self-selected or represent a random sample of Mexico’s population can inform policymakers in shaping labor market and immigration policies that impact both native and non-native workers. By comparing the pre-migration Body Mass Index (BMI) of individuals who migrated to the United States with those who remained in Mexico, this study directly tests for selection. The results indicate that younger, single, and non-overweight individuals are more likely to migrate, as they are better positioned to succeed in the United States labor market and benefit from greater wage differentials. Conversely, the effect of health on migration diminishes for married individuals, with higher capital and social investments in Mexico, coupled with greater migration costs, reducing their incentives to migrate. Chapter two explores the dynamics of weight and wages within Mexico using all three waves of MxFLS data, analyzing how the weight-wage relationship varies across gender, community size, and occupation type. The findings reveal a wage premium for male workers in rural areas and blue-collar jobs, while the weight-wage relationship for females is more complex and mixed. Chapter three introduces a parametric modeling approach based on the asymmetric Laplace distribution of errors and demonstrates the application of Bayesian inference to quantile regression. Using non-informative improper priors with a uniform distribution, values are simulated from the posterior distributions via a random-walk Metropolis-Hastings (MH) algorithm. Applying this methodology to pooled MxFLS data uncovers important features of the wage returns to BMI, particularly for male workers in Mexico, that would otherwise be hidden by traditional mean regression techniques.

https://openalex.org/W7110509043.abstractZh: 第一章利用墨西哥家庭生活调查的数据，在Roy模型的框架内进行实证分析，探讨墨西哥移民到美国的人在健康方面的选择情况。了解这些移民是否出于自身意愿选择迁移，还是代表了墨西哥人口的随机样本，有助于政策制定者在制定影响本地与非本地工人的劳动市场和移民政策时做出决策。通过比较迁移前和迁移后个体的身体质量指数，本研究直接检验了选择效应。结果表明，年轻、单身且体重不超标的人更有可能迁移，因为他们更有可能在美国的劳动力市场中取得成功，并从中获得更高的工资差异。相反，对于已婚人士来说，健康对迁移的影响较小，因为在墨西哥他们拥有更多的资本和社会投资，同时迁移成本也更高，这降低了他们迁移的动机。第二章探讨了利用墨西哥家庭生活调查的三波数据，分析体重与工资之间的关系如何因性别、社区规模和职业类型而异。研究发现，农村地区男性工人享有更高的工资，而女性工人的体重与工资关系则更为复杂。第三章介绍了一种基于不对称拉普拉斯分布误差的参数建模方法，并展示了贝叶斯推断在分位数回归中的应用。使用非信息性不当先验分布和均匀分布，通过随机游走Metropolis-Hastings算法从后验分布中模拟出数值。将这种方法应用于MxFLS数据的汇总分析，可以发现工资与BMI之间关系的重要特征，尤其是墨西哥男性工人的情况，这些特征传统的平均回归技术无法揭示。

abstract.text: This dissertation consists of three essays in econometrics. A common throughline is decision theory, defined here broadly as the formal considerations justifying, informing, or undermining choices of statistical procedures. The first chapter proposes a new interpretation of synthetic control methods as instances of online convex optimization algorithms. Viewed in a certain way, synthetic control methods implement an algorithm called Follow-The-Leader. Mathematical guarantees of Follow-The-Leader then translate into new guarantees for synthetic control. Specifically, over long time horizons, synthetic control methods predict almost as well as the best weighted average of untreated units chosen ex post. The second chapter proposes new empirical Bayes methods that improve statistical decision- making. It shows that conventional empirical Bayes methods embed an assumption called prior independence; this assumption frequently fails to hold; and imposing this assumption incorrectly can harm the performance of standard empirical Bayes methods. Motivated by these observations, the chapter proposes new empirical Bayes methods and proves some new decision-theoretic guarantees. The third chapter is a paper co-authored with Jonathan Roth. Empirical researchers frequently want to estimate some causal effect in terms of the log transformation of their outcome variables. However, when the outcome variable can take the value zero, its log is not well-defined. In such situations, empirical researchers often resort to certain “logarithm-like” transformations that are defined at zero and continue to interpret results as approximate log or percentage effects. We show that such interpretations are inappropriate. We also show that there exists no estimand satisfying certain desirable properties simultaneously, and one has to forgo at least one of these properties.

https://openalex.org/W7112045468.abstractZh: 本论文由三篇计量经济学论文组成。一个贯穿全文的主题是决策理论，这里将其广义定义为为选择统计程序提供理由、提供信息或对其产生影响的正式考虑。第一章提出了对合成控制方法的新解释，将其视为在线凸优化算法的实例。从某种角度来看，合成控制方法实现了一种称为“跟随领导者”的算法。对“跟随领导者”的数学保证可以转化为对合成控制的新保证。具体来说，在长时间范围内，合成控制方法的预测效果几乎与事后选择的最佳加权平均值一样好。第二章提出了新的经验贝叶斯方法，以改进统计决策。研究表明，传统的经验贝叶斯方法包含了一个称为“先验独立性”的假设；这一假设往往不成立；错误地施加这一假设会损害标准经验贝叶斯方法的性能。基于这些观察，该章节提出了新的经验贝叶斯方法，并证明了一些新的决策理论保证。第三章是与Jonathan Roth共同撰写的论文。实证研究人员经常希望根据结果变量的对数变换来估计某种因果效应。然而，当结果变量可以取零值时，其对数并不定义良好。在这种情况下，实证研究人员通常会采用某些在零处定义的“类似对数”的变换，并将结果解释为近似对数或百分比效应。我们表明，这种解释是不恰当的。我们还表明，不存在同时满足某些理想属性的估计量，因此至少必须放弃其中一个属性。

abstract.text: This thesis investigates managerial decision-making within the framework of the inventory management of a multi-establishment firm. Through a combination of descriptive analysis, reduced-form evidence, and structural modelling, the research aims to understand how decisions made by managers at the business unit level can have an impact on the overall performance of a decentralized organization. Specifically, this thesis examines the intricate vertical relationship between local managers and the firm's headquarters in order (1) to understand the impact of manager ability in different organizational structures, and (2) to quantify the impact of a misalignment between the objectives of the firm and the objectives of its managers due to within-firm competition. The findings of the research offer valuable insights into the trade-offs associated with decentralization in large organizations, and provide evidence of the overall impact on the firm's profits from aligning the strategic incentives of managers with its own goals. The first chapter provides a detailed description of the empirical setting studied in this thesis: the Liquor Control Board of Ontario. An overview of the organization's history and its institutional details reveals how the company has become one the largest retailers of beverage alcohol in the world, and how it now operates as a large multi-divisonal organization with a decentralized inventory management structure. A descriptive analysis of the organization's product portfolio decisions -- the process of introducing new products and delisting existing products -- describes the crucial top layer of the inventory management process in the organization, and shows how the company interacts with producers in order to provide consumers with a continuously evolving selection of products. The second chapter, based on joint work with Victor Aguirregabiria, investigates the impact of decentralizing inventory decision-making in multi-establishment firms. The findings show significant heterogeneity among the inventory decisions made by the store managers in the retail chain. Specifically, a dynamic structural model reveals substantial differences in managers’ perceived costs, and a correlation between the variance of these perceptions and the education and professional experience of managers. Counterfactual experiments then show that centralizing inventory management reduces costs by eliminating the impact of managers’ skill heterogeneity. However, these benefits are largely offset by the negative effect of delayed demand information. The third chapter examines how the objectives of managers can be misaligned with the overall objectives of the firm. In particular, the chapter investigates how competitive interactions between store managers in a decentralized retail chain can lead to sub-optimal outcomes from the point of view of the organization. The structural estimation of a game of product assortment decisions shows that store managers do not fully internalize the impact of their inventory decision-making on the overall organization. Findings also reveal that the extent to which store managers behave in their own self-interest is correlated with the size of their store and the number of stores they compete with. Counterfactual experiments then show that this misalignment of objectives implies a substantial loss in profit for the firm, but a negligible effect on consumer welfare. However, enhancing the role of district managers, who are responsible for overseeing store operations within a defined geographic area, can mitigate within-firm competition and provide consumers with greater product variety.

https://openalex.org/W7132870374.abstractZh: 本论文研究了多机构企业库存管理框架下的管理决策制定问题。通过描述性分析、简化形式证据和结构建模的结合，本研究旨在了解业务单元层面的管理者决策如何对分散式组织的整体绩效产生影响。具体而言，本文探讨了当地管理者与公司总部之间复杂的垂直关系，以（1）理解管理者能力在不同组织结构中的影响，以及（2）量化由于公司内部竞争导致公司目标与管理者目标不一致所带来的影响。研究结果表明，关于大型组织中分散化所带来的权衡问题，本论文提供了宝贵的见解，并证明了将管理者的战略激励与公司自身目标相结合，对公司的利润有积极影响。第一章详细描述了本论文研究的实证背景：安大略省酒类管制委员会。对该组织的历史和机构细节的概述揭示了该公司如何成为全球最大的饮料酒精零售商之一，以及它如何作为一个拥有分散式库存管理结构的大型多部门组织运作。对组织产品组合决策的描述性分析——包括引入新产品和退市现有产品的过程——描述了组织库存管理过程中的关键层面，并展示了该公司如何与生产商合作，为消费者提供不断发展的产品选择。第二章基于与Victor Aguirregabiria的联合研究，探讨了在多机构企业中分散库存决策的影响。研究发现，零售链中门店经理做出的库存决策存在显著的异质性。具体而言，动态结构模型显示，管理者对成本的感知存在显著差异，而这些感知的差异与管理者的教育背景和专业经验有关。反事实实验表明，集中库存管理通过消除管理者技能异质性的影响来降低成本。然而，这些好处在很大程度上被延迟需求信息的负面影响所抵消。第三章探讨了管理者的目标如何与企业的整体目标不一致的问题。具体而言，该章节研究了在分散式零售链中，门店经理之间的竞争互动如何导致从组织角度来看的次优结果。产品选择决策博弈的结构性估计表明，门店经理并未完全将库存决策对整体组织的影响内部化。研究还发现，门店经理自利行为的程度与其门店规模以及竞争对手数量有关。反事实实验表明，这种目标不一致会导致企业利润大幅损失，但对消费者福利的影响微乎其微。然而，加强负责监督特定地理区域内门店运营的地区经理的作用，可以缓解企业内部的竞争，并为消费者提供更丰富的产品选择。

abstract.text: The volatility of exchange rates is the source of exchange rate risk and has certain implications on the volume of international trade. Exchange rates influence decisions made by individuals, governments, and businesses. Collectively, this affects economic activity, inflation, and the balance of payments. The study sought to establish the effects of market sentiment, information asymmetry, and economic cycles on exchange rate volatility in Kenya, moderated by the balance payment position. The study was supported by the Purchasing Power Parity Theory. It applied a positivist research philosophy while its research design was correlational. Secondary data on the research variables was collected from the Central Bank of Kenya and Bloomberg for ten years between 2014 and 2023 using monthly data a total of 120 observations. This study used EViews12 to conduct descriptive and inferential statistical analysis. According to the findings of the study, Balance of payment was significant as a moderating variable for all the equations and reduced the effect of the independent variable on the dependent variable thus strengthening the Kenya shilling. All regression models indicate that the dependent variable of exchange rates was significantly affected by information asymmetry, economic cycles, and balance of payment. Inflation was introduced as a control variable and was found to be significant in all models. The study adds to the existing body of knowledge on drivers of exchange rate volatility by providing fresh insights through the focus on the moderating effect of balance of payments. Additionally, the interactions amongst market sentiment, information asymmetry, and economic cycles in one single study are unique in terms of their influence on exchange rate volatility, thereby offering useful references to scholars, professionals, and researchers. The study recommended that the Government needs to come up measures to reduced information asymmetry in the economy and find solution to high net imports by encouraging import substitution. These policies should be cognisant of underlying factors such as information asymmetry, economic cycles, and even balance of payments. Key Terms: Balance of Trade Position, Economic Cycles, Information Asymmetry.

https://openalex.org/W7214810817.abstractZh: 汇率的波动性是汇率风险的来源，并对国际贸易量产生一定影响。汇率影响着个人、政府和企业的决策。总体而言，这会影响经济活动、通货膨胀以及国际收支状况。本研究旨在探讨市场情绪、信息不对称和经济周期对肯尼亚汇率波动性的影响，同时考虑国际收支状况的调节作用。该研究以购买力平价理论为理论支撑，采用实证主义研究方法，其研究设计为相关性分析。关于研究变量的二手数据来自肯尼亚中央银行和彭博社，时间跨度为2014年至2023年的十年间，共收集了120个观测值。本研究使用EViews12软件进行描述性和推断性统计分析。根据研究结果，国际收支状况作为所有方程中的调节变量，显著降低了自变量对因变量的影响，从而增强了肯尼亚先令的购买力。所有回归模型均表明，汇率的因变量受到信息不对称、经济周期和国际收支状况的显著影响。通货膨胀被作为控制变量引入，并在所有模型中被发现具有显著意义。本研究通过关注国际收支状况的调节作用，为现有关于汇率波动性驱动因素的知识体系增添了新的见解。此外，一项研究对市场情绪、信息不对称与经济周期之间的相互作用进行了分析，这些相互作用在影响汇率波动方面具有独特性，为学者、专业人士和研究人员提供了有用的参考。研究建议政府应采取措施减少经济中的信息不对称问题，并通过鼓励进口替代来降低高净进口额。这些政策应考虑到信息不对称、经济周期以及国际收支等潜在因素。关键词：贸易平衡状况、经济周期、信息不对称。

abstract.text: The health care industry in recent times has restructured its service delivery system in order to survive in an enduring atmosphere responding from development of the industry, reduced financing, and increased competition. The restructuring has centered on finding effective ways to satisfy the requirementsand appeals of the cases. This case- centered health care service approach shifts the culture of the health care system from one formed by the preferences and decisions of medical professionals to one shaped by the views and requirements of its users. Consumer satisfaction is a abecedarian demand for health care providers. Satisfaction is important when cases themselves and institutional health care service buyers, make selection judgments. In addition to its positive impact on patient retention and client commitment, patient satisfaction influences the rates of patient compliance with physician advice.

https://openalex.org/W7217722000.abstractZh: 近年来，医疗保健行业为了在持续发展的环境中生存下来，对其服务交付系统进行了重组。这种重组的重点在于找到有效的方法来满足各类患者的需求和期望。这种以患者为中心的医疗保健服务方式，使得医疗保健系统的文化从由医疗专业人员的偏好和决策所塑造，转变为由患者需求和期望所塑造。对于医疗保健提供者来说，患者满意度是基本要求。当患者本身以及医疗机构的服务购买者做出选择时，满意度至关重要。除了对保持患者忠诚度和客户承诺有积极影响外，患者满意度还影响着患者对医生建议的遵守程度。
